But everything is graven in me; especially, for some reason, and apparently forever, I shall remember that unbearably cold floor.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men kecha mening sarguzashtlari bilan bogliq davom etadi. yotishdan oldin shaxsiy soat davomida band edi, va shuning uchun men kecha hamma narsani yozib olmadi. Lekin, ayniqsa, negadir, va abadiy, Men chidab bolmas sovuq zamin eslayman.

paras.en: I was expecting O-90 last evening as it was her regular day. I went downstairs to the controller on duty to get a permit for the lowering of my curtains.
paras.uz: Otgan kecha men O-90 ni kutgan edim, chunki bu uning odatiy kuni edi. Men ozimning pardalarimni almashtirish uchun ruxsat olish uchun menejerga murojaat qildim.

paras.en: “What is the matter with you?” asked the controller. “You seem so peculiar tonight.”
paras.uz: «Sizga nima bo'ldi?» deb so'radi nazoratchi. «Siz bugun kechqurun juda o'zgacha ko'rinasiz».

paras.en: “I⁠ ⁠… I am sick.”
paras.uz: "Men... kasalman."

paras.en: Strictly speaking, I told her the truth. I certainly am sick. All this is an illness. Presently I remembered; of course, my certificate! I touched it in my pocket. Yes, there it was, rustling. Then all this did happen! It did actually happen!
paras.uz: Rostini aytsam, men unga haqiqatni aytdim. Men, albatta, kasalman. Albatta, bularning barchasi eslayman; albatta, mening sertifikatim! Men uni chontagimga urdim. Ha, u erda edi, zanglash.

paras.en: I held out the paper to the controller. As I did so, I felt the blood rushing to my cheeks. Without looking directly at her, I noticed with what an expression of surprise she gazed at me.
paras.uz: Men qogozni nazoratchiga otkazdim. Shunday qilib, men sochlarimga qon tokilayotganini his qildim.

paras.en: Then at twenty-one-thirty o’clock.⁠ ⁠… In the room to the left the curtains were lowered, and in the room to the right my neighbor was sitting over a book. His head is bald and covered with bulging lumps. His forehead is enormous⁠—a yellow parabola. I was walking up and down the room⁠—suffering. How could I meet her, after all that happened! O-90, I mean. I felt plainly to my right, how the eyes of my neighbor were staring at me. I clearly saw the wrinkles on his forehead like a row of yellow, illegible lines; and for some reason I was certain that those lines dealt with me.
paras.uz: Songra yigirma bir ottiz soat ichida.... chapdagi xonada pardalar qisqartirildi va qoshnimning xonasiga bir kitob ustida otirgan edi. Uning boshi juda katta bolib, sargish parabola bilan qoplangan. Men yuqoriga va pastga - azob chekayotgan edim. qanday qilib u bilan uchrashishim mumkin edi! O-90, men ong tomonimni his qildim, qoshnimning kozlari menga qarab turardi. Men uning boynidagi ajinlarni sariq, noqonuniy chiziqlar kabi aniq kordim; va negadir bu chiziqlar men bilan bogliq ekanligiga amin edim.

paras.en: A quarter of an hour before twenty-two, the cheerful, rosy whirlwind was in my room; the firm ring of her rosy arms closed about my neck. Then I felt how that ring grew weaker and weaker, and then it broke and her arms dropped.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yigirma ikki soat oldin, mening xonamda yoqimli, rozet shamoli bor edi; uning pushti qollarining qattiq halqasi boyinimni yopib qoydi. Keyin men bu uzuk qanday qilib zaif va zaif bolib qolganini his qildim va keyin u buzilib ketdi va qollari tushdi.

paras.en: “You are not the same, not the same man! You are no longer mine!”
paras.uz: Сен худо эмассан. Сен Мендан эмассан», деди.

paras.en: “What curious terminology: ‘mine.’ I never belonged⁠—” I faltered. It suddenly occurred to me: true, I belonged to no one before, but now⁠—Is it not clear that now I do not live any more in our rational world but in the ancient delirious world, in a world of square-root of minus one?
paras.uz: Men hech qachon "men ga tegishli bolmaganman - bu menga tosatdan sodir boldi: haqiqatan ham, men ilgari hech kimga tegishli emas edim, lekin hozir men endi bizning ratsional dunyomizda emas, balki qadimgi zerikarli dunyoda, kam sonli kvadrat ildizli dunyoda yashayotganim aniq emasmi?

paras.en: The curtains fell. There to my right my neighbor let his book drop at that moment from the table to the floor. And through the last narrow space between the curtain and the floor I saw a yellow hand pick up the book. Within I felt: “Only to seize that hand with all my power.”
paras.uz: Mening ong qoshnim osha paytda uning kitobini stoldan polga tushishiga ruxsat berdi. Va parda va pol orasidagi oxirgi tor joy orqali men kitobni kordim. "Faqat bu qolni butun kuchim bilan ushlab turish uchun.

paras.en: “I thought⁠ ⁠… I wanted to meet you during the hour for the walk. I wanted⁠ ⁠… I must talk to you about so many things, so many.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men... men siz bilan yurish uchun soat davomida uchrashishni xohlardim. ... men siz bilan juda kop narsalar haqida gaplashishim kerak edi."

paras.en: Poor, dear, O-90. Her rosy mouth was a crescent with its horns downward. But I could not tell her everything, could I, if for no other reason than that it would make her an accomplice of my crimes? I knew that she would not have the courage to report me to the Bureau of Guardians, consequently.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ammo men unga hamma narsani ayta olmayman, agar u mening jinoyatlarimni fosh qilishi mumkin bolsa? Men u meni qoriqchilar byurosiga xabar berishga jurat etmasligini bilardim, shuning uchun ...

paras.en: “My dear O-, I am sick, I am exhausted. I went again today to the Medical Bureau; but it is nothing, it will pass. But let us not talk about it;⁠—let us forget it.”
paras.uz: "Azizim, men kasalman, bugun yana tibbiyot byurosiga bordim; lekin bu hech narsa emas, bu haqda gapirmaslik; - Keling, buni unutamiz.

paras.en: O-90 was lying down. I kissed her gently. I kissed that childish, fluffy fold at her wrist. Her blue eyes were closed. The pink crescent of her lips was slowly blooming, more and more like a flower. I kissed her.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men uni asta-sekin yoqotib qoydim. Uning kok kozlari yopiq edi. Uning lablarining pushti kozlari asta-sekin gullaydi, gulga oxshaydi.

paras.en: Suddenly I clearly realized how empty I was, how I had given away.⁠ ⁠… No, I could not⁠—impossible! I knew I must⁠ ⁠… but no⁠—impossible! I ought⁠ ⁠… but no⁠—impossible! My lips cooled at once. The rosy crescent trembled, darkened, drew together. O-90 covered herself with the bedspread, her face hidden in the pillow.
paras.uz: Tosatdan, men qanday bosh ekanligimni, qanday qilib qoyib yuborganimni aniq angladim.... Yoq, mumkin emas! Men buni bilardim ... lekin mumkin emas!... lekin - yoq! Bir vaqtning ozida lablarim shishib ketdi.

paras.en: I was sitting near the bed, on the floor. What a desperately cold floor! I sat there in silence. The terrible cold from the floor rose higher and higher. There in the blue, silent space among the planets, there probably it is as cold.
paras.uz: Men toshakda yaqin otirgan edi, qavatda. juda sovuq qavatda nima! Men jim otirdi. qavat dan dahshatli sovuq kotarildi yuqori va yuqori. sayyoralar orasida kok, jim bosh joy bor, ehtimol, u sovuq kabi bor.

paras.en: “Please understand, dear; I did not mean⁠ ⁠…” I muttered, “With all my heart, I⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Iltimos, meni tushuning, azizim, men... demoqchi emasman Men: "Butun qalbim bilan, men ..."

paras.en: It was the truth. I, my real self did not mean.⁠—⁠ ⁠… Yet how could I express it in words? How could I explain to her that the piece of iron did not want to.⁠ ⁠… But that the law is precise, inevitable!
paras.uz: Men, mening haqiqiy ozim degani emas edi. - Lekin qanday qilib men buni soz bilan ifodalashim mumkin? - Qanday qilib unga temirning bolagi xohlamaganligini qanday tushuntirib berishim mumkin ... lekin qonun aniq, shubhasiz!

paras.en: O-90 lifted her face from the pillow and without opening her eyes she said, “Go away.” But because she was crying she pronounced it “Oo aaa-ay.” For some reason this absurd detail will not leave my memory.
paras.uz: O-90 uning yuzini yostiqdan kotardi va kozlarini ochmasdan: "Boring dedi. Ammo u yiglayotgani uchun uni "Oo aaa-ay deb talaffuz qildi.

paras.en: Penetrated by the cold and torpid, I went out into the hall. I pressed my forehead against the cold glass. Outside a thin, almost imperceptible film of haze was spread. “Towards night,” I thought, “it will descend again and drown the world. How sad a night it will be!”
paras.uz: Sovuq va torpid tomonidan kirib, men zalga chiqdim. Men sovuq shishaga qarshi qolimni silkitdim. yupqa, deyarli sezilmaydigan film tarqaldi. "Kechasi, men yana tushib, dunyoni boshatadi deb oyladim. Qanday qayguli kecha boladi! "

paras.en: O-90 passed swiftly by, going toward the elevator. The door slammed.
paras.uz: O-90 tez otib, liftga yol oldi.

paras.en: “Wait a minute!” I screamed. I was frightened.
paras.uz: Мен: «Мен қўрқдим.

paras.en: But the elevator was already groaning, going down⁠—down⁠—down.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ammo lift allaqachon goyib boldi, pastga tushdi - pastga tushdi ...

paras.en: “She robbed me of R-, she robbed me of O-90, yet, yet⁠ ⁠… nevertheless.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "U menga R-ni ogirlab ketdi, u menga O-90 ni ogirlab berdi, lekin baribir ..."

paras.en: The bell⁠—The mirror-like sea⁠—I am to burn eternally.
paras.uz: Qo'ng'iroq — Ko'zgudek dengiz — Men abadiy yonaman.

paras.en: I was walking upon the dock where the Integral is being built, when the Second Builder came to meet me. His face as usual was round and white⁠—a porcelain plate. When he speaks it seems as though he serves you a plate of something unbearably tasty.
paras.uz: Men Integral qurilayotgan dok ustida yurgan edim, Ikkinchi quruvchi men bilan uchrashish uchun kelganida. Uning yuzi odatdagidek yumaloq va oq rangda edi.

paras.en: “You chose to be ill, and without the Chief we had an accident, as it were, yesterday.”
paras.uz: "Siz kasal bolishni tanladingiz va boshsiz biz kecha bolgani kabi baxtsiz hodisa sodir boldi."

paras.en: “An accident?”
paras.uz: ― Falokatmi?

paras.en: “Yes, sir. We finished the bell and started to let it down, and imagine! the men caught a male without a number. How he got in, I cannot make out. They took him to the Operation Department. Oh, they’ll draw the mystery out of the fellow there; ‘why’ and ‘how,’ etc.⁠ ⁠…” He smiled delightedly.
paras.uz: Biz qongiroqni tugatdik va uni qoyib yubordik va tasavvur qila boshladik! erkaklar bir kishini raqamsiz ushlab olishdi. Qanday qilib u kirib keldi, men buni qila olmadim.Ular uni operatsiya bolimiga olib borishdi.

paras.en: Our best and most experienced physicians work in the Operation Department under the direct supervision of the Well-Doer himself. They have all kinds of instruments, but the best of all is the Gas Bell. The procedure is taken from an ancient experiment of elementary physics: they used to put a rat under a gas bell and gradually pump out the air; the air becomes more and more rarified, and⁠ ⁠… you know the rest.
paras.uz: Bizning eng yaxshi va eng tajribali shifokorlarimiz Yaxshi-Doerning togridan-togri nazorati ostida operatsiya bolimida ishlaydilar.Ularda asboblarning barcha turlari mavjud, ammo ularning eng yaxshisi gaz qongirogi.Bu usul qadimiy eksperimental fizika tajribasidan olingan: ular gaz qongirogi ostida kalamushlarni qoyib, asta-sekin havoni pompalaydilar; havo tobora keskinlashib boradi va qolganlarini bilasiz.

paras.en: But our Gas Bell is certainly a more perfect apparatus and it is used in combination with different gasses. Furthermore, we don’t torture a defenseless animal as the ancients did; we use it for a higher purpose: to guard the security of the United State, in other words, the happiness of millions. About five centuries ago when the work of the Operation Department was only beginning, there were yet to be found some fools who compared our Operation Department with the ancient Inquisition. But this is as absurd as to compare a surgeon performing a tracheotomy with a highway cutthroat. Both use a knife, perhaps the same kind of a knife, both do the same thing, viz., cut the throat of a living man, yet one is a well-doer, the other is a murderer; one is marked plus, the other minus.⁠ ⁠… All this becomes perfectly clear in one second, in one turn of our logical wheel, the teeth of which engage that minus, turn it upward and thus change its aspect. That other matter is somewhat different; the ring in the door was still oscillating, apparently the door had just closed, yet she, I-330, had disappeared; she was not there! The logical wheel could not turn this fact. A dream? But even now I feel still in my right shoulder that incomprehensible sweet pain of I-330 near me in the fog, pressing herself against me. “Thou lovest fog?” Yes, I love the fog too. I love everything and everything appears to me wonderful, new, tense; everything is so good!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ammo bizning gaz qongirogimiz, albatta, yanada mukammaldir va u turli xil gazlar bilan birgalikda ishlatiladi; biz uni yuqori maqsadlar uchun ishlatmaymiz: bitta davlat xavfsizligini himoya qilish uchun, boshqacha qilib aytganda, millionlab baxt. Besh asr oldin, operatsiya bolimi ishi endigina boshlanganida, qadimgi Induksion bolimimiz bilan taqqoslash uchun hali ham bazi ahmoqlar topildi.Ammo bu yol kesishmasi bilan ishlaydigan jarrohni taqqoslash kabi bemani edi. Bularning barchasi bir soniya ichida aniq boladi, bizning mantiqiy gildirakimizning bir navbatida, tishlarimiz bu minusni ozgartiradi va shu bilan uning jihatini ozgartiradi. Boshqa masala biroz farq qiladi; eshik hali ham yopiq edi, u hali ham yoq edi, lekin u yoq edi! mantiqiy gildirak bu haqiqatni ozgartira olmadi.

paras.en: “So good,” I said aloud.
paras.uz: Мен: «Бу қандай ҳам яхши», деди.

paras.en: “Good?” The porcelain eyes bulged out. “What good do you find in that? If that man without a number contrived to sneak in, it means that there are others around here, everywhere, all the time, here around the Integral, they⁠—”
paras.uz: «Yaxshimi?» Kozlari qizarib ketdi. «Agar bu odam bir raqamsiz yashirinishga moyil bolsa, demak, bu erda hamma joyda, har doim, bu erda integral atrofida boshqalar bor, ular -».

paras.en: “Whom do you mean by ‘they’?”
paras.uz: "Ular deganda kimlarni nazarda tutayapsiz?

paras.en: “How do I know who? But I sense them, all the time.”
paras.uz: "Kimni bilaman, lekin men ularni har doim his qilaman.

paras.en: “Have you heard about the new operation which has been invented? I mean the surgical removal of fancy?” (There really were rumors of late about something of the sort.)
paras.uz: "Siz yangi operatsiya haqida eshitdingizmi? - deb soradim men xijolatdan jarrohlik yoli bilan olib tashlashni nazarda tutyapman (aslida bu turdagi biron bir narsa haqida kech mish-mishlar bor edi).

paras.en: “No, I haven’t. What has that to do with it?”
paras.uz: "Yoq, menda yoq, buning bunga nima aloqasi bor?"

paras.en: “Merely this: if I were you, I should go and ask to have this operation performed upon me.”
paras.uz: Мана шу: «Агар мен сизлар билан бирга бўлганимда, Мен Менга жавоб беришни сўрайман», деди.

paras.en: The plate expressed distinctly something lemon-like, sour. Poor fellow! He took offence if one even hinted that he might possess imagination. Well, a week ago I too should have taken offence at such a hint. Not so now, for I know that I have imagination, that is what my illness consists in, and more than that: I know that it is a wonderful illness⁠—one does not want to be cured, simply does not want to!
paras.uz: Bu plastinka aniq limonga oxshash narsa, nordon edi. Agar u hatto egalik qilishi mumkin bolsa ham, u ozini ozi qabul qildi. Yaxshi, bir hafta oldin men ham bunday tayoqni olishim kerak edi. hozir yoq, chunki men tasavvur qilaman, bu mening kasalligim va bundan ham koproq: Bilaman, bu ajoyib kasallik - uni davolash kerak emas, shunchaki istamaydi!

paras.en: We ascended the glass steps; the world spread itself below us like the palm of a hand.
paras.uz: Biz shisha qadam tashlash; dunyo bir qol kaft kabi bizga pastga tarqaldi.

paras.en: You, readers of these records, whoever you be, you have the sun above you. And if you ever were ill, as I am now, then you know what kind of a sun there is or may be in the morning; you know that pinkish, lucid, warm gold; the air itself looks a little pinkish; everything seems permeated by the tender blood of the sun; everything is alive; the stones seem soft and living; iron living and warm; people all full of life and smiles. It may be that in a short while all this will disappear, that in an hour the pinkish blood of the sun will be drained out, but in the meantime everything is alive. And I see how something flows and pulsates in the sides of the Integral; I see the Integral think of its great and lofty future, of the heavy load of inevitable happiness which it is to carry up there into the heights, to you, unseen ones, to you who seek eternally and who never find. You shall find! You shall be happy! You must be happy, and you have now not very long to wait!
paras.uz: Siz, bu yozuvlarning oquvchilari, kim bolsangiz ham, siz hozir kasal bolsangiz, quyoshning qanday turi borligini bilasiz yoki ertalab bolishi mumkin; siz bilasizki, pushti, porloq, issiq oltin; havo ozi biroz pushti korinadi; hamma narsa tirik; toshlar yumshoq va tirik; temir hayot va iliq; bularning barchasi qisqa vaqt ichida yoq bolib ketishi mumkin, ammo shu bilan birga hamma narsa tirik boladi. Va men uning buyuk va ulugvor kelajagi haqida umumiy tasavvurni koraman, u erda tepaliklarga kotarilish uchun ogir yukning, sizga, cheksiz bolganlarga, abadiy izlaydigan va hech qachon topa olmaydiganlarga. Siz baxtli bolishingiz kerak! Siz baxtli bolishingiz kerak, va endi kutish uchun juda uzoq vaqt yoq!

paras.en: The body of the Integral is almost ready; it is an exquisite, oblong ellipsoid, made of our glass, which is everlasting like gold and flexible like steel. I watched them within, fixing its transverse ribs and its longitudinal stringers; in the stern they were erecting the base of the gigantic motor. Every three seconds the powerful tail of the Integral will eject flame and gasses into the universal space, and the Integral will soar forward and higher⁠—like a flaming Tamerlane of happiness! I watched how the workers, true to the Taylor system, would bend down, then unbend and turn around swiftly and rhythmically like levers of an enormous engine. In their hands they held glittering glass pipes which emitted bluish streaks of flame; the glass walls were being cut into with flame; with flame there were being welded the angles, the ribs, the bars. I watched the monstrous glass cranes easily rolling over the glass rails; like the workers themselves they would obediently turn, bend down and bring their loads inward into the bowels of the Integral. All seemed one, humanized machine and mechanized humans. It was the most magnificent, the most stirring beauty, harmony, music!
paras.uz: Integralning tanasi deyarli tayyor; bu oltin va polat kabi moslashuvchan bolgan shishadan yasalgan yorqin, mort alleloiddir. Men ularni kordim, ozaro qovurgalarini va uzunlamasına chiziqlarni ornatdim; panjarada ular ulkan dvigatelning poydevorini ornatdilar.Integralning har uch soniyada kuchli dumi butun koinotga olov va gaz chiqaradi va oldinga va undan yuqori boladi - qanday qilib ishchilar, Teylor tizimiga togri kelib, egilib, tez va asta-sekin ulkan dvigatelning tutqichlari kabi aylana olishini kordim. Ularning qolida ular shisha quvurlarni ornatdilar; shisha devorlar olov bilan kesilgan edi; olov bilan, qovurgalar, barlar. Men ajoyib shisha kranlarni shisha temir yollar ustida osongina aylanib yurganini kordim; ishchilar ozlari kabi, oz yuklarini integralning bogimlariga osib qoyishadi va olib kelishadi.Bu eng ajoyib, eng chiroyli gozallik, nafislik, musiqa edi!

paras.en: Quick! Down! To them, and with them! And I descended and mingled with them, fused with their mass, caught in the rhythm of steel and glass. Their movements were measured, tense and round. Their cheeks were colored with health, their mirror-like foreheads not clouded by the insanity of thinking. I was floating upon a mirror-like sea. I was reposing.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly one of them turned toward me his carefree face.
paras.uz: Va men ular bilan birga suzib, ular bilan aralashib, ularning massasi bilan toqnashdim, polat va shisha ritmida qolga olindi. Ularning harakatlari olchandi, chozilgan va yumaloq edi. ularning kozlari sogliq bilan bezatilgan edi, kozguga oxshash kozguga oxshash soyalar fikrlash aqldan emas edi. Men qayta-qayta kozguga oxshardim. ... ulardan biri menga bepul yuziga murojaat qildi.

paras.en: “Well, better today?”
paras.uz: "Bugun yaxshiroqmi?"

paras.en: “What better?”
paras.uz: "Nima yaxshiroq?"

paras.en: “You were not here yesterday. And we thought something serious.⁠ ⁠…” His forehead was shining; a childish and innocent smile.
paras.uz: "Siz kecha bu erda bolmagan edingiz. Va biz jiddiy narsa deb oyladik. « Uning boshi qorayib ketdi; bola va begunoh tabassum.

paras.en: My blood rushed to my face. No, I could not lie, facing those eyes. I remained silent; I was drowning.⁠ ⁠… Above, the shiny round white porcelain face appeared in the hatchway.
paras.uz: Yoq, men yolgon gapira olmadim, bu kozlar oldida qoldim. Men sukut saqladim; Yuqorida, qora dumaloq oq yuz shlyapada paydo boldi.

paras.en: “Eh! D-503! Come up here! Something is wrong with a frame and brackets here, and⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Эй Од! Бас, келинглар! Бу ерда жой ва жамият ила жуда ёмон нарса бор.

paras.en: Not waiting until he had finished, I rushed to him, upstairs; I was shamefully saving myself by flight. I had not the power to raise my eyes. I was dazed by the sparkling glass steps under my feet, and with every step I made I felt more and more hopeless. I, a corrupted man, a criminal, was out of place here. No, I shall probably never again be able to fuse myself into this mechanical rhythm, nor to float over this mirror-like, untroubled sea. I am to burn eternally from now on, running from place to place, seeking a nook where I may hide my eyes, eternally, until I.⁠ ⁠… A spark cold as ice pierced me: “I myself, I matter little, but is it necessary that she also⁠ ⁠… ? I must see that she⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Yoq, men hech qachon bu yerda ozimni mexanik ritmga sigdira olmayman yoki kozguga oxshash, muammoga duch kelmayman. Men doimo kozlarimni yumib, doimiy joyga yugurib boraman. Men ozim kabi muz sovuq bolguncha: "Men kichkinaman, lekin u ham kerak ... korishim kerak. "Men ozimni juda yaxshi koraman. "Yoq, men bu erda ozimni tobora koproq va koproq noqulay his qilardim

paras.en: I crawled through the hatchway to the deck and stood there; where was I to go now? I did not know what I had come for! I looked aloft. The midday sun exhausted by its march, was fuming dimly. Below was the Integral, a gray mass of glass⁠—dead. The pink blood was drained out! It was clear to me that all this was my imagination and that everything remained as before, yet it was also clear to me that⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men shkafga otib, u erda turgan edim. Men nima uchun kelganimni bilmas edim. Yarim kunlik quyosh uning yurishidan charchagan edi. Integral, shishaning kulrang massasi - olik edi. pushti qon men uchun bularning barchasi mening tasavvurim bolganligi va hamma narsa avvalgidek qolgani aniq edi, lekin men uchun ham shunday edi ...

paras.en: “What is the matter with you, D-503? Are you deaf? I call you and call.⁠ ⁠… What is the matter with you?” It was the Second Builder yelling directly into my ear; he must have been yelling that way for quite a while.
paras.uz: - Senga nima boldi? - deb soradi u. - Senga nima boldi? - Men seni qongiroq qilaman va qongiroq qilaman. - Bu qulogimga togridan-togri ikkinchi qozgatuvchi edi; u bir muncha vaqt shu yolni bosib otgan bolishi kerak.

paras.en: What was the matter with me? I had lost my rudder, the motor was groaning as before, the aero was quivering and rushing on but it had no rudder. I did not even know where I was rushing, down to the earth or up to the sun, to its flame.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men ozimning rulimni yoqotib qoydim, dvigatel ilgari bolgani kabi goyib boldi, samolyot goyib boldi va chokib ketdi, lekin u hech qanday hukmdor yoq edi.

paras.en: Yellow⁠—A two-dimensional shadow⁠—An incurable soul.
paras.uz: Sariq — Ikki o'lchamli soya — Bedavo ruh.

paras.en: I have not written for several days, for I don’t know how many. All my days are alike. All are of one color⁠—yellow like dry, overheated sand. Not a patch of shade, not a drop of water, only an infinity of yellow sand. I cannot live without her, but she, since she disappeared that day so mysteriously in the Ancient House.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men bir necha kun davomida yozmaganman, chunki qancha odamni bilmayman. Barcha kunlarim oxshash. Barcha kunlar bitta rangda - quruq, haddan tashqari qizib ketgan qum kabi sariq rangga ega. Soyali yamoq emas, suv tomchisi emas, faqat sariq qumning cheksizligi. Men usiz yashay olmayman, lekin u osha kuni qadimgi uyda juda goyib boldi.

paras.en: Since that time I have seen her only once, during the hour for the Walk, two, three, four days ago, I do not remember exactly. All my days are alike. She only passed swiftly by and for a second filled up the yellow, empty world. With her, arm in arm, reaching not higher than her shoulder, were the double-curved S- and the thin papery doctor, and a fourth person whose fingers only I remember well; they streamed out, those fingers, from the sleeve of the unif like a bundle of rays, uncommonly thin, white, long. I-330 raised her hand and waved to me, then she bent toward the one with the ray-like fingers, over the head of S-. I overheard the word Integral. All four turned around to look at me⁠—and then they disappeared in the bluish-gray sea and my road was once more dry and yellow.
paras.uz: Oshandan beri uni faqat bir marta kordim, yurish uchun soat, ikki, uch, tort kun oldin, aniq esimda yoq.U faqat tez otdi va ikkinchi sariq, bosh dunyoni toldirdi. uning qolida qol bilan, uning yelkasidan yuqori emas, ikki egri S edi - va ingichka qogoz shifokor va faqat yaxshi eslayman tortinchi shaxs; ular bir xil barmoqlarni, juda nozik, oq, uzun. Tort kishi meni korish uchun atrofga qarashdi - keyin ular kok-kulrang dengizda goyib bolishdi va mening yolim yana quruq va sariq edi.

paras.en: That same evening she had a pink check on me. I stood before the switchboard and with hatred and tenderness I implored it to click and soon to show the number I-330. I would jump out into the hall at every sound of the elevator. The door of the latter would open heavily. Pale, tall, blonde and dark they would come out of the elevator, and here and there curtains were falling.⁠ ⁠… But she was not there. She did not come. And it is quite possible that now, at this minute, as I write these lines, at twenty-two o’clock exactly, with her eyes closed, she is pressing her shoulder against somebody else in the same way and in the same way she may be asking someone: “Do you love me?” Whom? Who is he? That one with ray-like fingers or that thick-lipped, sprinkling R-? Or S-? S-! Why is it that I have heard his steps splashing behind me as though in a ditch all these days? Why has he been following me all these days like a shadow? Ahead of me, to my side, behind me, a grayish-blue, two-dimensional shadow; people cross it, people step on it but it remains nearby, attached to me by unseen ties. Perhaps that tie is I-330. I do not know. Or perhaps they, the Guardians I mean, already know that I⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Osha kuni kechqurun u menga pushti chek qoydi. Men otish taxtasi oldida turgan edim va nafrat va nafrat bilan uni bostirdim va tez orada I-330 raqamini korsatish uchun uni ochirib tashladim. Ikkinchisining eshigi katta ochiladi.Pale, baland, qorongi va qorongilik ular liftdan chiqib ketishadi va u erda parda tushadi. Nima uchun men bu kunlarda meni soya kabi kuzatib boldi? mendan oldin, mening orqamda, kulrang-kok, ikki olchovli soya; odamlar uni kesib otadi, lekin u menga yaqin bolib qoladi. ehtimol, bu bogliqlik I-330. yoki ular, men bilaman, bilaman ...

paras.en: If someone should tell you your shadow sees you, sees you all the time, would you understand? All at once peculiar sensations arise in you; your arms seem to belong to someone else, they are in the way. That is how I feel; very frequently now I notice how absurdly I wave my hands without any rhythm. I have an irresistible desire to glance behind me but I am unable to do so, my neck might as well be forged of iron. I flee, I run faster and faster, and even with my back I feel that shadow following me as fast as I can run, and there is no place to hide myself, no place!
paras.uz: Agar kimdir sizning soyangizni korsa, sizni har doim koradi, tushunasizmi? Barcha oziga xos his-tuygular bir vaqtning ozida sizda paydo boladi; sizning qollaringiz boshqa birovga tegishli bolib tuyuladi, ular yolda bolib korinadi; Men ozimni qanday his qilayotganimni juda tez-tez koraman; Men qollarimni hech qanday ritmsiz qanday qilib tolqinlantira olaman, lekin men buni qila olmayman, boyinim ham temirdan xalos bolishi mumkin, men tezroq va tezroq yuguraman va hatto orqa tomonimda meni kuzatib turganimni his qilaman.

paras.en: At length I reach my room. Alone at last! But here I find another thing, the telephone. I pick up the receiver. “Yes, I-330 please.” And again I hear a light noise through the receiver; someone’s step in the hall there, passing the door of her room, and⁠—silence.⁠ ⁠… I drop the receiver. I cannot, cannot bear it any longer, and I run to see her!
paras.uz: Nihoyat, men yana bir narsani topdim. Bu erda men qabul qiluvchini qabul qilaman. "Ha, I-330 iltimos qiling Va yana qabul qiluvchi orqali yoruglik ovozini eshitaman; Zalda kimdir qadam, uning xonasi eshigidan otib, sukunat... Men qabul qiluvchini tushira olmayman, uni boshqa kora olmayman va uni korish uchun yuguraman!

paras.en: This happened yesterday. I ran there and for a whole hour from sixteen to seventeen I wandered near the house in which she lives. Numbers were passing by in rows. Thousands of feet were beating the time like a behemoth with a million legs passing by. I was alone, thrown out by a storm on an uninhabited island, and my eyes were seeking and seeking among the grayish-blue waves. “There soon,” I thought, “will appear from somewhere the sharp mocking angles of the brows lifted to the temples, and the dark window-eyes, and there behind them a flaming fireplace and someone’s shadow.⁠ ⁠… And I will rush straight in behind those windows and say to her, ‘Thou’ (yes, ‘thou’ without fail), ‘Thou knowest I cannot live without thee any longer, then why⁠—⁠ ⁠… ?’ ” But silence reigned.
paras.uz: Bu kecha sodir boldi. Men u erda va on oltidan on sakkizgacha bolgan uy yaqinida aylanib yurgan edim.Minglab oyoqlar bir million oyogi otib ketgan behemotga oxshardi. Men yolgiz edim, uysiz oroldagi borondan chiqib ketdim va kozlarim kulrang-kok tolqinlar orasida izlanmoqda deb oyladim. "Osha paytda men "jigarrang qoshlarning otkir masxaralari ibodatxonalarga kotarilgan joydan paydo boladi va qorongu oyna va kimningdir soyasi paydo boladi deb oyladim. «Ammo sukunat hukmronlik qildi.

paras.en: Suddenly I heard the silence; suddenly I heard the Musical Tower silenced, and I understood! It was after seventeen already; everyone had already left. I was alone. It was too late to return home. Around me⁠—a desert made of glass and bathed with yellow sunshine. I saw, as if in water, the reflection of the walls in the glass smoothness of the street, sparkling walls, hanging upside down. Myself also upside down, hanging absurdly in the glass.
paras.uz: Tosatdan men musiqa minorasining sukunatini eshitdim va tushundim! Bu allaqachon bolgan edi. Men uyga qaytish uchun juda kech edim. - shishadan yasalgan chol va sariq quyosh bilan toldirilgan.

paras.en: “I must go at once, this very second, to the Medical Bureau or else⁠ ⁠… or perhaps this would be best: to remain here, to wait quietly until they see me and come and take me into the Operation Department and put an end to everything at once, redeem everything.⁠ ⁠…” A slight rustle! and the double-curved S- was before me. Without looking I felt his two gray steel-drill eyes bore quickly into me. I plucked up all my strength to show a smile and to say (I had to say something), “I, I must go to the Medical Bureau.”
paras.uz: "Men bir vaqtning ozida, bu juda ikkinchi, Tibbiyot byurosiga yoki boshqa... yoki ehtimol bu eng yaxshi bolar edi: bu erda qolish, meni korish va operatsiya bolimiga olib borish va hamma narsani bir vaqtning ozida tugatish uchun. "Bir oz zang!" va ikki egri S - mendan oldin edi. uning ikki kulrang polat burgulash kozlari menga tezda tushib qolganini his qilmasdan, men tabassum korsatish uchun barcha kuchimni yigdim va aytishga majbur boldim, "Men tibbiy byurosiga borishim kerak.

paras.en: “Who is detaining you? What are you standing here for?”
paras.uz: Сизларни ким тутди? Сизга нима бўлди?» деб айт.

paras.en: I was silent, absurdly hanging upside down.
paras.uz: Men sukut saqladim, ahmoqona tarzda pastga tushdim.

paras.en: “Follow me,” said S- austerely.
paras.uz: Сен: «Менга эргашинглар», деди.

paras.en: I followed obediently, waving my unnecessary, foreign arms. I could not raise my eyes. I walked through a strange world turned upside down, where people had their feet pasted to the ceilings, and where engines stood with their bases upward, and where, still lower, the sky merged in the heavy glass of the pavement. I remember what pained me most was the fact that looking at the world for the last time in my life, I should see it upside down rather than in its natural state; but I could not raise my eyes.
paras.uz: Men ozimning keraksiz, begona qollarimni kotarolmadim. Men galati dunyoni aylanib chiqdim, u erda odamlar oyoqlarni shiftga qoyishdi va motorlar yuqoriga kotarilgan joyda va hali ham past bolsa, osmon mening hayotimdagi oxirgi marta dunyoga qarashim qanchalik ogriqli bolganini eslayman; lekin men kozlarimni kotarolmadim.

paras.en: We stopped. Steps. One step⁠ ⁠… and I should see the figures of the doctors in their white aprons and the enormous dumb Bell.
paras.uz: Bir qadam... va men ularning oq kokraklarida shifokorlarning raqamlarini va ulkan qongiroqni korishim kerak.

paras.en: With force, with some sort of an inner screw, at length I succeeded in tearing my eyes away from the glass beneath my feet, and I noticed the golden letters, “Medical Bureau.” Why did he bring me here rather than to the Operation Department? Why did he spare me?⁠—about this I did not even think at that moment. I made one jump over all the steps, firmly closed the door behind me and took a very deep breath, as if I had not breathed since morning and as if my heart had not beaten for the same length of time, as if only now I started to breathe and only now there opened a sluice in my chest.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Kuch bilan, ichki vintning bir turi bilan, uzunligi boyicha kozimni yumib oldim va oltin harflarni kordim, "Tibbiy byuro nima uchun u meni operatsiya bolimiga emas, balki bu erga olib keldi? - Nega u meni osha paytda oylamagan? - Bu haqda men ham oylamagan edim? - Men orqamga bir qadam tashlab qoydim, eshikni mahkam yopib qoydim va xuddi ertalabdan beri nafas olmagan edim va xuddi yuragim xuddi shu vaqt davomida urmagandek, xuddi hozir nafas ola boshlaganim kabi va hozir kokragimdagi bosh joyni ochdim.

paras.en: Inside there were two of them, one a short specimen with heavy legs, his eyes like the horns of a bull tossing the patients up, the other extremely thin with lips like sparkling scissors, a nose like a blade⁠—it was the same man who⁠ ⁠… I ran to him as to a dear friend, straight over close to the blade, and muttered something about insomnia, dreams, shadows, yellow sand. The scissors-lips sparkled and smiled.
paras.uz: Ularning ichida ikkita, ogir oyoqlari bolgan qisqa namunalardan biri, uning kozlari ogir oyoqlarga oxshash, boshqa biri ogiz bilan ogiz bilan juda nozik, pichoq kabi burun - men unga yaqin dost sifatida yugurdim, togridan-togri pichoqqa yaqinlashdim, orzular, soyalar, sariq qum haqida bir narsa.

paras.en: “Yes, it is too bad. Apparently a soul has formed in you.”
paras.uz: Бас, у(Қуръон) ёмондир. Сизлардан бир жон пайдо бўлди.

paras.en: A soul?⁠—that strange ancient word that was forgotten long ago.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uzoq vaqt oldin unutilgan bu galati soz...

paras.en: “Is it⁠ ⁠… v-very dangerous?” I stuttered.
paras.uz: «Bu... juda xavflimi?» Men hayron boldim.

paras.en: “Incurable,” was the cut of the scissors.
paras.uz: «Imkonsiz» qaychilarning kesilishi edi.

paras.en: “But more specifically, what is it? Somehow I cannot imagine⁠—”
paras.uz: "Ammo, aniqrogi, bu nima? qandaydir tarzda men tasavvur qila olmayman

paras.en: “You see⁠ ⁠… how shall I put it? Are you a mathematician?”
paras.uz: - Ko'rdingizmi, men uni qanday qo'yaman? - so'radi u.

paras.en: “Yes.”
paras.uz: У: «Эй Пайғамбар, албатта, Роббинг Ўзининг Пайғамбари.

paras.en: “Then you see⁠ ⁠… imagine a plane, let us say this mirror. You and I are on its surface. You see? there we are, squinting our eyes to protect ourselves from the sunlight, or here is the bluish electric spark in that tube, there the shadow of that aero that just passed. All this is on the surface, is momentary only. Now imagine this very same surface softened by a flame so that nothing can any longer glide over it, so everything instead will penetrate into that mirror world which excites such curiosity in children. I assure you, children are not so foolish as we think they are! The surface becomes a volume, a body, a world; and inside the mirror⁠—within you, there is the sunshine, and the whirlwind caused by the aero propeller, and your trembling lips and someone else’s lips also. You see, the cold mirror reflects, throws out, while this one absorbs; it keeps forever a trace of everything that touches it. Once you saw an imperceptible wrinkle on someone’s face, and this wrinkle is forever preserved within you; you may happen to hear in the silence a drop of water falling⁠—and you will hear it forever!”
paras.uz: “Keyin siz samolyot tasavvur qiling, biz bu kozgudamiz. Siz va men uning yuzasidamiz.Biz quyosh nuridan ozimizni himoya qilish uchun kozimizni yumib turibmizmi yoki bu erda yoruglik elektr uchquni bor, bu erda faqat yuzaga kelgan havo soyasi bor.Endi bu xuddi shu sirtni tasavvur qiling, shunda endi u erda hech narsa korinmaydi, shuning uchun endi hech narsa korinmasa kerak boladi, shuning uchun sizni ishontirib aytamanki, bolalar bunday qiziqish uygotadigan oyna dunyosiga kirib boradi. Korib turganingizdek, sovuq oyna aks ettiradi, bu soriladi; u uni orab turgan har bir narsaning izlarini abadiy saqlaydi. Birovning yuziga chidab bolmas ajinlarni korganingizdan song va bu ajinlar sizning ichingizda abadiy saqlanib qoladi; siz suvning bir tomchi tomchisini eshitishingiz mumkin - va siz buni abadiy eshitasiz! "

paras.en: “Yes, yes, that is it!” I grasped his hand. I could hear drops of water dripping in the silence from the faucet of a washstand and at once I knew it was forever.
paras.uz: "Ha, ha, bu shunday!" Men uning qolidan ushladim. Men yuvinish xonasining kranidan suv tomchilarini eshitdim va bir vaqtning ozida bu abadiy ekanligini bilardim.

paras.en: “But tell me please, why suddenly⁠ ⁠… suddenly a soul? There was none, yet suddenly.⁠ ⁠… Why is it that no one has it, yet I.⁠ ⁠…” I pressed the thin hand; I was afraid to loosen the safety belt.
paras.uz: "Ammo menga ayting, nima uchun tosatdan ruh bor edi? tosatdan hech kim yoq edi, lekin tosatdan ... nega hech kim yoq edi, men hali ham... Men nozik qolimni ushladim; xavfsizlik kamarini yoq qilishdan qorqardim.

paras.en: “Why? Well, why don’t we grow feathers or wings, but only shoulder blades, bases for wings? We have aeros; wings would only be in the way. Wings are needed in order to fly, but we don’t need to fly anywhere. We have arrived at the terminus. We have found what we wanted. Is that not so?”
paras.uz: "Nima uchun biz qanotlar yoki qanotlarni ostira olmaymiz, lekin faqat elka bogimlariga, qanotlariga ega bolamiz? Bizda samolyotlar bor; qanotlari faqat yolda boladi. Qanotlar uchish uchun kerak, lekin biz biron bir joyga uchishimiz shart emas. Biz xohlagan narsani topdik. shunday emasmi?"

paras.en: I nodded vaguely. He glanced at me and laughed a scalpel-like metallic laugh. The other doctor overheard us and stamped out of his room on his heavy legs. He picked up the thin doctor with his horn-eyes, then picked me up.
paras.uz: U menga qarab, bosh suyagiga oxshash kulishni tomosha qildi. Boshqa shifokor bizni eshitdi va ogir oyoqlarida xonasidan chiqib ketdi.U ingichka shifokorni kozlari bilan oldi, keyin meni oldi.

paras.en: “What is the matter, a soul? You say a soul? Oh, damn it! We may soon retrogress even to the cholera epidemics. I told you,” he tossed the thin one on the horns, “I told you the only thing to do is to operate on them all, wholesale! simply extirpate the centre for fancy. Only surgery can help here, only surgery.” He put on a pair of enormous X-ray spectacles and remained thus for a long while, looking into my skull, through the bones into my brain and making notes.
paras.uz: - Nima gap? - deb so'radi u. - Men ham tez orada o'z joniga qasd qilish epidemiyasiga qarshi tura olaman! - dedim men. - Men sizga aytmoqchi bo'lgan yagona narsa - bu ularning hammasi ustida ishlash, xolos. Faqat jarrohlik yordam berishi mumkin, faqat bu yerda operatsiya o'tkazish. - U bir juft katta rentgen nurlarini qo'ydi va shu tariqa uzoq vaqt davomida bosh barmog'imga, miyamga kirib, eslatmalar yasadi.

paras.en: “Very, very curious! Listen.” He looked firmly into my eyes. “Would you not consent to have me perform an extirpation on you? It would be invaluable to the United State; it might help us to prevent an epidemic. If you have no special reasons, of course.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: “Juda qiziq!” U ko'zlarimga diqqat bilan qaradi. “Agar siz meni sizga ekstruktsiya qilishga rozi bo'lmasangiz, bu One State uchun bebaho bo'ladi; bu epidemiyaning oldini olishga yordam beradi. Agar sizda maxsus sabablar bo'lmasa, albatta.”

paras.en: Some time ago I should probably have said without hesitation, “I am willing,” but now⁠—I was silent. I caught the profile of the thin doctor; I implored him!
paras.uz: Bir muncha vaqt oldin, ehtimol, "Men tayyorman deb aytmagan bolardim, lekin hozir sukut saqladim. nozik shifokorning profilini oldim; Men uni haqorat qildim!

paras.en: “You see,” he said at last, “Number D-530 is building the Integral and I am sure the operation would interfere.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Koryapsizmi, - dedi u nihoyat, - D-530 raqami integralni qurmoqda va operatsiya xalaqit berishiga aminman."

paras.en: “Ah-h!” grumbled the other and stamped back into his room.
paras.uz: «Oh!» ikkinchisini tortib olib, xonasiga qaytib kirdi.

paras.en: We remained alone. The paper-like hand was put lightly and caressingly upon mine, the profile-like face came nearer and he said in a very low voice: “I shall tell you a secret. You are not the only one. My colleague is right when he speaks of an epidemic. Try to remember, have you not noticed yourself, someone with something similar, very similar, identical?”
paras.uz: Biz yolgiz qoldik. Qogozga oxshash qol menga engil va ehtiyotkorlik bilan qoyildi, profilga oxshash yuz yaqinroq keldi va u juda past ovozda shunday dedi: "Men sizga bir sirni aytaman.Siz yolgiz emassiz. Mening hamkasbim epidemiya haqida gapirganda togri.Ozingizni eslashga harakat qiling, ozingizga oxshash, juda oxshash, oxshash narsa bolgan odamni payqamadingizmi? "

paras.en: He looked at me closely. What was he alluding to? To whom?⁠ ⁠… Is it possible?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U menga diqqat bilan qarab turardi. - Kim uchun bu mumkin?

paras.en: “Listen,” I jumped up from my seat. But he had already changed the subject. In a loud metallic tone:
paras.uz: Men oz orindigimdan kotarildim. Lekin u mavzuni allaqachon ozgartirgan edi.

paras.en: “… As to the insomnia and for the dreams you complain of, I advise you to walk a great deal. Tomorrow morning you must begin taking long walks⁠ ⁠… say as far as the Ancient House.”
paras.uz: "Siz shikoyat qilgan baxtsizliklar va orzularga kelsak, men sizga juda kop yurishingizni maslahat beraman. ertaga siz uzoq yurishdan boshlashingiz kerak ... qadimgi uy kabi. "

paras.en: Again he pierced me with his eyes and he smiled thinly. It seemed to me that I saw enveloped in the tender tissue of that smile a word, a letter, a name, the only name.⁠ ⁠… Or was it only my imagination? I waited impatiently while he wrote a certificate of illness for today and tomorrow. Once more I gently and firmly pressed his hand, then I ran out.
paras.uz: U yana meni kozlari bilan uygotdi va u sekin tabassum qildi. Menga bu soz, harf, ism, yagona ismning yumshoq toqimalariga oralganini kordim. Yoki bu mening tasavvurim edimi? U bugun va ertaga kasallik togrisida guvohnoma yozganida, men yana bir bor xotirjam va qatiy qolini oldim, keyin men qochib ketdim.

paras.en: My heart now feels light and swift like an aero; it carries me higher and higher.⁠ ⁠… I know joy will come tomorrow. What joy?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Endi yuragim yengil va tez havo kabi his qiladi; bu meni yuqoriga va yuqoriga olib keladi ... bilaman, quvonch ertaga keladi.

paras.en: Through glass⁠—I died⁠—The corridor.
paras.uz: Shisha orqali — Men o'ldim — Yo'lak.

paras.en: I am puzzled. Yesterday, at the very moment when I thought everything was untangled, and that all the X’s were at last found, new unknowns appeared in my equation. The origin of the coordinates of the whole story is of course the Ancient Home. From this centre the axes of all the X’s, Y’s, and Z’s radiate, and recently they have entered into the formation of my whole life.
paras.uz: Kecha, men hamma narsa notogri deb oyladim va nihoyat X ning barcha topilgan paytda, mening tenglamamda yangi nomalumlar paydo boldi. butun hikoyaning koordinatalarining kelib chiqishi, albatta, qadimgi uydir. bu markazdan barcha Xs, Ys va Zs radiatsiyasining oqlari va ular yaqinda mening butun hayotimning shakllanishiga kirishdilar.

paras.en: I walked along the X-axis (Avenue 59) towards the centre. The whirlwind of yesterday still raged within me; houses and people upside down; my own hands torturingly foreign to me; glimmering scissors; the sharp sound of drops dripping from the faucet;⁠—all this existed, all this existed once! All these things were revolving wildly, tearing my flesh, rotating wildly beneath the molten surface, there where the “soul” is located.
paras.uz: Men X-oqi boylab (Avenyu 59) markazga bordim.Kechagi shamol hali ham ichimda gazablandi; uylar va odamlar pastga qarab ketishdi; oz qollarim menga qattiq begona; gimnaziya qaychi; otkir tomchilarning otkir ovozi krandan otilib chiqdi; - bularning barchasi bir marta mavjud edi! - bularning barchasi mening goshtimni yirtib tashladi, eritilgan sirt ostiga singib ketdi, u erda "ruh joylashgan.

paras.en: In order to follow the instructions of the doctor I chose the road which followed not the hypotenuse but the two legs of a triangle. Soon I reached the road running along the Green Wall. From beyond the Wall, from the infinite ocean of green there rose toward me an immense wave of roots, branches, flowers, leaves. It rose higher and higher; it seemed as though it would splash over me and that from a man, from the finest and most precise mechanism which I am, I would be transformed into.⁠ ⁠… But fortunately there was the Green Wall between me and that wild green sea. Oh, how great and divinely limiting is the wisdom of walls and bars! This Green Wall is I think the greatest invention ever conceived. Man ceased to be a wild animal the day he built the first wall; man ceased to be a wild man only on the day when the Green Wall was completed, when by this wall we isolated our machine-like, perfect world from the irrational, ugly world of trees, birds and beasts.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tez orada men yashil devor boylab ishlaydigan yolni tanladim.U erda cheksiz yashil okeandan menga katta ildizlar tolqini, novdalar, gullar, barglar kotarildi; u menga va eng aniq mexanizmdan, men ozimni ozgartirgan odamga oxshardi ... lekin men va yovvoyi yashil dengiz ortasida yashil devor bor edi. Inson birinchi devorni qurgan kuni yovvoyi hayvon bolishni toxtatdi; odam faqat Yashil devor tugagan kuni yovvoyi odam bolishni toxtatdi, bu devor bilan biz oz mashinamizga oxshash, mukammal dunyomizni daraxtlar, qushlar va hayvonlar dunyosidan ajratdik.

paras.en: The blunt snout of some unknown beast was to be seen dimly through the glass of the Wall; its yellow eyes kept repeating the same thought which remained incomprehensible to me. We looked into each other’s eyes for a long while. Eyes are shafts which lead from the superficial world into a world which is beneath the surface. A thought awoke in me: “what if that yellow-eyed one, sitting there on that absurd dirty heap of leaves, is happier than I, in his life which cannot be calculated in figures!” I waved my hand. The yellow eyes twinkled, moved back and disappeared in the foliage. What a pitiful being! How absurd the idea that he might be happier! Happier than I he may be, but I am an exception, am I not? I am sick.
paras.uz: Bazi nomalum hayvonning dahshatli zarbasi devor oynasi orqali xira korinishi kerak edi; uning sariq kozlari uzoq vaqt davomida bir-birining koziga qarab turdi.Kozlar - bu gayritabiiy dunyodan sirt ostida bolgan dunyoga olib boradigan millar. "Agar osha sariq kozli koz menda paydo bolgan bolsa, men u erda otirgan bolsam, u mening qolimdan koproq baxtli bolsa nima boladi!" Men qolimni boglab qoydim, sariq kozlarim orqaga qaytib, barglarda goyib boldim.

paras.en: I noticed that I was approaching the dark red walls of the Ancient House and I saw the grown-together lips of the old woman. I ran to her with all speed.
paras.uz: Men eski uyning qorongi qizil devorlariga yaqinlashib kelayotganimni payqadim va keksa ayolning birga osgan lablarini kordim.

paras.en: “Is she here?”
paras.uz: "U shu yerdami?" deb soradi.

paras.en: The grown-together lips opened slowly:
paras.uz: Osib-ulgaygan ogiz asta-sekin ochildi:

paras.en: “Who is ‘she’?”
paras.uz: "U kim?

paras.en: “Who? I-330, of course. You remember we came together, she and I, in an aero the other day.”
paras.uz: “Kim? Men-330, albatta, siz bilan birga, u va men, boshqa kuni havoda birga yigilganimizni eslaysiz”.

paras.en: “Oh, yes, yes, yes⁠—yes.”
paras.uz: "Ha, ha, ha, - deb javob berdi u.

paras.en: Ray-wrinkles around the lips, artful rays radiating from the eyes. They were making their way deeper and deeper into me.
paras.uz: Koz atrofidagi nurlar, yorqin nurlar menga chuqurroq va chuqurroq kirib bordi.

paras.en: “Well, she is here, all right. Came in a while ago.”
paras.uz: "Xosh, u keldi, yaxshi, yaxshi. bir muncha vaqt oldin keldi.

paras.en: “Here!” I noticed at the feet of the old woman a bush of silver⁠—bitter wormwood. (The court of the Ancient House, being a part of the museum is carefully kept in its prehistoric state.) A branch of the bush touched the old woman, she caressed that branch; upon her knees lay stripes of sunshine. For a second I myself, the sun, the old woman, the wormwood, those yellow eyes, all seemed to be one; we were firmly united by common veins and one common blood, boisterous, magnificent blood, was running through those veins.
paras.uz: "Bu yerda!" Men keksa ayolning oyoqlarida kumush butasini payqadim - achchiq qurtlar. (Qadimgi uyning sudi, muzeyning bir qismi ehtiyotkorlik bilan saqlanadi).) Eski ayolning boyniga tegib, u bu novdaga gamxorlik qildi; uning oyoqlarida ozim, quyosh, eski ayol, qurt, sariq kozlar uchun bularning barchasi bitta bolib tuyuldi; biz keng tarqalgan tomirlar va bitta umumiy qon, bogimli, ajoyib qon bilan qatiyatli edik, bu tomirlardan otdik.

paras.en: I am ashamed now to write down all this, but I promised to be frank to the end of these records: yes, I bent over and kissed that soft, grown-together mouth of the old woman. She wiped it with her hand and laughed.
paras.uz: Men hozir bularning barchasini yozishga uyaldim, lekin men ushbu yozuvlarning oxiriga ochiq bolishga vada berdim: ha, men eski ayolning yumshoq, birgalikda osgan ogzini kesib tashladim.

paras.en: Running, I passed through familiar, half-dark, echoing rooms, and for some reason I ran straight to the bedroom. When I had reached the door, a thought flashed: “And if she is there⁠ ⁠… not alone?” I stopped and listened. But all I heard was the tick-tock of my heart, not within me, but somewhere near, outside me.
paras.uz: Yugurish, men tanish, yarim qorongi, etirozli xonalar orqali otdim va bazi sabablarga kora togridan-togri yotoqxonaga yugurdim. Eshik oldiga kelganimda, bir fikr yonib ketdi: "Agar u yolgiz bolsa?" Men toxtadim va tingladim.

paras.en: I entered. The large bed⁠—untouched. A mirror⁠ ⁠… another mirror in the door of the cupboard, and in the keyhole an ancient key upon an ancient ring. No one was there. I called softly: “I-330, are you here?”⁠—and then in a still lower voice with closed eyes, holding my breath⁠—in a voice as though I were kneeling before her, “I-, dear.” Silence. Only the water was dripping fast into the white basin of the washstand. I cannot now explain why, but I disliked that sound. I turned the faucet hard and went out. She was not there, so much was clear. She must be in another “apartment.”
paras.uz: Men ichkariga kirdim. Katta toshak - sensorli bolmagan. U erda yana bir oyna va eski halqaning eski kaliti bor edi. Men u erda hech kim yoq edi: "I-330, siz shu yerdamisiz?" va keyin hali ham yopiq kozlar bilan pastki ovozda - xuddi men uning oldida tiz chokkandek, "Men, azizim ovozini ushlab turdim.

paras.en: I ran down a wide, sombre stairway, pulled one door, another, a third⁠—locked. Every room was locked save that of “our” apartment. And she was not there. I went back again to the same apartment without knowing why. I walked slowly, with difficulty; my shoe-soles suddenly became as heavy as cast-iron. I remember distinctly my thought, “It is a mistake that the force of gravity is a constant; consequently all my formulae.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Men keng, sorbentli zinapoyadan yugurib chiqdim, bitta eshikni, boshqasini, uchinchisini qulfladim. Har bir xona "bizning kvartiramiz ni saqlab qoldi.Va u erda yoq edi.Men sekin yurib, qiyinchilik bilan qaytdim; mening poyabzalim tosatdan quyma temir kabi ogir boldi. "Bu tortishish kuchi doimiy ekanligini aniq eslayman; shuning uchun mening barcha formulam ..."

paras.en: Suddenly⁠—an explosion! A door slammed down below; someone stamped quickly over the flagstones. I again became lightfooted, extremely light! I dashed to the railing to bend over, and in one word, one exclamation, expressed everything: “You!”
paras.uz: Tosatdan - portlash! eshik pastga tushdi; kimdir tezda bayroq toshlari ustidan otib ketdi. Men yana yengil tortdim, juda yoruglik! Men bir soz bilan aytganda, hamma narsani aytdi: "Siz!"

paras.en: I became cold. Below in the square shadow of the window-frame, flapping its pink wing-ears, the head of S- passed by!
paras.uz: Men sovuq boldim. deraza ramkasining kvadrat soyasi ostida, pushti qanotlarini orab, S - boshi otib ketdi!

paras.en: Like lightning I saw only the naked conclusion. Without any premises (I don’t recall any premises even now) the conclusion: he must not see me here! And on the tips of my toes, pressing myself against the wall, I sneaked upstairs into the unlocked apartment.
paras.uz: Men faqat yalangoch xulosani kordim. hech qanday binosiz (hozir ham biron bir bino esimda yoq) xulosa: u meni bu erda kormasligi kerak! Va mening oyoq barmoqlarim boyicha devorga qarshi turib, men bosh kvartiraga kotarildim.

paras.en: I stopped for a second at the door. He was stamping upward, here. If only the door.⁠ ⁠… I prayed to the door but it was a wooden one⁠—It squeaked, it squealed. Like a wind something red passed my eyes, something green, and the yellow Buddha. In front of the mirror-door of the cupboard, my pale face; my ears still following those steps, my lips.⁠ ⁠… Now he was already passing the green and yellow, now he was passing Buddha, now at the doorsill of the bedroom.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men eshik oldida bir soniya uchun toxtadi. faqat eshik, bu erda ibodat, lekin u yogoch biri edi - u chayqalib ketdi. shamol bir narsa qizil kozimni otdi kabi, yashil narsa, va sariq Budda. oyna-eshik oldida, mening quloqlar hali ham bu qadamlar quyidagi, mening lablari.... Endi u allaqachon yashil va sariq otib edi, endi u budda, endi yotoqxonaning eshik oldida.

paras.en: I grasped the key of the cupboard; the ring oscillated. This oscillation reminded me of something. Again a conclusion, a naked conclusion without premises; a conclusion, or to be more exact, a fragment of one: “Now I-330 is.⁠ ⁠…” I brusquely opened the cupboard and when inside in the darkness shut the door firmly. One step! The floor shook under my feet. Slowly and softly I floated somewhere downward; my eyes were dimmed⁠—I died!
paras.uz: Men qongiroqning kalitini tushundim; uzuk osildi. Yana bir bor, binosiz yalangoch xulosa; binosiz xulosa yoki aniqroq bolish uchun: "Endi men-330 - bu ..." Men eshikni mahkam yopib qoyganimda va qorongilik ichida boldim.Bir qadam oyogim ostidagi pol asta-sekin va muloyimlik bilan bir joyga chozilib ketdi; kozlarim xiralashdi - men oldim!

paras.en: Later when I sat down to describe all these adventures, I sought in my memory and consulted some books; and now I understand, of course! I was in a state of temporary death. This state was known to the ancients, but as far as I am informed it is unknown to us. I have no conception of how long I was dead, probably not longer than five or ten seconds, but after awhile I arose from the dead and opened my eyes. It was dark. But I felt I was falling down⁠—down⁠—down. I stretched out my hand to attach myself to something but the rough wall scratched my fingers; it was running away from me, upward. I felt blood on my fingers. It was clear that all this was not merely a play of my sick imagination. But what was it? What?
paras.uz: Keyinchalik bu voqealarni tasvirlash uchun otirganimda, xotiramda bazi kitoblarni soradim va endi tushundim! Bu holat qadimgilarga malum edi, lekin menga nomalum bolgani kabi, men qancha vaqt olganim haqida hech qanday malumotga ega emasman, ehtimol besh yoki on soniyadan koproq emas, lekin bir muncha vaqt otgach, men qorongi va qorongi kozlarimni ochganimdan keyin.

paras.en: I heard my own frequent, trembling breaths. (I am not ashamed to confess this, it was all unexpected and incomprehensible.) A minute, two, three passed; I was still going down. Then a soft bump. The thing that had been falling away from under my feet was motionless. I found in the darkness a knob, and turned it; a door opened; there was a dim light. I now noticed behind me a square platform, travelling upward. I tried to run back to it but it was too late. “I am cut off here,” I thought. Where “here” might be, I did not know.
paras.uz: Men ozimning tez-tez, qorqinchli nafasimni eshitdim. (buni tan olishdan xafa emasman, hammasi kutilmagan va galati edi.) Bir daqiqa, ikki, uch otib, men hali ham pastga tushayotgandim.Songra yumshoq zarba boldi.Songra oyogim ostidan tushgan narsa harakatsiz edi. qorongilikda topdim va uni ozgartirdim; eshik ochildi; endi men orqamga bir kvadrat platformani kordim, yuqoriga qarab yugurdim, lekin bu juda kech edi. "Men bu erda bolaman deb oyladim.

paras.en: A corridor. A heavy silence. The small lamps on the vaulted ceiling resembled an endless, twinkling, dotted line. The corridor was similar to the “tube” of our underground railways but it was much narrower, and made not of our glass but of some other, very ancient material. For a moment I thought of the underground caves where they say many tried to save themselves during the Two Hundred Years’ War. There was nothing to do but to walk ahead.
paras.uz: Yolak ogir sukunat. Oralgan shiftdagi kichik chiroqlar cheksiz, egizak, nuqta chizigiga oxshardi.Yolak er osti temir yollarining "tubi ga oxshardi, lekin u bizning shishamizdan emas, balki boshqa bazi juda qadimiy materiallardan tayyorlangan edi.

paras.en: I walked, I think, for about twenty minutes. A turn to the right, the corridor became wider, the small lamps brighter. There was a dim droning somewhere.⁠ ⁠… Was it a machine or voices? I did not know. I stood before a heavy, opaque door, from behind which came the noise. I knocked. Then I knocked again, louder. Now there was silence behind the door. Something clanked; the door opened slowly and heavily.
paras.uz: Ong tomonga burilish, yolak kengroq boldi, kichik lampalar. ... Bu erda burgulash bor edi. ... bu mashina yoki ovoz bormi? bilmadim.Men ogir, galati eshik oldida turdim, orqa tomondan shovqin keldi. Keyin men yana taqillatdim, balandroq.Endi eshik ortida sukunat bor edi. eshik ortida bir narsa sekin va qattiq ochildi.

paras.en: I don’t know which of us was the more dumbfounded; the thin blade-like doctor stood before me!
paras.uz: Qaysi birimiz ahmoqroq ekanligimizni bilmayman; nozik pichoqqa oxshash shifokor mendan oldinda edi!

paras.en: “You here!” his scissors opened and remained open.
paras.uz: «Siz bu erdasiz!» Uning qaychilari ochildi va ochildi.

paras.en: And I, as if I did not know a human word, stood silent, merely stared, without comprehending that he was talking to me. He must have told me to leave, for with his thin paper stomach he slowly pressed me to the side, to the more brightly lighted end of the corridor and poked me in the back.
paras.uz: Va men inson sozini bilmagandek, jim turib, men bilan gaplashayotganini tushunmasdan turib, jim turdim. U meni tark etishimni aytishi kerak edi, chunki ingichka qogoz oshqozoni meni asta-sekin yon tomonga, yolakning yanada yorqinroq oxiriga olib bordi va meni orqa tomonga tortdi.

paras.en: “Beg your pardon⁠ ⁠… I wanted⁠ ⁠… I thought that she, I-330⁠ ⁠… but behind me.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Kechirasiz, men uni xohlagan edim, lekin u meni qollab-quvvatladi ..."

paras.en: “Stay where you are,” said the doctor brusquely, and he disappeared.
paras.uz: "Siz qaerda bolsangiz ham turing," dedi shifokor shafqatsiz tarzda va u yoqoldi.

paras.en: At last! At last she was nearby, here, and what did it matter where “here” was? I saw the familiar saffron-yellow silk, the smile-bite, the eyes with their curtains drawn.⁠ ⁠… My lips quivered, so did my hands and knees, and I had a most stupid thought: “Vibrations make sounds. Shivering must make a sound. Why then don’t I hear it?”
paras.uz: Nihoyat! Nihoyat, u yaqin edi, bu erda va u qaerda edi? men tanish safron-safar ipak kordim, tabassum-bit, ularning parda bilan kozlari chizilgan.... Mening lablari chiqib ketdi, shuning uchun mening qollari va tizzalar, va men eng ahmoqona fikr bor edi: "Vibrations ovoz qilish kerak.

paras.en: Her eyes opened for me widely. I entered into them.
paras.uz: Uning kozlari men uchun keng ochildi, men ularga kirdim.

paras.en: “I could not⁠ ⁠… any longer!⁠ ⁠… Where have you been?⁠ ⁠… Why?⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men endi qila olmayman ... endi siz qaerdasiz?"

paras.en: I was unable to tear my eyes away from her for a second, and I talked as if in a delirium, fast and incoherently, or perhaps I only thought without speaking out: “A shadow⁠ ⁠… behind me. I died. And from the cupboard.⁠ ⁠… Because that doctor of yours⁠ ⁠… speaks with his scissors.⁠ ⁠… I have a soul⁠ ⁠… incurable⁠ ⁠… and I must walk.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Men undan bir soniya kozimni uzolmay qoldim va men deurium, tez va noaniq nutq sozladim yoki shunchaki shunday deb oyladim: "Men soya ortida oldim. ... va sizning bosh barmogingiz shifokori uning qaychilari bilan gaplashadi ... menda aql bovar qilmaydigan... va men yurishim kerak."

paras.en: “An incurable soul? My poor boy!” I-330 laughed. She covered me with the sparkles of her laughter; my delirium left me. Everywhere around her little laughs were sparkling! How good it was!
paras.uz: «Mening kambagal oglim!» I-330 kulib. U meni uning kulgisi bilan qamrab oldi; Mening delirium meni tark etdi. uning kichik kulishlari atrofida bolgan joylar juda yaxshi edi!

paras.en: The doctor reappeared from around the turn, the wonderful, magnificent, thinnest doctor.
paras.uz: Shifokor oz-ozidan, ajoyib, nozik shifokor atrofida aylanib chiqdi.

paras.en: “Well?” He was already beside her.
paras.uz: U allaqachon uning yonida edi.

paras.en: “Oh, nothing, nothing. I shall tell you later. He got here by accident. Tell them that I shall be back in about a quarter of an hour.”
paras.uz: Бас, Мен сенга, албатта, ундан кейин ҳам айтаман. Сен: «Мен бир-биримдан кейин қайтаман», деб айт.

paras.en: The doctor slid around the corner. She lingered. The door closed with a heavy thud. Then slowly, very slowly, piercing my heart with a sharp sweet needle, I-330 pressed against me with her shoulder and then with her arm, with her whole body, and we walked away as if fused into one.
paras.uz: Keyin sekin, juda sekin, juda sekin, otkir shirin igna bilan yuragimni toldirdi, I-330 elkasi bilan, keyin qoli bilan, butun tanasi bilan menga qarshi chiqdi va biz bir-biriga yopishib qolgandek yurib ketdik.

paras.en: I do not remember now where we turned into darkness; in the darkness we walked up some endless stairway in silence. I did not see but I knew, I knew that she walked as I did, with closed eyes, blind, her head thrown a little backward, biting her lips and listening to the music, that is to say, to my almost audible tremor.
paras.uz: Men hozir qorongilikka aylanganimizni eslay olmayman; zulmatda biz sukunatda bazi cheksiz zinapoyaga chiqdik. Men kormadim, lekin u men kabi yurganini, yopiq kozlari, kozi bilan, boshini biroz orqaga tashlab, lablarini tishlab, musiqani tinglashini bilardim.

paras.en: I returned to consciousness in one of the innumerable nooks in the courtyard of the Ancient House. There was a fence of earth with naked stone ribs and yellow teeth of walls half fallen to pieces. She opened her eyes and said, “Day-after-tomorrow at sixteen.” She was gone.
paras.uz: Men qadimiy uyning hovlisidagi yalangoch tugunlardan birida vijdonga qaytdim. yalangoch tosh qovurga va yarim devorning sariq tishlari bolgan er devori bor edi.

paras.en: Did all this really happen? I do not know. I shall learn day-after-tomorrow. One real sign remains: on my right hand the skin has been rubbed from the tips of three fingers. But today, on the Integral the Second Builder assured me that he saw me touch the polishing wheel with those very same fingers. Perhaps I did. It is quite probable. I don’t know. I don’t know anything.
paras.uz: Bularning barchasi haqiqatan ham sodir boldimi? Men kundan-kunga organaman.Bir haqiqiy belgi qoladi: mening ong qolimda teri uchta barmoqning uchi bilan oralgan.Ammo bugungi kunda, Integral Ikkinchi quruvchi menga xuddi shu barmoqlar bilan gildirakni tegib turganimni kordi. Ehtimol, bu juda yaxshi. Men hech narsani bilmayman.

paras.en: Logical debris⁠—Wounds and plaster⁠—Never again.
paras.uz: Mantiq vayronalari — Yaralar va malham — Endi hech qachon.

paras.en: Last night as soon as I had gone to bed, I fell momentarily to the bottom of the ocean of sleep like an overloaded ship which has been wrecked. The heavy thicket of wavy green water enveloped me. Then slowly I floated from the bottom upward, and somewhere in the middle of that course, I opened my eyes⁠—my room! The morning was still green and motionless. A fragment of sunshine coming from the mirror on my closet door shone into my eyes. This fragment does not permit me to sleep, being thus an obstacle in the way of exactly fulfilling the rules of the Tables which prescribe so many hours of sleep. I should have opened the closet but I felt as though I were in a spider web, and cobweb covered my eyes; I had no power to sit up.
paras.uz: Men uxlab yotganimda, uxlab yotganimda, men haddan tashqari kotarilgan kema kabi bir vaqtning ozida uyqu okeaniga tushib qoldim.Songra tolqinli yashil suvning ogir qalinligi meni qamrab oldi. Keyin asta-sekin yuqoriga va osha kursning ortasida men kozlarimni ochdim - ertalab hali ham yashil va harakatsiz edim.

paras.en: Yet I got up and opened the closet door; suddenly, there behind that door, making her way through the mass of garments which hung there, was I-330! I have become so accustomed of late to most improbable things, that as far as I remember I was not even surprised; I did not even ask a question. I jumped into the closet, slammed the mirror-door behind me and breathlessly, brusquely, blindly, avidly I clung to her. I remember clearly even now:⁠—through the narrow crack of the door a sharp sun-ray like lightning broke into the darkness and played on the floor and walls of the closet, and a little higher the cruel ray-blade fell upon the naked neck of I-330, and this for some reason seemed to me so terrible that I could not bear it, and I screamed;⁠—and again I opened my eyes. My room!
paras.uz: Ammo men osha eshikning orqasida turib, u erda osha eshikni ochdim va u erda osilgan kiyimlarning ommaviyligini ochib, men eng imkonsiz narsalarga shunchalik berilib ketdimki, hatto men ham hayron bolmadim; men hatto savol bermaganman; Men shkafga tushib qoldim, orqamda oyna eshigidan pastga tushdim, shafqatsiz, shafqatsiz, hozir ham unga yopishib oldim. - Men qorongilik va devorda oynagan kabi otkir quyosh nurlarining tor tomi orqali, va bazi sabablarga kora, men uni kotarolmadim va yana kozimni ochdim. Mening xonam!

paras.en: The morning was still green and motionless. On the door of my closet was a fragment of the sunshine. I was in bed. A dream? Yet my heart was still wildly beating, quivering and twitching; there was a dull pain in the tips of my fingers and in my knees. This undoubtedly did happen! And now I am unable any more to distinguish what is dream from what is actuality; irrational numbers grow through my solid, habitual, tri-dimensional life; and instead of firm, polished surfaces⁠—there is something shaggy and rough.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Mening shkafimning eshigida hali ham toshakda yotgan edim. Ammo mening yuragim hali ham ogriyapti, terlaydi va ochirardi; barmoqlarimning uchlari va tizzalarimda ogriq bor edi. Va bu shubhasiz sodir boldi! Va endi men orzu qilingan narsadan farq qila olmayman; Mening qattiq, odatiy, uch qirrali hayotim orqali osadi; va qatiy, boshliqlar orniga - uyatchan va qopol narsa bor.

paras.en: I waited long for the Bell to ring. I was lying thinking, untangling a very strange logical chain. In our superficial life, every formula, every equation, corresponds to a curve or a solid. We have never seen any curve or solid corresponding to my square-root of minus one. The horrifying part of the situation is that there exist such curves or solids; unseen by us they do exist, they must, inevitably; for in mathematics as on a screen, strange sharp shadows appear before us. One must remember that mathematics like death, never makes mistakes, never plays tricks. If we are unable to see those irrational curves or solids, it only means that they inevitably possess a whole immense world somewhere beneath the surface of our life.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men qongiroq qilish uchun uzoq vaqt kutdim, juda galati zanjirni ochirib qoydim. Har bir formula, har bir tenglama, egri chiziq yoki qattiqlikka mos keladi.Biz hech qachon bunday egri chiziqlar yoki qattiq chiziqlar borligini kormaganmiz. Vaziyatning salbiy tomoni shundaki, ular bizda mavjud; chunki ular bizda mavjud; chunki biz bilan bogliq bolgan notogri manoda ular mavjud; chunki ekranda matematikada olim kabi otkir chiziqlar paydo bolishi kerak. Hech qachon olim kabi matematikani unutmaslik kerak, hech qachon notogri oynamaslik kerak.Agar biz bu egri chiziqlar yoki qattiq narsalarni kora olmasak, bu faqat butun dunyoga egaligimizni anglatadi.

paras.en: I jumped up without waiting for the waking Bell and began to pace up and down the room. My mathematics, the only firm and immovable island of my shaken life, this too was torn from its anchor and was floating, whirling. Then it means that that absurd thing, the “soul,” is as real as my unif, as my boots, although I do not see them since they are behind the door of the closet. If boots are not a sickness, why should the “soul” be one? I sought, but I could not find, a way out of the logical confusion. It looked to me like that strange and sad debris beyond the Green Wall; my logical debris too, is filled with extraordinary, incomprehensible, wordless but speaking beings. It occurred to me for a moment that through some strange, thick glass I saw it; I saw it at once infinitely large and infinitely small, scorpion-like with hidden but ever perceptible sting; I saw the square-root of minus one. Perhaps it was nothing else but my “soul,” which like the legendary scorpion of the ancients, was voluntarily stinging itself with.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men uygonish Bellni kutmasdan uygonib, xonani sekinlashtira boshladim.Mening matematikam, bu ham uning qolidan tortib olindi va chayqalib ketdi, degan manoni anglatadi. Keyin bu bemani narsa, "ruh mening bogimlarim kabi haqiqiydir, garchi ular qulfning eshigi orqasida bolganligi sababli ularni kormasam ham.Agar botlar kasal bolmasa, nima uchun "ruh bitta bolishi kerak? lekin men topa olmadim, mantiqiy chalkashliklardan chiqish yoli menga Yashil devordan tashqaridagi galati va qayguli narsalar kabi tuyuldi; Mening mantiqiy qarashlarim ham gayrioddiy, sozsiz, ammo sozsiz, lekin gapiradigan odamlar bilan tola. Bu menga galati, qalin shisha orqali men uni kordim; Men bir vaqtning ozida katta va nozik kichik, yashirin, ammo hech qachon sezilmaydigan boshliq bilan uni kordim; Men minusning kvadrat ildizini kordim. Ehtimol, bu mening "ruhim emas edi, bu qadimgilarning afsonaviy skorpori singari, ozini oziga jalb qildi.

paras.en: The Bell! The day began. All I saw and felt neither died, nor disappeared, it merely became covered with daylight, as our visible world does not die or disappear at the end of the day but merely becomes covered with the darkness of night. My head was filled by a light, thin haze. Through that haze I perceived the long glass tables and the globe-like heads busy chewing, slowly, silently, in unison. At a distance, through the haze, the metronome was slowly beating its tick-tock, and to the accompaniment of this customary and caressing music I joined with the others in counting automatically to fifty: fifty is the number of chewing movements required by the law of the State for every piece of food. And automatically then, keeping time, I went downstairs and put my name down in the book for the outgoing Numbers⁠—as everyone did. But I felt I lived separately from everybody; I lived by myself separated by a soft wall which absorbs noises; beyond that wall there was my world.
paras.uz: Qongiroq boshlandi! Men korgan hamma narsa va oldi, yoki yoq bolib ketdi, chunki bizning korinadigan dunyomiz kun oxirida olmaydi yoki faqat qorongilik bilan qoplangan. Mening boshim yoruglik bilan tolgan edi, ingichka boyin.Bu boshliq orqali men uzun shisha stollarni va dunyoga oxshash boshlarni sekin, bir-biriga boglab qoyganimni kordim. Ammo men ozimni boshqalardan alohida yashaganimni his qildim; shovqin chiqaradigan yumshoq devor bilan yashadim; bu devordan tashqarida mening dunyom bor edi.

paras.en: Here a thought occurred to me. If that world is only my own, why should I tell about it in these records? Why should I recount all these absurd “dreams” about closets, endless corridors? With great sorrow I notice that instead of a correct and strictly mathematical poem in honor of the United State, I am writing a fantastic novel. Oh! if only it were a novel and not my actual life, full of X’s, square-roots of minus one and down-fallings! Yet all may be for the best. Probably you, my unknown readers, are children still as compared with us. We are brought up by the United State; consequently we have reached the highest summits attainable by man. And you, being children, may swallow without crying all the bitter things I am to give you only if they be coated with the syrup of adventures.
paras.uz: Bu erda bir fikr men bilan sodir boldi. bu dunyo faqat mening ozim bilan sodir bolsa, nima uchun men bu dunyoda bu haqda aytib kerak? Nima uchun men bu notogri aytib kerak? buyuk qaygu bilan Men Yagona Davlat sharafiga togri va qatiy sher orniga ajoyib roman yozyapman. Oh! faqat bu roman va mening haqiqiy hayot emas edi, X ning toliq, kichik-tugma ildizlari va pastga tushib!

paras.en: The Same Evening
paras.uz: Xuddi shu kecha

paras.en: Are you familiar with the following sensation? You are in an aero and you dash upward along a blue spiral line; the window is open and the wind rushes past your face, whistling. There is no earth. The earth is forgotten. The earth is as far from you as Venus, Saturn or Jupiter. That is how I live now. A hurricane wind beats into my face; I forget the earth, forget rosy, dear O-90. Yet the earth does exist and sooner or later I must plane down to that earth; only I close my eyes to avoid seeing the date at which there is the name O-90 written on my Tables.
paras.uz: Siz quyidagi tuygu bilan tanishmisiz? Siz aerodasiz va kok spiral chiziq boylab chokib ketasiz; deraza ochiq va shamol sizning yuzingizdan otib ketadi.Yer hech qachon unutilmaydi.Yer Venera, Saturn yoki Yupiter kabi sizdan uzoqda.Men hozir shunday yashayman.Men erni unutaman, zangni unutaman, aziz O-90 ni unutaman.

paras.en: This evening the distant earth reminded me of itself. In order to fulfill the recommendation of the doctor (I desire sincerely, most sincerely I desire to be cured), I wandered for two hours and eight minutes over the straight lines of the deserted avenues. Everybody was in the auditoriums, in accordance with the Table. Only I, cut off from the rest, I was alone. Strictly speaking, it was a very unnatural situation. Imagine a finger cut off from the whole, from the hand; a separate human finger, somewhat hunched, running over the glass sidewalk. I was such a finger. What seemed most strange and unnatural was that the finger had no desire to be with its hand, with its fellows. I want either to be alone or with her; to transfuse my whole being into hers through a contact with her shoulder or through our interwoven fingers.
paras.uz: Bu kecha uzoq er menga ozini eslatib. shifokor tavsiya bajarish uchun (Men chin dildan istayman, eng togri bolishi istayman), Men ikki soat va sakkiz daqiqa davomida togridan-togri yollar boylab kesib. faqat men, Stolda kora, Bu juda gayritabiiy holat edi. faqat, Men yolgiz edi. faqat, Men, albatta, yolgiz bolishi kerak, deb eng galati va gayritabiiy edi, uning qoli bilan yoki u bilan birga bolish istagi edi.

paras.en: I came home as the sun was setting. The pink dust of evening was covering the glass of the walls, the golden peak of the Accumulating Tower, the voices and smiles of the Numbers. Is it not strange: the passing rays of the evening sun fall to the earth at the same angle as the awakening rays of the morning, yet they make everything seem so different; the pink tinge is different. At sunset it is so quiet, somewhat melancholy; at sunrise it is resounding, boisterous.
paras.uz: Kechaning pushti changi devorlarning stakanini, yoruglik minorasining oltin choqqisini, raqamlarning ovozini va tabassumlarini qamrab olgan edi.Bu galati emasmi: tungi quyosh nurlari ertalab yoruglik nurlari bilan bir xil burchak ostida erga tushadi, ammo ular hamma narsani boshqacha korinishga olib keladi; pushti hijob juda jim, biroz melanxoly; quyosh nurida u ajoyib, boshashgan.

paras.en: In the hall downstairs when I entered, I saw U-, the controller. She took a letter from the heaps of envelopes covered with pink dust and handed it to me.
