I repeat: she is a very respectable woman and I am sure she has only the very best feelings towards me.⁠ ⁠… Yet, every time I see those cheeks hanging down, which look like the gills of a fish, I.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men kirganimda koridorda men U-ni kordim, nazoratchi.U pushti chang bilan qoplangan konvertlardan xat oldi va uni menga uzatdi. Men buni takrorladim: u juda hurmatli ayol va ishonchim komilki, u menga nisbatan faqat eng yaxshi his-tuygularga ega.

paras.en: Holding out her dry hand with the letter, U- sighed. But that sigh only very slightly moved in me the curtains which separate me from the rest of the world. I was completely projected upon the envelope which trembled in my hand. I had no doubt but that it was a letter from I-330.
paras.uz: Ammo bu korinish meni dunyoning qolgan qismidan ajratib turadigan pardalarga juda ozgina kochib otdi. Men qolimga tushgan konvertga toliq kotarildim. Men bu I-330 dan kelgan xat ekanligiga shubha qilmadim.

paras.en: At that moment I heard another sigh, such a deliberate one, underscored with two lines, that I raised my eyes from the envelope and saw a tender, cloudy smile coming from between the gills, through the bashful jalousies of lowered eyes. And then:
paras.uz: Osha paytda men yana bir kozoynak eshitdim, shunday ajoyib, ikki chiziq bilan bezatilgan, men kozlarimni konvertdan kotarib, galtaklar orasidagi yumshoq tabassumni kordim.

paras.en: “You poor, poor, dear!⁠ ⁠…” a sigh underscored with three lines, and a glance at the letter, an imperceptible glance. (What was in the letter she naturally knew, ex officio.)
paras.uz: "Siz kambagal, kambagal, azizim!..." uch qator bilan bezatilgan bir kozgu va harfga bir nazar, tushunarsiz koz. (U tabiiy edi nima edi, sobiq ofis).

paras.en: “No, really?⁠ ⁠… Why?”
paras.uz: "Yoq, nima uchun?"

paras.en: “No, no, dear, I know better than you. For a long time I have watched you and I see that you need someone with years of experience of life to accompany you.”
paras.uz: "Yoq, azizim, men sizdan kora yaxshiroq bilaman. Men sizni uzoq vaqtdan beri kuzatib kelaman va sizga hamroh bolish uchun kop yillik tajribaga ega bolgan odamga muhtojligingizni koraman."

paras.en: I felt all pasted around by her smile. It was like a plaster upon the wounds which were to be inflicted upon me by the letter I held in my hand. Finally, through the bashful jalousies of her eyes, she said in a very low voice: “I shall think about it, dear. I shall think it over. And be sure that if I feel myself strong enough⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Men uning tabassumi bilan ozimni barcha atrofida joylashtirilgan his qildim. Bu mening qolimda ushlab turilgan xat bilan menga tegib ketgan jarohatlarga oxshash edi. Nihoyat, uning kozlaridagi gazabli hazillar orqali u juda past ovozda shunday dedi: "Men bu haqda oylayman, azizim. va agar men ozimni etarlicha kuchli his qilsam, amin bolaman ... "

paras.en: “Great Well-Doer! Is it possible that my lot is?⁠ ⁠… Is it possible that she means to say, that she?⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: У: «Эй Роббим, албатта, менинг жойим пайдоми?» деди. У: «Сен: «Уни поклаяпсанми?» деди.

paras.en: My eyes were dimmed and filled with thousands of sinusoids; the letter was trembling. I went near the light, to the wall. There the light of the sun was going out; from the sun was falling thicker and thicker the dark, sad, pink dust, covering the floor, my hands, the letter. I opened the envelope and found the signature as fast as I could⁠—the first wound! It was not I-330; it was O-90! And another wound: in the right-hand corner a slovenly splash⁠—a blot! I cannot bear blots. It matters little whether they are made by ink or by⁠ ⁠… well, it matters not by what. Heretofore, such a blot would have had only a disagreeable effect, disagreeable to the eyes; but now⁠—why did that small gray blot seem to be like a cloud and seem to spread about me a leaden, bluish darkness? Or was it again the “soul” at work? Here is a transcript of the letter:
paras.uz: Mening kozlarim xiralashdi va minglab sinoidlar bilan toldirdim; xat qorqinchli edi. Men yoruglikka yaqin bordim, devorga quyoshning nuri tushdi; quyoshning nuri tushib ketdi va qorongi, qaygu, pushti chang, qollarim, qolim, xat. Men konvertni ochdim va imzoni iloji boricha tezroq topdim - birinchi yara! Bu I-330 emas edi; va boshqa jarohat: ong burchakdagi ong burchakdagi bot - ular siyoh yoki... yaxshi, bu nima bilan bogliq emas. Shuning uchun, bunday murvat faqat noqulay tasir korsatishi mumkin edi, kozlarga mos kelmaydi; lekin hozir - nima uchun bu kichik kulrang boshliq bulutga oxshaydi va men haqimda qorgoshin, kok zulmatga oxshaydi? yoki yana ishdagi "ruh bolganmi?

paras.en: “You know, or perhaps you don’t⁠ ⁠… I cannot write well. Little it matters! Now you know that without you there is for me not a single day, a single morning, a single spring, for R- is only⁠ ⁠… well, that is of no importance to you. At any rate, I am very grateful to him, for without him, alone all these days, I don’t know what would.⁠ ⁠… During these last few days and nights I have lived through ten years, or perhaps twenty years. My room seemed to me not square but round; I walk around without end, round after round, always the same thing, not a door to escape through. I cannot live without you because I love you; and I should not, I cannot be with you any more⁠—because I love you! Because I see and I understand that you need no one now, no one in the world save that other, and you must realize that it is precisely because I love you I must⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Bilasizmi, ehtimol men yaxshi yoza olmayman.Sizsiz men uchun bir kun emas, bir kun, bir bahor, R uchun faqat... yaxshi, bu siz uchun hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas. Har qanday holatda ham, men u uchun juda minnatdorman, chunki usiz, men bu kunlar uchun, butun kun davomida, men nima bolishini bilmayman. ... songgi bir necha kun va tun davomida men on yil davomida yashaganman yoki ehtimol yigirma yil yashadim. Men korgan va men siz hozir hech kimga kerak emas, deb tushunaman, dunyoda hech kim bu boshqa saqlab qolish, va siz aniq, chunki men seni sevaman, deb tushunish kerak.

paras.en: “I need another two or three days in order to paste together the fragments of myself and thus restore at least something similar to the O-90 of old. Then I shall go myself, and myself I shall state that I take your name from my list, and this will be better for you; you must feel happy now. I shall never again.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Menga yana ikki yoki uch kun kerak boladi, shunda ozimning boyinturugimni yigish va hech bolmaganda eski O-90 ga oxshash narsani tiklashim kerak. Keyin men ozimga boraman va ozim sizning ismingizni royxatimdan olaman va bu siz uchun yaxshiroq boladi; endi ozingizni baxtli his qilishingiz kerak. "

paras.en: “Goodbye, O-.”
paras.uz: "Assalomu alaykum, O-

paras.en: Never again. Yes, that is better. She is right. But, why then?⁠ ⁠… Why then?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: - Yoq, u haq, keyin nima uchun?

paras.en: The infinitesimal of the third order⁠—From under the forehead⁠—Over the railing.
paras.uz: Uchinchi tartibli cheksiz kichik miqdor — Peshona ostidan — Panjaradan oshib.

paras.en: There in the strange corridor lighted by the dotted line of dim little electric lamps⁠ ⁠… or no, no, later, when we had already reached one of the nooks in the courtyard of the Ancient House, she said, “Day-after-tomorrow.” That “day-after-tomorrow” is today. And everything seems to have wings and to fly; the day flies; and our Integral too already has wings. We finished placing the motor and tried it out today, without switching it in. What magnificent, powerful salvos! Each of them sounded for me like a salute in honor of her, the only one⁠—in honor of today!
paras.uz: U erda galati yolakda eski uyning bogichlaridan biriga etib borganimizda, u shunday dedi: "Kundan-kunga bu "kundan-kunga bugungi kunda.Va hamma narsa qanotlari va uchib ketadiganga oxshaydi; va bizning integralimiz ham bugun qanotlarni tugatdik va uni ozgartirmasdan sinab kordik.

paras.en: At the time of the first explosion about a dozen loafing Numbers from the docks stood near the main tube⁠—and nothing was left of them save a few crumbs and a little soot. With pride I write down now that this occurrence did not disturb the rhythm of our work even for a second. Not a man shrank. We and our lathes continued our rectilinear or curved motions with the same sparkling and polished precision as before, as if nothing had happened. As a matter of fact, what did happen? A dozen Numbers represent hardly one hundred millionth part of the United State. For practical consideration, that is but an infinitesimal of the third order. That pity, a result of arithmetical ignorance, was known to the ancients; to us it seems absurd.
paras.uz: Birinchi portlash paytida dokonlardan onlab yuklanish raqamlari asosiy naycha yaqinida turgan edi - va ulardan hech narsa qolmagan edi. Endi men bu voqea bizning ish ritmini bir soniya ham bezovta qilmaganini yozaman.Biz va bizning lanatlarimiz hech narsa sodir bolmagandek, xuddi oldingi kabi togri chiziqli yoki egri harakatlarimizni davom ettirdik. Aslida, nima sodir boldi?Onlab onlab onlab odamlar bitta davlatning deyarli yuz millioninchi qismini anglatadi.

paras.en: It seems droll to me also, that yesterday I was thinking, even relating in these pages about a gray blot! All that was only the “softening of the surface” which is normally as hard as diamond, like our walls. (There is an ancient saying: “Shooting beans at a stone wall⁠—”)
paras.uz: Menga ham oxshab korinadi, kecha men bu sahifalarda kulrang bori haqida oyladim! Bularning barchasi faqat "yerni yumshatish edi, bu odatda olmos kabi qiyin edi, bizning devorlarimiz kabi. (Qadimgi soz bor: "tosh devorida loviya otish - ")

paras.en: Sixteen o’clock. I did not go for the supplementary walk; who knows, she might come now, when the sun is so noisily bright.
paras.uz: On olti soat. Men piyoda yurish uchun bormadim; kim biladi, u hozir kelishi mumkin, quyosh juda shovqinli yorqin bolsa.

paras.en: I am almost the only one in his room. Through the walls full of sunshine I see for a distance to the right and to the left and below strings of other rooms, repeating each other as if in a mirror, hanging in the air and empty. Only on the bluish stairway, striped by the golden ink of the sun, is seen rising a thin, gray shadow. Already I hear steps, and I see through the door and I feel a smile pasted to my face like a plaster. But it passed to another stairway and down. The click of the switchboard! I threw myself to that little white slit and⁠ ⁠… an unfamiliar male Number! (A consonant means a male Number.)
paras.uz: Men uning xonasida deyarli yagonaman. Quyosh devorlari orqali men ong va chap va pastki xonalarni koraman, xuddi oynadagi kabi bir-biriga yopishib, havoda va bosh boshliqda osilgan holda bir-birlarini koraman. Faqat quyoshning oltin siyohi bilan qoplangan kok zinapoyada nozik, kulrang soya kotariladi.

paras.en: The elevator groaned and stopped. A big, slovenly, slanting forehead stood before me, and the eyes⁠ ⁠… They impressed me strangely; it seemed as if the man talked with his eyes which were deep under the forehead.
paras.uz: Lift goyib boldi va toxtadi. Bir katta, nozik, orash pichoq mening oldimda turgan, va kozlari... Ular meni hayratda qoldirdi; Bu odam boshi ostidagi chuqur kozlari bilan gapirganga oxshardi.

paras.en: “Here is a letter from her, for you.” (From under the awning of that forehead.) “She asked that everything⁠ ⁠… as requested in the letter⁠ ⁠… without fail.” This too, from under the forehead, from under the awning, and he turned, looked about.
paras.uz: U xatda soralgan hamma narsani xatda soraganidek soradi. "Bu, shuningdek, orqa tomondan, burilish ostidan va u orqaga qarab, korib chiqdi.

paras.en: “No, there is nobody, nobody. Quickly! the letter!”
paras.uz: - Yoq, hech kim yoq, tezda! - dedi.

paras.en: He put the letter in my hand and went out without a word.
paras.uz: U xatni qolimga oldi va bir ogiz soz demay tashqariga chiqdi.

paras.en: A pink check fell out of the envelope. It was hers, her check! Her tender perfume! I felt like running to catch up with that wonderful under-the-forehead one. A tiny note followed the check from the envelope; three lines: “The check⁠ ⁠… Lower the curtains without fail, as if I were actually with you. It is necessary that they should think that I⁠ ⁠… I am very, very sorry.”
paras.uz: Bu uning, uning nozik fel-atvori edi! Men osha ajoyib pastki qism bilan qolga olish uchun yugurib ozimni his qildim. kichik eslatma konvertdan chek ergashdi; uchta chiziq: "Tekshiruv... men siz bilan bolganimday, pardalarni pastga tushiring. Ular meni juda afsusdaman deb oylashlari kerak. "

paras.en: I tore the note into small bits. A glance at the mirror revealed my distorted, broken eyebrows. I took the check and was ready to do with it as I had done with the note. “She asked that everything⁠ ⁠… as requested in the letter⁠ ⁠… without fail.” My arms weakened and the hands loosened. The check was back on the table. She is stronger than I, stronger than I. It seemed as though I were going to act as she wished. Besides⁠ ⁠… however, it is a long time before evening.
paras.uz: Kozgudagi bir korinish mening bogimlarimni ochib yubordi, singan kozlarimni yumdi. Men chekni oldim va u bilan nota kabi bajarishga tayyor edim. "U xatda soralgan hamma narsani ... muvaffaqiyatsiz deb soradi. Mening qollarim va qollarim orqaga qaytdi.

paras.en: The check remained on the table. In the mirror⁠—my distorted, broken eyebrows. Oh, why did I not have a doctor’s certificate for today? I should like to go and walk, walk without end around the Green Wall and then to fall on my bed⁠ ⁠… to the bottom of.⁠ ⁠… Yet I had to go to Auditorium No. 13, and I should have to grip myself, so as to bear up for two hours! Two hours without motion, at a time when I wanted to scream and stamp my feet!
paras.uz: Kozguda - mening bogimlarda, singan kozlarim bor edi. Oh, nima uchun bugungi kunda menda shifokorning sertifikati yoq edi?Men borib, yurishim kerak, Yashil devor boylab yurishim va keyin toshagimga tushishim kerak ... Shunga qaramay, men ozimni ushlashim kerak edi.

paras.en: The lecture was on. It was very strange to hear from the sparkling tube of the phono-lecturer not the usual metallic voice but a soft, velvety, mossy one. It was a woman’s voice and I seemed to have a vision of the woman: a little hook-like old woman, like the one of the Ancient House.
paras.uz: Maruza haqida edi. Fono-maruzachining badiiy naychasidan odatiy ovoz emas, balki yumshoq, chiroyli, moxistik ovozni eshitish juda galati edi.Bu ayolning ovozi edi va men ayolning tasavvuriga ega boldim: qadimgi uyning biri kabi bir oz hokga oxshash eski ayol.

paras.en: The Ancient House! Suddenly from within me a powerful fountain of.⁠ ⁠… I had to use all my strength to control myself, so as not to fill the auditorium with screams. The soft mossy words were piercing me, yet only empty words about children and child-production reached my ear. I was like a photographic plate: everything was making its imprint with a strange, senseless precision on me; the golden scythe which was nothing more than the reflection of light from the megaphone of the lecture apparatus, under the megaphone a child, a living illustration. It was leaning toward the megaphone, the angle of its infinitesimal unif in its mouth, its little fist clenched firmly, its thumb squeezed into the fist, a light fluffy pleat of skin at the wrist. Like a photographic plate I was taking the impression of all this. Now I saw how its naked leg hung over the edge of the platform, the pink fan of its finger waved in the air.⁠ ⁠… One minute more, one second and the child would be on the floor!
paras.uz: Men ozimni nazorat qilish uchun barcha kuch-quvvatdan foydalanishim kerak edi. Yumshoq mox sozlar meni chalgitdi, lekin faqat bolalar va bolalar-ishlab chiqarish haqida bosh sozlar qulogimga etib bordi. Men oz plastinkamga oxshardim: hamma narsa galati, aql bovar qilmaydigan aniqlik bilan oz tasavvurini amalga oshirdi; hamma narsa megafondagi yoruglik aks etishidan boshqa narsa emas edi, bola ostida. Endi men uning yalangoch oyogi platformaning chetidan qanday osilganini kordim, barmogining pushti muxlisi havoda uchib ketdi ... yana bir daqiqa, bir soniya va bola polda bolardi!

paras.en: A female’s scream, a wave of translucent wings, her unif on the platform! She caught the child, her lips clung to the fluffy pleat of the baby’s wrist; she moved the child to the middle of the table and left the platform. The imprints were registering in me: a pink crescent of a mouth, the horns downward! Eyes like small blue saucers filled with liquid! It was O-90. And as if reading a consequential formula, I suddenly felt the necessity, the naturalness of that insignificant occurrence.
paras.uz: Qizning qichqirigi, shaffof qanotlari tolqini, platformadagi bir tolqin! U bolani qolga oldi, lablarini chaqaloqning bilagining yumshoq lavhasiga tortdi; u bolani stolning ortasiga kochirdi va platformani tark etdi.

paras.en: She sat down behind me, somewhat to my left. I looked back. She quietly removed her gaze from the table and the child and looked straight into me. Within again: She, I, the table on the platform⁠—three points: and through those three points lines were drawn, a projection of some as yet unforeseen events!
paras.uz: U mening orqamda otirdi, bir oz orqamga. Men stoldan va boladan kozini olib tashladim va togridan-togri menga qaradi.: U, men, platformadagi stol - uchta nuqta: va bu uchta nuqta chizigi orqali bazilari hali ham kutilmagan voqealar!

paras.en: Then I went home through the green dusky street which seemed many-eyed because of the electric lights. I heard myself tick-tocking like a clock. And the hands of that clock seemed to be about to pass a figure: I was going to do something, something that would cut off every way of retreat. She wants somebody, whom I do not know, to think she is with me. I want her; what do I care what she wants? I do not want to be alone behind the curtains and that is all there is to it!
paras.uz: Keyin men elektr chiroqlari tufayli kop korinadigan yashil changi kochasi boylab uyga qaytdim. Men ozimni soat kabi boglab qoyganimni eshitdim. Va soatning qollari bir raqamdan otib ketayotganga oxshardi: men biron bir narsani qilmoqchi edim, orqaga qaytishning har bir yolini kesib tashlamoqchi edim. U kimnidir xohlaydi, men uni bilmayman deb oylayman; men nima xohlayman? u nimani xohlayman? men pardalar ortida yolgiz qolishni xohlamayman va bu hammasi unga tegishli!

paras.en: From behind came sounds of a familiar gait, like splashing in a ditch. I did not need to look back, I knew it was S-. He would follow me to the very door, probably. Then he would stay below on the sidewalk, and he would try to drill upward into my room with his boring eyes, until the curtains would fall, concealing something criminal.
paras.uz: Orqadan tanish giybat ovozi keldi, masalan, orqa tomonga qarashga hojat yoq edi, u menga ergashishini bilardim - ehtimol u juda eshik oldida bolardi. Keyin u orqada qoladi va u mening xonamga ozining zerikarli kozlari bilan burgulashga harakat qilar edi, pardalar yiqilib tushgunga qadar, biron bir jinoiy narsani yashirardi.

paras.en: Was he my Guardian-Angel? No! My decision was made.
paras.uz: Эй Роббим, албатта, Унинг Ўзи Пайғамбар бўлдим.

paras.en: When I came into my room and turned on the light, I could not believe my eyes! O-90 stood at my table, or to be more exact, she was hanging like a creased empty dress. She seemed to have no tensity, no spring beneath the dress; her arms and legs were springless, her voice was hanging and springless.
paras.uz: Men xonamga kirib, yoruglikka ogirilib, kozlarimga ishonmadim! O-90 mening stolimda turgan edi yoki aniqroq bolish uchun u yalangoch bosh kiyim kabi osilgan edi.U hech qanday zoravonlik yoq edi, kiyim ostida bahor yoq edi; uning qollari va oyoqlari bahorsiz edi, ovozi osilgan va bahorsiz edi.

paras.en: “About my letter, did you receive it? Yes? I must know your answer, I must⁠—today.”
paras.uz: «Mening xatim haqida, siz uni qabul qildingizmi? « Ha, men sizning javobingizni bilishim kerak, bugun - kerak».

paras.en: I shrugged my shoulders. I enjoyed looking into her blue eyes which were filled with tears as if she were the guilty one. I lingered over my answer. With pleasure I pricked her:
paras.uz: Men uning kok kozlariga koz yoshlari bilan tolib-toshgan kok kozlarimdan zavq oldim, xuddi u aybdor bolgani kabi.

paras.en: “Answer? Well.⁠ ⁠… You are right. Undoubtedly. In everything.”
paras.uz: «Togri javob berasizlar. », «Hamma narsada.

paras.en: “Then⁠ ⁠…” (She tried to cover the minute tremor with a smile but it did not escape me.) “Well, all right. I shall⁠ ⁠… I shall leave you at once.”
paras.uz: «Keyin...» (U bir daqiqa sukutni tabassum bilan yashirishga harakat qildi, lekin u mendan qochib qutula olmadi. «Mayli, mayli, men sizni darhol tark etaman».

paras.en: Yet she remained drooping over the table. Drooping eyelids, drooping arms and legs. The pink check of the other was still on the table. I quickly opened this manuscript, We, and with its pages I covered the check, trying to hide it from myself, rather than from O-.
paras.uz: Lekin u stol ustida turib qoldi. qollari va oyoqlarini tomchi tomchi. boshqa pushti nazorat hali stolda edi. Men tez bu qolyozmani ochdi, Biz, va uning sahifalari bilan men chekni qoplangan, Men ozim uni yashirish uchun harakat, O-orniga.

paras.en: “See, here, I am still busy writing. Already 101 pages! Something quite unexpected comes out in this writing.”
paras.uz: “Mana, men hali ham bandman. 101 sahifa allaqachon! Ushbu yozuvda juda kutilmagan narsa paydo boladi.”

paras.en: In a voice, in a shadow of a voice, “And do you remember⁠ ⁠… how the other day I⁠ ⁠… on the seventh page⁠ ⁠… and it dropped.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Bir ovoz bilan, bir ovoz soyasida, "Va boshqa kuni men qanday eslayman ... yettinchi sahifada ... va u tushib ketdi ..."

paras.en: The tiny blue saucers filled to the borders; silently and rapidly the tears ran down her cheeks. And suddenly, like the dropping of the tears⁠—rushing forth⁠—words:
paras.uz: Kichkina kok soslar chegaralarga toldi; sokin va tez koz yoshlari uning boynidan pastga tushdi. Va tosatdan, koz yoshlarining tokilishi kabi - oldinga - sozlar:

paras.en: “I cannot⁠ ⁠… I shall leave you in a moment. I shall never again⁠ ⁠… and I don’t care.⁠ ⁠… Only I want, I must have a child! From you! Give me a child and I will leave. I will!”
paras.uz: "Men sizni bir zumda tark eta olmayman ... va men boshqa hech qachon... va men hech qachon ahamiyat bermayman ... faqat menda farzand bolishi kerak! sizdan menga bola bering va men ketaman!"

paras.en: I saw she was trembling all over beneath her unif, and I felt⁠ ⁠… I too, would soon⁠ ⁠… would.⁠ ⁠… I put my hands behind my back and smiled.
paras.uz: Men uning qolidan ushlab kordim, u ham tez orada qolimni orqaga tortib, kulishini his qildim.

paras.en: “What? You desire to go under the Machine of the Well-Doer?”
paras.uz: «Ёки Роҳманнинг жамиятига боришни хоҳлайсизларми?!» деди.

paras.en: Like a stream her words ran over the dam.
paras.uz: Uning sozlari ot-olandan otib ketdi.

paras.en: “I don’t care. I shall feel it for a while within me. I want to see, to see only once the little fold of skin here at the wrist, like that one on the table in the Auditorium. Only for one day!”
paras.uz: "Men buni bir muncha vaqt his qilaman. Men korishni istayman, faqat bir marta korishni xohlayman, bu erda qorindagi terining kichik qatlami, masalan, Auditoriyadagi stolda. Faqat bir kun! "

paras.en: Three points: she, I and a little fist with a fluffy fold of skin there on the table!
paras.uz: Uch nuqta: u, men va stol ustidagi yumshoq teri bilan ozgina musht!

paras.en: I remember how once when I was a child they took me up on the Accumulating Tower. At the very top I bent over the glass railing of an opening in the Tower. Below people seemed like dots; my heart contracted sweetly. “What if.⁠ ⁠…” On that occasion I only clenched my hands around the railing; now I jumped over.
paras.uz: Bir paytlar bolaligimda ular meni Makkaga olib ketishganini eslayman. Tepasida men minoradagi ochilish oynasi ustida otirgan edim; quyida odamlar nuqta kabi korinardi; "Agar... nima bolsa." Osha paytda men qollarimni faqat qirgoq atrofida siladim; endi men sakrab chiqdim.

paras.en: “So you desire⁠ ⁠… being perfectly aware that⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Shunday qilib, siz ... juda yaxshi bilishingizni xohlaysiz ..."

paras.en: Her eyes were closed as if the sun were beating straight into her face. A wet, shining smile!
paras.uz: Uning kozlari quyoshning yuziga togridan-togri urayotganday yopiq edi.

paras.en: “Yes, yes! I want it!”
paras.uz: "Ha, men buni xohlayman!"

paras.en: Quickly I took out the pink check of the other from under the manuscript and down I went to the controller on duty. O-90 caught my hand, screamed out something, but what it was I understood only later, when I returned.
paras.uz: Tez orada men qolyozma ostida boshqa pushti chek olib, va men vazifa nazorat ketdi. O-90 qolimni qolga, bir narsa dedi, lekin u faqat keyinchalik tushunish nima edi, Men qaytib qachon.

paras.en: She was sitting on the edge of the bed, hands firmly clasped about the knees.
paras.uz: U toshakning chetiga otirdi, qollari oyoqlariga mahkam boglab qoydi.

paras.en: “Is it, is it her check?”
paras.uz: Бу унинг зиммасими?» деди.

paras.en: “What does it matter? Well, it is hers, yes.”
paras.uz: Бу Унинг Ўзи. Унинг Ўзи покдир», деди.

paras.en: Something cracked. It must have been the springs of the bed, for O-90 made a slight motion only. She remained sitting, her hands upon her knees.
paras.uz: Bu toshakning buloqlari bolishi kerak edi, chunki O-90 faqat ozgina harakat qildi.

paras.en: “Well, quick.⁠ ⁠…” I roughly pressed her hand. A red spot was left on her wrist (tomorrow it would become purple), where the fluffy, infantile fold.⁠ ⁠… It was the last.⁠ ⁠… I turned the switch, my thoughts went out with the light. Darkness, a spark! and I had jumped over the railing, down.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Yaxshi, tez... Men uning qolini taxminan tosib qoydim. Uning bilagida qizil nuqta qoldi (bu ertaga binafsha boladi), u erda yumshoq, chaqaloq qopqogi ... bu oxirgi narsa edi ... men oz fikrimni ozgartirdim, yoruglik bilan chiqib ketdim.

paras.en: Discharge⁠—The material of a idea⁠—The zero rock.
paras.uz: Razryad — G'oyaning moddasi — Nol qoya.

paras.en: Discharge is the best word for it. Now I see that it was actually like an electric discharge. The pulse of my last few days had been becoming dryer and dryer, more and more frequent, more intense. The opposite poles had been drawing nearer and nearer and already I could hear the dry crackling; one millimeter more, and⁠—an explosion! Then silence.
paras.uz: Endi men uning uchun eng yaxshi soz ekanligini koraman.Songgi bir necha kunimning zarbasi tobora kuchayib, tobora kuchayib borayotgan edi. qarama-qarshi qutblar yaqinroq va yaqinroq chizilgan edi va allaqachon quruq yorilishni eshitdim; bir millimetr koproq va - portlash!

paras.en: Within me there is quiet now and emptiness like that of a house after everybody has left, when one lies ill, all alone and hears so clearly the distinct, metallic, tick-tock of thoughts.
paras.uz: Mening ichimda hamma kasal bolganda, yolgiz yotganda va aniq, aniq, ravshan fikrlar toplamini eshitgandan song, hozir jim va xotirjam bolgan uy kabi.

paras.en: Perhaps that “discharge” cured me at last of my torturing “soul.” Again I am like all of us. At least at this moment as I write, I can see as it were, without any pain in my mental eye, how O-90 is brought to the steps of the Cube; or I see her in the Gas Bell. And if there in the Operation Department she should give my name⁠—I do not care. Piously and gratefully I should kiss the punishing hand of the Well-Doer at the last moment. I have this right in regard to the United State: to receive my punishment. And I shall not give up this right. No Number ought, or dares, to refuse this only personal, and therefore, most precious, privilege.
paras.uz: Ehtimol, bu mening azob-uqubatlarim oxirida meni "ruh yana. Hech bolmaganda, men yozganimda, ruhiy kozimga hech qanday ogriqsiz, O-90-ni kubning qadamlariga qanday olib kelishini korishim mumkin; yoki men uni gaz qongirogida koraman. va agar u mening ismimni berishi kerak bolsa - men oxirgi daqiqada yaxshi ish qiluvchining jazo qolini opaman.

paras.en: … Quickly, metallically, distinctly, do the thoughts rap in the head. An invisible aero carries me into the blue height of my beloved abstractions. And I see how there in the height, in the purest rarified air, my judgment about the only “right” bursts with a crack, like a pneumatic tire. I see clearly that only an atavism, the absurd superstition of the ancients, gives me this idea of “right.”
paras.uz: - Tez, metall jihatdan, boshda fikrlar zorga. Korinmas havo meni sevimli kok tepaliklarimning balandligiga olib boradi. Va men balandlikda, toza riflangan havoda, faqat "ong haqidagi hukmim pnevmatik shinalar kabi yoriqlar bilan tokilishini koraman. Men faqat aptim, qadimiylarning bemani mujassamlanishi menga "togri goyasini beradi.

paras.en: There are ideas of clay and ideas moulded of gold, or of our precious glass. In order to know the material of which an idea is made, one needs only to let fall upon it a drop of strong acid. One of these acids was known to the ancients under the name of reductio ad absurdum. This was the name of it, I think. But they were afraid of this poison; they preferred to believe that they saw heaven, even though it was a toy made of clay, rather than confess to themselves that it was only a blue nothing. We on the other hand (Glory to the Well-Doer!), we are adults and we have no need of toys. Now if we put a drop of acid on the idea of “right.”⁠ ⁠… Even the ancients (the most mature of them) knew that the source of right was⁠—might! Right is a function of might. Here we have our scale: on the one side an ounce, on the other a ton. On one side “I,” on the other “we,” the United State. Is it not clear? To assume that I may have any “right” as far as the State is concerned, is like assuming that an ounce may equilibrate a ton in a scale! Hence the natural distribution: tons⁠—rights, grams⁠—duties. And the natural road from nothingness to greatness, is to forget that one is a gram and to feel that one is one-millionth of a ton!
paras.uz: "Oltin top yoki "Oltin top goliblari haqida malumotlar mavjud.Agar biz oltin yoki qimmatbaho shishadan yasalgan goyalarga ega bolsak ham, unda goyaning manbai bolishi kerak bolgan materialni bilish uchun faqat kuchli kislotaning bir tomchisiga tushib qolish kerak.Bu kislotalardan biri uning nomi edi, deb oylayman, lekin ular osmonni korishni afzal kordilar, garchi bu loydan qilingan oyinchoq bolsa ham, ozlarini faqat kok narsa ekanligini tan olishgan. Bu erda biz bir tomondan, bir tomondan, bir tonna, ikkinchi tomondan "biz," "biz aniq emas. Davlat haqida gap ketganda, men har qanday "togri bolishi mumkin, deb taxmin qilish uchun, bir untsiya bir tonna miqyosda tenglashishi mumkin deb oylayman! shuning uchun tabiiy tarqatish: huquqlar - grammatika, majburiyatlar - va hech narsa uchun tabiiy yol, bir gramm ekanligini unutish va bir tonna bir million bir tonna his qilish!

paras.en: You ripe-bodied, bright Venerians; you sooty, blacksmith-like Uranians, I almost hear your protests in this silence. But only think, everything that is great is simple. Remember, only the four rules of arithmetic are unshakeable and eternal! And only that mortality will be unshakeable and eternal which is built upon those four rules. This is the superior wisdom, this is the summit of that pyramid around which people red with sweat, fought and battled for centuries trying to crawl up!
paras.uz: Siz pishgan, yorqin veeranslar; siz uyatchansiz, qora smorodinaga oxshaysiz, men deyarli bu sukunatda sizning noroziliklaringizni deyarli eshitaman. Ammo faqat ajoyib deb oylang. Esingizda bolsin, faqat tortta simmetriya qoidasi ajoyib va abadiydir! Va faqat bu tortta qoidaga binoan qurilgan abadiy va abadiy boladi.Bu eng yuqori donolik, bu piramidaning yigilishi bolib, uning atrofidagi odamlar ter bilan qizil rangga ega bolib, asrlar davomida jang qilishdi!

paras.en: Looking from this summit down to the bottom, where something is still left swarming like worms, from this summit all that is left over in us from the ancients seems alike. Alike are the unlawful coming motherhood of O-90, a murder, and the insanity of that Number who dared to throw verses into the face of the United State; and alike is the judgment for them⁠—premature death. This is that divine justice of which those stone-housed ancients dreamed, lit by the naive pink rays of the dawn of history. Their “God” punished sacrilege as a capital crime.
paras.uz: Bu sammitdan pastga qarab, hali ham qurtlar kabi chokayotgan narsa qoladi, bu choqqidan qadimgilardan qolgan hamma narsa shunga oxshash korinadi. Xuddi shunday, O-90 ning noqonuniy kelib chiqishi, qotillik va bitta davlatning yuziga nayza tashlashga jurat etgan bu raqamning aqldan ozganligi; va ular uchun erta olim hukmdir.

paras.en: You Uranians, morose and as black as the ancient Spaniards, who were wise in knowing so well how to burn at the stake, you are silent; I think you agree with me. But I hear you, pink Venerians, saying something about “tortures, executions, return to barbarism.” My dear Venerians, I pity you! You are incapable of philosophical, mathematical thinking. Human history moves upward in circles, like an aero. The circles are at times golden, sometimes they are bloody, but all have 360 degrees. They go from 0° to 10°, 20°, 200°, 360°⁠—and then again 0°. Yes, we have returned to zero. But for a mathematically working mind it is clear that this zero is different; it is a perfectly new zero. We started from zero to the right and came to zero on the left. Hence instead of plus zero, we are at minus zero. Do you understand?
paras.uz: Siz Uranliklar, moros va qadimgi ispanlar kabi qora tanlilarsiz, siz men bilan rozi bolasiz deb oylayman; lekin men sizni eshitdim, pushti Valensiyaliklar, sizni kechira olmayman! Siz falsafiy, falsafiy fikrlay olmaysiz. Inson tarixi aylanalarga kochib otadi, havo kabi.Bazida ular oltin, bazan esa qonli boladi, lekin ularning barchasi 360 darajaga ega. ular 0 ° dan 10 ° C gacha, 20 °, 200 °, 360 ° - va keyin yana 0 ° ga qaytadi. Biz 0 dan ongga boshladik va ong tomonda 0 ga keldik. shuning uchun biz nolga tengmiz.

paras.en: This zero appears to me now as a silent, immense, narrow rock, sharp as a blade. In cruel darkness, holding our breath, we set sail from the black night-side of the zero rock. For centuries we, Columbuses, floated and floated; we made the circuit of the whole world and at last! Hurrah! Salute! We climbed up the masts; before us now was a new side of the zero rock, hitherto unknown, bathed in the Polar light of the United State; a blue mass covered with rainbow sparkles! Suns!⁠—a hundred suns! A million rainbows! What does it matter if we are separated from the other, black side of the zero rock only by the thickness of a blade? A knife is the most solid, the most immortal, the most inspired invention of man. The knife served on the guillotine. The knife is the universal tool for cutting knots. The way of paradoxes follows its sharp edge, the only way becoming to a fearless mind.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu nol endi menga bir jim sifatida korinadi, katta, tor tosh, bir pichoq sifatida otkir. shafqatsiz zulmatda, Biz nafas ushlab, Biz nol tosh qora kecha-yon suzib ornatish. asrlar davomida, Kolumbus, va nihoyat, biz butun dunyo va nihoyat qildi! Hurra! Biz oldin nol tosh yangi tomoni boldi, Hetero nomalum, Yagona Davlat Polar nurida chomilgan! quyosh! - Bir yuz quyosh! - Bu nima muhim emas, biz boshqa qora tomoni pichoq qalinligi bilan ajratilgan bolsa, faqat bir pichoq bilan? Pichoq tugunlarni kesish uchun universal vositadir. Paradokslarning yoli uning otkir chetiga ergashadi, qorqmasdan aqlga aylanishning yagona yoli.

paras.en: The duty of an author⁠—The ice-swells⁠—The most difficult love.
paras.uz: Muallifning burchi — Muzning bo'rtishi — Eng qiyin muhabbat.

paras.en: Yesterday was her day and again she did not come. Again there came her incoherent note, explaining nothing. But I am tranquil, perfectly tranquil. If I do act as I am told to in the note, if I do go to the controller on duty, produce the pink check and then, having lowered the curtains if I do sit alone in my room, I do all this of course not because I have no power to act contrary to her desire. It seems funny? Decidedly not! It is quite simple: separated from all curative, plaster-like smiles I am enabled quietly to write these very lines. This first. And second: I am afraid to lose in her, in I-330, perhaps the only clue I shall ever have to the understanding of all the unknowns, like the story of the cupboard, or my temporary death, for instance. To understand, to discover these unknowns as the author of these records, I feel it simply my duty. Moreover, the unknown is naturally the enemy of man. And Homo Sapiens only then becomes Man in the complete sense of the word, when his punctuation includes no question marks, only exclamation points, commas and periods.
paras.uz: Yana uning kuni va yana u kelmadi. Yana u erda hech narsa tushuntirib, uning noaniq eslatma keldi, lekin men juda xotirjamman. Men eslatmada aytilgandek harakat qilsam, pushti tekshiruvni ishlab chiqarishim kerak va keyin xonada yolgiz otirsam, pardalarni ochirib qoysam, albatta, bularning barchasini qilaman, chunki men uning xohishiga qarshi harakat qila olmayman. Bu juda oddiy korinadi!Bu juda oddiy: barcha kulgili, plyuzga oxshash tabassumlardan ajralib turaman.Birinchidan, men unga yoqotishdan qorqaman, I-330, ehtimol mening shaxsiy olimim kabi barcha nomalumlarni tushunishim kerak. Tushunish uchun, bu nomalumlarni bu yozuvlar muallifi sifatida kashf qilish uchun, Men faqat mening vazifamni his. bundan tashqari, nomalum inson dushman hisoblanadi. va Homo Sapiens faqat keyin soz toliq manoda Inson boladi, uning hech qanday savol belgilari oz ichiga oladi qachon, faqat istisno ball, buyruqlar va davrlar.

paras.en: Thus, guided by what seems to me simply my duty as an author, I took an aero today at sixteen o’clock and went to the Ancient House. A strong wind was blowing against me. The aero advanced with difficulty through the thicket of air, its transparent branches whistling and whipping. The city below seemed a heap of blue blocks of ice. Suddenly⁠—a cloud, a swift, oblique shadow. The ice became leaden; it swelled. As in springtime when you happen to stand at the shore and wait; in one more minute everything will move and pull and crack! But the minute passes and the ice remains motionless; you feel as though you yourself are swelling, your heart beats more restlessly, more frequently.⁠ ⁠… But why do I write about all this? And whence all these strange sensations? For is there such an iceberg as could ever break the most lucid, solid crystal of our life?
paras.uz: Shunday qilib, menga muallif sifatida korinadigan narsa, men bugun soat on oltida aerobika olib bordim va Antik uyga bordim. Kuchli shamol menga qarshi edi.Tosatdan uning shaffof shoxlarini burish va tebranish orqali qiyinchilik bilan oldinga siljishdi.Tosatdan, bulut, tez, bosh soya paydo boldi. muz qorgoshinga aylandi; u cholda turish va kutish paytida bolgani kabi; yana bir daqiqada hamma narsa kochib otadi va yoq bolib ketadi; Ammo siz ozingizni noqulay his qilasiz, yuragingiz tez-tez uradi. Axir, bizning hayotimizdagi eng yorqin, eng kuchli kristalni buzishi mumkin bolgan muzdek narsa bormi?

paras.en: At the entrance of the Ancient House I found no one. I went around it and found the old janitress near the Green Wall. She held her hand above her eyes, looking upward. Beyond the Wall, sharp black triangles of some birds; they would rush, cawing, in onslaught on the invisible fence of electric waves, and as they felt the electricity against their breasts, they would recoil and soar once more beyond the Wall.
paras.uz: Eski uyning kirish qismida men hech kimni topa olmadim. Men uning atrofida bordim va Yashil devor yaqinidagi eski jitterni topdim.U qolini koz oldida ushlab turdi, yuqoriga qarab, devordan tashqarida, bazi qushlarning otkir qora uchburchagidan tashqari; ular elektr tolqinlarining korinmas panjarasiga bostirib kirib, elektr tolqinlarini ogirlab ketishdi va ular kokraklariga qarshi elektr energiyasini his qilishganda, ular yana qaytib ketishdi va devordan tashqariga chiqishdi.

paras.en: I noticed oblique, swift shadows on the dark, wrinkled face, a quick glance at me.
paras.uz: Men qorongu, qorongu, ajinlar yuzlarida tez, menga tez qarashini payqadim.

paras.en: “Nobody here, nobody, nobody! No! And no use coming here.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Bu yerda hech kim, hech kim, hech kim yo'q! « va bu yerga kelishdan foyda yo'q.

paras.en: In what respect is it “no use” and what a strange idea, to consider me somebody’s shadow. Perhaps all of you are only my shadows. Did I not populate these pages which only recently were white quadrangular deserts, with you? Without me would they whom I shall guide over the narrow paths of my lines, could they ever see you?
paras.uz: Ehtimol, barchangiz mening soyamdir. Men bilan birga oq tortburchak chollar bolgan bu sahifalarni kormadimmi? Mensiz ular mening chiziqlarimning tor yollari boylab yol-yoriq korsatadigan, sizni hech qachon kora olamanmi?

paras.en: Of course I did not say all this to the old woman. From experience I know that the most torturing thing is to inoculate someone with a doubt as to the fact that he or she is a three-dimensional reality and not some other reality. I remarked only, quite drily, that her business was to open the gate, and she let me into the courtyard.
paras.uz: Albatta, men bularning barchasini keksa ayolga aytmadim. Tajribadan shuni bilamanki, eng qiyin narsa shundaki, u ozining uch olchovli haqiqat ekanligi va boshqa haqiqat emasligi haqidagi shubha bilan odamni izolyatsiya qilishdir.

paras.en: It was empty. Quiet. The wind remained beyond the walls, distant as on that day, when shoulder to shoulder, two like one, we came out from beneath, from the corridors⁠—if it ever really happened. I walked under stone arches, my steps resounded against the damp vaults and fell behind me, sounding as though someone were continually following me. The yellow walls with patches of red brick were watching me through their square spectacles, windows⁠—watching me open the squeaky doors of a barn, look into corners, nooks and hidden places.⁠ ⁠… A gate in the fence and a lonely spot. The monument of the Two Hundred Years’ War. From the ground naked, stone ribs were sticking out. The yellow jaws of the wall. An ancient oven with a chimney like a ship petrified forever among redbrick waves.
paras.uz: Bu bosh edi.Bu bosh edi. devor orqasida qoldi, osha kuni uzoq, ikki elka kabi, biz ostidan chiqib ketdik, agar u haqiqatan ham sodir bolgan bolsa, toshlar ostida yurgan bolsa - men, mening qadamlarim yalangoch boronlarga qarshi qaytib keldi va meni kuzatib borayotgandek, orqamga yiqildi. qizil gisht bilan qoplangan sariq devorlar meni korib turgan edi, derazalar - meni korib turgan sariq gishtli devorlar, bolalar bogichlari, eshiklar va yashirin joylarni korib chiqdi.

paras.en: It seemed to me that I had seen those yellow teeth once before. I saw them still dimly in my mind, as at the bottom of a barrel, through water. And I began to search. I fell into caves occasionally; I stumbled over stones; rusty jaws caught my unif a few times; salt drops of sweat ran from my forehead into my eyes.
paras.uz: Men ilgari bu sariq tishlarni bir marta korgan edim. Ularni hali ham ongimda, barrelning pastki qismida, suv orqali kordim. Va men vaqti-vaqti bilan gorlarga tushib qoldim; toshlar ustiga yiqilib tushdim; zangli jaglar mening bogimni bir necha marta ushlab oldi; terning tuz tomchilari kozlarimdan oqib chiqdi.

paras.en: Nowhere! I could find that exit from below, from the corridors, nowhere! There was none. Well, perhaps it was better that it happened so. Probably that all was only one of my absurd “dreams.”
paras.uz: Yoq! Men quyida, yolaklardan, hech qaerdan bu chiqib topish mumkin edi! yaxshi, ehtimol, u shunday sodir boldi. ehtimol, barcha mening bemani biri edi, deb faqat bir "Orzular.

paras.en: Tired out, covered with cobweb and dust, I opened the gate to return to the main yard, when suddenly⁠ ⁠… a rustle behind me, splashing steps, and there before me were the pink winglike ears and the double-curved smile of S-. Half closing his eyes, he bored his little drills into me and asked:
paras.uz: Charchagan, kokrak va chang bilan qoplangan, men asosiy hovliga qaytish uchun eshikni ochdim, tosatdan... orqamda bir zang paydo boldi, qadam tashladi va u erda mening oldimda pushti qanot quloqlari va S-ning ikki qirrali tabassumi bor edi.Kozlarini yopishning yarmi, u menga kichik burgulashlarini yoqib yubordi va soradi:

paras.en: “Taking a walk?”
paras.uz: "Bir yurishmi?"

paras.en: I was silent. My arms were heavy.
paras.uz: Qollarim ogir edi.

paras.en: “Well, do you feel better now?”
paras.uz: "Hozir ozingizni yaxshiroq his qilyapsizmi?"

paras.en: “Yes, thank you. I think I am getting normal again.”
paras.uz: "Ha, rahmat. Men yana normallashyapman deb oylayman.

paras.en: He let me go. He lifted his eyes, looked upward, and I noticed his Adam’s apple for the first time; it resembles a broken spring, sticking out from beneath the upholstery of a divan.
paras.uz: U meni qoyib yubordi. U kozlarini kotardi, kordi va men birinchi marta Odam Atoning olmasini payqadim; u modaning qopolligidan chiqib ketgan singan bahorga oxshardi.

paras.en: Above us, not very high (about 50 meters) aeros were buzzing. By their low, slow flight and by the observation tubes which hung down, I recognized them. They were the aeros of the Guardians. But there were not two or three, as usual, there were about ten or twelve (I regret to have to confine myself to an approximate figure).
paras.uz: Biz yuqorida, juda baland emas edi (taxminan 50 metr) aerovokzal. ularning past tomonidan, sekin parvoz va ularni osib kuzatuv kuzatish yoli bilan, Men ularni tan. Ular soqchilar havo bor edi. lekin ikki yoki uch yoq edi, odatdagidek, haqida on yoki on ikki bor edi (Men bir taxminiy soni bilan ozimni yopish uchun uzr).

paras.en: “Why are there so many today?” I dared to ask S-.
paras.uz: "Nega bugun shunchalik kop?" Men S-ni sorashga jurat etdim.

paras.en: “Why? Hm.⁠ ⁠… A real physician begins to treat a patient when he is still well but on the way to becoming sick tomorrow, day-after-tomorrow or within a week. Prophylaxis! Yes!”
paras.uz: "Nima uchun?... Haqiqiy shifokor bemorni hali ham yaxshi bolganida, lekin ertaga, kundan-kunga yoki bir hafta ichida kasal bolish yolida davolashni boshlaydi.

paras.en: He nodded and went splashing over the stones of the yard. Then he turned his head and said over his shoulder, “Be careful!”
paras.uz: U ornidan turib, hovlining tosh ustiga otib ketdi. Song boshini ogirib, elkasiga dedi: Ehtiyot boling!

paras.en: Again I was alone. Silence. Emptiness. Far beyond the Green Wall the birds and the wind. What did he mean? My aero ran very fast with the wind. Light and heavy shadows from the clouds. Below blue cupolas, cubes of glass-ice were becoming leaden and swelling.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yashil devordan tashqarida qushlar va shamol nimani anglatadi? Mening havom shamol bilan juda tez otdi. Bulutlardan yoruglik va ogir soyalar.Kok kosulalar ostida shisha muz kublari etakchi bolib qoldi.

paras.en: The Same Evening
paras.uz: Xuddi shu kecha

paras.en: I took up my pen just now in order to write upon these pages a few thoughts which, it seems to me, will prove useful for you, my readers. These thoughts are concerned with the great Day of Unanimity which is now not far away. But as I sat down, I discovered that I cannot write at present; instead I sit and listen to the wind beating the glass with its dark wings; all the while I am busy looking about and I am waiting, expecting.⁠ ⁠… What? I do not know. So I was very glad when I saw the brownish-pink gills enter my room, heartily glad I may say. She sat down and innocently smoothed a fold of her unif that fell between her knees, and very soon she pasted upon me, all over me, a host of smiles⁠—a bit of a smile on each crack of my face and this gave me pleasant sensations, as if I were tightly bound like an infant of the ancients in a swaddling-cloth.
paras.uz: Men hozir ushbu sahifalarda bir nechta fikrlarni yozish uchun qalamimni oldim, bu men uchun foydali bolib tuyuladi, oquvchilarim uchun foydali boladi.Ammo men otirganimda, men hozirda yoza olmasligimni aniqladim; buning orniga men otirib, qorongi qanotlari bilan shishani urib turgan shamolni tingladim; barcha band bolganimda va kutayotganimda, nima deb oylayman. U otirdi va oyoqlari orasiga tushib qolgan bir varaqni begunoh yumshatdi va juda tez orada u menga, mening atrofimda, kop tabassum qildi - yuzimdagi har bir yoriqda bir oz tabassum qildi va bu menga yoqimli his-tuygularni berdi, goyo men eski kiyimdagi chaqaloq kabi qattiq boglangan edim.

paras.en: “Imagine! Today, when I entered the classroom” (she works in the Child-Educational Refinery), “I suddenly noticed a caricature upon the blackboard. Indeed! I assure you! They had pictured me in the form of a fish! Perhaps I really⁠—”
paras.uz: "Bugun men sinfga kirganimda (u bolalar uchun talim bolimida ishlaydi), "Men tosatdan qora taxtada karikaturani kordim! Men sizni ishontirib aytamanki, ular meni baliq shaklida suratga olishgan!

paras.en: “No, no! Why do you say that?” I hastily exclaimed. When one was near her, it was clear indeed that she had nothing resembling gills. No. When I referred to gills in these pages I was certainly irreverent.
paras.uz: "Yoq, nima uchun bunday deysiz?" Men zudlik bilan soradim. Uning yonida bolganimda, u hech qanday gril yoqligi aniq edi.Yoq, men bu sahifalardagi grillarga murojaat qilganimda, men, albatta, befarq edim.

paras.en: “Oh, after all it does not matter. But the act as such, think of it! Of course I called the Guardians at once. I love children very much and I think that the most difficult and the most exalted love is⁠—cruelty. You understand me, of course.”
paras.uz: "Oh, bu muhim emas, lekin bunday harakat, albatta, men bir vaqtning ozida soqchilarni chaqirdim. Men bolalarni juda yaxshi koraman va menimcha, eng qiyin va eng shafqatsiz sevgi - shafqatsizlik.

paras.en: “Certainly!” Her sentence so closely resembled my thoughts! I could not refrain from reading to her a passage from my Record No. 20, beginning “Quietly, metallically, distinctly, do the thoughts”⁠ ⁠… etc. I felt her brownish-pink cheeks twitching and coming closer and closer to me. Suddenly I felt in my hands her firm, dry, even slightly prickling fingers.
paras.uz: Uning sozlari mening fikrlarimga juda oxshash edi! Men unga 20 -sonli yozuvimdan "Sokin, metall, aniq, fikrlarni bajaring va hokazolardan boshlab, unga oqishni toxtata olmadim. Uning jigarrang-pushti boyinboglari ozgarib, menga yaqinroq va yaqinroq ekanligini his qildim. tosatdan men uning qolida qattiq, quruq, hatto biroz jirkanch barmoqlarini his qildim.

paras.en: “Give, give this to me please. I shall have it phonographed and make the children learn it by heart. Not only your Venerians need all this, but we ourselves right now, tomorrow, day-after-tomorrow.”
paras.uz: “Menga buni bering, iltimos. Men uni fonografiya qilaman va bolalarni yurak bilan organaman. nafaqat sizning venesuelalaringiz bularning barchasiga muhtoj, balki biz hozir, ertaga, kundan-kunga ozimizni ozimiz qilamiz”.

paras.en: She glanced around and said in a very low voice:
paras.uz: U atrofga qarab, juda past ovozda dedi:

paras.en: “Have you heard, they say that on the Day of Unanimity⁠—”
paras.uz: Сен: «Эй Пайғамбарлар! Улар: «Биринчи кун», дерлар.

paras.en: I sprang to my feet.
paras.uz: Oyogimga chokib ketdim.

paras.en: “What? What do they say? What⁠—on the Day of Unanimity?”
paras.uz: Улар: «Қиёмат куни нима дерлар?» дерлар.

paras.en: The coziness of my room, its very walls, seemed to have vanished. I felt myself thrown outside, where the tremendous, shaggy wind was tossing about and where the slanting clouds of dusk were descending lower and lower.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Mening xonam, uning juda devorlari goyib bolganga oxshaydi. Men ozimni tashqariga tashlaganimni his qildim, u erda ulkan, soyali shamol tosib qoyilgan va chang bulutlari quyi va past bolgan joyda.

paras.en: U- boldly and firmly grasped me by the shoulders. I even noticed how her fingers, responding to my emotion, trembled slightly.
paras.uz: U qollarim bilan meni qattiq va qatiy tushunishdi. Hatto barmoqlarim qanday qilib mening his-tuygularimga javob berishini, biroz gazabimni uygotdi.

paras.en: “Sit down, dear, and don’t be upset. They say many things; must we believe them all? Moreover, if only you need me, I shall be near you on that day. I shall leave the schoolchildren with someone else and I shall stay with you, for you, dear, you too are a child and you need.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Otiring, azizam, xafa bolmang. Ular kop narsalarni aytishlari kerakmi? Bundan tashqari, agar siz menga kerak bolsangiz, osha kuni men sizga yaqin bolaman. Men maktab oquvchilarini boshqa birov bilan qoldiraman va men siz bilan qolaman, chunki siz ham bolasiz va sizga kerak. "

paras.en: “No, no!” (I raised my hands in protest). “Not for anything! You really think then that I am a child and that I cannot do without a.⁠ ⁠… Oh, no! Not for anything in the world.” (I must confess I had other plans for that day!)
paras.uz: "Yoq, yoq!" (Men qolimni kotarib, hech narsa uchun emas, balki, albatta, men bir bola emasman, deb oylayman va men bir holda qila olmaydi, deb oylayman.

paras.en: She smiled. The wording of that smile apparently was: “Oh, what a stubborn, what a stubborn boy!” She sat down, eyelids lowered. Her hands modestly busied themselves with fixing the fold of the unif which fell again between her knees, and suddenly, about something entirely different, she said:
paras.uz: U tabassum qildi: "Oh, qanday ojar bola!" U otirdi va ornidan turdi. Uning qollari tizzalari orasiga tushib qolgan bir bolakning qopqogini mahkam boglab, tosatdan butunlay boshqacha narsa haqida shunday dedi:

paras.en: “I think I must decide⁠ ⁠… for your sake.⁠ ⁠… But I implore you, do not hurry me. I must think it over.”
paras.uz: "Men qaror qabul qilishim kerak deb oylayman ... lekin men sizni rad etaman, shoshilmang. buni oylab korishim kerak."

paras.en: I did not hurry her, although I realized that I ought to have been delighted, as there is no greater honor than to crown someone’s evening years.
paras.uz: Men uni shoshiltirmadim, garchi men xursand bolishim kerakligini tushungan bolsam-da, chunki kimningdir tungi yillarini toj kiyishdan kattaroq sharaf yoq.

paras.en: … All night strange wings were about. I walked and protected my head with my hands from those wings. And a chair, not like ours, but an ancient chair, came in with a horse-like gait: first the right fore- and left hind-leg, then the left fore- and right hind-leg. It rushed to my bed and crawled into it, and I liked that wooden chair, although it made me uncomfortable and caused me some pain.
paras.uz: Men butun tun galati qanotlari atrofida edi. va men osha qanotlari qollarim bilan boshimni himoya. va bir stul, emas, balki bizning eski stul kabi, otga oxshash koylagi bilan keldi: avval ong old va chap oyoq, keyin chap old va ong oyoq.U mening toshagimga yugurib, unga osha yogoch stulni yoqdi, garchi bu meni bezovta qildi va menga ogriq keltirdi.

paras.en: It is very strange; is it really impossible to find any cure for this dream-sickness, or to make it rational, perhaps even useful?
paras.uz: Bu juda galati; bu tush kasalligi uchun hech qanday davolash topish yoki uni oqilona qilish, ehtimol, hatto foydali?

paras.en: The benumbed waves⁠—Everything is improving⁠—I am a microbe.
paras.uz: Karaxt to'lqinlar — Ishlar yaxshilanmoqda — Men mikrobman.

paras.en: Please imagine that you stand at the seashore. The waves go rhythmically up, down, up.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly when they have risen they remain in that position, benumbed, torpid! It was just as weird and unnatural when everything became confused and our regular walk which is prescribed by the Tables, suddenly came to an end. The last time such a thing happened was 119 years ago, when according to our historians a meteorite fell hissing and fuming into the very midst of the marchers. We were walking yesterday as usual, that is like warriors on the Assyrian monuments, a thousand heads and two composite, integrated legs and two swinging integrated arms. At the end of the avenue where the Accumulating Tower was formidably resounding, a quadrangle appeared: on the sides, in front and behind⁠—guards; in the centre three Numbers. Their unifs were already stripped of the golden State badges; everything was painfully clear. The enormous dial on the top of the Tower looked like a face; it bent down from the clouds and spitting down its seconds, it waited with indifference. It showed six minutes past thirteen exactly. There was some confusion in the quadrangle. I was very close and I saw the most minute details. I clearly remember a thin, long neck and on the temple a confused net of small blue veins like rivers on the map of a small unfamiliar world, and that unknown world was apparently still a very young man. He evidently noticed someone in our ranks; he stopped, rose upon his tiptoes and stretched his neck. One of the guards snapped his back with the bluish spark of the electric whip⁠—he squealed in a thin voice like a puppy. The distinct snaps followed each other at intervals of approximately two seconds; a snap and a squeal, a snap and a squeal.⁠ ⁠… We continued to walk as usual, rhythmically, in our Assyrian manner. I watched the graceful zigzags of the electric sparks and thought: “Human society is constantly improving, as it should. How ugly a tool was the ancient whip and how much beauty there is⁠—”
paras.uz: Iltimos, dengiz qirgogida turganingizni tasavvur qiling.Tolqinlar asta-sekin yuqoriga kotariladi, yuqoriga kotariladi.... tosatdan ular osha pozitsiyada qolishdi, sanab otilgan, tosatdan hamma narsa chalkashib ketdi va stollar tomonidan belgilangan odatiy yurishimiz kabi galati va gayritabiiy edi.Songgi marta bunday voqea 119 yil oldin sodir bolgan edi, bizning leyborizmimiz yurish va yurishlar ortasida aylanib yurganimizda. Ularning bolaklari allaqachon oltin davlat kamarlari bilan qoplangan edi; hamma narsa aniq edi; Qalaning tepasida ulkan terish yuzga oxshardi; u bulutlardan pastga tushib, uning soniyalarini korsatdi, bu aniq on uch daqiqali farq bilan kutib oldi.Men juda yaqin edim va men eng kichik malumotlarni kordim. Men kichkina nomalum dunyo xaritasidagi daryolar kabi nozik, uzun boyin va mabaddagi chalkash kok tomirlarning togriligini aniq eslayman va u hali ham nomalum odam ekanligini kordi; u toxtadi, oyoqlariga kotarilib, boyninininini tirnaydi. Alohida boshliqlar taxminan ikki soniya oraligida bir-biriga ergashdi; bir eshak va skalyar, shpal va shpal.... Biz odatdagidek yurishni davom ettirdik, ritmik ravishda, bizning yolimiz bilan. Men elektr uchqunlarining yoqimli zigzaglarini kordim va oyladim: "Inson jamiyati doimo yaxshilanmoqda, u kerak bolganidek, qadimiy qamchi qanchalik yomon edi va qancha gozallik bor

paras.en: At that moment, like a nut flying from a wheel revolving at full speed, a female Number, thin, flexible and tense, tore herself from our rows, and with a cry, “Enough! Don’t you dare!” she threw herself straight into the quadrangle. It was like the meteorite of 119 years ago; our march came to a standstill and our rows appeared like the gray crests of waves frozen by sudden cold. For a second I looked at that woman’s figure with the eye of a stranger as all the others did. She was no Number any longer; she was only a human being and she existed for us only as a substantiation of the insult which she cast upon the United State. But a motion of hers, her bending while twisting to the left upon her hips, revealed to me clearly who she was. I knew, I knew that body, flexible as a whip! My eyes, my lips, my hands knew it; at that moment I was absolutely certain.⁠ ⁠… Two of the guards dashed to catch her. One more moment and that limpid mirror-like point on the pavement would have become the point of meeting of their trajectories, and she would have been caught! My heart fell, stopped. Without thinking whether it was permissible or not, whether it was reasonable or absurd, I threw myself straight to that point.
paras.uz: Osha paytda, toliq tezlikda uchib ketayotgan yongoq kabi, bir ayol soni, nozik, moslashuvchan va qopol, bizning qator ozini urdi, va bir yiglab bilan, "Yetarli! U togridan-togri tort burchakli ogirib yubordi. Bu bir necha yil oldin tolqin tolqinlarning kulrang panjara kabi paydo boldi va bizning qator tolqinlar tosatdan sovuq muzlatilgan kabi paydo boldi. bir soniya uchun men bu ayolning korinishiga qaradim, u endi emas edi; u faqat odam edi va u faqat biz uchun mavjud edi, u bitta davlat ustiga tashlagan haqorat bir qismi sifatida. Kozlarim, lablarim, qollarim osha paytda buni bilar edi. ... Yana bir daqiqa va kozguga oxshash kozguga oxshash nuqta ularning traektoriyalarining yigilishi nuqtasi bolar edi va u qolga olingan bolar edi! Mening yuragim toxtab qoldi, bu mantiqiy yoki bemani bolganmi, oylab kormasdan, ozimni shu nuqtaga tashladim.

paras.en: I felt thousands of eyes bulging with horror fixed upon me but that only added a sort of desperately joyful power to that wild being with hairy paws which arose in me and ran faster and faster. Two more steps⁠—she turned around⁠—
paras.uz: Men minglab kozlarni dahshatli tarzda orab oldim, lekin bu menga kirib, tezroq va tezroq yugurib boradigan soch tokilishiga yoqimli kuch qoshdi.

paras.en: I saw a quivering face covered with freckles, red eyebrows.⁠ ⁠… It was not she! Not I-330!
paras.uz: Kordimki, kozlari qora, kozlari qizil, kozlari yoq!

paras.en: A rabid, quivering joy took hold of me. I wanted to shout something like: “Catch her! Get her, that⁠—” But I heard only my whisper. A heavy hand was already upon my shoulder; I was caught and led away. I tried to explain to them:
paras.uz: Men xursand bolib yiglab yubordim: "Uni oling, uni oling! - Men faqat mening qichqirigimni eshitdim. Ogir qolim allaqachon elkamga tushdi; men qolga tushib, ularga tushuntirishga harakat qildim:

paras.en: “But listen, you must understand that I thought that.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ammo tinglang, men buni oylaganimni tushunishingiz kerak ..."

paras.en: But could I explain even to myself all the sickness which I have described in these pages? My light went out; I waited obediently. As a leaf that is torn from its branch by a sudden gust of wind falls humbly, but on its way down turns and tries to catch every little branch, every fork, every knot; so I tried to catch every one of the silent, globe-like heads, or the transparent ice of the walls, or the blue needle of the Accumulating Tower which seemed to pierce the clouds.
paras.uz: Ammo men bu sahifalarda tasvirlab bergan barcha kasalliklarni ozimga tushuntirib bera olamanmi? Mening yorugligim chiqib ketdi; Men itoatkorlik bilan kutdim.Uning boynidan shamol tosatdan yogilib ketgan barg sifatida pastga aylanadi va har bir kichik novdani, har bir tugunni olishga harakat qiladi; shuning uchun men har bir sokin, dunyoga oxshash bosh yoki devorlarning shaffof muzini yoki bulutlarni teshib yuboradigan kok ignasini olishga harakat qildim.

paras.en: At that moment, when a heavy curtain was about to separate from me this beautiful world, I noticed not far away a familiar, enormous head gliding over the mirror surface of the pavement and wagging its winglike ears. I heard a familiar, flat voice:
paras.uz: Osha paytda, ogir parda mendan bu gozal dunyoni ajratib olmoqchi bolganida, men uzoqdan tanish, ulkan boshni kormadim, uning tashqi korinishining oyna yuzasi ustidan gijirlatib, quloqlariga oxshashini eshitdim. tanish, tekis ovoz eshitdim:

paras.en: “I deem it my duty to testify that Number D-503 is ill and is unable to regulate his emotions. Moreover, I am sure that he was led by natural indignation⁠—”
paras.uz: "Men D-503 raqami kasal ekanligini va uning his-tuygularini tartibga sola olmasligini tasdiqlash mening vazifam deb hisoblayman.

paras.en: “Yes! Yes!” I exclaimed, “I even shouted ‘catch her!’ ”
paras.uz: Men: "Ha, men hatto uni qolga oldim!" - dedim.

paras.en: From behind me: “You did not shout anything.”
paras.uz: Менинг ортимдан: «Сизлар ҳеч бир жон жамламадингиз», деди.

paras.en: “No, but I wanted to. I swear by the Well-Doer, I wanted to!”
paras.uz: Йўқ! Бас, Мен Роҳман ила қасам ичдим.

paras.en: For a second I was bored through by the gray, cold, drill-eyes. I don’t know whether he believed that what I said was the truth (almost!), or whether he had some secret reason for sparing me for a while, but he wrote a short note, handed it to one of those who had held me and again I was free. That is, I was again included in the orderly, endless, Assyrian rows of Numbers.
paras.uz: Bir soniya davomida men kulrang, sovuq, burgulash kozlari bilan charchadim. U mening aytganlarim haqiqat ekanligiga ishonganmi yoki u meni bir muncha vaqt ushlab turish uchun biron bir yashirin sabab bor edimi, bilmayman (deyarli!), lekin u qisqa eslatma yozdi, meni ushlab turganlardan biriga berdi va yana ozod boldim.

paras.en: The quadrangle, the freckled face and the temple with the map of blue veinlets disappeared forever around the corner. We walked again⁠—a million-headed body; and in each one of us resided that humble joyfulness with which in all probability molecules, atoms and phagocytes live.
paras.uz: Tortburchak, muzlatilgan yuz va kok tomirlar xaritasi bilan mabad burchak atrofida abadiy yoqoldi.Biz yana bir million boshli tanani bosib otdik; va har birimiz barcha potentsial molekulalar, atomlar va fagotsitlar yashaydigan kamtar quvonchni boshdan kechirdik.

paras.en: In the ancient days the Christians understood this feeling; they are our only (though very imperfect) direct forerunners. The greatness of the “Church of the United Flock” was known to them. They knew that resignation is virtue, and pride⁠—a vice; that “We” is from God, “I” from the devil.
paras.uz: Qadimgi davrlarda masihiylar bu tuyguni tushunishgan; ular bizning yagona (juda nomukammal) togridan-togri oldingi yuguruvchilarimiz. "Birlashgan suruv cherkovi ning buyukligi ularga malum edi.

paras.en: I was walking, keeping step with the others yet separated from them. I was still trembling from the emotion just felt, like a bridge over which a thundering ancient steel train has passed a moment before. I felt myself. To feel one’s self, to be conscious of one’s personality, is the lot of an eye inflamed by a cinder, or an infected finger, or a bad tooth. A healthy eye, or finger, or tooth is not felt; it is nonexistent as it were. Is it not clear then, that consciousness of oneself is a sickness?
paras.uz: Men piyoda yurgan edim, boshqalar bilan bir-biridan ajralib turdim.Men hali ham eski polatdan yasalgan poezd bir lahza oldin otgan koprik kabi his qilardim.Ozimni his qilish, oz shaxsiyatini anglash, koz pardasi yoki zararlangan barmogining kopligi yoki yomon tish; soglom koz yoki barmoq his qilinmaydi; u aniq emas, bu oz-ozini anglash kasallikmi?

paras.en: Apparently I am no longer a phagocyte which quietly, in a businesslike way devours microbes (microbes with freckled faces and blue temples); apparently I am myself a microbe, and she too, I-330, is a microbe, a wonderful, diabolic microbe! It is quite possible that there are already thousands of such microbes among us, still pretending to be phagocytes, as I pretend. What if today’s accident, although in itself not important, is only a beginning, only the first meteorite of a shower of burning and thundering stones which the infinite may have poured out upon our glass paradise?
paras.uz: Korinishidan, men hali ham bizning oramizda minglab bunday mikroblar mavjud bolishi mumkin, ular hali ham fagotsitlar bolib qolmoqdalar. Bugungi baxtsiz hodisa, oz-ozidan muhim bolmasa-da, faqat boshlangich bolsa-da, faqat yonish va yonish dushining birinchi qismi bolsa-da, bizning shisha idishlarimizga tokilmasligi mumkin.

paras.en: Flowers⁠—The dissolution of a crystal⁠—If only (?).
paras.uz: Gullar — Kristallning erishi — Qaniydi (?).

paras.en: They say there are flowers that bloom only once in a hundred years. Why not suppose the existence of flowers that bloom only once a thousand years? We may have known nothing about them until now only because today is the “once in a thousand years”?
paras.uz: Ular yuz yilda faqat bir marta gullaydigan gullar borligini aytishadi. Nima uchun faqat ming yilda bir marta gullaydigan gullarning mavjudligini taxmin qilmaslik kerak?Biz ular haqida hech narsa bilmas edik, chunki bugungi kunda "ming yilda bir marta?

paras.en: Happy and dizzy I walked downstairs to the controller on duty and quickly under my gaze all around me and silently the thousand-year-old buds burst, and everything was blooming: armchairs, shoes, golden badges, electric bulbs, someone’s dark heavy eyes, the polished columns of the banisters, the handkerchief which someone lost on the stairs, the small, inkblotted desk of the controller and the tender brown, somewhat freckled cheeks of U-. Everything seemed not ordinary, new, tender, rosy, moist. U- took the pink stub from me while the blue, aromatic moon, hanging from an unseen branch, shone through the glass of the wall and over the head of U-. With a solemn gesture I pointed my finger and said:
paras.uz: Baxtli va boshashgan men atrofimdagi nazoratchi tomon yugurdim va atrofimda tez yurib, minglab yillik kurtaklarning oqlari va hamma narsa gullab-yashnadi: qollar, poyabzallar, oltin kamarlar, elektr lampochkalar, birovning qorongu ogir kozlari, zinapoyalarda yoqolgan qol ushlagichi, kichik, siyohlangan boshqaruv stoli va tender jigarrang, bir oz muzlatilgan U -. hamma narsa oddiy emas, yangi, yumshoq, zangli, nam bolib tuyuldi.

paras.en: “The moon. You see?”
paras.uz: Ойни кўринг-чи?!» деди.

paras.en: U- glanced at me, then at the number of the stub and again made that familiar, charmingly innocent movement with which she fixes the fold of the unif between her knees.
paras.uz: U-menga qarab, song osha tanish, begunoh harakatni yana kordi, u bilan uning tizzalari orasidagi boginning qopqogini ornatdi.

paras.en: “You look abnormal and ill, dear. Abnormality and illness are the same thing. You are killing yourself. And no one would tell you that, no one!”
paras.uz: "Siz gayritabiiy va kasal korinasiz, azizim, gayritabiiylik va kasallik bir xil narsa. Siz ozingizni oldiryapsiz va hech kim sizga buni aytmaydi! "

paras.en: That “No one” was certainly equivalent to the number on the stub⁠—I-330. This thought was confirmed by an inkblot which fell close to the figure 330. Dear, wonderful U-! You are right, of course. I am not reasonable. I am sick. I have a soul. I am a microbe. But is blooming⁠—not a sickness? Is it not painful when the buds are bursting? And don’t you think that spermatozoa are the most terrible of all microbes?
paras.uz: "Hech kim shubhasiz oqdagi raqamga teng edi - I-330. Bu fikr 330 raqamiga yaqin bolgan inkblot tomonidan tasdiqlangan. azizim, ajoyib U-! Siz togrisiz. Men togrisiz.Men kasalman. Men kasalman. Lekin men gullashni emas, balki kasallikmi? kurtaklari yorilganda ogriqli emasmi? Va siz spermatozoa barcha mikroblarning eng dahshatlisi deb oylaysizmi?

paras.en: Back upstairs to my room. In the widely open cup of the armchair was I-330. I, on the floor, embracing her limbs, my head on her lap. We were silent. Everything was silent. Only the pulse was audible. Like a crystal I was dissolving in her, in I-330. I felt most distinctly how the polished facets which limited me in space were slowly thawing, melting away. I was dissolving in her lap, in her, and I became at once smaller and larger and larger, unembraceable. For she was not she but the whole universe. For a second I and that armchair near the bed, transfixed with joy, we were one. And the wonderfully smiling old woman at the gate of the Ancient House, and the wild debris beyond the Green Wall, and some strange silver wreckage on a black background, dozing like the old woman and the slam of a door in the distance⁠—all this was within me, was listening to my pulse and soaring through the happiest of seconds.
paras.uz: Men, polda, bosh barmogimni qoydim.Biz jim boldik.Faqat uning ichida eriydigan kristall singari, I-330 da.Men uning tizzasida tarqatib yubordim va men bir vaqtning ozida kattaroq va kattaroq, katta bolib qoldim. U emas edi, balki butun koinot edi. Qadimgi uyning eshigidagi dahshatli keksa ayol va Yashil devor ustidagi yovvoyi xarobalar va qora fonda bazi galati kumush qirgin, eski ayol va uzoqdagi eshikning yorilishi kabi - bularning barchasi mening ichimda edi, mening pulimni eshitib, eng baxtli soniyalar ichida yiglab yubordim.

paras.en: In absurd, confused, overflowing words I attempted to tell her that I was a crystal and that there was a door in me, and that I felt how happy the armchair was. But something nonsensical came out of the attempt and I stopped. I was ashamed. And suddenly:
paras.uz: Ahmoqona, chalkash, bemani sozlar bilan men unga kristal ekanligimni va menda eshik borligini va qol stulining qanchalik baxtli ekanligini aytishga harakat qildim. Ammo ahmoqona narsa urinishdan chiqib ketdi va men toxtadim. Va birdan:

paras.en: “Dear I-! Forgive me! I understand nothing. I talk so foolishly!”
paras.uz: Эй Роббим, мени мағфират қил! Мен ҳеч нарсани алмаштирмасман.

paras.en: “And why should you think that foolishness is not fine? If we had taken pains to educate human foolishness through centuries, as we have done with our intelligence, it might perhaps have been transformed into something very precious.”
paras.uz: "Agar biz asrlar davomida inson ongini orgatish uchun ogriqlarni boshdan kechirgan bolsak, ehtimol bu juda qimmatli narsaga aylangan bolishi mumkin."

paras.en: Yes, I think she is right! How could she be wrong at that moment?
paras.uz: Ha, u togri deb oylayman, u qanday qilib osha paytda notogri bolishi mumkin?

paras.en: “… And for this foolishness of yours and for what you did yesterday during the walk, I love you the more, much more.”
paras.uz: «Сизнинг ваъдангизнинг маълумоти ва юзингиз учун, албатта, мен сени кўпроқ, кўпроқ яхши кўраман», деди.

paras.en: “Then why did you torture me? Why would you not come? Why did you send me the pink check and make me⁠—?”
paras.uz: Сўнгра нима учун мени лаънатламадинг? Бас, нима учун менга пуфни юбормаяпсан?!» деди.

paras.en: “Perhaps I wanted to test you. Perhaps I must be sure that you will do anything I wish, that you are completely mine.”
paras.uz: "Ehtimol, men sizni sinab kormoqchi edim. Ehtimol, siz xohlagan narsani qilishingizga amin bolishim kerak, siz butunlay menikisiz."

paras.en: “Yes, completely.”
paras.uz: «Ha, butunlay».

paras.en: She took my face, my whole self, between her palms, lifted my head:
paras.uz: Butun vujudimni, butun vujudimni oz bagriga oldi-da:

paras.en: “And how about ‘It is the duty of every honest Number’? Eh?”
paras.uz: Va "Bu har bir halol raqamning vazifasi-chi?

paras.en: Sweet, sharp, white teeth⁠—a smile. In the open cup of the armchair she was like a bee⁠—sting and honey combined.
paras.uz: Shirin, otkir, oq tishlar - bir tabassum. qol shkafi ochiq piyola u pivo kabi edi-tushirish va asal birlashgan edi.

paras.en: Yes, duty.⁠ ⁠… I turned over in my mind the pages of my records; indeed there is not a thought about the fact that strictly speaking I should.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Togri, men oz sahifamni ozgartirdim; haqiqatan ham men qatiy gapirishim kerak bolgan haqiqat haqida fikr yoq ...

paras.en: I was silent. Exaltedly (and probably stupidly) I smiled, looking into the pupils of her eyes. I followed first one eye and then the other and in each of them I saw myself, a millimetric self imprisoned in those tiny rainbow cells. Then again the lips and the sweet pain of blooming.
paras.uz: Men jim boldim. (va ehtimol ahmoq) Men uning kozlari oquvchilariga qarab kulib yubordim, avval bir kozni, songra har birida ozimni kordim, keyin bu kichik jingalak hujayralarda ogiz va gullashning shirin ogrigi.

paras.en: In each Number of the United State there is an unseen metronome which tick-tocks silently; without looking at the clock we know exactly the time of day within five minutes. But now my metronome had stopped and I did not know how much time had passed. In fright I grasped my badge with its clock from under the pillow. Glory be to the Well-Doer! I had twenty minutes more! But those minutes were such tiny, short ones! They ran! And I wanted to tell her so many things. I wanted to tell her all about myself; about the letter from O- and about that terrible evening when I gave her a child; and for some reason also about my childhood, about our mathematician Plappa and about the square-root of minus one; and how, when I attended the glorification on the Day of Unanimity for the first time in my life, I wept bitterly because there was an ink-stain on my unif⁠—on such a holy day!
paras.uz: "Bir davlatning har bir raqamida besh daqiqa ichida kunning aniq vaqtini aniq bilamiz; lekin endi mening metrom toxtab qoldi va qancha vaqt otganini bilmasdim.Qorqib, men soatimni yostiq ostidan soat bilan ushladim. "Yaxshi ish qiluvchi!" Ammo bu kichik, qisqa daqiqalar edi! Va men unga juda kop narsalarni aytmoqchi edim. Men unga ozim haqimda hamma narsani aytmoqchi edim; O-dan kelgan maktub va osha dahshatli kecha haqida unga bola berganimda; va bolaligim haqida, shuningdek, mening bolalikm haqida, bizning ulugvor Plappamiz va mening hayotimdagi birinchi marta birdamlik kuni ulugvorligida qatnashganimda, men boynimda ichki dog bolganligi sababli achchiq yigladim - bunday muqaddas kunda!

paras.en: I-330 lifted her head. She leaned on her elbow. In the corners of her lips two long, sharp lines and the dark angle of lifted eyebrows⁠—a cross.
paras.uz: I-330 boshini kotardi. U elkasiga chokdi. Uning lablarining burchaklarida ikki uzun, otkir chiziqlar va kotarilgan kokraklarning qorongi burchagi - xoch.

paras.en: “Perhaps on that day⁠ ⁠…” her brow grew darker; she took my hand and pressed it hard. “Tell me, will you ever forget me? Will you always remember me?”
paras.uz: «Ehtimol, osha kuni... - uning qoli qorongilashib ketdi; u qolimni kotardi va qattiq tortdi. «Menga ayting, meni hech qachon unutasizmi?»

paras.en: “But why such talk? What is it, I-, dear?”
paras.uz: «Ҳолбуки, бу нима?» деди.

paras.en: She was silent. And her eyes were already sliding past me, through me, away into the distance. I suddenly heard the wind beating the glass with its enormous wings. Of course it had been blowing all the while but I had not noticed it until then. And for some reason those cawing birds over the Green Wall came to my mind.
paras.uz: U jim edi. Va uning kozlari allaqachon mendan uzoqda, men orqali otib ketdi. Men tosatdan uning ulkan qanotlari bilan shishani urib shamol eshitdim. albatta, u vaqt boyi chayqalayotgan edi, lekin men uni shu paytgacha sezmagan edim.
