paras.en: I-330 shook her head with a gesture of throwing something off. Once more she touched me for a second with her whole body, as an aero before landing touches the ground for a second with all the tension of a recoiling spring.
paras.uz: I-330 boshini silkitib, biron bir narsani ochirib qoyish bilan boshini tortdi. Yana bir bor u menga butun tanasi bilan bir soniyaga tegib ketdi, chunki u ikkinchi qavatga qaytib kelayotgan bahorning barcha kuchlanishlari bilan bir soniyaga qonishdan oldin.

paras.en: “Well, give me my stockings, quick!”
paras.uz: - Qani, tezroq bol-chi! - dedi.

paras.en: The stockings were on the desk, on the open manuscript, on page 124. Being in haste I caught some of the pages and they were scattered over the floor so that it was hard to put them back in the proper order. Moreover, even if I put them in that order there will be no real order; there are obstacles to that anyway, some undiscoverable unknowns.
paras.uz: Ular stol ustida edi, ochiq qolyozma, sahifasida 124. darhol bolib, men sahifalar bazi qolga va u togri tartibda ularni qaytarib qoyish qiyin edi, shunday qilib, pol ustiga tarqaldi. bundan tashqari, Men bu tartibda ularni qoyish bolsa ham, haqiqiy tartibi yoq boladi, agar; har qanday holatda ham, bazi nomalum nomalum tosiqlar bor.

paras.en: “I can’t bear it,” I said. “You are here, near me, yet you seem to be behind an opaque ancient wall; through that wall I hear a rustle and voices; I cannot make out the words, I don’t know what is there. I cannot bear it. You seem always to withhold something from me; you have never told me what kind of a place it was where I found myself that day beneath the Ancient House. Where did those corridors lead? Why was the doctor there⁠—or perhaps all that never happened?”
paras.uz: "Men uni kotara olmayman, - dedim men. - Siz bu yerdasiz, menga yaqinsiz, ammo siz qadimiy devor orqasida turganga oxshaysiz; bu devor orqali men sozlarni eshitmayman, u erda nima borligini bilmayman. Siz har doim mendan nimanidir ushlab turolmaysiz; siz menga osha kuni eski uy ostida ozimni qanday joyda topganimni hech qachon aytmadingiz.

paras.en: I-330 put her hands on my shoulders and slowly entered deeply into my eyes.
paras.uz: Men qollarimni qollarimga qoydim va asta-sekin kozlarimga chuqur kirib bordim.

paras.en: “You want to know all?”
paras.uz: "Siz hamma narsani bilishni xohlaysizmi?"

paras.en: “Yes, I do.”
paras.uz: "Ha, men qilaman

paras.en: “And you would not be afraid to follow me anywhere? Wherever I should lead you?”
paras.uz: Сен: «Менга эргашишдан қўрқмайсизларми?! Сизларни қаерга кетказаман?» деди.

paras.en: “Anywhere!”
paras.uz: Бас, Биз Унга Пайғамбар бўлиб юбордик. (Яъни, Муҳаммад (с. а. в.) ва Муҳаммад (с. а. в.) Бани Исроилнинг Исроилга Пайғамбарлик қилиб юбордилар.

paras.en: “All right then. I promise you, after the holiday, if only.⁠ ⁠… Oh yes, there is your Integral. I always forget to ask; will it soon be completed?”
paras.uz: Men sizga vada beraman, tatildan keyin, agar faqat... Oh, agar sizning integralingiz bolsa, men har doim sorashni unutaman; u tez orada tugaydimi? "

paras.en: “No. ‘If only’ what? Again! ‘If only’ what?”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, agar faqat »? «Agar yana bo'lsa nima bo'ladi?

paras.en: She, already at the door: “You shall see.”
paras.uz: У эшикда: «Сиз кўрурсиз», деди.

paras.en: I was again alone. All that she left behind her was a barely perceptible scent, similar to that of a sweet, dry, yellow dust of flowers from behind the Green Wall; also, sunk deeply within me, question marks like small hooks similar to those the ancients used for fishing (vide the Prehistoric Museum).
paras.uz: Men yana yolgiz edim. Uning orqasida qolgan hamma narsa yashil devor orqasida gullarning shirin, quruq, sariq changiga oxshash deyarli sezilmaydigan hid edi; shuningdek, ichimda chuqur bolib, baliq ovlash uchun ishlatiladigan qadimiylarga oxshash kichik ilgaklarga oxshash savollar paydo boldi (qadimgi muzeyga qarang).

paras.en: … Why did she suddenly ask about the Integral?
paras.uz: - Nega birdan sorab qoldi?

paras.en: The limit of the function⁠—Easter⁠—To cross out everything.
paras.uz: Funksiyaning limiti — Pasxa — Hammasining ustidan chiziq tortish.

paras.en: I am like a motor set in motion at a speed of too many revolutions per second, the bearings have become too hot and in one more minute the molten metal will begin to drip and everything will go to the devil. Cold water! Quick! Some logic! I pour pailfuls of it, but my logic merely sizzles on the hot metal and disappears in the air in the form of vapor.
paras.uz: Men sekundiga juda kop inqiloblar tezligida harakatlanayotgan dvigatelga oxshayman, rulmanlar juda issiq bolib qoldi va yana bir daqiqada eritilgan metall eriy boshlaydi va hamma narsa shaytonning oldiga boradi.

paras.en: Of course it is clear that in order to establish the true meaning of a function, one must establish its limit. It is also clear that yesterday’s “dissolution in the universe” taken to its limit is death. For death is exactly the most complete dissolution of the self in the universe. Hence: L = f(D), love is the function of death.
paras.uz: Albatta, funktsiyaning haqiqiy manosini ornatish uchun uning chegarasini belgilash kerak.Bundan tashqari, uning chegarasigacha bolgan kechaning "yuzi olimdir.Olim uchun koinotdagi oz-ozidan eng toliq yoq bolib ketadi.

paras.en: Yes, exactly, exactly! That is why I am afraid of I-330; I struggle against her, I don’t want.⁠ ⁠… But why is it that within me “I don’t want to” and “I want to” stand side by side? That is the chief horror of the matter; I continue to long for that happy death of yesterday. The horror of it is that even now, when I have integrated the logical function, when it becomes evident that the latter contains death hidden in it, nevertheless I long for it with my lips, arms, breast, with every millimeter.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ha, aynan! Shuning uchun men I-330 ga qarshi kurashaman, istamayman. ... Lekin nima uchun men ichimda "istamayman va "men buni xohlamayman yonma-yon turish? bu masalaning asosiy dahshati; bu kechaning baxtli olimi uchun uzoq davom etaman.

paras.en: Tomorrow is the Day of Unanimity. She will certainly be there and I shall see her, though from a distance. That distance will be painful to me, for I must be, I am inevitably drawn, close to her, so that her hands, her shoulder, her hair.⁠ ⁠… I long for even that pain.⁠ ⁠… Let it come.⁠ ⁠… Great Well-Doer! How absurd to desire pain! Who is ignorant of the simple fact that pains are negative items which reduce that sum total we call happiness? Consequently⁠ ⁠… Well, no “consequently”⁠ ⁠… Emptiness.⁠ ⁠… Nakedness!
paras.uz: U, albatta, u erda boladi va men uni koraman, uzoqdan bolsa ham. Bu masofa men uchun ogriqli boladi, chunki men unga yaqinman, uning qollari, elkasi, sochlari... Men hatto bu ogriq uchun uzoq bolaman. - Yaxshi, ogriqni xohlayman! - Ogriqlar qanchalik bemani, biz baxt deb ataydigan salbiy narsalar?

paras.en: The Same Evening.
paras.uz: Xuddi shu kecha.

paras.en: Through the glass wall of the house I see a disquieting, windy, feverishly pink, sunset. I move my armchair to avoid that pinkness and turn over these pages, and I find I am forgetting that I write this not for myself but for you unknown people whom I love and pity, for you who still lag centuries behind, below. Let me tell you about the Day of Unanimity, about that Great Day. I think that day for us is what Easter was for the ancients. I remember I used to prepare an hour-calendar the eve of that day; solemnly I would cross out every time the figure of the hour elapsed; nearer by one hour! one hour less to wait!⁠ ⁠… If I were certain that nobody would discover it, I assure you I should now too, make out such a calendar and carry it with me, and I should watch how many hours remain until tomorrow, when I shall see, at least from a distance.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uyning shisha devori orqali men bu pushtilikka yol qoymaslik uchun ozimning stulimni siljitaman va men buni ozim uchun emas, balki hali ham kop asrlar orqada qoladigan nomalum odamlar uchun yozayotganimni, quyida sizni yaxshi koradigan va qayguradigan odamlar uchun yozyapman.Oylaymanki, osha kuni biz uchun eng zor Pasxa qadimgilar uchun nima bolganligi haqida aytib beraman. Men osha kunning har bir soatini tayyorlash uchun ishlatgan edim; tantanali ravishda men soatning korsatkichini ochirib otdim; bir soatga kamroq kutish kerak! Agar uni hech kim kashf etmasligiga amin bolganimda, hozir ham shunday taqvimni tuzishim va men bilan birga olib borishim kerak edi va ertaga qancha soat qolishini, hech bolmaganda uzoqdan korishimni kuzatishim kerak edi.

paras.en: (I was interrupted. They brought me a new unif from the shop. As is customary, new unifs are given to us for tomorrow’s celebration. Steps in the hall, exclamations of joy, noises.)
paras.uz: (Men ishdan boshatildim. Ular menga dokondan yangi bir bolakni olib kelishdi.

paras.en: I shall continue; tomorrow I shall see the same spectacle which we see year after year and which always awakes in us fresh emotions, as though we saw it for the first time: an impressive throng of piously lifted arms. Tomorrow is the day of the yearly election of the Well-Doer. Tomorrow we shall again hand over to our Well-Doer the keys to the impregnable fortress of our happiness. Certainly this in no way resembles the disorderly, unorganized election-days of the ancients, on which (it seems so funny!) they did not even know in advance the result of the election. To build a state on some non-discountable contingencies, to build blindly⁠—what could be more nonsensical? Yet centuries were required to pass before this was understood!
paras.uz: Men davom etaman; Ertaga biz har yili koradigan va har doim yangi his-tuygularni uygotadigan xuddi shu narsani koraman, xuddi biz uni birinchi marta korganimiz kabi: har yili kotarilgan qollar tasirchan bolgan kun. ertaga biz yana Yaxshi-Doerning yillik saylov kuni boladi., albatta, bu bizning yaxshi niyatli tanlovimiz uchun kalitlarni qaytarib beramiz. albatta, qadimgilarning tartibsiz, tashkil etilmagan saylov kunlariga oxshab, ular hatto saylov natijasini oldindan bilmagan.

paras.en: Needless to say, we in this respect as in all others have no place for contingencies; nothing unexpected can happen. The elections themselves have rather a symbolic meaning. They remind us that we are a united, powerful organism of millions of cells, that⁠—, to use the language of the “gospel” of the ancients, we are a united church. The history of the United State knows not a single case in which upon this solemn day even a solitary voice has dared to violate the magnificent unison.
paras.uz: Shubhasiz, biz hamma joyda bolgani kabi, bu borada ham hech narsa sodir bolmaydi; kutilmagan hodisalar roy berishi mumkin emas.Ular bizga eslatib turadiki, biz millionlab hujayralarning birlashgan, kuchli organimiz, yani qadimgilarning " xushxabari tilidan foydalanish uchun biz birlashgan cherkovmiz.

paras.en: They say that the ancients used to conduct their elections secretly, stealthily like thieves. Some of our historians assert even that they would come to the electoral celebrations completely masked. Imagine the weird, fantastic spectacle! Night. A plaza. Along the walls the stealthily creeping figures covered with mantles. The red flame of torches dancing in the wind.⁠ ⁠… Why was such secrecy necessary? It has never been satisfactorily explained. Probably it resulted from the fact that elections were associated with some mystic and superstitious, perhaps even criminal ceremonies. We have nothing to conceal or to be ashamed of; we celebrate our election openly, honestly, in daylight. I see them all vote for the Well-Doer and everybody sees me vote for the Well-Doer. How could it be otherwise, since “all” and “I” are one “we”? How ennobling, sincere, lofty, is this compared with the cowardly, thievish “secrecy” of the ancients! Moreover, how much more expedient! For even admitting for a moment the impossible, that is the outbreak of some dissonance in our customary unity, in that case our unseen Guardians are always right there among us, are they not, to register the Numbers who would fall into error and save them from any further false steps? The United State is theirs, the Numbers’! And besides.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ular oz saylov sirlarini otkazish uchun ishlatiladi, deb aytish, yashirincha ogrilar kabi. bazi ota-bobolarimiz, hatto ular butunlay masked saylov keladi, deb ishora. bir kecha. bir plaza boylab. shamol raqs qizil olov boylab.... Bu hech qachon kerak edi. bu qoniqarli tushuntirib boldi. ehtimol, bu saylovlar bazi shafqatsiz va yuzaki bilan bogliq edi, ehtimol, hatto jinoiy jinoyatchilar. Biz yashirin yoki hatto xafa bolishi hech narsa yoq edi; Biz ochiq-oydin, halol, hamma-Doer uchun ovoz va meni koradi, chunki "men biz bir "biz? Qanchalik begubor, samimiy, loli, bu qadimgilarning qopol, ogri "sehri bilan solishtirganda! Bundan tashqari, qanchalik tez-tez! hatto imkonsiz bir lahza uchun, bu bizning cheksiz birlikimizda bazi bir tartibsizlikning boshlanishi, bu holda bizning qoriqchilarimiz har doim oramizda bolsa, ular yoq, ularni har qanday notogri qadamlardan qutqara oladigan raqamlarni royxatdan otkazish uchun emasmi?

paras.en: Through the wall to my left a she-number before the mirror-door of the closet; she is hastily unbuttoning her unif. For a second, swiftly⁠—eyes, lips, two sharp, pink⁠ ⁠… the curtains fell. Within me instantly awoke all that happened yesterday and now I no longer know what I meant to say by “besides.⁠ ⁠…” I no longer wish to;⁠—I cannot. I want one thing. I want I-330. I want her every minute, every second, to be with me, with no one else. All that I wrote about Unanimity is of no value; it is not what I want; I have a desire to cross it out, to tear it to pieces and throw it away. For I know (be it a sacrilege, yet it is the truth), that a glorious Day is possible only with her and only then when we are side by side, shoulder to shoulder. Without her the Sun of tomorrow will appear to me only as a little circle cut out of a tin sheet, and the sky a sheet of tin painted blue, and I myself⁠ ⁠… I snatched the telephone receiver.
paras.uz: Devordan otib, uning koylagining oynasi oldida u-raqamni oldim; u darhol uning birligini taqillatmoqda.Bir soniya ichida - kozlar, ikki otkir, pushti... pardalar qulab tushdi. Mening ichimda kecha sodir bolgan hamma narsani zudlik bilan bosib otdi va endi men "bundan tashqari nima demoqchi ekanligimni bilmayman. - Men bitta narsani xohlayman. - Men uni har daqiqada, har soniyada, men bilan birga bolishni xohlayman. Men hech kim bilan birga bolishni xohlayman; Men xohlagan narsa emas, uni kesib otish istagim bor; uni kesib otish, bolaklarni tashlash va uni tashlash istagim bor. Men bilaman uchun (bu qurbonlik bolsin, lekin u haqiqat), faqat u bilan mumkin, deb ulugvor kun va faqat biz yon tomonda bolsa, elka. u holda ertaga quyosh menga faqat bir kichik doira kesilgan kabi korinadi, va bir yupqa kok boyalgan osmon, va men ozim... Men telefon qabul qildim.

paras.en: “I-330, are you there?”
paras.uz: - I-330, sen shu yerdamisan? - deb soradi.

paras.en: “Yes, it is I. Why so late?”
paras.uz: - Yoq, nega kech boldi? - deb soradi.

paras.en: “Perhaps not too late yet. I want to ask you⁠ ⁠… I want you to be with me tomorrow⁠—dear!”
paras.uz: "Ehtimol, hali ham kech emas. Men sizdan soramoqchi edim ... ertaga men bilan birga bolishingizni xohlayman - azizim!"

paras.en: “Dear” I said in a very low voice. And for some reason a thing I saw this morning at the docks flashed through my mind: just for fun someone put a watch under the hundred-ton sledgehammer.⁠ ⁠… A swing, a breath of wind in the face and the silent hundred-ton, knife-like weight on the breakable watch.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Azizim men juda past ovoz bilan aytdim. Va bazi sabablarga kora men bu ertalab dokonda mening miyamga chaqmoq urganini kordim: shunchaki oyin-kulgi uchun kimdir yuz tonnali slayder ostida soat qoydi ... Yuzdagi shamol, yuzdagi shamol nafasi va boshashgan soatdagi pichoqqa oxshash ogirlik.

paras.en: A silence. I thought I heard someone’s whisper in I-330’s room. Then her voice:
paras.uz: Osha paytda men I-330 xonasida kimningdir ovozini eshitdim deb oyladim.

paras.en: “No, I cannot. Of course you understand that I myself.⁠ ⁠… No, I cannot. ‘Why?’ You shall see tomorrow.”
paras.uz: "Yoq, men qila olmayman. albatta, siz men ozim ekanligimni tushunasiz ... yoq, nega men qila olmayman? "Siz ertaga korasiz.

paras.en: Night.
paras.uz: Qaraldi: 9-iyul 2021-yil.

paras.en: The descent from heaven⁠—The greatest catastrophe in history⁠—The known ⸻ is ended.
paras.uz: Osmondan tushish — Tarixdagi eng katta falokat — Ma'lum ⸻ tugadi.

paras.en: At the beginning all arose, and the hymn, like a solemn mantle, slowly waved above our heads. Hundreds of tubes of the Musical Tower and millions of human voices. For a second I forgot everything; I forgot that alarming something at which I-330 hinted in connection with today’s celebration; I think I even forgot about her. At that moment I was the very same little boy who once wept because of a tiny ink-stain on his unif, which no one else could see. Even if it be so, if nobody sees that I am covered with black, ineffaceable stains, I know it, do I not? I know that there should be no place for a criminal like me among these frank open faces. What if I should rush forward and shout out all at once everything about myself! The end might follow. Let it! At least for a second I would feel myself clear and clean and senseless like that innocent blue sky.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Boshida hamma yigladi va boshimiz asta-sekin ogriyapti. Bir soniya davomida men hamma narsani unutib qoydim; Men bugungi bayram bilan bogliq bolgan I-330 ni unutgan narsani unutdim; Men hatto u haqida oylayman; Osha paytda men hech kim kormaydigan bolsa ham, agar men qora, chidab bolmaydigan doglar bilan qoplanganimni korsam ham, bilaman, men bu ochiq yuzlar orasida men kabi jinoyatchi uchun joy bolmasligi kerakligini bilaman. Hech bolmaganda bir soniya ozimni bu begunoh kok osmon kabi aniq va manosiz his qilardim ...

paras.en: All eyes were directed upward; in the pure morning blue, still moist with the tears of night, a small dark spot appeared. Now it was dark, now bathed in the rays of the sun. It was He, descending to us from the sky, He⁠—the new Jehovah⁠—in an aero, He, as wise and as lovingly cruel as the Jehovah of the ancients. Nearer and nearer, and higher toward him were drawn millions of hearts. Already he saw us. And in my mind with Him I looked over everything from the heights: concentric circles of stands marked with dotted blue lines of unifs⁠—like circles of a spiderweb strewn with microscopic suns (the shining of the badges). And in the centre there soon the wise white spider would occupy his place⁠—the Well-Doer clad in white, the Well-Doer who wisely tangled our hands and feet in the salutary net of happiness.
paras.uz: Barcha kozlar yonaltirilgan edi; toza ertalab kok rangda, hali ham qorongi joyda paydo boldi. Endi u qorongi edi, endi quyosh nurlarida chomildi. U bizga osmondan chomildi, yangi Yahova - xuddi eskirgan Yahova kabi aqlli va mehribon shafqatsiz edi. Va u erda tez orada dono oq orgimchak oz ornini egallaydi - oq rangdagi Yaxshi-Doer loyi, baxtning mazali tarmogida qol va oyoqlarni muloyimlik bilan boglab qoygan Yaxshi-Doer.

paras.en: His magnificent descent from the sky was accomplished. The brassy Hymn came to silence; all sat down. At once I perceived that everything was really a very thin spiderweb, the threads of which were stretched tense and trembling, and it seemed that in a moment those threads might break and something improbable.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning ajoyib osmoni amalga oshdi.Gimn gamgin sukunatga keldi; hammasi otirdi. Bir vaqtning ozida men hamma narsa haqiqatan ham juda nozik orgimchak tori ekanligini angladim, ularning iplari chozilgan va qorqinchli edi va bir zumda bu iplar buzilib ketishi va imkonsiz narsa bolishi mumkin edi.

paras.en: I half rose and looked around, and I met many lovingly-worried eyes which passed from one face to another. I saw someone lifting his hand and almost imperceptibly waving his fingers⁠—he was making signs to another. The latter replied with a similar finger-sign. And a third.⁠ ⁠… I understood; they were the Guardians. I understood; they were alarmed by something⁠—the spiderweb was stretched and trembling. And within me as if tuned to the same wavelength of a radio, within me there was a corresponding quiver.
paras.uz: Men yarim kotarilib, atrofga qaradim va bir yuzimdan ikkinchisiga otgan koplab yoqimli kozlarni uchratdim. Men uning qolini kotarib, barmoqlarini deyarli tanib bolmaydigan qilib qoygan odamni kordim - u boshqasiga ishora qildi. va uchinchisi. ... va ular shunga oxshash barmoq belgisi bilan javob berishdi.

paras.en: On the platform a poet was reciting his pre-electoral ode. I could not hear a single word; I only felt the rhythmic swing of the hexametric pendulum, and with its every motion I felt how nearer and nearer there was approaching some hour set for.⁠ ⁠… I continued to turn over face after face like pages but I could not find the one, the only one, I was seeking, the one I needed to find at once, as soon as possible, for one more swing of the pendulum and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Platformada shoir uning saylovgacha bolgan odini oqir edi. Men faqat bir sozni eshita olmadim; men gemametrik qalamning ritmik tebranishini his qildim va uning har bir harakati bilan men bir soat davomida qanchalik yaqin va yaqinroq bolganimni his qildim. ... men sahifalar kabi yuzni ozgartirdim, lekin topa olmadim, faqat bitta, men topdim, iloji boricha tezroq topish kerak bolgan narsani topdim.

paras.en: It was he, certainly it was he! Below, past the main platform, gliding over the sparkling glass, the ear-wings flapped by, the running body gave a reflection of a double-curved S-, like a noose which was rolling toward some of the intricate passages among the stands. S-, I-330⁠—there is some thread between them. I have always felt some thread between them. I don’t know yet what that thread is but some day I shall untangle it. I planted my gaze on him; he was rushing farther away, behind him that invisible thread.⁠ ⁠… There he stopped⁠ ⁠… there.⁠ ⁠… I was pierced, twisted together into a knot as if by a lightning-like, many-volted electric discharge; in my row, not more than 40° from me, S- stopped and bowed. I saw I-330 and beside her the smiling, repellent, negro-lipped R-13.
paras.uz: Bu, albatta, u edi!, quyida, asosiy platforma otdi, quloq-oqim shisha ustidan gijirladi, yugurish tanasi ikki egri S - bir aks berdi, ular orasida bazi tosiq bor. S--, I-330 - Men har doim ular ortasida bazi bir ipni his. hali bu ip hali ham bilmayman, lekin bazi bir kun men uni tortib olaman. Men uning ustiga koylagini ekdim; u erda u korinmas ipni qoydi ... u erda men toxtadi, xuddi toxtab qolgan, kop vulqonli elektr toki bilan birga bolgandek edim; mening qatorimdan emas, 40 ° dan ortiq bolmagan, S - tolib, toxtab, toxtadi va taxtadi. Men uni kordim I-330 va uning yonida, shafqatsiz, salbiy lab boyogi R-13.

paras.en: My first thought was to rush to her and cry, “Why with him? Why did you not want⁠ ⁠… ?” But the salutary invisible spiderweb bound fast my hands and feet; so, gritting my teeth together I sat stiff as iron, my gaze fixed upon them. A sharp physical pain at my heart. I remember my thought: “if nonphysical causes effect physical pain, then it is clear that.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Mening birinchi fikrim unga shoshilish va yiglash edi, "nima uchun u bilan?..." Lekin soglom korinmas ignabargli veb-sayt mening qolim va oyoqlarimni tez boglab qoydi; shunday qilib, tishlarimni bir-biriga boglab, men temir kabi qattiq otirdim, kokragim ularning ustiga otirdi.

paras.en: I regret that I did not come to any conclusion. I remember only that something about “soul” flashed through my mind, a purely nonsensical ancient expression, “His soul fell into his boots” passed through my head. My heart sank. The hexameter came to an end. It was about to start. What “It”?
paras.uz: Men hech qanday xulosaga kelmaganimdan afsusdaman. "ruh haqida bir narsa miyamdan otganini eslayman, shunchaki bemani qadimiy ibora, "Uning ruhi boshimdan otib ketdi.

paras.en: The five minute pre-election recess established by custom. The custom-established pre-electional silence. But now it was not that pious, really prayer-like silence that it usually was. Now it was as in the ancient days when there were no Accumulating Towers, when the sky, still untamed in those days, would roar from time to time with its “storms.” It was like the “lull before the storm” of the ancient days. The air seemed to be made of transparent, vaporized cast-iron. One wanted to breathe with one’s mouth wide open. My hearing, intense to painfulness, registered from behind a mouse-like, gnawing, worried whisper. Without lifting my eyes I saw those two, I-330 and R-13, side by side, shoulder to shoulder⁠—and on my knees my trembling, foreign, hateful, hairy hands.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Besh daqiqa oldin otkazilgan saylov oldidan otkazilgan ovoz berish odatiy hol emas edi. Ammo endi bu ibodatga oxshash sukut emas edi, odatda shunday edi.Endi u qadimgi kunlarda, osmon hali ham boronlar bilan vaqti-vaqti bilan tolib-toshganda, u "borondan oldin kabi edi. Kozlarimni yuqoriga kotarmasdan, ikkalasini, I-330 va R-13 ni yonma-yon, elkasiga elkama-elka va tizzalarimga qorqinchli, begona, jingalak, soch turmagim bilan kordim.

paras.en: Everybody was holding a badge with a clock in his hands. One.⁠ ⁠… Two.⁠ ⁠… Three.⁠ ⁠… Five minutes. From the main platform a cast-iron, slow voice:
paras.uz: Har bir inson qolida soat bilan kamar ushlab edi... Bir... ikki... uch... besh daqiqa. asosiy platforma bir quyma temir-temir dan, sekin ovoz:

paras.en: “Those in favor shall lift their hands.”
paras.uz: Ва хурсандлар қўлларини кўтарурлар», дедилар.

paras.en: If only I dared to look straight into his eyes as formerly! Straight and devotedly, and think: “Here I am, my whole self! Take me!” But now I did not dare. I had to make an effort to raise my hand, as if my joints were rusty.
paras.uz: Agar men uning kozlariga togridan-togri qarashga jurat etgan bolsam! adolatli va bagishlangan va oylab koring: "Men shu yerdaman, butun ozim!" Lekin endi men jurat etolmadim. qolimni kotarish uchun harakat qilishim kerak edi, xuddi bogimlarim qopol edi.

paras.en: A whisper of millions of hands. Someone’s subdued “Ah!” and I felt something was coming, falling heavily, but I could not understand what it was, and I did not have the strength or courage to take a look.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir necha million qollari. kimningdir "oh!" va men bir narsa kelayotgan his, ogir tushib, lekin men uning nima ekanligini tushunmadim, va men bir qarash uchun kuch yoki jasorat yoq edi.

paras.en: “Those opposed?”⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Ular qarshimi?"

paras.en: This was always the most magnificent moment of our celebration: all would remain sitting motionless, joyfully bowing their heads under the salutary yoke of that Number of Numbers. But now, to my horror again I heard a rustle; light as a sigh, yet it was more distinct even than the brass tube of the Hymn. Thus the last sigh in a man’s life, around him people with their faces pale and with drops of cold sweat upon their foreheads.⁠ ⁠… I lifted my eyes and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu har doim bizning bayramimizning eng ajoyib lahzasi edi: hamma otirib, bu raqamlarning salomli yonogi ostida boshlarini quvonch bilan bosib otirar edi. Ammo endi men yana bir bor qorquvga tushib qoldim; nur kabi yoruglik, ammo bu Hymnning qopol naychasidan ham farq qilardi.

paras.en: It took one hundredth of a second only; I saw thousands of hands arise “opposed” and fall back. I saw the pale cross-marked face of I-330 and her lifted hand. Darkness came upon my eyes.
paras.uz: Bu faqat bir soniya yuz ogirdi; Men qollari minglab paydo kordim "qarshi va qaytib tushdi. Men I-330 va uning kotarilgan qolini och kordim.

paras.en: Another hundredth of a second, silence. Quiet. The pulse. Then, as if at the sign of some mad conductor, from all the stands rattling, shouting, a whirlwind of unifs lifted by the rush, the perplexed figures of the Guardians running to and fro. Someone’s heels in the air near my eyes and close to those heels someone’s wide-open mouth tearing itself by an inaudible scream. For some reason this picture remains particularly distinct in my memory: thousands of mouths noiselessly yelling as if on the screen of a monstrous cinema. Also as if on a screen, somewhere below at a distance, for a second⁠—O-90, pressed against the wall in a passage, her lips white, defending her abdomen with her crossed arms. She disappeared as if washed away by a wave, or else I simply forgot her because.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir soniyaning yana bir yuz qismida sukunat. Keyin, xuddi bazi aqldan ozgan chavandozning belgisida bolgani kabi, tezkor, shovqin-suronli boshliqlardan kotarilgan bolaklarning shamoli, qoriqchilarning kozlariga yaqin va kimningdir keng ochiq ogziga yaqin bolgan odamlarning kozlari dahshatli qichqiriq bilan oziga jalb qiladi.

paras.en: This not on the screen any more but within me, within my compressed heart, within the rapidly pulsating temples; over my head, somewhat to the left, R-13 suddenly jumped upon a bench, all sprinkling, red, rabid. In his arms was I-330, pale, her unif torn from shoulder to breast, red blood on white. She firmly held him round the neck, and he with huge leaps from bench to bench, repellent and agile, like a gorilla, was carrying her away upward.
paras.uz: Bu endi ekranda emas, balki mening ichimdagi, tez tortib olinadigan mabadlar ichida; boshim ustida, bir oz chap tomonda, R-13 tosatdan skameyka ustiga sakrab tushdi, barcha sepildi, qizil, qolida qizil, boynidan kokrakgacha bolgan boldi.

paras.en: As if it were in a fire of ancient days, everything became red around me. Only one thing in my head: to jump after them, to catch them. At this moment I cannot explain to myself the source of that strength within me, but like a battering-ram I broke through the crowd, over somebody’s shoulders, over a bench and I was there in a moment and caught R-13 by the collar:
paras.uz: Bu qadimgi kunlarda olov ichida bolgani kabi, hamma narsa menga atrofida qizil boldi. faqat mening boshimda bir narsa: ulardan keyin sakrash, ularni qolga olish. bu vaqtda men ozimga ichimda bu kuch manbasini tushuntirib bera olmayman, lekin batareyka-ram kabi men olomondan, birovning qollari ustidan, skameykadan otib, u erda boldim va men R-13 ni qolga kiritdim:

paras.en: “Don’t you dare! Don’t you dare, I say! Immediately⁠—”
paras.uz: Сен: «Эй Пайғамбар, Мен: «Сен: «Мен «Сен, албатта, Роббим, Сен Ўзинг ғолиб эмассан», деб айт.

paras.en: Fortunately no one could hear my voice, as everyone was shouting and running.
paras.uz: Ovozimni hech kim eshitmadi, chunki hamma yiglab yubordi.

paras.en: “Who is it? What is the matter? What⁠—” R-13 turned around; his sprinkling lips were trembling. He apparently thought it was one of the Guardians.
paras.uz: «Bu nima? «Nima? » «R-13» atrofida aylandi; uning chokish lablari qorqinchli edi.

paras.en: “What? I do not want⁠—I won’t allow⁠—Put her down at once!”
paras.uz: "Men nima istamayman - men bunga yol qoymayman - uni darhol qoying!"

paras.en: But he only sprinkled angrily with his lips, shook his head and ran on. Then I⁠ ⁠… I am terribly ashamed to write all this down but I believe I must, so that you, my unknown readers, may make a complete study of my disease.⁠ ⁠… Then I hit him over the head with all my might. You understand? I hit him. This I remember distinctly. I remember also a feeling of liberation that followed my action, a feeling of lightness in my whole body.
paras.uz: Lekin u faqat ogzini boshatdi, boshini qimirlatdi va yugurib ketdi. Keyin men bularning barchasini yozishni juda yomon koraman, lekin men ishonaman, shuning uchun siz mening nomalum oquvchilarim mening kasallikimni toliq organishi mumkin. ... Keyin men uni butun kuchim bilan boshiga urdim.

paras.en: I-330 slid quickly out of his arms.
paras.uz: I-330 tezda uning qolidan chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: “Go away!” she shouted to R-, “Don’t you see that he⁠—? Go!”
paras.uz: - Ko'rmaysanmi? - deb so'radi.

paras.en: R-13 showed his white negro teeth, sprinkled into my face some word, dived down and disappeared. And I picked up I-330, pressed her firmly to myself and carried her away.
paras.uz: R-13 ozining oq nekro tishlarini korsatdi, yuzimga bir oz soz tashladi, pastga bolinib ketdi va goyib boldi.

paras.en: My heart was beating forcibly. It seemed enormous. And with every beat it would splash out such a thundering, such a hot, such a joyful wave! A flash: “Let them, below there, let them toss and rush and yell and fall; what matter if something has fallen, if something has been shattered to dust?⁠—Little matter! Only to remain this way and carry her, carry and carry.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Va har bir maglubiyat bilan u shunday dahshatli, bunday issiq, bunday yoqimli tolqinni yoq qiladi: "Ularga, quyida, ularni silkiting va tez suring va qichqiring va yiqiling; agar biror narsa tushib qolsa, nima boladi? - Faqat shu tarzda qolish va uni olib yurish uchun! "

paras.en: The Same Evening, Twenty-Two O’Clock.
paras.uz: Xuddi Shu Kecha, Yigirma Ikki Soat.

paras.en: I hold my pen with great difficulty. Such an extraordinary fatigue after all the dizzying events of this morning. Is it possible that the strong, salutary, centuries-old walls of the United State have fallen? Is it possible that we are again without a roof over our heads, back in the wild state of freedom like our remote ancestors? Is it possible that we have lost our Well-Doer? “Opposed!” On the Day of Unanimity⁠—opposed! I am ashamed of them, painfully, fearfully ashamed.⁠ ⁠… But who are “they”? And who am I? “They,” “We”⁠ ⁠… ? Do I know?
paras.uz: Bugun ertalab bolib otgan barcha dahshatli voqealardan song, bunday gayrioddiy charchoqni ushlab turaman.Bir davlatning kuchli, soglom, yuz yillik devorlari tushib ketgan bolishi mumkinmi? biz uzoq ajdodlarimiz kabi yovvoyi ozodlik holatida yana bir tomsiz bolishimiz mumkinmi? "Birlik kuni - qarshimiz! Men ulardan xafaman, qorqaman, ular kim? va men kimman? "Ular, biz?

paras.en: I shall continue.
paras.uz: Men davom etaman.

paras.en: She was sitting where I had brought her on the uppermost glass bench which was hot from the sun. Her right shoulder and the beginning of the wonderful and incalculable curve were uncovered⁠—an exceedingly thin serpent of blood. She seemed not to be aware of the blood, or that her breast was uncovered. No, I will say rather: she seemed to see all that and seemed to feel that it was essential to her, that if her unif were buttoned she would have torn it, she would have.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U men quyoshdan issiq bolgan eng yuqori shisha skameykaga olib kelgan joyda otirardi.Uning ong yelkasi va ajoyib va hisob-kitobsiz egri chiziqning boshlanishi - qonning juda nozik korinishi edi, yoki uning kokraklari yoq edi.Yoq, men aytaman: u bularning barchasini kordi va agar uning birligi yoqilgan bolsa, u uni tortib olardi.

paras.en: “And tomorrow!” She breathed the words through sparkling white clenched teeth, “Tomorrow, nobody knows what⁠ ⁠… do you understand? Neither I nor anyone else knows; it is unknown! Do you realize what a joy it is? Do you realize that all that was certain has come to an end? Now⁠ ⁠… things will be new, improbable, unforeseen!”
paras.uz: «Va ertaga!» U oq klanlangan tishlari orqali sozlarni nafas, “ertaga, hech kim nima bilmaydi? Men ham, boshqa hech kim ham bilmayman. Bu qanday quvonch ekanligini tushunyapsizmi? «Endi hamma narsa yangi boladi, imkonsiz, tushunarsiz!»

paras.en: Below the human waves were still foaming, tossing, roaring, but they seemed to be very far away, and to be growing more and more distant. For she was looking at me. She slowly drew me into herself through the narrow, golden windows of her pupils. We thus remained silent for a long while. And for some reason I recalled how once I watched some queer yellow pupils through the Green Wall, while above the Wall birds were soaring (or was this another time?).
paras.uz: U asta-sekin meni oz oquvchilarining tor, oltin derazalari orqali oziga tortdi. Shunday qilib, biz uzoq vaqt sukut saqladik. Va negadir men bir vaqtlar yashil devor boylab bazi bir shubhali sariq oquvchilarni qanday korganimni eslayman, devor qushlari yuqoriga kotarilganda (yoki bu boshqa safar edi).

paras.en: “Listen, if nothing particular happens tomorrow, I shall take you there; do you understand?”
paras.uz: «Эй Пайғамбар, агар Биз сени жаннатга киритамиз. Сен: «Эй Пайғамбарлар!

paras.en: No, I did not understand but I nodded in silence. I was dissolved, I became infinitesimal, a geometrical point.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yoq, men tushunmadim, lekin sukut saqladim. Men tarqatib yuborildim, cheksiz boldim, geometrik nuqta boldim.

paras.en: After all, there is some logic⁠—a peculiar logic of today, in this state of being a point. A point has more unknowns than any other entity. If a point should start to move, it might become thousands of curves, or hundreds of solids.
paras.uz: Axir, bazi mantiqiy bor - bugungi kunda, nuqtasi bolish bu holatda. nuqtasi har qanday boshqa shaxs kora koproq nomalum bor. nuqtasi harakat boshlash kerak bolsa, u egri minglab bolishi mumkin, yoki qattiq yuzlab.

paras.en: I was afraid to budge. What might I have become if I had moved? It seemed to me that everybody like myself was afraid now of even the most minute of motions.
paras.uz: Agar men kochib otgan bolsam, nima bolishim mumkin edi? Menga oxshagan hamma hozir ham eng kop harakatlardan qorqqanga oxshardi.

paras.en: At this moment, for instance, as I sit and write, everyone is sitting hidden in his glass cell, expecting something. I do not hear the buzzing of the elevators, usual at this hour, or laughter or steps, from time to time Numbers pass in couples through the hall, whispering, on tiptoe.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ayni paytda, masalan, men otirganimda va yozayotganimda, har bir kishi shisha kamerasida yashirin otiradi, nimanidir kutadi.Men liftlarning, odatdagidek, bu soatda yoki qichqirayotgan yoki qadam tovushlarini eshitmayman, vaqti-vaqti bilan raqamlar zaldan otadi, qichqiradi, xit ustida.

paras.en: What will happen tomorrow? What will become of me tomorrow?
paras.uz: Ertaga nima boladi?

paras.en: The world does exist⁠—Rash⁠—Forty-one degrees centigrade.
paras.uz: Dunyo mavjud — Toshma — Qirq bir daraja issiq.

paras.en: Morning. Through the ceiling the sky is as usual firm, round, red-cheeked. I think I should have been less surprised had I found above some extraordinary quadrangular sun, or people clad in many-colored dresses made of the skins of animals, or opaque walls of stone. Then the world, our world, does still exist? Or is it only inertia? Is the generator already switched out, while the armature is still roaring and revolving;⁠—two more revolutions, or three, and at the fourth will it die away?
paras.uz: Osmonni kotarish odatdagidek qattiq, yumaloq, qizil-jigarrang.Agar men gayrioddiy tortburchak quyoshning tepasida yoki hayvonlarning terisidan yasalgan koplab rangli kiyimlarda yoki toshning yalangoch devorlari bilan qoplangan bolsam, hayron bolardim deb oylayman. Keyin dunyo, bizning dunyomiz hali ham mavjudmi? Yoki u faqat mavjudmi?

paras.en: Are you familiar with that strange state in which you wake up in the middle of the night, open your eyes into the darkness and then suddenly feel you are lost in the dark; you quickly, quickly begin to feel around, to seek something familiar and solid, a wall, a lamp, a chair? In exactly the same way I felt around, seeking in the Journal of the United State; quickly, quickly⁠—I found this:
paras.uz: Kechaning ortasida uygongan galati holat bilan tanishmisiz, qorongilikda kozingizni oching va keyin tosatdan qorongida yoqolganingizni his qilasiz; siz tezda ozingizni his qila boshlaysiz, tanish va mustahkam, devor, chiroq, stulni qidirasiz? Xuddi shu tarzda, men ozimni xuddi shunday his qildim.

paras.en: “The celebration of the Day of Unanimity, long awaited by all, took place yesterday. The same Well-Doer who so often proved his unshakeable wisdom, was unanimously reelected for the forty-eighth time. The celebration was clouded by a little confusion, created by the enemies of happiness, who by their action naturally lost the right to be the bricks for the foundation of the renovated United State. It is clear to everybody that to take into consideration their votes would mean to consider as a part of a magnificent, heroic symphony the accidental cough of a sick person who happened to be in a concert hall.”
paras.uz: "Birlik kunining nishonlanishi, hamma tomonidan uzoq kutilgan edi. Ozining ajoyib donoligini tez-tez isbotlagan xuddi shunday yaxshi-Doer qirq sakkizinchi marta qayta saylandi. Bayram baxt dushmanlari tomonidan yaratilgan, ularning harakatlari bilan tabiiy ravishda yagona davlatning poydevori uchun gisht bolish huquqini yoqotgan.

paras.en: Oh, great Sage! Is it really true that despite everything we are saved? What objection indeed can one find to this most crystalline syllogism? And further on a few more lines:
paras.uz: Haqiqatan ham hamma narsa saqlanib qolgan bolsa-da, haqiqatan ham bu eng kristalli sillogizmga nima xalaqit berishi mumkin? va yana bir nechta chiziqlar:

paras.en: “Today at twelve o’clock a joint meeting of the Administrative Bureau, Medical Bureau, and Bureau of Guardians will take place. An important State decree is to be expected shortly.”
paras.uz: “Bugun soat o'n ikkida Qo'riqlash byurosi, tibbiyot byurosi va qo'riqchilar byurosining qo'shma yig'ilishi bo'lib o'tadi.

paras.en: No, the Walls still stand erect. Here they are! I can feel them. And that strange feeling of being lost somewhere, of not knowing where I am⁠—that feeling is gone. I am not surprised any longer to see the sky blue and the sun round and all the Numbers going to work as usual.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yoq, devorlar hali ham tik turibdi.Bu erda men ularni his qila olaman. Va qaerda ekanligimni bilmaslik - bu tuygu yoqolganligi galati tuygu.Men endi osmon kok va quyosh botishini va odatdagidek ishlaydigan barcha raqamlarni korishdan hayron emasman.

paras.en: I walked along the avenue with a particularly firm resounding step. It seemed to me that everyone else walked exactly like me. But at the crossing, on turning the corner, I noticed people strangely shying away, going around the corner of a building sidewise, as if a pipe had burst in the wall, as if cold water were spurting like a fountain on the sidewalk and it was impossible to cross it.
paras.uz: Men ayniqsa qatiy burilish qadam bilan yol boylab yurib ketdim. Menga hamma xuddi men kabi harakat qilayotgandek tuyuldi. Ammo burchakni aylanib otishda, odamlar devorning chetiga oralib, xuddi sovuq suv qirgoqdagi favvoraga oxshab oqib ketayotganday va uni kesib otish mumkin emas edi.

paras.en: Another five or ten steps and I too felt a spurt of cold water that struck me and threw me from the sidewalk; at a height of approximately two meters a quadrangular piece of paper was pasted to the wall and on that sheet of paper⁠—unintelligible, poisonously green letters:
paras.uz: Yana besh-on qadam va men ham sovuq suv bir izini his, meni urdi va yolakdan tashladi; taxminan ikki metr balandlikda devor va qogoz osha varaqda - aql bovar qilmaydigan, galati yashil harflar joylashtirilgan edi:

paras.en: Mephi
paras.uz: MefiName

paras.en: And under the paper⁠—an S-like curved back and wing-ears shaking with anger or emotion. His right arm lifted as high as possible, his left arm hopelessly stretched out backward like a hurt wing, he was trying to jump high enough to reach the paper and tear it off but he was unable to do so. He was a fraction of an inch too short.
paras.uz: Va qogoz ostida - ong qoli iloji boricha baland kotarildi, uning chap qoli yara qanoti kabi orqaga burilib ketdi, u qogozga yetib borish va uni yirtib tashlashga harakat qildi, lekin u buni qila olmadi. U juda qisqa dyuymning bir qismi edi.

paras.en: Probably every one of the passersby had the same thought: “If I go to help him, I, only one of the many, will he not think that I am guilty of something and that I am therefore anxious to.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Ehtimol, otkinchilarning har biri bir xil fikrga ega edi: "Agar men unga yordam berish uchun boradigan bolsam, men kopchilikdan faqat bittasi, u men biron bir narsada aybdorman deb oylamaydi va shuning uchun tashvishlanaman."

paras.en: I must confess, I had that thought. But remembering how many times he had proved my real Guardian-angel and how often he had saved me, I stepped towards him and with courage and warm assurance I stretched out my hand and tore off the sheet. S- turned around. The little drills sank quickly into me to the bottom and found something there. Then he lifted his left brow, winked toward the wall where “Mephi” had been hanging a minute ago. The tail of his little smile twinkled even with a certain pleasure which greatly surprised me. But why should I be surprised? A doctor always prefers a temperature of 40° C and a rash to the slow, languid rise of the temperature during the period of incubation of a disease; it enables him to determine the character of the disease. Mephi broke out today on the walls like a rash. I understood his smile.
paras.uz: Men buni tan olishim kerak edi, lekin u mening haqiqiy qoriqchi farishtamni necha marta isbotladi va meni qanchalik tez-tez qutqarganini korib, men unga yaqinlashdim va jasorat bilan qolimni silkitdim. S-atrofni aylanib chiqdi. Keyin u chap qolini kotardi va u erda biror narsa topdi. "Mefi bir daqiqa oldin osib qoyilgan devorga urdi. Men uning kulishini tushundim.

paras.en: In the passage to the underground railway, under our feet on the clean glass of the steps again a white sheet: Mephi. And also on the walls of the tunnel and on the benches and on the mirror of the car. (Apparently pasted on in haste as some were hanging on a slant.) Everywhere the same white gruesome rash.
paras.uz: Er osti temir yoliga otishda, oq varaqning toza oynasidagi oyoqlarimiz ostida: Mefi. Shuningdek, tunnelning devorlarida va skameykada va avtomobilning oynasidagi. (Bazi odamlar shlak ustiga osilgandek tez joylashtirilgan korinadi).) xuddi shu oq gayrioddiy toshmada joylashgan.

paras.en: I must confess that the exact meaning of that smile became clear to me only after many days which were overfilled with the strangest and most unexpected events.
paras.uz: Shuni tan olishim kerakki, bu tabassumning aniq manosi menga galati va eng kutilmagan voqealar bilan toldirilgan kop kundan keyin aniq boldi.

paras.en: The roaring of the wheels, distinct in the general silence, seemed to be the noise of infected streams of blood. Some Number was inadvertently touched on the shoulder and he started so that a package of papers fell out of his hands. To my left another Number was reading a paper, his eyes fixed always on the same line; the paper perceptibly trembled in his hands. I felt that everywhere, in the wheels, in the hands, in the newspapers, even in the eyelashes, the pulse was becoming more and more rapid and I thought it probable that today when I-330 and I should find ourselves there, the temperature would rise to 39°, 40°, perhaps 41° and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Gildiraklarning umumiy sukunatda ajralib turishi qonning yuqtirilgan oqimlarining shovqiniga oxshardi.Bazi raqamlar tasodifan elkasiga tegib ketdi va u qolidan qogozlar toplami tushib ketishi uchun boshlandi. Mening chap qolimda yana bir raqam bor edi, uning kozlari har doim bir qogozni oqiydi; qogoz har doim uning qolida mahkamlanganini his qildim. Men hamma joyda, gildiraklarda, hatto gazetalarda, bosh ogrigi tobora tezlashib borayotganini his qildim va bugun men u erda ozimizni topishim kerak edi, harorat 39 °, 40 °, ehtimol 41 ° va ...

paras.en: At the docks⁠—the same silence filled with the buzzing of an invisible propeller. The lathes were silent as if brooding. Only the cranes were moving almost inaudibly as if on tiptoe, gliding, bending over, picking up with their tentacles the lumps of frozen air and loading the tanks of the Integral. We are already preparing the Integral for a trial flight.
paras.uz: Dokonlarda - bir xil sukunat bir kozga korinmas yolovchining shovqin bilan tolgan. maysalar kabi jim boldi. faqat nayzalar deyarli tik turib kabi harakat edi, gilay, ustidan otib, ularning chodirlari muzlagan havo toplamlari bilan olish va Integral tanklarini yuklash. Biz allaqachon sinov parvoz uchun integral tayyorlanmoqdamiz.

paras.en: “Well, shall we have her up in a week?” This was my question addressed to the Second Builder. His face is like porcelain, painted with sweet blue and tender pink little flowers (eyes and lips), but today those little flowers looked faded and washed-out. We were counting aloud when suddenly I broke off in the midst of a word and stopped, my mouth wide open; above the cupola, above the blue lump lifted by the crane, there was a scarcely noticeable small white square. I felt my whole body trembling⁠—perhaps with laughter. Yes! I myself heard my own laughter. (Did you ever hear your own laughter?)
paras.uz: "Xosh, biz uni bir hafta ichida kotaramizmi?" - degan savol Ikkinchi quruvchiga qaratilgan edi. Uning yuzi shirin kok va yumshoq pushti kichik gullar bilan boyalgan, ammo bugungi kunda bu kichkina gullar sargaygan va yuvilgan.Biz tosatdan sozning ortasida sindirib, toxtaganimda va toxtaganimda, ogzim ochiq bolganida hisob-kitob qildik; kok tepadan yuqoriga kotarilgan kok kokdan yuqorida, men butun tanamni qozgaganimni his qildim - ehtimol!

paras.en: “No, listen,” I said. “Imagine you are in an ancient aeroplane. The altimeter shows 5,000 meters. A wing breaks; you are dashing down like.⁠ ⁠… And on the way you calculate: ‘Tomorrow from twelve to two⁠ ⁠… from two to six⁠ ⁠… and dinner at five!’ Would it not be absurd?”
paras.uz: "Yoq, quloq soling, - dedim men. - Siz qadimiy samolyotda ekanligingizni tasavvur qiling. 5000 metrni korsatadi. A qanot sinishi; va siz ozingizni xuddi shunday tortasiz ... va yolda: " Ertaga on ikkidan ikkigacha... va beshda kechki ovqat!"

paras.en: The little blue flowers began to move and bulge out. What if I were made of glass and he could have seen what was going on within me at that moment? If he knew that some three or four hours later.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Kichkina kok gullar kochib keta boshladi. Agar men shishadan yasalgan bolsam va u osha paytda ichimda nima sodir bolganini korsa edi? Agar u uch-tort soatdan keyin buni bilsa edi.

paras.en: No headings. It is impossible!
paras.uz: Sarlavhalar yo'q. Iloji yo'q!

paras.en: I was alone in the endless corridors. In those same corridors.⁠ ⁠… A mute, concrete sky. Water was dripping somewhere upon a stone. The familiar heavy opaque door⁠—and the subdued noise from behind it.
paras.uz: Men cheksiz yolaklarda yolgiz edim. ... xuddi shu yolaklarda... bir gumbaz, beton osmon. suv tosh ustiga bir joyda oralgan edi. tanish ogir burun eshigi - va uning orqasida qolgan shovqin.

paras.en: She said she would come out at sixteen sharp. It was already five minutes, then ten, then fifteen past sixteen. No one appeared. For a second I was my former self, horrified at the thought that the door might open.
paras.uz: U on olti otkir chiqib keladi dedi. Bu allaqachon besh daqiqa edi, keyin on besh, keyin on on on on on olti otgan. bir soniya uchun men sobiq ozim edi, eshik ochilishi mumkin, deb oyladim.

paras.en: “Five minutes more, and if she does not come out.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Besh daqiqa koproq va agar u chiqmasa ..."

paras.en: Water was dripping somewhere upon a stone. No one about. With melancholy pleasure I felt: “saved,” and slowly I turned and walked back along the corridor. The trembling dots of the small lamps on the ceiling became dimmer and dimmer. Suddenly a quick rattle of a door behind me. Quick steps, softly echoing from the ceiling and the walls. It was she, light as a bird, panting somewhat from running.
paras.uz: Hech kim bir joyda tosh ustiga suv oqib edi. haqida. melanxoly zavq bilan men his: "qutqarilgan," va asta-sekin orqaga qaytib, yolak boylab yurib. shiftdagi kichik lampalar titroq doglar xira va xira boldi. tosatdan eshik bir tez otish, shiftdan va devorlardan etibor. u edi, bir qush sifatida nur, yugurish bir oz boyalgan.

paras.en: “I knew you would be here, you would come! I knew you⁠—you.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men siz bu erda bolishingizni bilardim, siz kelishingiz mumkin edi, men sizni bilardim - siz ... "

paras.en: The spears of her eyelashes moved apart to let me in and⁠ ⁠… how can I describe what effect that ancient, absurd and wonderful rite has upon me when her lips touch mine? Can I find a formula to express that whirlwind which sweeps out of my soul everything, everything save her? Yes, yes from my soul. You may laugh at me if you will.
paras.uz: Uning qollarining nayzalari menga kirishga ruxsat berish uchun bir-biridan kochib otdi va... lablarimga tegganda menga qanday tasir korsatishini qanday tasvirlab berishim mumkin? Men ruhimdan hamma narsani yutib yuboradigan shamolni ifoda etish uchun formulani topa olamanmi? ha, agar xohlasangiz, men bilan kulishingiz mumkin.

paras.en: She made an effort to raise her eyelids and her slow words too came with an effort:
paras.uz: U oz sozlarini aytishga harakat qildi va uning sekin sozlari ham harakat bilan keldi:

paras.en: “No. Now we must go.”
paras.uz: "Yoq, endi biz borishimiz kerak.

paras.en: The door opened. Old, worn steps. An unbearably multicolored noise, whistling and light.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Eski, eskirgan qadamlar.Kop rangli shovqin, hushtak va yoruglik.

paras.en: Twenty-four hours have passed since then and everything seems to have settled in me, yet it is most difficult for me to find words for even an approximate description.⁠ ⁠… It is as though a bomb had exploded in my head.⁠ ⁠… Open mouths, wings, shouts, leaves, words, stones, all these one after another in a heap.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Oshandan beri yigirma tort soat otdi va hamma narsa menda hal qilinganga oxshaydi, lekin men uchun hatto taxminiy tavsif uchun sozlarni topish eng qiyin. ... xuddi bomba boshimga qulab tushganga oxshaydi ... ogiz, qanotlar, barglar, sozlar, toshlar, bularning barchasi bir-biridan keyin juda kop.

paras.en: I remember my first thought was: “Fast⁠—back!” For it was clear to me that while I was waiting there in the corridors, they somehow had blasted and destroyed the Green Wall, and from behind it everything rushed in and splashed over our city which until then had been kept clean of that lower world. I must have said something of this sort to I-330. She laughed.
paras.uz: Men birinchi oylaganimni eslayman: "Tez - orqaga!" Men u erda yolakda kutib turganimda, ular qandaydir tarzda yonib ketgan va yashil devorni yoq qilishgan va uning orqasida hamma narsa yonib ketgan va bizning shahrimizga singib ketgan, keyin esa bu past dunyodan toza bolgan.

paras.en: “No, we have simply come out beyond the Green Wall.”
paras.uz: "Yoq, biz shunchaki yashil devordan tashqariga chiqdik."

paras.en: Then I opened my eyes, and close to me, actually, I saw those very things which until then not a single living Number had ever seen otherwise than depreciated a thousand times, dimmed and hazy through the cloudy glass of the Wall.
paras.uz: Keyin men kozlarimni ochdim va haqiqatan ham menga yaqin bolgan narsalarni kordim, osha paytgacha bitta tirik raqam devorning chiroyli oynasi orqali minglab marta aylanib, xiralashib, uygunlashganidan boshqa narsani kormagan.

paras.en: The Sun⁠—it was no longer our light, evenly diffused over the mirror surface of the pavements; it seemed an accumulation of living fragments, of incessantly oscillating, dizzy spots which blinded the eyes. And the trees! Like candles rising into the very sky, or like spiders which squatted upon the earth, supported by their clumsy paws, or like mute green fountains. And all this was moving, jumping, rustling. Under my feet some strange little ball was crawling.⁠ ⁠… I stood as though rooted to the ground. I was unable to take a step because under my foot there was not an even plane, but (imagine!), something disgustingly soft, yielding, living, springy, green!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Quyosh - endi bizning nurimiz emas edi; u doimiy ravishda kozni qamashtiradigan, kozni qamashtiradigan, boshashtiradigan, boshashgan doglar paydo boldi. Va daraxtlarga oxshab, juda osmonga kotarilgan kabi, yoki er yuzida chozilgan orgimchaklar kabi, ularning qopol panjalari bilan qollab-quvvatlangan. va bularning barchasi kochib otdi, sakrash, chayqalish. ... Bazi oyoqlarim ostida ozgina top yoq edi.

paras.en: I was dazed; I was strangled⁠—yes, strangled; it is the best word to express my state. I stood holding fast with both hands to a swinging branch.
paras.uz: Men xafa boldim; Men xafa boldim - ha, haqoratlangan; bu mening davlatimni ifoda etish uchun eng yaxshi soz.

paras.en: “It is nothing. It is all right. It is natural⁠—for the first time. It will pass. Courage!”
paras.uz: Bu hech narsa emas. Bu tabiiy - birinchi marta otadi. Jasorat!

paras.en: At I-330’s side bouncing dizzily on a green net⁠—someone’s thinnest profile, cut out of paper. No, not “someone’s.” I recognized him. I remembered. It was the doctor. I understood everything very clearly. I realized that they both caught me beneath the arms and laughingly dragged me forward. My legs twisted and glided.⁠ ⁠… Terrible noise, cawing, stumps, yelling, branches, tree-trunks, wings, leaves, whistling.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: I-330 ning yon tomonida yashil rangda - kimningdir eng nozik profili, qogozni kesib tashladi. "Yoq Men uni esladim.Bu shifokor edi.Men hamma narsani aniq tushundim.Ular meni qollar ostiga qoyishdi va oldinga siljishdi.

paras.en: The trees ran apart. A bright clearing. In the clearing, people, or perhaps to be more exact, beings. Now comes the most difficult part to describe for this was beyond any bounds of probability. It is clear to me now why I-330 was stubbornly silent about it before; I should not have believed it, should not have believed even her. It is even possible that tomorrow I shall not believe myself, shall not believe my own description in these pages.
paras.uz: Endi buni tasvirlash uchun eng qiyin qism ehtimol har qanday chegaralardan tashqarida boladi.Endi nima uchun I-330 ilgari bu haqda jim bolganligi aniq; Men bunga ishonmasligim kerak edi, hatto unga ishonmasligim kerak edi. Ertaga ham ozimga ishonmayman, bu sahifalarda ozimning tarifimga ishonmayman.

paras.en: In the clearing, around a naked, skull-like rock⁠—a noisy crowd of three or four hundred⁠ ⁠… people. Well, let’s call them people. I find it difficult to coin new words. Just as on the stands you recognize in the general accumulation of faces only those which are familiar to you, so at first I recognized only our grayish-blue unifs. But one second later and I saw distinctly and clearly among the unifs dark, red, golden, black, brown and white humans⁠—apparently they were humans. None of them had any clothes on, and their bodies were covered with short, glistening hair, like that which may be seen on the stuffed horse in the Prehistoric Museum. But their females had faces exactly, yes exactly, like the faces of our women: tender, rosy and not overgrown with hair. Also their breasts were free of hair, firm breasts of wonderful geometrical form. As to the males, only a part of their faces were free from hair, like our ancestors’, and the organs of reproduction, similar to ours.
paras.uz: Tortburchakda, yalangoch, bosh suyagiga oxshash tosh atrofida - uch yoki tort yuz... odamlar. mayli, ularni yangi sozlarni tanga bilan chaqirishim qiyin. Xuddi siz faqat sizga tanish bolgan odamlarning yuzlarining umumiy korinishini tan olasiz, shuning uchun dastlab men faqat kulrang-kok boshliqlarini tan oldim.Ammo bir soniya otgach va men aniq va aniq kordimki, qorongi, qizil, oltin, jigarrang va oq odamlar orasida - ular odamlar edi. Bundan tashqari, ularning kokraklari sochlarsiz, ajoyib geometrik shaklning qattiq kokraklari edi. Erkaklarga kelsak, yuzlarining faqat bir qismi ota-bobolarimiz kabi sochlardan, shuningdek, biznikiga oxshash kopayish organlaridan ozod edi.

paras.en: All this was so unbelievable, so unexpected, that I stood there quietly (I assert positively that I stood quietly), and looked around. Like a scale: overload one side sufficiently and then you may gently put on the other as much as you will; the arrow will not move.
paras.uz: Bularning barchasi shu qadar kutilmagan edi, shuning uchun men u erda jimgina turdim (men sekin turganimni takidladim) va atrofga qaradim. Bir tomondan etarlicha kop bolgani kabi, keyin siz boshqa tomonni xohlaganingizcha qoyishingiz mumkin; oq harakat qilmaydi.

paras.en: Suddenly I felt alone. I-330 was no longer with me. I don’t know how nor where she disappeared. Around me were only those, with their hair glistening like silk in the sunlight. I caught someone’s warm, strong, dark shoulder.
paras.uz: Tosatdan men ozimni yolgiz his qildim. I-330 endi men bilan emas edi. Men qanday qilib va qaerda yoqolganini bilmayman. atrofimda faqat osha odamlar bor edi, ularning sochlari quyosh nurida ipak kabi eshitilar edi.

paras.en: “Listen, please, in the name of the Well-Doer, could you tell me where she went? A while, a minute ago she.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Iltimos, yaxshi dost nomi bilan menga qaerga ketganini aytib bera olasizmi?"

paras.en: Long-haired, austere eyebrows turned to me.
paras.uz: Koz oldimdan otdi uzun, kongil.

paras.en: “Sh⁠ ⁠… sh⁠ ⁠… silence!” He made a sign with his head towards the centre where there stood the yellow, skull-like stone.
paras.uz: “Sh... sukunat!” U boshi bilan sariq, bosh suyagiga o'xshash tosh turgan markazga ishora qildi.

paras.en: There above the heads of all I saw her. The sun beat straight into my eyes, and because of that she seemed coal-black, standing out on the blue cloth of the sky⁠—a coal-black silhouette on a blue background. A little higher the clouds were floating. And it seemed that not the clouds but the rock itself, and she herself upon that rock, and the crowd and the clearing⁠—all were silently floating like a ship, and the earth was light and glided away from under the feet.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U erda men uni kordim. Quyosh kozimga togridan-togri komir-qora korindi, osmonning kok matosida - kok fonda kok-qora chiziq paydo boldi.

paras.en: “Brothers!” (It was she.) “Brothers, you all know that there inside the Wall, in the City, they are building the Integral. And you know also that the day has come for us to destroy that Wall and all other walls, so that the green wind may blow all over the earth, from end to end. But the Integral is going to take these walls up into the heights to the thousands of other worlds which every evening whisper to us with their lights through the black leaves of night.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Birodarlar, barchangiz bilasizki, devor ichida, shaharda, ular integralni qurishadi. Shuningdek, siz bilasizki, biz uchun bu devor va boshqa barcha devorlarni yoq qilish kuni keldi, shunda yashil shamol er yuzida, boshidan oxirigacha zarba berishi mumkin.

paras.en: Waves and foam and wind were beating the rock:
paras.uz: Tolqinlar va kopiklar tosh bilan toqnashdi:

paras.en: “Down with the Integral! Down!”
paras.uz: Бас, Исломга киринглар!» деди.

paras.en: “No, brothers, not ‘down.’ The Integral must be ours. And it shall be ours. On the day when it first sets sail into the sky, we shall be on board. For the Builder of the Integral is with us. He left the walls, he came with me here in order to be with us. Long live the Builder!”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, birodarlar, pastga emas. » Integral bizniki bo'lishi kerak. Va u birinchi marta osmonga suzib o'tadigan kuni biz bortda bo'lamiz. Integral quruvchisi biz bilan birga bo'ladi.

paras.en: A second⁠—and I was somewhere above everything. Under me: heads, heads, heads, wide open yelling mouths, arms rising and falling.⁠ ⁠… There was something strange and intoxicating in it all. I felt myself above everybody; I was⁠—I⁠—a separate world; I ceased to be the usual item; I became unity.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir soniya - va men hamma narsadan yuqori joyda edim.: boshlar, boshlar, keng ochiq ogiz, qollar kotariladi va tushadi. ... unda galati va mast bolgan narsa bor edi.Men ozimni hamma narsadan ustun his qildim; Men - alohida dunyo edim; men odatdagi narsa bolishni toxtatdim; men birdam boldim.

paras.en: Again I was below, near the rock, my body happy, shaken and rumpled, as after an embrace of love. Sunlight, voices, and from above⁠—the smile of I-330. A golden-haired woman, her whole body silky-golden and diffusing an odor of different herbs, was near by. She held a cup, apparently made of wood. She drank a little from it with her red lips and then offered the cup to me. I closed my eyes and with avidity I drank the sweet cold prickly sparks, pouring them down on the fire which burned within me.
paras.uz: Men yana quyida edim, tosh yaqinida, tanam baxtli, ovoz chiqarib, yuqoridan - I-330 ning tabassumi. Oltin sochli ayol, uning butun tanasi ipak-oltin va turli xil otlarning hidini tarqatib yuborgan, u bir chashka ushlab turdi, ehtimol undan qizil lablari bilan ozgina ichdi va keyin stakanni menga taklif qildi. Men kozlarimni yumdim va tez-tez sovuq uchqunlarni ichdim, ularni ichimda yoqib yubordi.

paras.en: Soon afterward my blood and the whole world began to circulate a thousand times faster; the earth seemed to be flying, light as down. And within me everything was simple, light and clear. Only then I noticed on the rock the familiar, enormous letters: M E P H I, and for some reason the inscription seemed to me necessary. It seemed to be a simple thread binding everything together. A rather rough picture hewn in the rock; this too, seemed comprehensible; it represented a youth with wings and with a transparent body, and in the place ordinarily occupied by the heart⁠—a blinding, red, blazing coal. Again, I understood that coal, or no, I felt it as I felt without hearing every word of I-330 (she continued to speak from above, from the rock), and I felt that all of them breathed one breath and that they were all ready to fly somewhere like the birds over the Wall.
paras.uz: Kop otmay, mening qon va butun dunyo ming marta tezroq suzib keta boshladi; yer uchib ketayotganga oxshardi, yoruglik va menda hamma narsa oddiy, yoruglik edi. Faqat keyin men tanish, ulkan harflarni kordim: M P X I va bazi sabablarga kora bu menga kerak bolgan narsani boglaydigan oddiy ipga oxshardi. Yana shuni angladimki, komir yoki yoq, men I-330 ning har bir sozini eshitmasdan his qildim (u yuqoridan, toshdan) va ularning barchasi bitta nafas olganini va ularning barchasi bir joyda devorga qushlar kabi uchishga tayyor ekanliklarini his qildim.

paras.en: From behind, from the confusion of breathing bodies⁠—a loud voice:
paras.uz: Orqa tomondan nafas olish organlarining buzilishidan - baland ovoz:

paras.en: “But this is folly!”
paras.uz: Бу (Қуръони Карим) Қуръони Каримда Каримни Пайғамбарнинг (с. а. в.) Пайғамбарларига (с. а. в.) Пайғамбар қилиб юборилган.)

paras.en: It seems to me it was I, yes, I am certain it was I, who then jumped on the rock; from there I saw the sun, heads, a green sea on a blue background, and I cried:
paras.uz: Oylaymanki, bu men, ha, keyin tosh ustida sakrab otgan men edim; u erdan quyosh, boshlar, kok fonda yashil dengizni kordim va yigladim:

paras.en: “Yes, yes, precisely. All must become insane; we must become insane as soon as possible! We must; I know it.”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, aniq. Hamma galati bolishi kerak; iloji boricha tezroq xafa bolishimiz kerak; Men buni bilaman».

paras.en: I-330 was at my side. Her smile⁠—two dark lines from the angles of her mouth directed upward.⁠ ⁠… And within me a blazing coal. It was momentary, light, a little painful, beautiful.⁠ ⁠… And later⁠—only stray fragments that remained sticking in me.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning tabassumi - ogzidan ikki qorongu chiziq yonaltirilgan... Va men ichida chaqmoq, engil, ozgina ogriqli, gozal edi. va keyinchalik - faqat mening ichimda qolgan boshliqlar.

paras.en: … Very low and slowly a bird was moving. I saw it was living, like me. It was turning its head now to the right and then to the left like a human being, and its round black eyes screwed themselves into me.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U xuddi men kabi tirik edi. U hozir boshini ong tomonga, songra chap tomonga inson kabi ogirilib, dumaloq qora kozlari menga ozini urdi.

paras.en: … Then: a human back glistening with fur the color of ancient ivory;⁠—a mosquito crawling on that back, a mosquito with tiny transparent wings. The back twitched to chase the mosquito away; it twitched again.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Songra: qadimiy ivorning rangini mol-kol tinglab turgan odam; - osha orqa tarafdagi chivin, kichkina yaltiroq qanotlari bolgan chivin. Orqa oqni taqib qilish uchun oralgan; u yana ochib ketdi.

paras.en: … And yet another thing: a shadow from the leaves, a woven, net-like shadow. Some lay in that shadow, chewing something, something similar to the legendary food of the ancients, a long yellow fruit and a piece of something dark. They put some of it in my hand, and it seemed droll to me for I did not know whether I might eat it or not.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Va yana bir narsa: barglardan soya, toqilgan, oq rangga oxshash soya.Bazilari bu soyada yotadi, qadimiy taomlarga oxshash narsa, uzun sariq meva va qorongu narsaning bir qismiga oxshaydi.

paras.en: … And again: a crowd, heads, legs, arms, mouths, faces appearing for a second and disappearing like bursting bubbles. For a second appeared (or perhaps it was only an hallucination?) the transparent, flying wing-ears.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Va yana: olomon, boshlar, oyoqlar, qollar, ogizlar, bir soniya uchun yuzlar paydo boladi va oq-dorilar kabi kozga tashlanadi. Ikkinchi marta paydo boldi (yoki ehtimol bu faqat kor-korona edi?) shaffof, uchib ketadigan qanot quloqlari.

paras.en: With all my might I pressed the hand of I-330. She turned to me.
paras.uz: Qolimdan kelgancha, I-330 qolini ushladim.

paras.en: “What is the matter?”
paras.uz: «Бу нима?» деди.

paras.en: “He is here! I thought, I⁠—”
paras.uz: Бас, Мен: «Мен, албатта, Бани Исроил, Исроил, Исроил, Ийсо алайҳиссаломнинг Пайғамбарларидирман», деди.

paras.en: “Who?”
paras.uz: - Kim? - deb so'radi.

paras.en: “S-, a second ago, in the crowd.”
paras.uz: «S-, bir soniya oldin, olomon ichida».

paras.en: The ends of the thin coal-black, brows moved to the temples⁠—a smile like a sharp triangle. I could not see clearly why she smiled. How could she smile?
paras.uz: Kichik komir qora-qora uchlarining uchlari, qoshlar mabadlarga kochib otdi - otkir uchburchak kabi tabassum.

paras.en: “But you understand, I-330, don’t you, you understand what it means if he, or one of them is here?”
paras.uz: "Ammo bilasizmi, I-330, agar u yoki ulardan biri bu erda bolsa, nimani anglatishini tushunasizmi?"

paras.en: “You are funny! How could it ever enter the heads of those within the Wall that we are here? Remember; take yourself. Did you ever think it was possible? They are busy hunting us there⁠—let them! You are delirious!”
paras.uz: «Эй аёл! Биз у(Қуръон)даги жаҳаннамдаги жонлар жойига кириб, жойлашиб кета олдингизми?» деб айт. Сен: «Бизларни ғайбладик», деб ўйлайсан.

paras.en: Her smile was light and cheerful and I too, was smiling; the earth was drunken, cheerful, light, floating.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning tabassumi yengil va quvnoq edi, men ham xursand boldim; Yer mast, quvnoq, yorug, suzib ketdi.

paras.en: Both of them⁠—Entropy and energy⁠—The opaque part of the body.
paras.uz: Ikkalasi ham — Entropiya va energiya — Tananing shaffof bo'lmagan qismi.

paras.en: If your world is similar to the world of the ancients, then you may easily imagine that one day you suddenly come upon a sixth or a seventh continent, upon some Atlantis, and you find there unheard of cities, labyrinths, people flying through the air without the aid of wings or aeros, stones lifted into the air by the power of a gaze⁠—in brief, imagine that you see things that cannot come to your mind even if you suffer from dream-sickness. That is how I feel now. For you must understand that no one has ever gone beyond the Green Wall since the Two Hundred Years’ War, as I already have told you.
paras.uz: Agar sizning dunyoingiz qadimgi dunyolarga oxshasa, unda siz birdaniga oltinchi yoki ettinchi qitaga etib borishingizni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin, bazi shaharliklar, tog velosipedlari, qanotlar yoki samolyotlar yordamisiz havo orqali uchib ketadigan odamlar - qisqacha tasavvur qilingki, agar siz tush korgan bolsangiz ham, ongingizga kelmaydigan narsalarni korasiz.

paras.en: I know that it is my duty to you, my unknown friends, to give more details about that unsuspected strange world which opened to me yesterday. But for the time being I am unable to return to that subject. Everything is so novel, so novel it is like a rainstorm, and I am not big enough to collect it all. I spread out the folds of my unif, my palms⁠—and yet pailfuls splash past me and only drops can reach these pages.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bilaman, siz uchun, mening nomalum dostlarim, kecha menga ochilgan shubhali galati dunyo haqida koproq malumot berish mening vazifamdir. Ammo hozircha men bu mavzuga qaytolmayman, shuning uchun hamma narsa shunchalik yangiki, u yomgirga oxshaydi va men uni toplash uchun etarlicha katta emasman.Men ozimning bogim, kaftlarim va hali ham ogriqli narsalarimni tarqataman va faqat bu sahifalarga etib borishim mumkin.

paras.en: At first I heard behind me, behind the door, a loud voice. I recognized her voice, the voice of I-330, tense, metallic⁠—and another one, almost inflexible, like a wooden ruler, the voice of U-. Then the door came open with a crack and both of them shot into the room. Shot is the right word.
paras.uz: Avvaliga men eshik ortida, baland ovoz bilan eshitdim. Men uning ovozini, I-330 ovozini, oq-dorini, oqni va boshqa bir, deyarli mumkin bolmagan ovozni, yogoch hokim kabi, U-ning ovozini tanidim. Keyin eshik yoriqlar bilan ochildi va ikkalasi ham xonaga tashlandi.

paras.en: I-330 put her hand on the back of my armchair and smiled over her shoulder but only with her teeth, at U-. I should not care to stand before such a smile.
paras.uz: I-330 qolini yelkamning orqa tomoniga qoydi va elkasiga tabassum qildi, lekin faqat oyoqlari bilan, U - men bunday tabassum oldida turishga ahamiyat bermasligim kerak.

paras.en: “Listen,” she said to me, “this woman seems to have made it her business to guard you from me like a little child. Is it with your permission?”
paras.uz: У: «Эй Пайғамбар, бу аёл мени поклаб ёд этди.

paras.en: “But he is a child. Yes! That is why he does not notice that you⁠ ⁠… that it is only in order.⁠ ⁠… That all this is only a foul game! Yes! And it is my duty.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ammo u bir bola. ha, shuning uchun u sizni etiborsiz qoldirmaydi ... bu faqat tartibda ekanligini korsatadi ... bularning barchasi shunchaki bemani oyin!

paras.en: For a second (in the mirror) the broken, trembling line of brows. I leaped, controlling with difficulty the other self within me, the one with the hairy fists; with difficulty, pushing every word through my teeth, I cried straight into her face, into her very gills:
paras.uz: Bir soniya uchun (kozguda) qoshlarning singan, qorqinchli chizigi. Men sakrab chiqdim, boshqa ozini ichimda, soch tokilishini qiyinlashtirdim; har bir sozni tishlarimdan otkazib, uning yuziga togridan-togri yiglab yubordim, uning juda gilllariga:

paras.en: “Get out of here at once! Out! At once!”
paras.uz: Бас, бирдан юз ўгир!» деди.

paras.en: The gills swelled at first into brick-red lumps, then fell and became gray. She opened her mouth to say something but without a word she slammed it shut and went out.
paras.uz: Gishtlar dastlab gisht-qizil bolaklarga bolinib, keyin yiqilib, kulrang bolib qoldi. U ogzini ochib, bir narsa dedi, lekin sozsiz uni yopib, tashqariga chiqdi.

paras.en: I threw myself towards I-330.
paras.uz: Men ozimni I-330 ga tashladim.

paras.en: “Never, never will I forgive myself! She dared! You⁠ ⁠… but you don’t think, do you, that you, that she.⁠ ⁠… This is all because she wants to register on me but I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Hech qachon, men ozimni kechirmayman! - U jurat etdi, lekin siz oylaysiz, deb oylamaysiz, u... chunki u meni royxatdan otkazishni xohlaydi, lekin men ..."

paras.en: “Fortunately she will not have time for that now. Besides, even a thousand like her.⁠ ⁠… I don’t care.⁠ ⁠… I know you will not believe that thousand but only me. For after all that happened yesterday, I am all yours, all, to the very end, as you wanted it. I am in your hands; you can now at any moment.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Afsuski, u hozir buning uchun vaqt topa olmaydi.Bundan tashqari, unga oxshagan minglab... Men sizga faqat ming emas, balki menga ishonishingizni bilaman. Kecha sodir bolgan barcha narsalar uchun men sizning qolingizdaman; endi siz har qanday vaqtda bolishingiz mumkin. "

paras.en: “What, ‘at any moment?’ ” (But at once I understood what. My blood rushed to my ears and cheeks.) “Don’t speak about that, you must never speak about that! The other I, my former self⁠ ⁠… but now.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Nima, har qanday vaqtda?" (lekin men bir vaqtning ozida nima tushunganimni tushundim. Mening qonim qulogimga va bogzimga tegdi.) "Bu haqda hech qachon gapirmaslik kerak, boshqa men, sobiq ozim ... lekin hozir ..."

paras.en: “How do I know? Man is like a novel: up to the last page one does not know what the end will be. It would not be worth reading otherwise.”
paras.uz: "Men qanday bilaman? Inson romanga oxshaydi: oxirgi sahifaga qadar nima bolishini bilmaydi.

paras.en: She was stroking my head. I could not see her face but I could tell by her voice that she was looking somewhere very far into the distance; she hooked herself to that cloud which was floating silently, slowly, no one knows where to.
paras.uz: Men uning yuzini kora olmadim, lekin uning ovozi bilan u juda uzoq joyga qarab turganini aytishim mumkin edi; u asta-sekin suzayotgan bulutga ozini tashladi, hech kim qaerga borishni bilmaydi.

paras.en: Suddenly she pushed me away with her hand, firmly but tenderly.
paras.uz: Birdan u meni qoli bilan tortib oldi, lekin qatiy, ammo muloyim.

paras.en: “Listen. I came to tell you that perhaps we are now⁠ ⁠… our last days.⁠ ⁠… You know, don’t you, that all Auditoriums are to be closed after tonight?”
paras.uz: "Men sizga shuni aytishim kerakki, biz hozir ... bizning oxirgi kunimiz ... bilasizmi, barcha auditoriyalar bu kechadan keyin yopilishi kerakmi?"

paras.en: “Closed?”
paras.uz: «Тошқами?»

paras.en: “Yes. I passed by and saw that in all Auditoriums preparations are going on: tables; medics all in white.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ha, men otib ketdim va barcha Auditoriya kurslarida: jadvallar; barcha shifokorlar oq rangda. "

paras.en: “But what does it all mean?”
paras.uz: "Ammo bularning barchasi nimani anglatadi?"

paras.en: “I don’t know. Nobody knows as yet. That is the worst of it. I only feel the current is on, the spark is jumping, and if not today, then tomorrow.⁠ ⁠… Yet perhaps they will not have time.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Bilmayman, hech kim hozircha buni bilmaydi.Bu eng yomoni.Men faqat oqimni his qilyapman, uchqun uchib ketadi va agar bugun bolmasa, ertaga ... lekin ular vaqt topa olmaydi. "

paras.en: For a long while I have ceased to understand who are they and who we. I do not understand what I want; do I want them to have or not to have enough time? One thing is clear to me: I-330 is now on the very edge, on the very edge, and in one second more.⁠ ⁠…
