paras.uz: Men uzoq vaqt davomida ular kimligini va biz kim ekanligimizni tushunishni toxtatdim. Men nimani xohlayotganimni tushunmayapman; ularga etarli vaqt kerak yoki yoq bolishini xohlaymanmi? Bir narsa aniq: I-330 endi juda chekkada, juda chekkada va yana bir soniya ichida.

paras.en: “But it is folly,” I said. “You, versus the United State! It is the same as if you should cover the muzzle of a gun with your hands and expect that way to prevent the shot.⁠ ⁠… It is absolute folly!”
paras.uz: "Ammo bu ahmoq, - dedim men. - Bir davlatga qarshi! xuddi qolingiz bilan qurolning ogzini yopishingiz va oqni oldini olish uchun shunday yolni kutishingiz kerak.

paras.en: A smile.
paras.uz: bir yilmaz.

paras.en: “ ‘We must all go insane⁠—as soon as possible go insane.’ It was yesterday, do you remember?”
paras.uz: Бас, албатта, Биз ғолиб келгувчимиз», дедилар. Сен: «Эй Пайғамбарлар!

paras.en: Yes, she was right; I had even written it down. Consequently it really took place. In silence I looked into her face. At that moment the dark cross was especially distinct.
paras.uz: Ha, u togri edi; men hatto uni yozgan edim. shuning uchun bu haqiqatan ham sodir boldi. sukunatda men uning yuziga qaradim. Osha paytda qorongi xoch ayniqsa farq qilardi.

paras.en: “I-, dear, before it is too late.⁠ ⁠… If you want⁠ ⁠… I’ll leave everything, I’ll forget everything, and we’ll go there beyond the Wall, to them.⁠ ⁠… I do not even know who they are.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men, azizim, juda kech bolishidan oldin ... agar xohlasangiz ... men hamma narsani unutaman, men hamma narsani unutaman va devordan tashqariga chiqamiz, ular uchun ... men ularning kimligini ham bilmayman. "

paras.en: She shook her head. Through the dark windows of her eyes I saw within her a flaming oven, sparks, tongues of flame and above them a heap of dry, tarry wood. It was clear to me that it was too late, my words could be of no avail.
paras.uz: Uning kozlaridagi qorongu derazalar orqali men uning olovli ochoq, uchqunlar, olov tillari va ularning tepasida quruq yogochni kordim, bu juda kech bolganligi aniq edi.

paras.en: She stood up. She would soon leave. Perhaps these were the last days, or the last minutes.⁠ ⁠… I grasped her hand.
paras.uz: Ehtimol, bu songgi kunlar yoki songgi daqiqalar edi ... men uning qolini ushladim.

paras.en: “No, stay a little while longer⁠ ⁠… for the sake⁠ ⁠… for the sake.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Yoq, bir oz koproq vaqt ... uchun ... uchun ..."

paras.en: She slowly lifted my hand towards the light, my hairy paw which I detest. I wanted to withdraw it but she held it tightly.
paras.uz: U asta-sekin qolimni yoruglikka, sochimni yoqotib qoydim. Men uni olib tashlamoqchi edim, lekin u uni mahkam ushlab turardi.

paras.en: “Your hand.⁠ ⁠… You undoubtedly don’t know and very few do know, that women from here occasionally used to fall in love with them. Probably there are in you a few drops of that blood of the sun and the woods. Perhaps that is why I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Sizning qolingiz... Siz, albatta, bilmaysiz va juda kam bilasiz, bu erdan kelgan ayollar vaqti-vaqti bilan ular bilan sevib qolishadi. Ehtimol, sizda quyosh va ormonning bu qonining bir necha tomchisi bor.

paras.en: Silence. It was so strange that because of that silence, because of an emptiness, of nothing, my heart should beat so wildly. I cried.
paras.uz: Bu sukunat shunchalik galati ediki, chunki bu sukunat tufayli, hech narsa tufayli yuragim shunchalik qattiq urishi kerak edi. Men yiglab yubordim.

paras.en: “Ah, you shall not go yet! You shall not go until you tell me about them⁠ ⁠… for you love⁠ ⁠… them, and I do not know even who they are, nor where they come from.”
paras.uz: «Эй Йўқ! Сен уларнинг хабарини бермагунингча юбормагин.

paras.en: “Who are they? The half we have lost. H2 and O, two halves; but in order to get water, H2O, creeks, seas, waterfalls, storms, it is necessary that those two halves be united.”
paras.uz: "Ular kim? yarim biz yoqolgan. H2 va O, ikki oq; lekin suv olish uchun, H2O, suv, suv, suv, suv, dengiz, qirgoq, boron, bu ikki ikki boron birlashtirilishi kerak. "

paras.en: I distinctly remember every movement of hers. I remember she picked up a glass triangle from my table and while talking she pressed its sharp edge against her cheek; a white scar would appear; then it would fill again and become pink and disappear. And it is strange that I cannot remember her words, especially the beginning of the story. I remember only different images and colors. At first, I remember, she told me about the Two Hundred Years’ War. Red color.⁠ ⁠… On the green of the grass, on the dark clay, on the pale blue of the snow⁠—everywhere red ditches that would not become dry. Then yellow; yellow grass burned by the sun, yellow naked wild-men and wild dogs side by side near swollen cadavers of dogs or perhaps of men. All this, certainly beyond the Walls, for the City was already the victor and it possessed already our present-day petroleum food. And at night⁠ ⁠… down from the sky⁠ ⁠… heavy black folds. The folds would swing over the woods, the villages⁠—blackish-red slow columns of smoke. A dull moaning; endless strings of people driven into the City to be saved by force and to be whipped into happiness.
paras.uz: Men uning har bir harakatini aniq eslayman. u stolimdan shisha kranni oldi va uning otkir chetini bogib qoydi; keyin u yana toldiradi va pushti boladi va yoq bolib ketadi. Va men uning sozlarini, ayniqsa, hikoyaning boshlanishini eslay olmayman.Birinchi navbatda, u menga faqat turli xil tasvirlar va ranglarni eslaydi. Bularning barchasi, albatta, devorlardan tashqarida, shahar allaqachon golib bolgan va u bizning hozirgi yogoch ovqatimizni oz ichiga olgan edi. Va kechasi... osmondan... qattiq qora tosiqlar.

paras.en: “… You knew almost all this.”
paras.uz: Бас, Сенинг Ўзинг Ўзинг Унинг Ўзини биласан», деди.

paras.en: “Yes, almost.”
paras.uz: Йўқ!

paras.en: “But you did not know and only a few did, that a small part of them remained together and stayed to live beyond the Wall. Being naked, they went into the woods. They learned there from the trees, beasts, birds, flowers and sun. Hair soon grew over their bodies, but under that hair they preserved their warm red blood. With you it was worse; numbers covered your bodies; numbers crawled over you like lice. One ought to strip you of everything, and naked you ought to be driven into the woods. You ought to learn how to tremble with fear, with joy, with wild anger, with cold; you should pray to fire! And we Mephi, we want.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ammo siz ularning kichik bir qismi birga bolib, devor tashqarisida yashashini bilmas edingiz, yalangoch bolib, ular ormonda qolishdi.Ular tez orada daraxtlar, hayvonlar, qushlar, gullar va quyoshdan organishdi, lekin bu sochlar ostida ular ozlarining issiq qizil qonini saqlab qolishdi.

paras.en: “Oh, wait a minute! ‘Mephi,’ what does it mean!”
paras.uz: «Эй Масжидул Ҳаром, у нима degani?!» деди.

paras.en: “Mephi? It is from Mephisto. You remember, there on the rock, the figure of the youth? Or, no. I shall explain it to you in your own language and you will understand better: there are two forces in the world, entropy and energy. One leads into blessed quietude, to happy equilibrium, the other to the destruction of equilibrium, to torturingly perpetual motion. Our, or rather your ancestors, the Christians, worshipped entropy like a God. But we are not Christians, we.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Siz eslaysiz, u erda toshda, yoshlar sonida? yoki yoq, men buni oz tilingizda tushuntirib beraman va siz yaxshiroq tushunasiz: dunyoda ikkita kuch, donolik va kuch bor: baxtli muvozanatga olib keladi, ikkinchisi muvozanatni yoq qiladi, ota-onangiz, nasroniylar, Xudo kabi bolamiz.

paras.en: At that moment a slight whisper was suddenly heard, a knock at the door, and in rushed that flattened man with the forehead low over his eyes, who several times had brought me notes from I-330. He ran straight to us, stopped, panting like an air-pump, and could say not a word, as he must have been running at top speed.
paras.uz: Osha paytda tosatdan eshik oldida bir oz shovqin eshitildi va meni I-330-dan bir necha marta eslatmalar olib kelgan kozlari bilan tekislangan odamni hayratda qoldirdi.U bizga togridan-togri yugurib, havo pompasi kabi bosdi va sozni ayta olmadi, chunki u yuqori tezlikda ishlayotgan bolishi kerak.

paras.en: “But tell me! What has happened?” I-330 grasped him by the hand.
paras.uz: Сен: «Менга нима бўлди?» деб айт. «Мен уни қўл билан тутдим.

paras.en: “They are coming here⁠—” panted the air-pump, “with guards.⁠ ⁠… And with them that what’s-his-name, the hunchback.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ular bu erga keladilar - havo nasosini, soqchilar bilan... va ular bilan uning ismi nima, orqaga qaytish. "

paras.en: “Yes. They are in the house by this time. They’ll soon be here. Quick, quick!”
paras.uz: «Ha, ular bu vaqtga kelib uyda bo'lishadi. Ular tez orada bu erda bo'lishadi.

paras.en: “Nonsense, we have time!” I-330 was laughing, cheerful sparks in her eyes. It was either absurd, senseless courage, or else there was something I did not yet understand.
paras.uz: «Aniq, bizda vaqt bor!» I-330 edi, uning kozlarida gamgin uchqunlar edi. Bu bemani, manosiz jasorat edi yoki men hali tushunmagan narsa bor edi.

paras.en: “I-, dear, for the sake of the Well-Doer! You must understand that this.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Эй Роббим, албатта, сен буни англабсан», деди.

paras.en: “For the sake of the Well-Doer!” The sharp, triangle-smile.
paras.uz: «Yaxshi niyatli kishi uchun!» Otkir, uchburchak-sim.

paras.en: “Well⁠ ⁠… well, for my sake, I implore you!”
paras.uz: - Xop, mayli, men seni oldirib qoyaman! - dedi.

paras.en: “Oh, yes, I wanted to talk to you about some other matters.⁠ ⁠… Well, never mind.⁠ ⁠… We’ll talk about them tomorrow.”
paras.uz: "Ha, men siz bilan boshqa narsalar haqida gaplashmoqchi edim. - Xosh, hech qanday ahamiyati yoq ... biz ular haqida ertaga gaplashamiz."

paras.en: And cheerfully (yes cheerfully) she nodded to me; the other came out for a second from under his forehead’s awning and nodded also. I was alone.
paras.uz: Va muloyimlik bilan (ha) u menga qongiroq qildi; ikkinchisi bir soniya davomida uning boynidan chiqib ketdi va men yolgiz edim.

paras.en: Quick! To my desk! I opened this manuscript, took the pen so that they should find me at this work which is for the benefit of the United State. Suddenly I felt every hair on my head living, separated, moving: “What if they should read, even one page of these most recently written?”
paras.uz: Men bu qolyozmani ochdim, ular meni bitta davlat manfaati uchun ishlaydigan bu ishda topishlari uchun qalamni oldim. tosatdan boshimdagi har bir sochimni alohida his qildim va: "Agar ular oqishi kerak bolsa-chi, hatto eng yaqin yozilgan sahifalardan biri? "

paras.en: Motionless I sat at the table but everything around me seemed to be moving, as if the less than microscopic movements of the atoms suddenly were magnified millions of times, and I saw the walls trembling, my pen trembling and the letters swinging and fusing together. “To hide them! But where?” Glass all around. “To burn them?” But they would notice the fire through the corridor and in the neighboring room. Besides I felt unable, I felt too weak, to destroy this torturing and perhaps dearest piece of my own self.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men stolda otirdim, lekin atrofimdagi hamma narsa kochib ketayotganga oxshardi, xuddi atomlarning harakatchan harakatlari tosatdan yoq bolib ketgandek tuyuldi va men devorlarni qozgatib yuborganimni, qalamim titrayotganini va harflarni bir-biriga urayotganini kordim. "Ammo ularni qaerga yashirish kerak? " Lekin ularni hamma joyda yonib ketishdi? "Lekin ular yolak va qoshni xonada olovni sezishdi.

paras.en: Voices from a distance (from the corridor) and steps. I had only time to snatch a handful of pages and put them under me, and then as if soldered to the armchair, every atom of which was quivering, I remained sitting, while the floor under my feet rolled like the deck of a ship, up and down.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uzoqdan (yolakdan) va qadamlardan ovozlar. Men bir nechta sahifalarni chop etish va ularni menga qoyish uchun faqat vaqtim bor edi, keyin esa har bir atom chiqib ketayotgan bolsa, men otirdim, oyoqlarim ostidagi pol kemaning pastki qismiga, yuqoriga va pastga qarab qoyildi.

paras.en: All shrunk together and hidden under the awning of my own forehead like that messenger, I watched them stealthily; they were going from room to room, beginning at the right end of the corridor. Nearer⁠ ⁠… nearer.⁠ ⁠… I saw that some sat in their rooms, torpid like me; others would jump up and open their doors wide⁠—lucky ones! If only I too, could.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma bir-biriga tikilib, osha elchi kabi oz kokragim ostida yashiringan, men ularni muloyimlik bilan kordim; ular yolakning ong uchida joylashgan xonadan xonaga ketayotgan edilar. ... yaqinroq ... bazilari oz xonalarida otirganlarini kordim, menga oxshab zorga otirganlarini kordim; boshqalari oz eshiklarini keng ochishardi - faqat men omadli bolsam!

paras.en: “The Well-Doer is the most perfect fumigation humanity needs, consequently no peristalsis in the organism of the United State could.⁠ ⁠…” I was writing this nonsense, pressing my trembling pen hard, and lower and lower my head bent over the table, and within me some sort of crazy forge.⁠ ⁠… With my back I was listening⁠ ⁠… and I heard the click of the doorknob.⁠ ⁠… A current of fresh air.⁠ ⁠… My armchair was dancing a mad dance.⁠ ⁠… Only then, and even then with difficulty, I tore myself away from the page, turned my head in the direction of the newcomers (how difficult it is to play a foul game!). In front of all was S-, morose, silent, swiftly drilling with his eyes deep shafts within me, within my armchair and within the pages which were twitching in my hands. Then for a second⁠—familiar, everyday faces at the door; one of them separated itself from the rest with its bulging, pinkish-brown gills.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Yaxshi-Doer - bu eng mukammal fumigatsiya insoniyat ehtiyojlari, xususan, One State organida hech qanday peristalz yoq...." Men bu dahshatli, qorqinchli qalamimni qattiq bosib, boshimni stol ustiga pastga tushirdim va boshimning pastki qismini stol ustiga qoydim ... va orqamda qandaydir aqldan ozgan forigini eshitdim. ... va men yangi havo tugmachasini eshitdim. ... Faqat keyin va hatto qiyin bolsa ham, men ozimni sahifadan tortib oldim, boshimni chap tomonga tortdim (bu iflos oyinni oynash qanchalik qiyin!). Hammasining oldida S-, koproq, jim, tezda kozlari menda, qollarimda va qollarimda oralgan sahifalarda chuqur millar bor edi. Songra bir soniya uchun - tanish, kundalik yuzlar eshik oldida; ulardan biri ozini chozilgan, pushti-jigarrang panjaralari bilan ajralib turardi.

paras.en: At once I recalled everything that happened in the same room half an hour ago and it was clear to me that they would presently.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir kuni men xuddi shu xonada yarim soat oldin sodir bolgan hamma narsani esladim va ular menga bundan keyin ham aniq bolishi aniq edi.

paras.en: All my being was shriveling and pulsating in that fortunately opaque part of my body with which I was covering the manuscript. U- came up to S-, gently plucked his sleeve and said in a low voice:
paras.uz: Mening butun borligim qolyozmani oz ichiga olgan tanamning baxtli bolgan qismida shongib, tortishayotgan edi. U-ga kelib, uning yengini muloyimlik bilan silkitdi va past ovoz bilan dedi:

paras.en: “This is D-503, the builder of the Integral. You have probably heard of him. He is always like that, at his desk; does not spare himself at all!”
paras.uz: «Bu D-503, Integral quruvchisi, ehtimol siz u haqida eshitgansiz. U har doim shunday, uning stolida; umuman ozini ushlab turmaydi!»

paras.en: … And I thought!⁠ ⁠… What a dear, wonderful woman!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Va men oyladim, qanday gozal ayol!

paras.en: S- slid up to me, bent over my shoulder toward the table. I covered the lines I had written with my elbow but he shouted severely:
paras.uz: Men oz qolim bilan yozgan sherlarimni qogozga tushirdim-u, lekin u menga qattiq tasir qildi:

paras.en: “Show us at once what you have there, please!”
paras.uz: Сен: «Эй Роббимиз, Ўзингдаги нарсани бизга кўрсатгин», деди.

paras.en: Dying with shame, I held out the sheet of paper. He read it over, and I noticed a tiny smile jump out of his eyes, jump down his face and slightly wagging its tail, perch upon the right angle of his mouth.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U buni oqib chiqdi va men uning kozlaridan kichik tabassumni sezdim, yuzini pastga tushirdim va dumini biroz qimirlatdim, ogzining ong burchagidan opdim.

paras.en: “Somewhat ambiguous, yet.⁠ ⁠… Well, you may continue; we shall not disturb you any more.”
paras.uz: Бас, сизлар жуда оз ғазабланасиз. Биз сени ғазаб қилмаймиз», деди.

paras.en: He went splashing towards the door as if in a ditch of water. And with every step of his I felt coming back to me my legs, my arms, my fingers⁠—my soul again distributed itself evenly over my whole body; I breathed.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Va men uning har bir qadami bilan oyoqlarimga, qollarimga, barmoqlarimga qaytib kelishini his qildim - yuragim yana butun tanamga teng ravishda tarqaldi; Men nafas oldim.

paras.en: The last thing: U- lingered in my room to come back to me and say in my very ear in a whisper: “It is lucky for you that I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Songgi soz: u-menga qaytib kelib, qulogimga juda baland ovozda: "Men siz uchun omadliman," - deb aytishga majbur boldi.

paras.en: I did not understand. What did she mean by that? The same evening I learned that they led away three Numbers, although nobody speaks out loud about that, or about anything that happened. This ostensible silence is due to the educational influence of the Guardians who are ever present among us. Conversations deal chiefly with the quick fall of the barometer and the forthcoming change in the weather.
paras.uz: Osha oqshom men ular uchta raqamni olib ketishganini bilib oldim, garchi hech kim bu haqda baland ovozda gapirsa ham, yoki nima sodir bolgan bolsa ham.Bu ochiq-oydin sukunat bizning oramizda mavjud bolgan soqchilarning talim tasiri bilan bogliq.

paras.en: Threads on the face⁠—Sprouts⁠—An unnatural compression.
paras.uz: Yuzdagi tolalar — Nihollar — G'ayritabiiy siqilish.

paras.en: It is strange: the barometer continues to fall yet there is no wind. There is quiet. Above, the storm which we do not yet hear has begun. The clouds are rushing with a terrific speed. There are few of them as yet; separate fragments; it is as if there above us an unknown city were being destroyed and pieces of walls and towers were rushing down, coming nearer and nearer with terrific speed, but it will take some days of rushing through the blue infinite before they reach the bottom, that is us, below. And below there is silence.
paras.uz: Bu galati: barometr hali ham shamol yoq.Yuqorida, biz hali eshitmaymiz boron boshlangan. Bulutlar hali ham ajoyib tezlik bilan osib bormoqda; alohida boshliqlar mavjud; xuddi bizdan yuqorida nomalum shahar vayron bolgandek; devorlar va devorlarning qismlari qulab tushayotgandek, yaqinlashib kelayotgandek, lekin ular pastga etib kelishidan oldin bir necha kun kok cheksizlik orqali otadi.

paras.en: There are thin, incomprehensible, almost invisible threads in the air; every autumn they are brought here from beyond the Wall. They float slowly, and suddenly you feel something foreign and invisible on your face; you want to brush it off, but no, you cannot rid yourself of it. You feel it especially near the Green Wall, where I was this morning. I-330 made an appointment with me to meet her in the Ancient House in that “Apartment” of ours.
paras.uz: Har kuzda ular devordan tashqariga olib kelinadi; Ular asta-sekin suzib ketishadi va tosatdan yuzingizda begona va korinmas narsani his qilasiz; siz uni chotkalashni xohlaysiz, lekin yoq, ozingizni olib tashlay olmaysiz.Siz buni ayniqsa yashil devor yaqinida his qilasiz, men bugun ertalab bolganimda. I-330 men bilan eski uyda uchrashish uchun uchrashuvni amalga oshirdi.

paras.en: I was not far from the rust-red, opaque mass of the Ancient House, when I heard behind me short hasty steps and rapid breathing. I turned around and saw O-90 trying to catch up to me. She seemed strangely and perfectly rounded. Her arms and breast, her whole body, so familiar to me, was rounded out, stretching her unif. It seemed as though it would soon tear the thin cloth and come out into the sun, into the light. I think that there in the green debris, in springtime, the unseen sprouts try thus to tear their way through the ground in order to emit their branches and leaves and to bloom.
paras.uz: Men eski uyning zang-qizil, galati massasi uzoq emas edi, men orqamda qisqa qadam va tez nafas eshitdim.U atrofga ogirilib, menga qol va kokrak, juda tanish edi, uning birligini tosib qoydi. Bu tez orada nozik matoni yirtib, quyoshga chiqadi, deb oylayman. Menimcha, bahorda, osimliklar oz shoxlarini va barglarini chiqarish va gullash uchun erga oz yolini yirtib tashlashga harakat qiladi.

paras.en: For a few seconds she shone into my face with her blue eyes in silence.
paras.uz: Bir necha daqiqa ichida u kok kozlari bilan kok kozli kozlari bilan yuzimga ishora qildi.

paras.en: “I saw you on the Day of Unanimity.”
paras.uz: Сенларни жамоат куни кўрдим», деди.

paras.en: “I saw you, too.” I at once remembered; below, in a narrow passage she had stood, pressing herself to the wall, protecting her abdomen with her arms, and automatically I glanced now at her abdomen which rounded the unif. She must have noticed, for she became pink, and with a rosy smile:
paras.uz: "Men ham sizni kordim. Men bir vaqtning ozida eslayman; quyida, tor oqda u ozini devorga itarib, qollari bilan qollarini himoya qildi va avtomatik ravishda uning boyniga qaradim, chunki u pushti bolib qoldi va rosa tabassum bilan:

paras.en: “I am so happy⁠ ⁠… so happy! I am so full of⁠ ⁠… you understand, I am⁠ ⁠… I walk and I hear nothing around me.⁠ ⁠… And all the while I listen within, within me.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men juda baxtliman ... juda xursandman! Bilasizmi, men piyoda yuraman va atrofimda hech narsa eshitmayman.

paras.en: I was silent. Something foreign was shadowing my face and I was unable to rid myself of it. Suddenly, all shining, light blue, she caught my hand; I felt her lips upon it.⁠ ⁠… It was for the first time in my life.⁠ ⁠… It was some ancient caress as yet unknown to me.⁠ ⁠… And I was so ashamed and it pained me so much that I swiftly, I think even roughly, pulled my hand away.
paras.uz: Tosatdan, butun yoruglik, kok, u qolimni ushladi; u mening hayotimda birinchi marta ogzini his qildi ... Bu men uchun hali nomalum bolgan qadimiy gamxorlik edi ... va men juda xafa boldim va bu meni shunchalik tez boshatdi, hatto qolimni tortib oldim.

paras.en: “Listen, you are crazy, it seems.⁠ ⁠… And anyway you⁠ ⁠… what are you happy about? Is it possible that you forget what is ahead of you? If not now, then within a month or two.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Siz aqldan ozganga oxshaysiz, korinadi ... va baribir siz nimadan xursandsiz?" Agar hozir bolmasa, bir-ikki oy ichida.

paras.en: Her light went out, her roundness sagged and shrank. And in my heart an unpleasant, even a painful compression, mixed with pity. Our heart is nothing else than an ideal pump: a compression, i.e., a shrinking at the moment of pumping, is a technical absurdity. Hence it is clear how essentially absurd, unnatural and pathological are all these “loves” and “pities,” etc., etc., which create that compression.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning nuri chiqib ketdi, uning yumaloqligi va keskin. Va mening yuragimda yoqimsiz, hatto ogriqli qichishish ham qaygu bilan aralashdi.Bizning yurakimiz ideal nasosdan boshqa narsa emas: oq-dori, yani tortishish paytida yoq bolib ketish - bu texnik notogri, gayritabiiy va "nafratlar va boshqalar.

paras.en: Silence. To the left the cloudy green glass of the Wall. And just ahead the dark red mass. Those two colors combined, gave me as a resultant what I thought was a splendid idea.
paras.uz: Va faqat qorongi qizil massa oldinda. bu ikki ranglar birlashgan, Men ajoyib fikr edi, deb oyladim nima natijasida berdi.

paras.en: “Wait! I know how to save you! I shall save you from.⁠ ⁠… To see one’s own child for a few moments only and then be sent to death! No! You shall be able to bring it up! You shall watch it and see it grow in your arms, and ripen like a fruit.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Сизларни нажот топиш учун бир озгина жонини кўриш учун, сўнгра ўлдириш учун. Йўқ! Бас, уни кўтариб, қўлингизда ўсиб, мевага ўхшайсизлар», деди.

paras.en: Her body quivered and she seemed to have chained herself to me.
paras.uz: U ozini onglab oldi va menga ozini korsatdi.

paras.en: “Do you remember that woman, I-330? That⁠ ⁠… of⁠ ⁠… of long ago?⁠ ⁠… Who during that walk?⁠ ⁠… Well, she is now right here, in the Ancient House. Let us go to her and I assure you that I shall arrange matters at once.”
paras.uz: "Osha ayolni eslaysizmi, I-330 yil oldin... bu yurish paytida u hozir shu erda, qadimgi uyda? keling, biz unga boramiz va sizni ishontirib aytamanki, men bir vaqtning ozida masalalarni tartibga solaman."

paras.en: I already pictured us, I-330 and I, leading O-90 through the corridors⁠ ⁠… then how she would be brought amidst flowers, grass, and leaves.⁠ ⁠… But O-90 stepped back, the little horns of her rosy crescent trembling and bending downward.
paras.uz: Men allaqachon bizni, I-330 va men, yolaklar boylab etakchi O-90 ni kordim ... keyin u qanday qilib gullar, otlar va barglar orasida olib kelingan bolar edi ... lekin O-90 orqaga qarab ketdi, uning zangli toj qozgatadigan va yoq bolib ketishining kichik izlari.

paras.en: “Is she that same one?” she asked.
paras.uz: “U ham shundaymi?” deb so'radi u.

paras.en: “That is.⁠ ⁠…” I was confused for some reason. “Yes, of course⁠ ⁠… that very same.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Bu ... Men biron bir sababga kora adashib qoldim. "Ha, albatta, xuddi shunday ..."

paras.en: “And you want me to go to her, to ask her⁠ ⁠… to.⁠ ⁠… Don’t you ever dare to say another word about it!”
paras.uz: "Siz mendan uning oldiga borishimni, undan sorashimni xohlaysiz ... bu haqda boshqa gapirishga hech qachon jurat etolmaysiz!"

paras.en: Leaning over, she walked away.⁠ ⁠… Then as if she remembered something, she turned around and cried:
paras.uz: U xuddi bir narsani eslagandek, orqasiga ogirilib, yiglab yubordi:

paras.en: “I shall die; be it so! And it is none of your business⁠ ⁠… what do you care?”
paras.uz: "Men olaman; shunday bolsin! va bu sizning biznesingiz emas ... nima gamxorlik qilasiz?"

paras.en: Silence. From above pieces of blue towers and walls were falling downward with terrific speed⁠ ⁠… they will have perhaps hours or days to fly through the infinite.⁠ ⁠… Unseen threads were slowly floating through the air, planting themselves upon my face, and it was impossible to brush them off, impossible to rid myself of them.
paras.uz: Kok minoralar va devorlarning tepasidan ajoyib tezlik bilan tushib ketishdi ... ular cheksiz uchib otish uchun bir necha soat yoki kun bolishi mumkin. ... Korinmas iplar asta-sekin havo orqali suzib otib, yuzimga ekishdi va ularni choktirishning iloji yoq edi, ulardan xalos bolish mumkin emas edi.

paras.en: I walked slowly toward the Ancient House and in my heart I felt that absurd, tormenting compression.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men osha eski uyga asta-sekin qadam tashladim va yuragimdagi bu bemanilikni his qildim va azob chekdim.

paras.en: The last number⁠—Galileo’s mistake⁠—Would it not be better?
paras.uz: So'nggi son — Galileyning xatosi — Yaxshiroq bo'lmasmidi?

paras.en: Here is my conversation with I-330, which took place in the Ancient House yesterday in the midst of loud noise, among colors which stifled the logical course of my thoughts, red, green, bronze, saffron-yellow, orange colors.⁠ ⁠… And all the while under the motionless marble smile of that snub-nosed ancient poet.
paras.uz: Bu erda mening suhbatim I-330 bilan bolib otdi, u kecha Eski uyda baland shovqin ortasida bolib otdi, bu mening fikrlarimning mantiqiy kursini yumshatdi ranglar orasida, qizil, yashil, bronza, safron-safro sariq, toq sariq ranglar ... va hamma vaqt osha burunsiz qadimiy shoirning tinimsiz tabassumi ostida.

paras.en: I shall reproduce the conversation word by word, for it seems to me that it may have an enormous and decisive importance for the fate of the United State⁠—more than that, for the fate of the universe. Besides, reading it, you my unknown readers, may find some justification for me. I-330, without preliminaries, at once threw everything upon my head:
paras.uz: Men soz bilan suhbat sozini kopaytiraman, chunki bu bitta davlatning taqdiri uchun katta va muhim ahamiyatga ega bolishi mumkin - bundan tashqari, koinotning taqdiri uchun.Bundan tashqari, uni oqish, siz mening nomalum oquvchilarim, men uchun bazi malumotlarni topishlari mumkin. I-330, boshlangichsiz, bir vaqtning ozida boshimdagi hamma narsani tashladi:

paras.en: “I know that the day after tomorrow the first trial trip of the Integral is to take place. On that day we shall take possession of it.”
paras.uz: «Bilaman, ertaga Integralning birinchi sinov safari bo'lib o'tadi. O'sha kuni biz unga egalik qilamiz».

paras.en: “What! Day after tomorrow?”
paras.uz: Бас, Биз, албатта, Биз, албатта, Биз, албатта, Бизнинг Пайғамбармиз. Сен: «Эй Пайғамбарлар!

paras.en: “Yes. Sit down and don’t be upset. We cannot afford to lose a minute. Among the hundreds who were arrested yesterday there are twenty Mephis. To let pass two or three days means that they will perish.”
paras.uz: "Ha, otiring va xafa bolmang.Biz bir daqiqani yoqotishga qodir emasmiz. hibsga olingan yuzlab odamlar orasida yigirma Mifi bor. Ikki yoki uch kundan keyin ular halok bolishini anglatadi. "

paras.en: I was silent.
paras.uz: Men sukut saqladim.

paras.en: “As observers on the trial trip they will send electricians, mechanicians, physicians, meteorologists, etc.⁠ ⁠… At twelve sharp, you must remember this, when the bell rings for dinner we shall remain in the passage, lock them all up in the dining hall, and the Integral will be ours. You realize that it is most necessary, happen what may! The Integral in our hands will be a tool that will help to put an end to everything at once without pain.⁠ ⁠… Their aeros?⁠ ⁠… Bah! They would be insignificant mosquitos against a buzzard. And then, if it proves inevitable, we may direct the tubes of the motors downward and by their work alone.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Uchrashuvda kuzatuvchilar sifatida ular onlab otkir, siz buni eslab qolishingiz kerak, kechki ovqat uchun qongiroq jiringlaganda biz otish joyida qolamiz, ularni ovqatlanish zalida qulflaymiz va integral bizniki boladi.Siz eng zarur narsani tushunasiz! Bizning qollarimizdagi integral ogriqsiz hamma narsani bir vaqtning ozida tugatishga yordam beradigan vosita boladi. ... ularning havolari? ... Keyin, agar u isbotlansa, biz motorlarning yonalishini va ularning ishlarini yolgiz ozimiz boshqarishimiz mumkin. "

paras.en: I jumped up.
paras.uz: Men yuqoriga kotarildim.

paras.en: “It is inconceivable! It is absurd! Is it not clear to you that what you are contriving is a revolution?”
paras.uz: Бу Қуръони Каримда Пайғамбарнинг (с. а. в.) Пайғамбари Пайғамбаримиз (с. а. в.) Пайғамбар алайҳиссаломни Пайғамбарга (с. а. в.) Пайғамбар қилиб юбордилар.)

paras.en: “Yes, a revolution. Why is it absurd?”
paras.uz: У: «Йўқ! Бу нима учун ғайбдир?» деди.

paras.en: “Absurd? because a revolution is impossible! Because our (I speak for myself and for you), our revolution was the last one. No other revolutions may occur. Everybody knows that.”
paras.uz: Бизнинг юлдузларимиз, албатта, жуда ҳам ёмон бўлди. Бизнинг ажрим пок бўлди.

paras.en: A mocking, sharp triangle of brows.
paras.uz: Kop qirrali, otkir uchburchagi.

paras.en: “My dear, you are a mathematician, are you not? More than that, a philosopher-mathematician? Well then, name the last number!”
paras.uz: - Xosh, azizam, siz ham faylasufmisiz? - deb soradi.

paras.en: “What is⁠ ⁠… I⁠ ⁠… I cannot understand, which last?”
paras.uz: "Men nima ... bilmayman, qaysi biri oxirgi?"

paras.en: “The last one, the highest, the largest.”
paras.uz: Бас, «Салом» (а. с.) ва «Роббуллоҳ» (с. а. в.) (а.) Пайғамбар алайҳиссаломнинг (с. с.) Пайғамбарларига (с. а. в.) Пайғамбаримиз (с.) (с. а. в.) Пайғамбар алайҳиссаломни (с. а. в.) Пайғамбарга (с. в.) Пайғамбарлик билан юбордик.)

paras.en: “But I-330, it is absurd! Since the number of numbers is infinite, how can there be a last one?”
paras.uz: "Ammo men-330, bu notogri! Raqamlar cheksiz bolgani uchun, qanday qilib oxirgi bolishi mumkin?"

paras.en: “And why then do you think there is a last revolution? There is no last revolution, their number is infinite.⁠ ⁠… The ‘last one’ is a children’s story. Children are afraid of the infinite, and it is necessary that children should not be frightened, so that they may sleep through the night.”
paras.uz: Va keyin nima uchun oxirgi inqilob bor deb oylaysiz? songgi inqilob yoq, ularning soni cheksizdir. «oxirgisi» - bu bolalar hikoyasi. «Bolalar cheksizlikdan qorqishadi» va bolalar tunda uxlashlari uchun qorqmasligi kerak.»

paras.en: “But what is the use, what is the use of it all? For the sake of the Well-Doer! What is the use since all are happy already?”
paras.uz: Бас, нимадан юрмоқдасиз? Зотан, Роҳманга нима бўлди?! Бас, пок бўлдингиз, албатта, пок бўлдингиз?!

paras.en: “All right! Even suppose that is so. What further?”
paras.uz: «Бас, албатта, у(Қуръон) покдир, деб ўйлайман», деди.

paras.en: “How funny! A purely childish question. You tell something to children, come to the very end, yet they will invariably ask you, ‘what further?’ and ‘what for?’ ”
paras.uz: “Qanday kulgili! Oddiy bolalar savol. Siz bolalarga biror narsa aytasiz, oxirigacha keling, lekin ular sizdan: "yana nima?" va "nima uchun?” deb sorashadi.

paras.en: “Children are the only courageous philosophers. And courageous philosophers are invariably children. One ought always to ask like children, ‘what further’?”
paras.uz: "Bolalar yagona falsafiy faylasuflardir. Va falsafiy faylasuflar bolalardir. Bolalar kabi doimo sorash kerak, "yana nima?"

paras.en: “Nothing further! Period. In the whole world evenly, everywhere, there is distributed.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Bundan boshqa hech narsa yoq! butun dunyoda bir xil, hamma joyda tarqalgan. "

paras.en: “Ah, ‘evenly!’ ‘Everywhere!’ That is the point, entropy! Psychological entropy. Don’t you as a mathematician know that only differences (only differences!), in temperature, only thermic contrasts make for life? And if all over the world there are evenly warm or evenly cold bodies, they must be pushed off!⁠ ⁠… in order to get flame, explosions! And we shall push!⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Oh, hamma joyda! " Bu nuqta, bemanilik! " (faqat farqlar!), haroratda, faqat issiqlik qarama-qarshiliklari hayot uchun ekanligini bilmaysizmi? va agar butun dunyo boylab teng darajada issiq yoki teng sovuq jismlar bolsa, ular olov olish uchun, portlashlar! va biz itarib kerak! "

paras.en: “But I-330, please realize that our ancestors during the Two Hundred Years’ War did exactly that!”
paras.uz: "Ammo men-330, iltimos, ikki yuz yillik urush paytida ota-bobolarimiz aynan shunday qilganini tushunib eting!"

paras.en: “Oh, they were right! A thousand times right! They did one wrong thing, however; later they began to believe that they were the last number, a number that does not exist in nature. Their mistake was the mistake of Galileo; he was right in that the earth revolves about the sun but he did not know that our whole solar system revolves about some other centre, he did not know that the real (not relative) orbit of the earth is not a naive circle.”
paras.uz: "Oh, ular togri! Ular bitta notogri ish qilishdi, ammo keyinchalik ular oxirgi raqam, tabiatda mavjud bolmagan raqam ekanligiga ishonishni boshladilar. Ularning xatosi Galileyning xatosi edi; u togri edi, chunki u quyosh haqida gapiradi, lekin bizning butun quyosh tizimimiz boshqa biron bir markaz haqida oylab kormagan, u Yerning haqiqiy ( nisbiy emas) orbitasi dahshatli doira emasligini bilmas edi. "

paras.en: “And you, the Mephi?”
paras.uz: «Ва сен Масжидул Масжидул Ҳаромдасанми?!» деди.

paras.en: “We? For the time being we know that there is no last number. We may forget that some day. Of course, we shall certainly forget it when we grow old, as everything inevitably grows old. Then we shall inevitably fall like autumn leaves from the trees, like you the day-after-tomorrow.⁠ ⁠… No, no dear, not you personally. You are with us, are you not? You are with us?”
paras.uz: "Biz oxirgi raqam yoqligini bilamiz. albatta, biz eski osib ulgayganimizda uni unutamiz, chunki hamma narsa osib ulgayganda. Keyin biz, albatta, ertadan-kunga daraxtlardan kuz barglari kabi tushib ketamiz.

paras.en: Flaming, stormy, sparkling! I never before had seen her in such a state. She embraced me with her whole self; I disappeared.
paras.uz: Men uni hech qachon bunday holatda kormaganman. U meni butun ozi bilan qabul qildi; Men yoqotdim.

paras.en: Her last word, looking steadily, deeply into my eyes:
paras.uz: Uning songgi sozi, chuqur, kozlarimga korinadi:

paras.en: “Then, do not forget: at twelve o’clock sharp.”
paras.uz: Сўнгра: «Бас, эсланг: «Ўша ўн икки жойда.

paras.en: And I answered:
paras.uz: Men javob berdim:

paras.en: “Yes, I remember.”
paras.uz: Йўқ! Мен эслайман.

paras.en: She left. I was alone amidst a rebellious, multi-voiced commotion of blue, red, green, saffron-yellow and orange.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U ketdi. Men faqat kok, qizil, yashil, safron-safro va toq sariq rangli kok, kop ovozli qogirchoq yonida edim.

paras.en: Yes, at twelve!⁠ ⁠… Suddenly a feeling of something foreign on my face, of something implanted, that could not be brushed off. Suddenly, yesterday morning, and U- and all she shouted into the face of I-330! Why, how absurd!
paras.uz: Ha, on ikkida!... Tosatdan yuzimdagi begona narsaning hissi, implantatsiya qilingan narsa haqida, uni choktirish mumkin emas edi. tosatdan, kecha ertalab va U - va u I-330 yuziga urdi!

paras.en: I hastened to get out of the house and home, home! Somewhere behind me I heard the chattering of birds beyond the Wall. And ahead of me in the setting sun the balls of cupolas made of red, crystallized fire, enormous flaming cubes⁠—houses, and the sharp point of the Accumulating Tower high in the sky like a paralyzed streak of lightning. And all this, all this impeccable, most geometric beauty, shall I, I myself, with my hands⁠ ⁠… ? Is there no way out? No path? No trail?
paras.uz: Men uydan va uydan chiqib ketishni tezlashtirdim, orqamdan devor orqasida qushlarning qichqirigini eshitdim. Va quyosh botishida qizil, kristallangan olov, ulkan alangali kublar - uylar va osmonda baland bolgan togli minoraning otkir nuqtasi chaqmoq kabi. va bularning barchasi, eng dahshatli gozallik, men ozim bilan, qollarim bilan, hech qanday yol yoqmi? Yoq?

paras.en: I passed by an auditorium (I do not recall its number). Inside, the benches were stacked along the walls. In the middle, tables covered with snow-white glass sheets, with pink stains of sunny blood on the white.⁠ ⁠… There was foreshadowed in all that some unknown and therefore alarming tomorrow. It is unnatural for a thinking and seeing human being to live among irregularities, unknowns, X’s. If suddenly your eyes were covered with a bandage and you were let go to feel around, to stumble, ever aware that somewhere very close to you there is the borderline, one step only and nothing but a compressed, smothered piece of flesh will be left of you.⁠ ⁠… I now feel somewhat like that.
paras.uz: Men bir parcha orqali otdi (men uning raqamini esimda yoq). ortasida, skameykalar devorlari boylab qoplangan edi. ortasida, qor-oq shisha plitalar bilan qoplangan jadvallar, oq ustida qora qon pushti doglar bilan qoplangan.... Bu bazi nomalum va shuning uchun ertaga tugyonga ketgan, nomalum, Xs. tosatdan kozlaringiz bilan qoplangan va siz atrofida his qilish uchun ruxsat berilgan bolsa, hech qachon sizga juda yaqin chegara bor, faqat bir qadam va bir narsa, goshtli parcha sizdan qolgan boladi.

paras.en: … And what if without waiting for anything I should⁠ ⁠… just head down.⁠ ⁠… Would it not be the only right thing to do? To disentangle everything at once?
paras.uz: Va agar men biron bir narsani kutmasdan ... shunchaki pastga tushsam nima boladi? hamma narsani birdaniga ajratish uchun?

paras.en: The great operation⁠—I forgave everything⁠—The collision of trains.
paras.uz: Buyuk operatsiya — Men hammasini kechirdim — Poyezdlar to'qnashuvi.

paras.en: Saved! At the very last moment, when it seemed that there was nothing to hold to, that it was the end!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Songgi daqiqada, ushlab turish uchun hech narsa yoqdek tuyuldi, bu oxiri edi!

paras.en: It was as if you already ascended the steps towards the threatening machine of the Well-Doer, or as if the great glass Bell with a heavy thud already covered you, and for the last time in life you looked at the blue sky to swallow it with your eyes⁠ ⁠… when suddenly, it was only a dream! The sun is pink and cheerful and the wall⁠ ⁠… what happiness to be able to touch the cold wall! And the pillow! To delight endlessly in the little cavity formed by your own head in the white pillow!⁠ ⁠… This is approximately what I felt, when I read the State Journal this morning. It has been all a terrible dream and this dream is over. And I was so feeble, so unfaithful, that I thought of selfish, voluntary death! I am ashamed now to reread the last lines of yesterday. But let them remain as a memory of that incredible might-have-happened, which will not happen! On the front page of the State Journal the following gleamed:
paras.uz: Goyo siz allaqachon yaxshi dostning qopol mashinasiga qadam qoyganga oxshardingiz, yoki katta shisha qongiroq sizni allaqachon qamrab olganga oxshaydi va oxirgi marta kok osmonga kozingiz bilan yuvmoqchi bolganingizda, bu faqat orzu edi! va sovuq devorga qanday baxt bor! va yostiq! ... Va men bugun ertalab Davlat jurnalini oqiganimda, men buni his qildim.Bu dahshatli tush boldi va bu tush tugadi. va men juda xafa boldim, olim haqida oyladim! Ammo ularni bu ajoyib voqea sodir bolgan xotira sifatida qoldiring, bu sodir bolmaydi!

paras.en: “Rejoice!
paras.uz: Сен: «Эй Роббим, албатта, поксан.

paras.en: “For from now on we are perfect!
paras.uz: Бас, ундан кейин биз гўзал бўлдик!

paras.en: “Before today your own creation, engines, were more perfect than you.
paras.uz: «Bugun oz yaratish oldin, dvigatellari, sizdan kora koproq mukammal edi.

paras.en: “Why?
paras.uz: Nima uchun?

paras.en: “For every spark from a dynamo⁠—is a spark of pure reason; each motion of a piston⁠—a pure syllogism. Is it not true that the same faultless reason is within you?
paras.uz: "Dynadan har bir uchqun uchun - bu sof sababdir; Pistonning har bir harakati - sof sylologizm.

paras.en: “The philosophy of the cranes, presses, and pumps is finished and clear like a circle. But is your philosophy less circular? The beauty of a mechanism lies in its immutable, precise rhythm, like that of a pendulum. But have you not become as precise as a pendulum, you who are brought up on the system of Taylor?
paras.uz: «Tosiqlar, presslar va nasoslar falsafasi tugadi va aylana kabi aniqmi? Lekin sizning falsafangiz kamroq doiraga oxshaydimi? Mexanizm gozalligi uning ozgarmas, aniq ritmida, qalamga oxshab aniq bolmagan, lekin siz Teylor tizimiga kotarilganmisiz?

paras.en: “Yes, but there is one difference:
paras.uz: «Ha, lekin bitta farq bor:

paras.en: “Mechanisms have no fancy
paras.uz: «Mexanizmlar hech qanday tasavvurga ega emas.

paras.en: “Did you ever notice a pump cylinder during its work show upon its face a wide, distant, sensuously-dreaming smile? Did you ever hear cranes restlessly toss about and sigh at night, during the hours designed for rest?
paras.uz: «Siz hech qachon oz ishi davomida nasos silindrini uning yuzida keng, uzoq va sezgir tabassum bilan korganligini korganmisiz? tun boyi, dam olish uchun moljallangan soat davomida shovqin va korish haqida hech qachon eshitmaganmisiz?

paras.en: “No!
paras.uz: Йўқ!

paras.en: “Yet on your faces (you may well blush with shame!), the Guardians have seen more and more frequently those smiles and they have heard your sighs. And (you should hide your eyes for shame!) the historians of the United State all tendered their resignations so as to be relieved from having to record such shameful occurrences.
paras.uz: «Ҳолбуки, Сенинг Ўзинг Ўзинг ила покланасан!» деб айт. Бас, Улар жиноятчиларнинг жойларини поклаб ёд этдилар.

paras.en: “It is not your fault; you are ill. And the name of your illness is
paras.uz: «Bu sizning aybingiz emas; siz kasalsiz.

paras.en: “Fancy
paras.uz: & Fanti

paras.en: “It is a worm that gnaws black wrinkles on one’s forehead. It is a fever that drives one to run farther and farther, albeit ‘farther’ may begin where happiness ends. It is the last barricade on our road to happiness.
paras.uz: "Bu oz peshonasida qora ajinlarni yoq qiladigan qurtdir.Bu eng yaxshi va eng dahshatli yugurish uchun bir isitma, garchi "uzoq baxt tugashi mumkin bolgan joyda boshlanishi mumkin.

paras.en: “Rejoice! This Barricade Has Been Blasted at Last! The Road is Open!
paras.uz: Бу Қуръони Каримда Пайғамбаримиз (с. а. в.) Бани Исроилнинг Пайғамбарларига (с. а. в.) Қуръони Каримни Пайғамбар қилиб юбордилар.

paras.en: “The latest discovery of our State science is that there is a centre for fancy⁠—a miserable little nervous knot in the lower region of the frontal lobe of the brain. A triple treatment of this knot with X-rays will cure you of fancy⁠—
paras.uz: "Bizning davlat ilm-fanimizning songgi kashfiyoti shundan iboratki, miyaning oldingi bolagining pastki qismida gayrioddiy ozgina asab tuguni bor.

paras.en: “Forever!
paras.uz: Бу жумладан, Пайғамбарнинг (с. а. в.) Пайғамбарларига (с. а. в.) Пайғамбарларига (с. а. в.) ва у зотга (с. а. в.) Пайғамбарлик қилиб юрганлар.)

paras.en: “You are perfect; you are mechanized; the road to hundred percent happiness is open! Hasten then all of you, young and old, hasten to undergo the great Operation! Hasten to the auditoriums where the great Operation is being performed! Long live the Great Operation! Long live the United State! Long live the Well-Doer.”
paras.uz: «Siz mukammalsiz; yuz foiz baxt yo'li ochiq! Бас, barchangiz, yosh va qari bo'lib, buyuk operatsiyani boshdan kechiring! Buyuk operatsiyani amalga oshirayotganlarga sabr qiling! «Buyuk davlat uzoq umr ko'ring!

paras.en: You, had you read all this not in my records which look like an ancient strange novel, had you like me held in your trembling hands the newspaper, smelling of typographic ink⁠ ⁠… if you knew as I do, that all this is most certain reality, if not the reality of today, then that of tomorrow⁠—would you not feel the very things I feel? Would not your head whirl as mine does? Would there not run over your back and arms those strange, sweet, icy needles? Would you not feel that you were a giant, an Atlas?⁠—that if only you stood up and straightened out you would reach the ceiling with your head?
paras.uz: Agar siz mening yozuvlarimda bularning barchasini oqimagan bolsangiz edi, menga oxshagan eski galati romanga oxshab korinayotgan bolsangiz edi, siz menga gazetani oqib, grafik siyohni hidlagan bolar edingiz ... agar men bilganingizda edi, bularning barchasi eng aniq haqiqat, agar bugun haqiqat bolmasa, ertaga bolmasa - bu his qilmagan bolarmidingiz? sizning orqa tomoningizda yugurib, galati, shirin, muzli ignalarni qollaringiz bolmasa edi?

paras.en: I snatched the telephone receiver.
paras.uz: Telefonni qabul qiluvchiga berdim.

paras.en: “I-330. Yes.⁠ ⁠… Yes. Yes⁠ ⁠… 330!” And then, swallowing my own words I shouted, “Are you at home? Yes? Have you read? You are reading now? Is it not, is it not stupendous?”
paras.uz:
- Ha, ozingiz oqidingizmi? - deb soradim men. - Hozir oqiyapsizmi?
- Juda zor emasmi?

paras.en: “Yes.⁠ ⁠…” A long, dark silence. The wires buzzed almost imperceptibly. She was thinking.
paras.uz: “Ha...” Uzoq, qorong'u sukunat.

paras.en: “I must see you today without fail. Yes, in my room, after sixteen, without fail!”
paras.uz: "Men bugun sizni muvaffaqiyatsiz korishim kerak. Ha, mening xonamda, on oltitadan keyin, muvaffaqiyatsiz bolmasdan!"

paras.en: Dear⁠ ⁠… she is such a dear!⁠ ⁠… “Without fail!” I was smiling and I could not stop, I felt I should carry that smile with me into the street like a light above my head.
paras.uz: U shunday aziz! «Muvaffaqiyatsiz!» Men hayron boldim va toxtata olmadim, boshimdagi yoruglik kabi men bilan birga kochaga tabassum qilishim kerakligini his qildim.

paras.en: Outside the wind ran over me, whirling, whistling, whipping, but I felt even more cheerful. “All right, go on, go on moaning and groaning! The Walls cannot be torn down.” Flying leaden clouds broke over my head⁠ ⁠… well let them! They could not eclipse the sun! We chained it to the zenith like so many Joshuas, sons of Nuns!
paras.uz: Shamolning tashqarisida men ozimni yanada yoqimli his qildim. "Yaxshi, davom eting, gazab va gazabni davom eting! Devorlar pastga tushmaydi."Ehtiyot boling, qorgoshinli bulutlar boshimni sindirib qoymaydi.

paras.en: At the corner a group of Joshuas, sons of Nuns, were standing with their foreheads pasted to the glass of the wall. Inside, on a dazzling white table already a Number lay. One could see two naked soles diverging from under the sheet in a yellow angle.⁠ ⁠… White medics bent over his head⁠—a white hand, a stretched-out hand holding a syringe filled with something.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yoshuas bir guruh, Nuns ogillari, devor shisha oralgan bilan turgan edi. ichida, allaqachon bir soni yotar. Bir sariq burchak ostida varaq ostidan farq ikki yalangoch yolgiz korish mumkin edi.... Oq shifokorlar boshini ustida egilib - oq qoli, bir qoli bilan bir narsa bilan toldirilgan bir qol ushlab, bir qoli.

paras.en: “And you, what are you waiting for?” I asked nobody in particular, or rather all of them.
paras.uz: «Сен нима сўраяпсан?» деди. Бас, Мен ҳеч кимдан, албатта, ёки уларнинг барчасини сўрадим.

paras.en: “And you?” Someone’s round head turned to me.
paras.uz: «Va siz?» kimningdir dumaloq boshi menga murojaat qildi.

paras.en: “I? Oh, afterward! I must first.⁠ ⁠…” Somewhat confused, I left the place. I really had to see I-330 first. But why first? I could not explain to myself.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Men birinchi bolishim kerak!..." Biroz chalkashdim, men bu joyni tark etdim. avval I-330 ni korishim kerak edi. Lekin nega avval ozimga tushuntirib bera olmadim.

paras.en: The docks. The Integral, bluish like ice, was glistening and sparkling. The engine was caressingly grumbling, repeating some one word, as if it were my word, a familiar one. I bent down and stroked the long, cold tube of the motor. “Dear! What a dear tube! Tomorrow it will come to life, tomorrow for the first time it will tremble with burning, flaming streams in its bowels.”
paras.uz: Integral, muz kabi kok rang, diqqat bilan tinglanayotgan edi. Dvigatel bir soz, tanish soz bolgani kabi, bir sozni etiborsiz qoldirdi. „Hurmatli naycha! ertaga qanday hayot keladi, u birinchi marta yonib ketadi, uning qollaridagi olov oqimlari bilan yonadi.“

paras.en: With what eyes would I have looked at the glass monster had everything remained as it was yesterday? If I knew that tomorrow at twelve I should betray it, yes, betray.⁠ ⁠… Someone behind cautiously touched my elbow. I turned around. The plate-like, flat face of the Second Builder.
paras.uz: Agar men ertaga on ikki yoshida uni talon-taroj qilishim kerakligini bilganimda edi, ha, xiyonat qilardim ... kimdir mening tirsakimga tegib ketdi. Men ikkinchi quruvchining plastinkaga oxshash tekis yuzi.

paras.en: “Do you know already?” he asked.
paras.uz: У: «Сизлар билдингизми?» деди.

paras.en: “What? About the Operation? Yes. How everything, everything⁠ ⁠… suddenly.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Nima? operatsiya haqida? Ha, hamma narsa qanday qilib ... tosatdan?"

paras.en: “No, not that. The trial flight is put off until day-after-tomorrow⁠—on account of that Operation. They rushed us for nothing; we hurried.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Yoq, unday emas. Sinov parvozi kundan-kunga ochiriladi - bu operatsiya tufayli ular bizni hech narsaga majburlamadilar; biz otdik. "

paras.en: “On account of that Operation!” Funny, limited man. He could see no farther than his own platter! If only he knew that but for the Operation tomorrow at twelve he would be locked-up in a glass cage, would be tossing about, trying to climb the walls!
paras.uz: "Bu operatsiya tufayli!" U oz plastinka kora hech qanday dahshatli korish mumkin edi! faqat u on ikki yoshida operatsiya uchun u shisha qafasda qulflab bolardi, deb bilgan bolsa, haqida otib edi, devorlar kotarilishni harakat!

paras.en: At twelve-thirty when I came into my room I saw U-. She was sitting at my table, firm, straight, bone-like, resting her right cheek on her hand. She must have waited for a long while because when she brusquely rose to meet me there remained on her cheek five white imprints of her fingers.
paras.uz: On ikkida xonamga kirganimda U-ni kordim.U mening stolimda otirgan edi, qattiq, togri, suyakqa oxshash, qolida ong boynini ushlab turardi.

paras.en: For a second that terrible morning came back to me; she beside I-330, indignant. But for a second only. All was at once washed off by the sun of today, as it happens sometimes when you enter your room on a bright day and absentmindedly turn on the light, the bulb shines but it is out of place, droll, unnecessary.
paras.uz: Bir soniya uchun dahshatli ertalab menga qaytib keldi; u I-330 tashqari, gazablangan. Lekin faqat bir soniya uchun. Barcha bir vaqtning ozida bugun quyosh tomonidan yuvib boldi, Agar yorqin kuni xonaga kirib va yoruglik yoqilganda bazan sodir bolgani kabi, lampochka, lekin u joy yoq, tomchi, keraksiz.

paras.en: Without hesitation I held out my hand to her; I forgave her everything. She firmly grasped both my hands and pressed them till they hurt. Her cheeks quivering and hanging down like ancient precious ornaments, she said with emotion:
paras.uz: Men unga qolimni tekkizdim; Men unga hamma narsani kechirdim. U qollarimni mahkam boglab, ogriguncha ularni quchoqlab oldi.

paras.en: “I was waiting.⁠ ⁠… I want only one moment.⁠ ⁠… I only wanted to say⁠ ⁠… how happy, how joyous I am for you! You realize of course, that tomorrow or day-after-tomorrow you will be healthy again, as if born anew.”
paras.uz: "Men faqat bir daqiqa kutib turdim ... men sizga aytmoqchi edim, qanchalik baxtliman! Siz, albatta, ertaga yoki kundan-kunga soglom bolasiz, xuddi yangi tugilgan kabi."

paras.en: I noticed my papers on the table; the last two pages of my record of yesterday; they were in the place where I left them the night before. If only she knew what I wrote there! Although I did not care after all. Now it was only history; it was the ridiculously far off distance like an image through a reversed opera-glass.
paras.uz: Men oz maqolalarimni stolda payqadim; kechagi yozuvimning songgi ikki sahifasi; ular men ularni bir kecha oldin qoldirgan joyda edi.Agar u erda yozganlarimni bilsa edi!

paras.en: “Yes,” I said, “a while ago, while passing through the avenue, I saw a man walking ahead of me. His shadow stretched along the pavement and think of it! his shadow was luminous! I think, more than that, I am absolutely certain that tomorrow all shadows will disappear. Not a shadow from any person or anything! The sun will be shining through everything.”
paras.uz: "Ha, - dedim men, - bir muncha vaqt oldin, yoldan otib, men bir odamni oldinda yurganini kordim. Uning soyasi yolak boylab suzib otib, oylab kordim! uning soyasi yorqin edi! menimcha, bundan tashqari, men ertaga barcha soyalar yoq bolishiga aminman. hech qanday odam yoki hech narsadan soya bolmaydi!

paras.en: She, gently and earnestly:
paras.uz: U muloyimlik bilan:

paras.en: “You are a dreamer! I should not allow my children in school to talk that way.”
paras.uz: “Siz orzukorsiz! Men maktabda bolalarimga shunday gapirishiga yo'l qo'ymayman”.

paras.en: She told me something about the children; that they were all led in one herd to the Operation; that it was necessary to bind them afterward with ropes; and that one must love pitilessly, “yes, pitilessly,” and that she thought she might finally decide to.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U menga bolalar haqida bir narsa aytdi; ularning barchasi bitta podada operatsiyaga olib borilgan; keyinchalik ularni arqonlar bilan boglash kerak edi; va "ha, shafqatsiz va nihoyat u qaror qabul qilishi mumkin deb oylashi kerak.

paras.en: She smoothed out the grayish-blue fold of the unif that fell between her knees, swiftly pasted her smiles all over me and went out.
paras.uz: U oyogi orasiga tushgan bolakning kulrang-kok qopqogini yumshatdi, tezda uning ustidan tabassum qildi va tashqariga chiqdi.

paras.en: Fortunately the sun did not stop today. The sun was running. It was already sixteen o’clock.⁠ ⁠… I was knocking at the door, my heart was knocking.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Quyosh bugun to'xtab qolgani yo'q. Quyosh allaqachon o'n oltida edi... Men eshik oldida cho'kib ketdim, yuragim siqildi.

paras.en: “Come in!”
paras.uz: Бас, киринглар», деди.

paras.en: I threw myself upon the floor near her chair, to embrace her limbs, to lift my head upward and look into her eyes, first into one then into the other, and in each of them to see the reflection of myself in wonderful captivity.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men ozimni uning stuli yaqinidagi erga tashladim, oyoqlarini kotarish, boshimni yuqoriga kotarish va uning kozlariga qarash uchun, avval boshqasiga, keyin esa ularning har birida ozimni ajoyib korish uchun.

paras.en: There beyond the wall it looked stormy, there the clouds were leaden⁠—let them be! My head was overcrowded with impetuous words, and I was speaking aloud, and flying with the sun I knew not where.⁠ ⁠… No, now we know where we are flying; planets were following me, planets sparkling with flame and populated with fiery, singing flowers and mute planets, blue ones where rational stones were unified into one organized society, and planets which like our own earth had reached already the apex of one hundred percent happiness.
paras.uz: U erda devor orqasida bulutlar paydo boldi - ular bolsin! Mening boshim galati sozlar bilan tolib-toshgan edi va men qaerga ketayotganimni bilmas edim.Yoq, endi biz uchib ketayotgan quyosh bilan uchib ketayotganimizni bilamiz; sayyoralar, olov va ot ochiruvchilar, qoshiqlar va sayyoralar, bitta jamiyatga birlashtirilgan kok sayyoralar va bizning erimiz kabi oz sayyoramiz yuz foiz baxtning eng yuqori choqqisiga chiqqan sayyoralar.

paras.en: Suddenly from above:
paras.uz: Birdan yuqoridan:

paras.en: “And don’t you think that at the apex are, precisely, stones unified into an organized society?” The triangle grew sharper and sharper, darker and darker.
paras.uz: «Сен: «Сен: «Эй Пайғамбар, албатта, жаннатга кириб, жаннатга кирадиган жаннатда лойиқлар бор, деб ҳисобламаяпсанми?» деб айт.

paras.en: “Happiness⁠ ⁠… well?⁠ ⁠… Desires are tortures, are they not? It is clear therefore, that happiness is where there are no longer any desires, not a single desire any more. What an error, what an absurd prejudice it was, that formerly we would mark happiness with the sign ‘plus’! No, absolute happiness must be marked ‘minus,’⁠—divine minus!”
paras.uz: «Baxt nima?... Istaklar azoblar, ular emasmi? Bu aniq, baxt endi hech qanday istak yoq bolgan joyda, endi bitta istak yoq. Nima xato, nima notogri notogri bolsa, biz ilgari "qoshimcha belgisi bilan baxtni belgilashimiz kerak! Yoq, mutlaq baxt "minimum deb belgilanishi kerak - ilohiy minus!

paras.en: I remember I stammered unintelligibly:
paras.uz: Ozimni onglab oldim:

paras.en: “Absolute zero!⁠—minus 273° C.”
paras.uz: " Mutlaq nol!" - minus 273 ° C.

paras.en: “Minus 273°⁠—exactly! A somewhat cool temperature. But does it not prove that we are at the summit?”
paras.uz: “Minus 273 ° – aniq! biroz salqin harorat. Lekin bu biz sammitda ekanligimizni isbotlamaydimi?”

paras.en: As before she seemed somehow to speak for me and through me, developing to the end my own thoughts. But there was something so morbid in her tone that I could not refrain⁠ ⁠… with an effort I drew out a “No.”
paras.uz: U men uchun va men orqali gapirish kabi tuyuldi oldin, oz fikrlarini oxirigacha rivojlantirish. Lekin uning ohangida bir narsa bor edi, Men bir "yoq chiqib ketdi harakat bilan.

paras.en: “No,” I said. “You, you are mocking.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Мен: «Йўқ! Сен истеҳзо қиляпсан», деди.

paras.en: She burst out laughing loudly, too loudly. Swiftly, in a second, she laughed herself to some unseen edge, stumbled and fell over.⁠ ⁠… Silence.
paras.uz: Tez orada u ozini biroz gamgin, gamgin va gamgin his qildi.

paras.en: She stood up, put her hands upon my shoulders and looked into me for a long while. Then she pulled me toward her and everything seemed to have disappeared save her sharp, hot lips.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U ornidan turdi, qollarini qolimga qoydi va uzoq vaqt menga qaradi. Keyin u meni unga tortdi va hamma narsa otkir, issiq lablarini saqlab qolganga oxshardi.

paras.en: “Goodbye.”
paras.uz: «Солиҳ».

paras.en: The words came from afar, from above, and reached me not at once, only after a minute, perhaps two minutes later.
paras.uz: Sozlar yuqoridan kelib chiqqan va bir daqiqadan keyin, ehtimol ikki daqiqadan song emas, balki menga etib keldi.

paras.en: “Why⁠ ⁠… why ‘goodbye’?”
paras.uz: "Nima uchun?" - "Nima uchun?"

paras.en: “You have been ill, have you not? Because of me you have committed crimes. Has not all this tormented you? And now you have the Operation to look forward to. You will be cured of me. And that means⁠—goodbye.”
paras.uz: «Сен Мендан жиноятчи бўлдингми? Бас, Мендан пок бўлдинг.

paras.en: “No!” I cried.
paras.uz: Йўқ! Бас, Бани Исроилни Пайғамбар қилиб юбордик.

paras.en: A pitilessly sharp black triangle on a white background.
paras.uz: Oq fonda shafqatsiz otkir qora uchburchak.

paras.en: “What? Do you mean that you don’t want happiness?”
paras.uz: «Nima, siz baxtni xohlamaysiz deganimi?»

paras.en: My head was breaking into pieces; two logical trains collided and crawled upon each other, rattling and smothering.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Mening boshim bolaklarga bolinib ketdi; ikkita mantiqiy poezd bir-biriga tegib, zarba berdi va chayqaldi.

paras.en: “Well, I am waiting. You must choose; the Operation and hundred percent happiness, or.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Xosh, men kutmoqdaman. Siz tanlashingiz kerak; operatsiya va yuz foiz baxt, yoki ..."

paras.en: “I cannot⁠ ⁠… without you.⁠ ⁠… I must not⁠ ⁠… without you.⁠ ⁠…” I said, or perhaps I only thought, I am not sure which, but I-330 heard.
paras.uz: "Men sensiz... men bolmasligim kerak ..." Men aytdim, yoki ehtimol, men nima deb oyladim, lekin men-330 eshitdim.

paras.en: “Yes, I know,” she said. Then, her hands still on my shoulders and her eyes not letting my eyes go, “Then⁠ ⁠… until tomorrow. Tomorrow at twelve. You remember?”
paras.uz: - Ha, bilaman, - dedi u. - Keyin qo'llari hali ham ko'zimga ko'rinmaydi, ertagacha, o'n ikkida.

paras.en: “No, it was postponed for a day. Day-after-tomorrow!”
paras.uz: Йўқ! Бас, у бир кун жазоланди.

paras.en: “So much the better for us. At twelve, day-after-tomorrow!”
paras.uz: «Биз учун яхшироқдир. Ўша иккита, кундуздан кейин», деди.

paras.en: I walked alone in the dusky street. The wind was whirling, carrying, driving me like a piece of paper; fragments of the leaden sky were soaring, soaring⁠—they had to soar through the infinite for another day or two.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men changi kochasida yolgiz yurgan edim. Shamol goyib bolib, meni qogozga oxshatishdi; qorgoshin osmonning bolaklari qorqib ketdi, qozgaldi - ular yana bir-ikki kun cheksiz boylab baqirishlari kerak edi.

paras.en: Unifs of Numbers were brushing my sides⁠—yet I was walking alone. It was clear to me that all were saved but that there was no salvation for me. For I do not want salvation.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Raqamlar birliklari mening tomonlarimni orab olishdi - lekin men yolgiz yurgan edim. Menga hamma qutqarilgan, lekin men uchun najot yoqligi aniq edi.

paras.en: I do not believe⁠—Tractors⁠—A little human splinter.
paras.uz: Ishonmayman — Traktorlar — Insondan qolgan kichik payraxa.

paras.en: Do you believe that you will die? Oh, yes, “Man is mortal. I am a man, consequently.⁠ ⁠…” No, not that; I know that; you know it. But I ask: has it ever happened that you actually believed it? Believed definitely, believed not with your reason but with your body, that you actually felt that some day those fingers which now hold this page, will become yellow, icy?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Siz olasiz deb ishonasizmi? ha, "Men odam oldi deb oylayman. shuning uchun men buni bilmayman; Men buni bilmayman; lekin men: "Siz haqiqatan ham bunga ishonganingizni hech qachon soramadimmi?, sizning sababingiz bilan emas, balki tanangiz bilan, aslida siz ushbu sahifani ushlab turgan barmoqlarning bir kuni sariq, muz bolishini his qilganmisiz?

paras.en: No, of course you cannot believe this. That is why you have not jumped from the tenth floor to the pavement before now, that is why you eat, turn over these pages, shave, smile, write.
paras.uz: Yoq, albatta, siz bunga ishonolmaysiz. Shuning uchun siz oninchi qavatdan pastga tushmadingiz, shuning uchun ovqatlanasiz, bu sahifalarni ozgartiring, silkiting, tabassum qiling, yozing.

paras.en: This very thing, yes, exactly this is alive in me today. I know that that small black hand on the clock will slide down here towards midnight, then again it will start to ascend, and it will cross some last border and the improbable tomorrow will have arrived. I know it, but somehow I do not believe it, or perhaps I think that twenty-four hours are twenty-four years. Therefore I am still able to act, to hurry, to answer questions, to climb the rope-ladder to the Integral. I am still able to feel how the latter is shaking the surface of the water, and I still understand that I must grasp the railing, and I am still able to feel the cold glass in my hand. I see the transparent, living cranes, bending their long necks, carefully feeding the Integral with the terrible explosive food which the motors need. I still see below on the river the blue veins and knots of water swollen by the wind.⁠ ⁠… Yet all this seems very distant from me, foreign, flat⁠—like a draught on a sheet of paper. And it seems to me strange, when the flat, draught-like face of the Second Builder, suddenly asks:
paras.uz: Bu juda narsa, ha, aynan shu men bugun tirikman. Bilaman, soatning kichik qora qoli bu erda yarim kechagacha choziladi, keyin yana yuqoriga kotarila boshlaydi va u bir necha songgi chegarani kesib otadi va ertaga imkonsiz boladi, men buni bilaman, lekin men bunga ishonmayman, yoki yigirma tort soat deb oylayman.Shuning uchun men hali ham harakat qila olaman, Savollarga javob berish, arqonni kotarish uchun integralga kotarilish qanday qilib suv yuzasiga kotarilishini his qila olaman va men hali ham sovuq shishani qolimda his qilishim kerakligini tushunaman. shaffof, jonli boshliqlarni koraman, uzun boyni korib, dvigatelga muhtoj bolgan dahshatli oziq-ovqat bilan toldirish. Men hali ham daryoda kok tomirlar va shamol tomonidan oqib suv tugunlar quyida koraman... Lekin bu barcha mendan juda uzoq korinadi, begona, tekis - qogoz bir varaqda bir burgulash kabi. va u menga korinadi, qachon tekis, Ikkinchi quruvchi-kabi qurgoqchilikka oxshash yuzi, tosatdan soradi:

paras.en: “Well, then. How much fuel for the motors shall we load on? If we count on three, or say three and a half hours.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Xosh, keyin. Biz motorlar uchun qancha yoqilgi yuk boladi? uch yoki uch yarim soat aytish bolsa."

paras.en: I see before me, over a draught, my hand with the counter and the logarithmic dial at the figure 15.
paras.uz: Men oz qolim bilan korib turibman, 15 raqamida hisoblagich va logarifmik terish bilan.

paras.en: “Fifteen tons. But you’d better take⁠ ⁠… yes, better take a thousand.”
paras.uz: «O'n besh tonna. Lekin siz... ha, ming olib qo'ysangiz yaxshi bo'lardi».

paras.en: I said that because I know that tomorrow.⁠ ⁠… I noticed that my hands and the dial began to tremble.
paras.uz: Men buni ertasi kuni bilganim uchun aytdim ... qollarim va terishim titray boshlaganini payqadim.

paras.en: “A thousand! What do you need such a lot for? That would last a week! No, more than a week!”
paras.uz: «Сизга нима бўлди?! Бу бир hafta davom etadi», деди.

paras.en: “Well, nobody knows.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Hech kim bilmaydi..."

paras.en: I do know.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men bilaman ...

paras.en: The wind whistled, the air seemed to be stuffed to the limit with something invisible. I had difficulty in breathing, difficulty in walking, and with difficulty, slowly but without stopping for a second the hand of the Accumulating Tower was crawling, at the end of the avenue. The peak of the Tower reached into the very clouds;⁠—dull, blue, groaning in a subdued way, sucking electricity from the clouds. The tubes of the Musical Tower resounded.
paras.uz: Shamol goyib boldi, havo korinmas narsa bilan chegaraga tushib qolgandek tuyuldi. Men nafas olishda, yurishda qiyinchiliklarga duch keldim va sekin, lekin asta-sekin, ikkinchi qolini toxtatmasdan, yolning oxirida, yolning oxirida toxtadi.

paras.en: As always⁠—four abreast. But the rows did not seem as firm as usual; they were swinging, bending more and more, perhaps because of the wind. There! They seemed to have stumbled upon something at the corner, and they drew back and stopped, congealed, a close mass, a clot, breathing rapidly; at once all had stretched their necks like geese.
paras.uz: Lekin qatorlar odatdagidek qattiq korinmadi; ular koproq va koproq, ehtimol shamol tufayli. Ular burchak ostida nimadir uzilib qolganga oxshardilar va orqaga qarab toxtab, toxtadilar, qopol, yaqin massa, lok, tez nafas olishdi; bir vaqtning ozida boyinlarini tish kabi kesib tashladilar.

paras.en: “Look! No look, look⁠—there, quick!”
paras.uz: Сен: «Қўрқма! Бас, у(Қуръон)га назар сол.

paras.en: “They? Are those they?”
paras.uz: Улар анавиларми?» дерлар.

paras.en: “Ah, never! Never! I’d rather put my head straight into the Machine.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Hech qachon, hech qachon! Men boshimni togridan-togri mashinaga qoyishni afzal koraman."

paras.en: “Silence! Are you crazy?”
paras.uz: Сен пок бўлдингми?» деди.

paras.en: On the corner the doors of the auditorium were ajar, a heavy column of about fifty people⁠—. The word “people” is not the right one. These were heavy-wheeled automatons bound in iron and moved by an invisible mechanism. Not people but a sort of human-like tractor. Over their heads, floating in the air⁠—a white banner with a golden sun embroidered on it, and the rays of the sun: “We are the first! We have already been operated upon! Follow us, all of you!”
paras.uz: "Odamlar sozi temir bilan boglangan va korinmas mexanizm bilan kochib otgan ogir gildirakli avtomatlar edi. emas, balki odamlarning bir turi. ularning boshlari ustidan havoda uchib yurgan oq bayroq - uning ustida oltin quyosh va quyosh nurlari: "Biz birinchimiz!

paras.en: They slowly, unhesitatingly mowed through the crowd, and it was clear that if they had had in their way a wall, a tree, a house, they would have moved on with no more hesitation through wall, tree or house. In the middle of the avenue they fused and stretched out into a chain, arm in arm, their faces turned towards us. And we, a human clot, tense, the hair pricking our heads, we waited. Our necks were stretched out goose-fashion. Clouds. The wind whistled. Suddenly the wings of the chain from right and left bent quickly around us, and faster, faster, like a heavy engine descending a hill, they closed the ring and pulled us toward the yawning doors and inside.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ular asta-sekin kopchilikni orab olishdi va agar ular devor, daraxt, uy bolsa, ular devor, daraxt yoki uy orqali hech qanday tosiqlarsiz harakat qilishlari aniq edi.Yolning ortasida ular devor, daraxt yoki uyga kirib ketishdi, qol bilan, yuzlari bizga yaqinlashdi. Va biz inson lyuksi, qol bilan boglab qoydik, sochlarimiz bizni kutib oldi.

paras.en: Somebody’s piercing cry: “They are driving us in! Run!”
paras.uz: Kimdir yiglab yubordi: "Ular bizni boshqaradilar!"

paras.en: All ran. Close to the wall there still was an open living gate of human beings. Everybody dashed through it, heads forward. Their heads became sharp wedges, so with their ribs, shoulders, hips.⁠ ⁠… Like a stream of water compressed in a firehose they spurted out in the form of a fan⁠—and all around me stamping feet, raised arms, unifs.⁠ ⁠… The double-curved S- with his transparent wing-ears appeared for a moment close before my eyes; he disappeared as suddenly; I was alone among arms and legs appearing for a second and disappearing. I was running.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Devorga yaqin orada hali ham odamlarning ochiq yashash eshigi bor edi. Ularning boshlari oldinga siljiydi, shuning uchun ularning qovurgalari, elkalari, boshlari bilan otkir nayzalar boldi. ... ular fan shaklida paydo bolgan otloqdagi suv oqimi kabi - va men atrofida, qollari, bogimlarini kotarib oldim.... Ikki qirrali S - koz oldida bir lahzaga yaqin paydo boldi; u tosatdan goyib boldi; men qol va oyoqlari orasida bir soniya uchun paydo boldi.

paras.en: I dashed to the entrance of a house to stop for a breath, my back close to the door⁠—and immediately, like a splinter borne by the wind, a human being was thrown towards me.
paras.uz: Men bir uyga kirib, nafas olish uchun toxtadim, orqa eshik eshigiga yaqinlashdim - va darhol shamol bilan oralgan parcha kabi, menga bir odam tashlandi.

paras.en: “All the while I⁠ ⁠… I have been following you. I do not want⁠ ⁠… do you see? I do not want⁠ ⁠… I am ready to.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men sizni kuzatib borayapman ... men xohlamayman ... kormayapsizmi?

paras.en: Small round hands on my sleeves, round dark blue eyes⁠—it was O-90. She just slipped along my body like a unif which, its hanger broken, slips along the wall to fall upon the floor. Like a little bundle she crumpled below me on the cold doorstep, and I stood over her, stroking her head, her face⁠—my hands were wet. I felt as if I were very big and she very small, a small part of myself. I felt something quite different from what I feel towards I-330. I think that the ancients must have had similar feelings towards their private children.
paras.uz: U mening tanamni bir bolagi kabi kesib tashladi, uning kok kok kozlari erga tushib ketdi.U sovuq bogimlarda menga yiqilib tushdi va men uning ustiga yiqildim, boshim, qollarim hol edi. Men ozimni juda katta his qildim va u juda kichik, ozimning kichkina qismim kabi his qildim. Men qadimiylarning oz farzandlariga nisbatan xuddi shunday his-tuygularga ega edi deb oylayman.

paras.en: Below, passing through her hands with which she was covering her face, a voice came to me:
paras.uz: Uning qollari bilan otirganimda, u menga bir ovoz keldi:

paras.en: “Every night I⁠ ⁠… I cannot! If they cure me.⁠ ⁠… Every night I sit in the darkness alone and think of him, and of what he will look like when I.⁠ ⁠… If cured I should have nothing to live with⁠—do you understand me? You must⁠ ⁠… you must.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Men har kecha... agar ular meni davolasalar, har kecha qorongida yolgiz otirib, u haqida oylayman va u menga oxshab korinadigan narsa haqida oylayman ... agar men bilan yashash uchun hech narsa bolmasligim kerak bolsa, meni tushunasizmi?"

paras.en: An absurd feeling yet it was there; I really must! Absurd, because this “duty” of mine was nothing but another crime. Absurd, because white and black cannot be one, duty and crime cannot coincide. Or perhaps there is no black and white in life, but everything depends upon the first logical premise? If the premise is that I unlawfully gave her a child.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ahmoqona tuygu hali ham bor edi; men haqiqatan ham u erda bolishim kerak edi! Chunki mening bu " burchim boshqa jinoyatdan boshqa narsa emas edi., chunki oq va qora bir narsa bolishi mumkin emas, majburiyat va jinoyat sodir eta olmaydi. Yoki hayotda qora va oq narsa yoq, lekin hamma narsa birinchi mantiqiy asosga bogliq.

paras.en: “It is all right, but don’t, only don’t⁠ ⁠…” I said. “Of course I understand.⁠ ⁠… I must take you to I-330, as I once offered to, so that she.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Bu yaxshi, lekin yoq, shunchaki...," dedim men. “Albatta, men sizni bir marta taklif qilganimdek I-330 ga olib borishim kerak.

paras.en: “Yes.” (This in a low voice, without uncovering her face.)
paras.uz: «Ha!» (bu uning yuzini ochmasdan past ovozda).

paras.en: I helped her rise. Silently we went along the darkening street, each busy with his own thoughts, or perhaps with the same thought.⁠ ⁠… We walked between silent leaden houses, through the tense, whipping branches of the wind.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men unga kotarilishga yordam berdim.Biz qorongi kocha boylab, har biri oz fikrlari bilan band yoki ehtimol bir xil fikr bilan bordik. ... Biz sokin qorgoshinli uylar ortasida, shamolning bogimlari orqali yurdik.

paras.en: Through the whistling of the wind all at once I heard, as if splashing through ditches, the familiar footsteps coming from some unseen point. At the corner I turned around, and among the clouds, flying upside-down reflected in the dim glass of the pavement I saw S-. Instantly my arms became foreign, swinging out of time, and I began to tell O-90 in a low voice that tomorrow, yes tomorrow, was the day of the first flight of the Integral, and that it was to be something that never happened before in all history, great, miraculous.
paras.uz: Men shamolning hushtak chalishi orqali bir vaqtning ozida eshitgan edim, goyo tolqinlardan otayotgandek, tanish yollar atrofida aylanib chiqdim va bulutlar orasida men S-ni kordim.Tosatdan qollarim chet elga aylandi, vaqt otib ketdi va ertasi kuni O-90 ga past ovoz bilan aytishni boshladim, ha, bu butun tarixdan oldin hech qachon sodir bolmagan narsa edi, ajoyib, ajoyib.

paras.en: “Think of it! For the first time in life to find myself outside the limits of our city and see⁠—who knows what is beyond the Green Wall?”
paras.uz: "Oylab koring, hayotda birinchi marta ozimni shahar chegaralaridan tashqarida topish va korish uchun - Yashil devordan tashqarida nima borligini kim biladi?"

paras.en: O-90 looked at me extremely surprised, her blue eyes trying to penetrate mine; she looked at my senselessly swinging arms. But I did not let her say a word⁠—I kept talking, talking.⁠ ⁠… And within me, apart from what I was saying and audible only to myself a thought was feverishly buzzing and knocking. “Impossible! You must somehow⁠ ⁠… you must not lead him to I-330!”
paras.uz: O-90 menga juda hayron boldi, uning kok kozlari meni chalgitishga harakat qildi; u mening aql bovar qilmaydigan tebranish qollarimni korib chiqdi; lekin men unga bir soz aytishga ruxsat bermadim - men gapirishda davom etdim ... va ichimda, men aytayotgan va eshitgan narsamdan tashqari, faqat ozimga bir fikr dahshatli va galati edi. "Siz... siz uni biron-bir tarzda I-330 ga olib bormasligingiz kerak!"

paras.en: Instead of turning to the right I turned to the left. The bridge submissively bent its back in a slavish way to all three of us, to me, to O-, to him behind. Lights were falling from the houses across the water, falling and breaking into thousands of sparks which danced feverishly, sprayed with the mad white foam of the water. The wind was moaning like a tensely stretched string of a double-basso somewhere not far away. Through this basso, behind, all the while.⁠ ⁠…
