paras.uz: Ong tomonga burilish orniga, men chap tomonga burilib ketdim. Koprik orqa tomondan ozining orqa tomoniga ogirilib, har uchalamizga, O-ga, orqamga qarab, suv boylab uylar boylab qulab tushdi va suvning aqldan ozgan oq kozi bilan oqib ketgan minglab uchqunlarga qulab tushdi.

paras.en: The house where I live. At the entrance O- stopped and began:
paras.uz: Men yashaydigan uy - O-ga kirishda toxtadi va boshladi:

paras.en: “No! You promised, did you not, that.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Йўқ! Сен ваъда қилдинг-ку!» деди.

paras.en: I did not let her finish. Hastily I pushed her through the entrance and we found ourselves in the lobby. At the controller’s desk⁠—the familiar, hanging, excitedly quivering cheeks, a group of Numbers around. They were quarreling about something, heads bending over the banisters on the second floor; they were running downstairs one by one. But about that later. I at once drew O-90 into the opposite, unoccupied corner and sat down with my back to the wall. I saw a dark large-headed shadow gliding back and forth over the sidewalk. I took out my notebook. O-90 in her chair was slowly sinking as if she were evaporating from under her unif, as if her body were thawing, as if only her empty unif were left, and empty eyes taking one into the blue emptiness. In a tired voice:
paras.uz: Men unga kirishga ruxsat bermadim va biz lobbida ozimizni topdik. Nazoratchining stolida - tanish, qongiroq qiluvchi, hayajon bilan galaba qozonish, raqamlar guruhi atrofida. Ular bir narsa haqida gazablangan edilar, ikkinchi qavatdagi bannerlar ustidan yugurib ketishdi; Ammo bu haqda men bir vaqtning ozida O-90 ni qarama-qarshi tomonga tortdim, ishgol qilinmagan burchakni oldim va devorga otirdim. Charchagan ovoz bilan:

paras.en: “Why did you bring me here? You lied to me?”
paras.uz: «Эй Менинг Пайғамбарим, нима учун мени ёлғончига чиқардингиз?» деди.

paras.en: “No, not so loud! Look here! Do you see? Through the wall?”
paras.uz: Йўқ! Бу жойда кўринг-чи?!» деди.

paras.en: “Yes, I see a shadow.”
paras.uz: "Ha, men soyani koraman."

paras.en: “He is always following me.⁠ ⁠… I cannot.⁠ ⁠… Do you understand? I cannot therefore⁠ ⁠… I am going to write a few words to I-330. You take the note and go alone. I know he will remain here.”
paras.uz: "U har doim meni kuzatib turadi ... men tushunmayapman. Men I-330 ga bir nechta sozlarni yozaman. Siz eslatmani olib, yolgiz borasiz. Bilaman, u bu erda qoladi."

paras.en: Her body began again to take form and to move beneath the unif; on her face a faint sunrise, dawn. I put the note between her cold fingers, pressed her hand firmly and for the last time looked into her blue eyes.
paras.uz: Uning tanasi yana shakllana boshladi va unif ostiga kochib otishni boshladi; uning yuzida qorongi nur, tong. Men uning sovuq barmoqlari orasiga eslatma qoydim, qolini mahkam boglab qoydim va oxirgi marta uning kok kozlariga qaradim.

paras.en: “Goodbye. Perhaps some day.⁠ ⁠…” She freed her hand. Slightly bending over she slowly moved away, made two steps, turned around quickly and again we were side by side. Her lips were moving; with her lips and with her eyes she repeated some inaudible word. What an unbearable smile! What suffering!
paras.uz: Bir kun kelib, u qolini ozod qiladi. "U asta-sekin kochib otdi, ikki qadam orqaga qaytdi, biz tomon tez va yana yonma-yon edik. Uning lablari kochib otdi; lablari va kozlari bilan u bir necha marta ajoyib tabassum qildi!

paras.en: Then the bent-over human splinter went to the door; a bent-over little shadow beyond the wall; without turning around she went on faster, still faster.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Shundan song, bedana ustidan otuvchi eshik oldiga bordi; devorning orqasida biroz soyali; u tezroq, hali ham tezroq aylanib otdi.

paras.en: I went to U-’s desk. With emotion filling up her indignant gills she said to me:
paras.uz: U-bu sozlarni eshitib, konglidan otkazdi:

paras.en: “They have all gone crazy! He, for instance, is trying to assure me that he himself saw a naked man covered with hair near the Ancient House.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Hammalari aqldan ozishdi! Misol uchun, u menga ozini eski uy yaqinidagi sochlar bilan qoplangan yalangoch odamni korishga harakat qilmoqda."

paras.en: A voice from the group of empty raised heads;
paras.uz: bosh boshlar guruhidan ovoz;

paras.en: “Yes. I repeat it, yes.”
paras.uz: Бас, уни жазолайман», деди.

paras.en: “Well, what do you think of that? Oh, what a delirium!” The word “delirium” came out of her mouth so full of conviction, so unbending, that I asked myself: “Perhaps it really was nothing but delirium, all that has been going on around me of late?” I glanced at my hairy hand and I remembered: “There are, undoubtedly, some drops of that blood of the sun and woods in you. That is why perhaps you.⁠ ⁠…” No, fortunately it was not delirium; or no, unfortunately it was not delirium.
paras.uz: - Xosh, nima deb oylaysiz? - deb soradi "Delirium sozi uning ogzidan shunchalik kop ishonch bilan chiqdiki, men ozimga shunday savol berdim: "Ehtimol, bu haqiqatan ham delirium edi, hamma narsa men atrofida sodir bolgan narsa edimi?" Men sochlarimga qaradim va eslayman: "Albatta, sizda quyosh va ormonning bazi tomchilari bor.

paras.en: This without a synopsis, hastily, the last.
paras.uz: Bu qayd qisqa mazmunsiz, shoshilib yozildi. So'nggisi.

paras.en: The day.
paras.uz: day.

paras.en: Quick, to the newspaper! perhaps there.⁠ ⁠… I read the paper with my eyes (exactly; my eyes now are like a pen, or like a counting machine which you hold and feel in your hands like a tool, something foreign, an instrument). In the newspaper on the first page, in large print:
paras.uz: Tez, gazetaga!... Men qogozni kozlarim bilan oqiyman (aniq; endi mening kozlarim qalamga oxshaydi, yoki siz qolingizda ushlab turadigan va asbob kabi his qiladigan hisoblash mashinasi kabi). Birinchi sahifada katta bosmada:

paras.en: “The enemies of happiness are awake! Hold to your happiness with both hands. Tomorrow all work will stop and all the numbers are to come to be operated upon. Those who fail to come will be submitted to the machine of the well-doer.”
paras.uz: «Baxt dushmanlari uyg'oq! Har ikki qo'lingiz bilan baxtingizga rioya qiling. Ertaga barcha ishlar to'xtaydi va barcha raqamlar ishga tushadi.

paras.en: Tomorrow! How can there be, how can there be any tomorrow?
paras.uz: Ertaga qanday bolishi mumkin?

paras.en: Following my daily habit, I stretched out my arm (instrument!) to the bookshelf to put today’s paper with the rest in a cover ornamented with gold. While doing this: “What for? What does it matter? Never again shall I.⁠ ⁠… In this cover, never.⁠ ⁠…” And out of my hands, down to the floor it fell.
paras.uz: Kundalik odatimdan song, men qolimni (asbob!) kitob javoniga oltin bilan qoplangan qopqoq bilan bugun qogozni qoyish uchun qolimni uzatdim. "Nima uchun?" buni amalga oshirayotganda: "Bu nima uchun muhim? hech qachon bu qoplamada ... va qollarimdan u yiqilib tushdi.

paras.en: I stood looking all around, over all my room; hastily I was taking away, feverishly putting into some unseen valise everything I regretted leaving here: my desk, my books, my chair. Upon that chair sat I-330 that day; I was below on the floor.⁠ ⁠… My bed.⁠ ⁠… Then for a minute or two I stood and waited for some miracle to happen; perhaps the telephone would ring, perhaps she would say that.⁠ ⁠… But no, no miracle.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men butun xona boylab qarab turdim; Men tezda olib ketayotgan edim, bazi bir bemani narsalarni qoyib yubordim: stolim, kitoblarim, stulim. Osha stulda otirganimda I-330 otirdim; osha kuni men polda otirdim. ... Keyin bir-ikki daqiqa otirdim va mo " jiza bolishini kutdim; ehtimol telefon jiringlaydi, ehtimol u buni aytadi ... lekin hech qanday mojiza yoq.

paras.en: I am leaving, going into the unknown. These are my last lines. Farewell you, my unknown beloved ones, with whom I have lived through so many pages, before whom I have bared my diseased soul, my whole self to the last broken little screw, to the last cracked spring.⁠ ⁠… I am going.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men ketyapman, nomalum kirib. Bu mening songgi chiziqlar bor. siz, mening nomalum nomalum kishilar, kim bilan men juda kop sahifalar orqali yashagan, oldin men kasal ruhini yoq qilgan kim, oxirgi singan kichik vida uchun butun ozim, oxirgi bahor qadar... Men ketyapman.

paras.en: The forgiven ones⁠—A sunny night⁠—A radio-walkyrie.
paras.uz: Kechirilganlar — Quyoshli tun — Radio-valkiriya.

paras.en: Oh, if only I actually had broken myself to pieces! If only I actually had found myself with her in some place beyond the Wall, among beasts showing their yellow tusks; if only I actually had never returned here! It would be a thousand, a million times easier! But now⁠—what? Now to go and choke that⁠—! But would it help? No, no, no! Take yourself in hand, D-503! Set into yourself the firm logical hub; at least for a short while weigh heavily with all your might on the lever, and like the ancient slave, turn the millstones of syllogisms until you have written down and understood everything that happened.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Oh, agar men haqiqatan ham ozimni bolaklarga bolib tashlagan bolsam edi! Agar men u bilan devordan tashqarida biron bir joyda bolganimda edi, aslida bu erga hech qachon qaytib kelmagan bolardim! Bu ming, million marta osonroq bolar edi! Lekin hozir nima? - Endi borib, buni taqillatish kerak?!Yoq, yoq! ozingizni qolingizga oling, D-503! qatiy mantiqiy markazni ornating; hech bolmaganda sizning qolingiz bilan qisqa vaqt davomida ogirlik qilish mumkin va qadimgi qul singari, siz yozgan va sodir bolgan hamma narsani tushunmaguningizcha, sillogizmning tegirmonlarini aylantiring.

paras.en: When I boarded the Integral, everybody was already there and everybody occupied his place; all the cells of the gigantic hive were filled. Through the glass of the decks⁠—tiny, ant-like people below, at the telegraph, dynamo, transformers, altimeters, ventilators, indicators, motor, pumps, tubes.⁠ ⁠… In the saloon people sitting over tables and instruments, probably those commissioned by the Scientific Bureau. Near them the Second Builder and his two aides. All three had their heads down between their shoulders like turtles, their faces gray, autumnal, rayless.
paras.uz: Men Integralni ornatganimda, hamma bor edi va hamma uning ornini egalladi; ulkan chodirning barcha hujayralari toldirildi. - kichik, piyodalarga oxshash odamlar, quyida joylashgan, dinozavrlar, alerjiyalar, ventilyatorlar, dvigatellar, nasoslar, nasoslar....Badiiy byurosi tomonidan otirgan odamlar.

paras.en: “Well?” I asked.
paras.uz: Men "yaxshimi?" - deb soradim.

paras.en: “Well, somewhat uncanny,” replied one of them smiling a gray rayless smile, “Perhaps we shall have to land in some unknown place. And, generally speaking, nobody knows.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Xosh, biroz noaniq," deb javob berdi ulardan biri kulrang nursiz tabassum bilan, "ehtimol, biz nomalum joyga qonishimiz kerak boladi. va umuman aytganda, hech kim bilmaydi."

paras.en: I hardly could bear to look at them, when in an hour or so I was to throw them out with my own hands, to cast them out from the cozy figures of our Tables of Hours, forever to tear them away from the mother’s breast of the United State. They reminded me of the tragic figures of “The Three Forgiven Ones”⁠—a story known to all of our schoolchildren. It tells about three Numbers, who by way of experiment were exempted for a whole month from any work.3 “Go wherever you will, do what you will,” they were told. The unhappy three wandered the whole time about the place of their usual work and gazed within with hungry eyes. They would stop on the plazas and for hours busy themselves repeating the motions which they were used to making during certain hours of the day; it became a bodily necessity for them to do so. They would saw and plane the air; with unseen sledgehammers they would bang upon unseen stakes. Finally, on the tenth day they could bear it no longer; they took one another by the hand, entered the river, and to the accompaniment of the March they waded deeper and deeper until the water forever ended their sufferings.
paras.uz: Men ularga qarash deyarli mumkin emas edi, bir soat ichida yoki shuning uchun men ularni oz qollarim bilan tashlab yuborish edi qachon, abadiy One State onasining kokragidan ularni yirtib tashlash uchun. Ular menga "Uch uzrli bolganlar fojiali raqamlar haqida esladilar - Bu haqida aytib beradi uch raqamlar, tajriba orqali kim har qanday ish bir oy ozod qilindi. "Agar xohlagan narsani qiling, ular aytilgan edi. baxtsiz uch ularning odatiy ish joy haqida butun vaqt va och kozlari bilan otdi. Ular plazalarda toxtashardi va bir necha soat band bolganlar kunning malum soatlarida qilgan harakatlarini toxtatib turishdi; ular buni korib, havoda uchishga majbur bolishdi; ular notogri qorgoshinlar bilan havoni korishdi; Nihoyat, oninchi kuni ular endi uni ushlab tura olmadilar; ular bir-birlarini qoldan olib, daryo ichiga kirib ketishdi va martning yonida abadiy azob-uqubatlarini tugatmaguncha chuqurroq va chuqurroq suv bilan davom etdilar.

paras.en: I repeat, it was hard for me to look at them, and I was anxious to leave them.
paras.uz: Men ularni korish juda qiyin edi va men ularni tark etishga qorqardim.

paras.en: “I just want to take a glance into the engine-room, and then off!” I said.
paras.uz: “Men faqat dvigatel xonasiga qarashni xohlayman, keyin esa chiqib ketaman!” dedim.

paras.en: They were asking me questions: What voltage should be used for the initial spark, how much ballast water was needed in the tank aft. As if a phonograph were somewhere within me, I was giving quick and precise answers but I, my inner self, was busy with its own thoughts.
paras.uz: Ular menga savol berishdi: dastlabki uchqun uchun qanday kuchlanishdan foydalanish kerak, tankda qancha balast suv kerak edi. xuddi men bir joyda bolganim kabi, men ham tez va aniq javoblarni berayotgan edim, lekin men oz fikrlarim bilan band edim.

paras.en: In the narrow passage gray unifs were passing, gray faces and for a second, one face with its hair low over the forehead, eyes gazing from deep beneath it⁠—it was that same man. I understood: they had come and there was no escape from it for me; only minutes remained, a few dozens of minutes.⁠ ⁠… An infinitesimal, molecular quiver of my whole body. This did not cease to the very end⁠—it was as if an enormous motor were placed under the very foundation of my body which was so light that the walls, partitions, cables, beams, lights⁠—everything was quivering.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tor oqli oq bolaklari otib ketdi, kulrang yuzlar va bir soniya davomida sochlarning pastki qismidan pastga, kozlari uning ostidan pastga - men tushundim: ular kelishdi va men uchun undan hech qanday qochish yoq edi; atigi bir necha daqiqa qoldi, butun tanamning cheksiz, molekulyar gildiragi.Bu juda oxirigacha toxtamadi - xuddi ulkan vosita mening tanamning poydevoriga shunchalik yoruglik, devorlar, pardalar, nurlar, chiroqlar, chiroqlar - hamma narsa goyib bolgandek edi.

paras.en: I did not yet know whether she was there. But I had no time.⁠ ⁠… They were calling me: quick! To the commander’s bridge; time to go⁠ ⁠… where?
paras.uz: Men hali u erda bolganmi yoki yoqmi bilmayman. Lekin menda vaqt yoq edi ... ular menga qongiroq qilishdi: "Tez! qomondon koprigiga, qaerga borish vaqti keldi?

paras.en: Gray, rayless faces. Below in the water⁠—tense blue veins. Heavy, cast-iron patches of sky. It was so difficult to lift my cast-iron hand and take up the receiver of the commander’s telephone!⁠ ⁠… “Up! Forty-five degrees!”
paras.uz: Suv ostida - zich kok tomirlar. ogir, quyma-temir chiziqlar osmon. u mening quyma-temir qolini kotarish va qomondon telefon qabul olish uchun juda qiyin edi! "Yuqori!" qirq besh daraja!

paras.en: A heavy explosion⁠—a jerk⁠—a rabid greenish-white mountain of water aft⁠—the deck beneath my feet began to move, soft as rubber; and everything below, the whole life, forever.⁠ ⁠… For a second, falling deeper and deeper into a sort of funnel, becoming more and more compressed⁠—the icy-blue relief-map of the City, the round bubbles of cupolas, the lonely leaden finger of the Accumulating Tower.⁠ ⁠… Then instantaneously a cotton curtain of cloud.⁠ ⁠… We pierced it, and there was the sun and the blue sky! Seconds, minutes, miles⁠—the blue was hardening, fast filling with darkness; like drops of cold silver sweat appeared the stars.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ogir portlash - kok-yashil-oq suv togi kochib ota boshladi - oyogim ostidagi bosh joy, kauchuk kabi yumshoq; va hamma narsa quyida, butun hayot, abadiy... Bir soniya uchun, shaharning tobora chuqurroq va chuqurroq bolib, kok-kok yordam xaritasi, kok-kok-kok yordam xaritasi, kok rangli minoraning dumaloq izlari ... Keyin biz uni quyosh va kok osmonning yolgiz qorgoshin barmogi bor edi.

paras.en: A sad, unbearably bright, black, starry, sunny night.⁠ ⁠… As if one had become deaf, one still saw that the pipes were roaring, but one only saw, dead silence all about. The sun was mute. It was natural, of course. One might have expected it; we were beyond the terrestrial atmosphere. The transition was so quick, so sudden that everyone became timid and silent. Yet I⁠ ⁠… I thought I felt even easier under that fantastic, mute sun. I had bounded over the inevitable border, having left my body somewhere there below, and I was soaring bodiless to a new world, where everything was to be different, upside down.
paras.uz: Bir gamgin, jirkanch yorqin, qora, yulduz, quyoshli kecha... xuddi qorongu bolgandek, quvurlarning tokilayotganini kordi, lekin faqat bir kishi kordi, hamma jim edi. Albatta, bu tabiiy edi; Biz uni tabiiy ravishda kutgan edik; biz tabiiy muhitdan tashqarida edik; otish shunchalik tez ediki, tosatdan hamma jim va jim bolib qoldi. Shunga qaramay, men osha ajoyib, quyosh ostida ham osonroq his qildim.

paras.en: “Keep the same course!” I shouted into the engine-room, or perhaps it was not I but a phonograph in me, and the same machine with a mechanical, hinge-like movement handed the commander’s trumpet to the Second Builder. All permeated by that most delicate, molecular quiver known only to me, I ran down the companionway, to seek.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: “Bir xil kursni saqlang!” Men dvigatel xonasiga kirdim yoki ehtimol mendagi fonografdan boshqa narsa emas edi va mexanik, mexanik harakatga oxshash harakat bilan bir xil mashina qomondonning qomondonini Ikkinchi quruvchiga topshirdi.

paras.en: The door of the saloon.⁠ ⁠… An hour later it was to latch and lock itself.⁠ ⁠… At the door stood an unfamiliar Number. He was small, with a face like a hundred or a thousand others which are usually lost in a crowd, but his arms were exceptionally long⁠—they reached down to the knees as though by mistake they had been taken from another set of human organs and fastened to his shoulders.
paras.uz: Bir soat otgach, ozini qulflash va qulflash kerak edi.... Eshikda nomalum raqam bor edi.U kichik edi, xuddi yuz yoki ming boshqa odamlar kabi yuz bilan, lekin uning qollari uzun bolib qoldi - ular boshqa inson organlari toplamidan olingan va uning qollariga kotarilgan xato tufayli tizzalariga etib borishdi.

paras.en: The long arm stretched out and barred the way.
paras.uz: Uzun qol chiqib, yolni kesib otdi.

paras.en: “Where do you want to go?”
paras.uz: "Qayerga ketmoqchisan?"

paras.en: It was clear that he was not aware I knew everything. All right! Perhaps it was necessary that it should be so. From above him, in a deliberately significant tone I said:
paras.uz: Ehtimol, bu shunday bolishi kerak edi. Uning tepasidan, men aytgan juda muhim ohangda:

paras.en: “I am the Builder of the Integral and I am directing the test flight. Do you understand?”
paras.uz: “Men integralning yaratuvchisiman va sinov parvozini amalga oshirmoqdaman. Bilasizmi?”

paras.en: The arm drew away.
paras.uz: Qoli chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: The saloon. Heads covered with bristles, gray iron bristles, and yellow heads, and bald, ripe heads were bent over the instruments and maps. Swiftly, with a glance, I gathered them in with my eyes, off I ran, back along the long passage, then through the hatch into the engine-room. There it was hot from the red tubes, overheated by the explosions; a constant roar⁠—the levers were dancing their desperate drunken dance, quivering ceaselessly with a barely noticeable quiver; the arrows on the dials.⁠ ⁠… There! At last! Near the tachometer, a notebook in his hand, was that man with the low forehead.
paras.uz: Kopriklar, kulrang temir kopriklar va sariq boshlar bilan qoplangan, pishgan boshlar asboblar va xaritalar ustiga oralgan edi. Tez orada men ularni kozlarim bilan topladim, uzoq yol boylab yugurdim, keyin dvigatelga otdim.U erda qizil chiziqlardan issiq bolib, portlashlar bilan qizib ketdi; doimiy tor - qollar mast bolgan raqslarini raqsga tushib, toxtovsiz goyib boldi; u erda!

paras.en: “Listen,” I shouted straight into his ear (because of the roar), “Is she here? Where is she?”
paras.uz: Men uning qulogiga togridan-togri: "U shu yerdami?" - dedim.

paras.en: “She? There at the radio.”
paras.uz: У(Мусо): «Бас, у(аёл) жойдадир».

paras.en: I dashed over there. There were three of them, all with receiving helmets on. And she seemed a head taller than usual, wingy, sparkling, flying like an ancient walkyrie, and those bluish sparks from the radio seemed to emanate from her⁠—from her also that ethereal, lightning-like odor of ozone.
paras.uz: Men u erda uch bor edi, ularning hammasi chochqalarni qabul qilishdi. Va u odatdagidan kora balandroq, qanotli, galati, uchib ketayotgan, qadimiy yurish kabi uchib ketgan va radiodagi bu kok uchqunlar undan paydo bolganga oxshardi - shuningdek, ozon hidiga oxshaydi.

paras.en: “Someone⁠—well, you for instance,” I said to her, panting from having run, “I must send a message down to earth, to the docks. Come, I shall dictate it to you.”
paras.uz: Бас, Мен унга: «Мен ер юзида юз ўгиришим, жойларга юборишим керак», деди. Бас, уни сизга юбораман.

paras.en: Close to the apparatus there was a small boxlike cabin. We sat at the table side by side. I found her hand and pressed it hard.
paras.uz: Biz stol yonida otirdik, qolini kordim va qattiq tortdim.

paras.en: “Well, what is going to happen?”
paras.uz: "Xosh, nima boladi?"

paras.en: “I don’t know. Do you realize how wonderful it is? To fly without knowing where⁠ ⁠… no matter where? It will soon be twelve o’clock and nobody knows what.⁠ ⁠… And when night.⁠ ⁠… Where shall you and I be tonight? Perhaps somewhere on the grass, on dry leaves.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Bilmayman, bu qanchalik ajoyib ekanligini bilasizmi? Qaerda bolishidan qati nazar, qaerda bolishidan qati nazar, u tez orada on ikki soat boladi va hech kim nima bilmaydi ... va kecha qachon ... va qachon siz va men bugun qaerda bolamiz?, ehtimol otda, quruq barglarda. "

paras.en: Blue sparks emanated from her and the odor of lightning, and the vibration became more and more frequent within me.
paras.uz: Kok uchqunlar undan paydo boldi va porlash hidi paydo boldi va shovqin ichimda tobora tez-tez paydo boldi.

paras.en: “Write down,” I said loudly, panting (from having run), “Time: eleven-twenty; speed 5800.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Yozishni bas qiling, - dedim baland ovozda (yani yugurishdan), "Vaqt: on yigirma; tezlik 5800 dedim.

paras.en: “Last night she came to me with your note. I know⁠ ⁠… I know everything; don’t talk.⁠ ⁠… But the child is yours. I sent her over; she is already beyond the Wall. She will live.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Kecha u sizning eslatmangiz bilan menga keldi. Men hamma narsani bilaman, lekin gapirmayapman ... lekin bola siznikidir; Men uni jonatdim; u allaqachon devordan tashqarida. U yashaydi."

paras.en: I was back on the commander’s bridge, back in the delirious night with its black, starry sky and its dazzling sun. The hands of the clock on the table were slowly moving from minute to minute. Everything was permeated by a thin, hardly perceptible quivering (only I noticed it). For some reason a thought passed through my head: it would be better if all this took place not here but somewhere below, nearer to earth.
paras.uz: Men qomondonning koprigiga qaytib keldim, qorongi kechada qora, yulduzli osmon va qorongu quyosh bilan qaytib keldim. Stol ustidagi soatning qollari asta-sekin harakatlanardi.Hamma narsa ingichka, deyarli sezilmaydigan goyib boldi (faqat men buni payqadim).Bazi sabablarga kora, bu mening boshim orqali otdi: agar bu erda emas, balki pastda, erga yaqinroq joyda bolsa yaxshi bolardi.

paras.en: “Stop!” I commanded.
paras.uz: «To'xta!» Men buyruq berdim.

paras.en: We kept moving by inertia, but more and more slowly. Now the Integral was caught for a second by an imperceptible little hair⁠—for a second it hung motionless, then the little hair broke and the Integral like a stone dashed downward with increasing speed. That way in silence, minutes, tens of minutes passed. My pulse was audible; the hand of the clock before my eyes came closer and closer to twelve. It was clear to me I was a stone; I-330 the earth; and the stone was under irresistible compulsion to fall downward, to strike the earth and break into small particles. What if⁠ ⁠… ? Already the hard blue smoke of the clouds appeared below.⁠ ⁠… What if⁠ ⁠… ? But the phonograph within me with a hinge-like motion and precision took the telephone and commanded: “Low speed!” The stone ceased falling. Only the four lower tubes were growling, two ahead and two aft, only enough to hold the Integral motionless, and the Integral, only slightly trembling, stopped in the air as if anchored, about one kilometer from the earth.
paras.uz: Endi integral bir soniya davomida korinmas kichkina sochlar bilan qolga olindi - bir soniya davomida u harakatsiz, keyin kichik sochlar buzilib ketdi va on daqiqa davom etdi. Mening pulemyotim baland edi; Mening kozlarim oldida soatning qoli on ikki ga yaqinlashdi. Bu men uchun aniq edi; I-330 yer edi; va tosh qulab tushdi, erni urib, kichik bolaklarga bolinib ketdi. Faqat tortta pastki naycha osib borayotgan edi, ikkitasi oldinga va ikkitasi otdi, faqat integralsiz harakatni ushlab turish uchun etarli, va faqat biroz qorqinchli, havoda toxtadi, xuddi yerdan taxminan bir kilometr uzoqlikda.

paras.en: Everybody came out on deck, (it was shortly before twelve, before the sounding of the dinner-gong) and leaned over the glass railing; hastily, in huge gulps, they swallowed the unknown world which lay below, beyond the Green Wall. Amber, blue, green, the autumnal woods, prairies, a lake. At the edge of a little blue saucer, some lone yellow debris, a threatening, dried-out yellow finger⁠—it must have been the tower of an ancient “church” saved by a miracle.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma pastki qavatga chiqdi, (kechki ovqat-gongning ochilishidan on ikki yil oldin edi) va shisha panjara ustiga qoyildi; Ajablanarlisi shundaki, katta boshliqlarda ular yashil devordan tashqarida joylashgan nomalum dunyoni bosib olishdi.Amber, kok, yashil, kuzgi ormon, marvaridlar, kol.

paras.en: “Look, there! Look! There to the right!”
paras.uz: Сен: «Эй Роббим, Ўзинг у(Қуръон)нинг ўнгидасан», деб айт.

paras.en: There (over the green desert) a brown blot was rapidly moving. I held a telescope in my hands and automatically I brought it to my eyes: the grass reaching their chests, a herd of brown horses was galloping, and on their back⁠—they, black, white, and dark.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U erda (yashil chol ustida) jigarrang murvat tez harakatlanayotgan edi. Men qollarimda teleskop ushlab turdim va avtomatik ravishda kozlarimga olib keldim: ot kokragiga etib bordi, jigarrang otlar podasi va ularning orqasida - ular qora, oq va qorongi edi.

paras.en: Behind me:
paras.uz: Orqamdan:

paras.en: “I assure you, I saw a face!”
paras.uz: Сен: «Албатта, мен бир юзни кўрдим», деди.

paras.en: “Go away! Tell it to someone else!”
paras.uz: Уни бошқага айт!» деди.

paras.en: “Well, look for yourself! Here is the telescope.”
paras.uz: "Xosh, ozingizni izlang! Mana teleskoplar.

paras.en: They had already disappeared. Endless green desert, and in that desert, dominating it completely and dominating me, and everybody⁠—the piercing vibrations of the gong; dinner time, one minute to twelve.
paras.uz: Ular allaqachon goyib boldi. cheksiz yashil chol, va bu cholda, uni toliq ozgartirib, meni va hamma - qogirchoqning yigimlari; kechki ovqat vaqti, bir daqiqadan on ikki daqiqagacha.

paras.en: For a second the little world around me became incoherent, dispersed. Someone’s brass badge fell to the floor. It mattered little. Soon it was under my heel. A voice: “And I tell you, it was a face!” A black square, the open door of the main saloon. White teeth pressed together, smiling.⁠ ⁠… And at that moment, when the clock began slowly, holding its breath between beats, to strike, and when the front rows began to move towards the dining saloon, the rectangle of the door was suddenly crossed by the two familiar, unnaturally long arms:
paras.uz: Kop otmay, kimningdir boshi yerga tushdi. "Men sizga aytsam, bu yuz edi!" degan ovoz ostida: "Men sizga aytaman, qora maydon, asosiy shkafning ochiq eshigi bor edi. ... Va osha paytda, soat asta-sekin, zarba ortasida nafas olishni boshlagan va old qatorlar ovqatlanish joyiga kochib otganida, eshik tosatdan ikkita tanish, tabiiy ravishda uzoq qollar kesib otgan:

paras.en: “Stop!”
paras.uz: Бас, тўғри келинглар», деди.

paras.en: Someone’s fingers sank piercing into my palm. It was I-330. She was beside me.
paras.uz: Kimningdir barmoqlari kaftimga yopishib qoldi. Bu men 3-30 edi. U yonimda edi.

paras.en: “Who is it, do you know him?”
paras.uz: - Kim u, uni taniysizmi? - deb soradi.

paras.en: “Is he not⁠ ⁠… is he not?⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: - U... shunday emasmi? - dedi.

paras.en: He was already lifted upon somebody’s shoulders. Above a hundred other faces, his face like hundreds, like thousands of other faces yet unique among the rest.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U allaqachon birovning qoliga kotarilgan edi. yuz boshqa yuzlardan yuqorida, uning yuzi yuzlab kabi, boshqalar orasida noyob bolgan minglab boshqa yuzlar kabi.

paras.en: “In the name of the Guardians! You, to whom I talk, they hear me, every one of them hears me⁠—I talk to you: we know! We don’t know your numbers yet but we know everything else. The Integral shall not be yours! The test flight will be carried out to the end and you yourselves, you will not dare to make another move! You with your own hands will help to go on with the test and afterward⁠ ⁠… well, I have finished!”
paras.uz: «Siz, men kimga murojaat qilaman, ularning har biri meni eshitadi - men siz bilan gaplashaman: biz sizning raqamlaringizni hali bilmaymiz, lekin biz boshqa hamma narsani bilamiz. Integral sizniki bolmaydi! sinov parvozi oxirigacha amalga oshiriladi va siz ozingiz harakat qilishga jurat etasiz! Siz oz qollaringiz bilan test bilan davom ettirishga yordam berasiz va keyin... yaxshi, men tugadim!»

paras.en: Silence. The glass plates under my feet seemed soft, cotton-like. My feet too⁠—soft, cotton-like. Beside me⁠—she with a dead-white smile, angry blue sparks. Through her teeth to me:
paras.uz: Oyogim ostidagi shisha plitalar yumshoq, paxtaga oxshaydi. Mening oyoqlarim ham yumshoq, paxtaga oxshaydi.Men bilan birga u olik oq tabassum bilan, kok kok uchqunlar bilan gazablangan.

paras.en: “Ah! It is your work! You did your ‘duty’! Well.⁠ ⁠…” She tore her hand from mine; the walkyrie helmet with indignant wings was soon to be seen some distance in front of me. I was alone, torpid, silent. Like everyone else I followed into the dining saloon.
paras.uz: "Oh, bu sizning ishingiz!" - dedi u qolini qolimdan tortib oldi; U gazablangan qanotlari bolgan yurish-turish dubulgasi tez orada mening oldimda biroz masofani korishi kerak edi. Men yolgiz edim, qiynoqqa solingan, jim edim.

paras.en: But it was not I, not I! I told nobody, save these white, mute pages.⁠ ⁠… I cried this to her within me, inaudibly, desperately, loudly. She was across the table, directly opposite me and not once did she even touch me with her gaze. Beside her, someone’s ripe, yellow, bald head. I heard (it was I-330’s voice):
paras.uz: Lekin men hech kimga aytmadim, bu oqni saqlab qoldim.... Men buni unga ichimda yiglab yubordim, bemani, muloyimlik bilan, muloyimlik bilan.U stol boylab edi, togridan-togri menga qarama-qarshi edi va hatto bir marta ham koylagi bilan menga tegmadi.

paras.en: “ ‘Nobility’ of character! But my dear professor, even a superficial etymological analysis of the word shows that it is a superstition, a remnant of the ancient feudal epoch. We.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Ammo mening aziz oqituvchim, hatto sozning axloqiy tahlili shuni korsatadiki, bu qadimgi afsonalarning qoldigi.

paras.en: I felt I was growing pale⁠—and that they would soon notice it. But the phonograph within me performed the prescribed fifty chewing movements for every bite. I locked myself into myself as though into an opaque house; I threw up a heap of rocks before my door and lowered the window-blinds.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men osib borayotganimni his qildim - va ular tez orada buni payqashadi. Lekin mening ichimdagi fonograf har bir luqma uchun belgilangan ellik tasirli harakatlarni amalga oshirdi.Men ozimni goyo galati uyga tushib qolgandek qulfladim; Men eshik oldida bir qator toshlarni tashladim va deraza korlarini yoq qildim.

paras.en: Afterward, again the telephone of the commander was in my hands and again we made the flight with icy, supreme anxiety through the clouds into the icy, starry, sunny night. Minutes, hours passed.⁠ ⁠… Apparently all that time the logical motor within me was working feverishly at full speed. For suddenly somewhere at a distant point of the dark blue space I saw my desk, and the gill-like cheeks of U- over it and the forgotten pages of my records! It became clear to me; nobody but she⁠ ⁠… everything was clear to me!
paras.uz: Shundan song, qomondonning telefoni yana qolimda edi va biz yana muz bilan parvozni amalga oshirdik, bulutlar boylab muzga yuqori tashvish, yulduz, quyosh kechasi otdi. ... daqiqalar, soat otdi....Korinib turibdiki, men ichidagi mantiqiy vosita toliq tezlikda ishlayotgan edi. tosatdan qorongu kok maydonning bir joyida stolimni kordim va U-ning grilga oxshash parchalari va yozuvlarimning unutilgan sahifalari menga aniq boldi; u... hamma narsa menga aniq edi!

paras.en: If only I could reach the radio-room soon⁠ ⁠… winglike helmets, the odor of blue lightnings⁠ ⁠… I remember telling her something in a low voice and I remember how she looked through me and how her voice seemed to come from a distance:
paras.uz: Agar tez orada radio-xonaga etib borsam edi... qanotga oxshash dubulgalar, kok chaqmoqlar hidi... Men unga past ovozda nimadir aytib berganimni eslayman va u menga qanday qarashini va uning ovozi uzoqdan qanday korinishini eslayman:

paras.en: “I am busy. I am receiving a message from below. You may dictate yours to her.”
paras.uz: “Men bandman. Men quyida bir xabar olaman. Siz unga ozingizni tayinlashingiz mumkin”.

paras.en: The small, boxlike little cabin.⁠ ⁠… I thought for a second and then dictated in a firm voice:
paras.uz: Kichkina, kichkina quti, men bir soniya oyladim va keyin qattiq ovoz bilan:

paras.en: “Time 14:40. Going down. Motors stopped. The end of all.”
paras.uz: “Vaqt 14:40. pastga ketadi. Motors toxtadi. barcha oxiri.”

paras.en: The commander’s bridge. The machine-heart of the Integral stopped; we were falling; my heart could not catch up and would remain behind and rise higher and higher into my throat.⁠ ⁠… Clouds.⁠ ⁠… And then a distant green spot⁠—everything green, more and more distinct, running like a storm towards us. “Soon the end.”
paras.uz: Qomondonning koprigi.Integralning mashina yuragi toxtab qoldi; biz pastga tushib qoldik; yuragim orqaga qaytib, tomoqimga yuqori va baland kotariladi. ... Va keyin uzoq yashil joy - hamma narsa yashil, tobora oziga xos bolib, bizga qarshi boron kabi ishlaydi. "Yaqin orada

paras.en: The porcelain-like white distorted face of the Second Builder! It was he who struck me with all his strength; I hurt my head on something; and through the approaching darkness while falling I heard:
paras.uz: U menga butun kuchim bilan zarba berdi; Men biron bir narsaga zarar etkazdim; va men yiqilib tushayotganimda yaqin atrofda:

paras.en: “Full speed⁠—aft!”
paras.uz: "Toliq tezlik - ot!"

paras.en: A brusque jolt upward.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yuqori haroratli kozoynak ...

paras.en: In a ring⁠—A carrot⁠—A murder.
paras.uz: Halqa ichida — Sabzi — Qotillik.

paras.en: I did not sleep all night. The whole night but one thought.⁠ ⁠… As a result of yesterday’s mishap my head is tightly bandaged⁠—it seems to me not a bandage but a ring, a pitiless ring of glass-iron, riveted about my head. And I am busy with the same thought, always the same thought in my riveted circle: to kill U-. To kill U- and then go to her and say: “Now do you believe?” What is most disquieting is that to kill is dirty, primitive. To break her head with something⁠—the thought of it gives me a peculiar sensation of something disgustingly sweet in my mouth, and I am unable to swallow my saliva; I am always spitting into my handkerchief, yet my mouth feels dry.
paras.uz: Men tun boyi uxlamadim, lekin bitta oylab kordim. ... kechaning shamasi tufayli boshim qattiq shikastlanganga oxshaydi - menga uzuk emas, shisha-temir halqa, boshim haqida galati uzuk, har doim xuddi shu fikr bilan bandman: U-ni oldirish va keyin unga borish va: "Endi ishonasizmi?" Eng jirkanch narsa shundaki, boshini oldirish iflos, bemani narsa bilan sindirish - bu mening ogzimga yoqimli bir narsa haqida oziga xos tuygu beradi va men qollarimga singib ketaman; hali ham ogzim quruq.

paras.en: I had in my closet a heavy piston-rod which cracked during the casting and which I brought home in order to find out the cause of the cracking with a microscope. I made my manuscript into a tube (let her read me to the last letter!), pushed the broken piston into that tube and went downstairs. The stairway seemed endless, the steps disgustingly slippery, liquid. I had to wipe off moisture from my mouth very frequently. Downstairs⁠ ⁠… my heart dropped. I took out the piston and went to the controller’s table, but she was not there; instead an empty, icy desk with inkblots. I remembered that today all work was stopped; everybody was to go to be operated upon. Hence there was no need for her to stay here. There was nobody to be registered.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men shkafimda ogir pistonni ushlab turdim va uyga mikroskop bilan olib keldim. Men qolyozmamni naychaga solib qoydim (uni oxirgi harfga oqib qoydim!), singan pistonni naychaga tushirdim va yolga chiqdim. zinapoyaga kotarildim, asta-sekin, suyuqlik.Men ogzimdan namlikni tez-tez ochirib qoydim.

paras.en: The street. It was windy. The sky seemed to be composed of soaring panels of cast-iron. And exactly as it seemed for one moment yesterday, the whole world was broken up into separate, sharp, independent fragments, and each of these fragments was falling at full speed; each would stop for a second, hang before me in the air and disappear without trace. It was as if the black, precise letters on this page should suddenly move apart and begin to jump hither and thither in fright, so that there was not a word on the page, only nonsensical “ap,” “jum,” “wor.” The crowd seemed just as nonsensical, dispersed (not in rows), going forward, backward, diagonally, transversely.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu kocha shamolli edi. Va aynan bir lahzaga oxshab, butun dunyo alohida, otkir, mustaqil chiziqlarga bolinib ketdi va ularning har biri toliq tezlikda qulab tushdi; ularning har biri bir soniyaga toxtab, havoda osib qoydi va iz qoldirmasdan yoq bolib ketadi. xuddi qora, aniq harflar tosatdan bir-biridan uzoqlashishi va qorquv bilan sakrashni boshlashi kerak edi, shuning uchun sahifada faqat bemani "ap," "juft sozi yoq edi.

paras.en: Then nobody. For a second while I was dashing at full speed, suddenly stopping, I saw on the second floor in the glass cage hanging in the air⁠—a man and a woman⁠—a kiss; she standing with her whole body bent backward brokenly: “This is for the last time, forever.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Keyin hech kim yoq. Men bir soniya davomida toliq tezlikda qotib qoldim, tosatdan toxtadim, men havoda osilgan shisha qafasdagi ikkinchi qavatda - erkak va ayol - opichni kordim; u butun tanasi bilan orqada qoldi: "Bu oxirgi marta, abadiy."

paras.en: At a corner a thorny, moving bush of heads. Above the heads, separate, floating in the air, a banner: “Down with the machines! Down with the Operation!” And (distinct from my own self) I thought: “Is it possible that each one of us bears such a pain, that it can be removed only with his heart.⁠ ⁠… That something must be done to each one, before he.⁠ ⁠…” For a second everything disappeared for me from the world, except my beast-like hand with the heavy cast-iron package it held.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir burchak ostida, boshlar kochib otadigan butaning tepasida, alohida-alohida, bayroq: "Ish bilan pastga!" va (oz-ozidan ajralib turadi) Men shunday deb oyladim: "Har birimiz bunday ogriqni boshdan kechira olamizmi, uni faqat yuragi bilan olib tashlash mumkinmi?... Bu har bir kishi uchun amalga oshirilishi kerak bolgan narsa, u oldida...." Bir soniya men uchun dunyodan hamma narsa yoqoldi, u ushlab turgan ogir quyma temir paketi bilan mening qolim bilan.

paras.en: A boy appeared. He was running, a shadow under his lower lip. The lower lip turned out like the cuff of a rolled-up sleeve. His face was distorted; he wept loudly; he was running away from somebody. Stamping of feet was heard behind him.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir bola paydo boldi. U yugurib ketayotgan edi, pastki ogzi ostida soya. pastki labi kotarilgan yengning boyogi kabi paydo boldi. Uning yuzi yirtilib ketdi; u baland ovozda yiglab yubordi; u kimdandir qochib ketdi.

paras.en: The boy reminded me: “U- must be in school. I must hurry!” I ran to the nearest opening of the Underground Railway. At the entrance someone passed me and said, “Not running. No trains today⁠ ⁠… there!” I descended. A sort of general delirium was reigning. The glitter of cut-crystal suns; the platform packed closely with heads. An empty, torpid train.
paras.uz: Bola menga shunday dedi: "Men maktabda bolishim kerak! "Men zudlik bilan metro temir yolining eng yaqin ochilishiga yugurdim. Kirish paytida kimdir mendan otdi va: "Yoq, bugun poezdlar yoq!" dedi.

paras.en: In the silence⁠—a voice. I could not see her but I knew, I knew that intense, living, flexible, whip-like, flogging voice! I felt there that sharp triangle of brows drawn to the temples.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men uni kora olmadim, lekin men uning kuchli, jonli, moslashuvchan, qamchiga oxshash ovozini bilardim! Men u erda mabadlarga chizilgan qoshlarning keskin uchburchagi borligini his qildim.

paras.en: “Let me! Let me reach her! I must!⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Мен унга етарман», деди.

paras.en: Someone’s tentacles caught my arm, my shoulders. I was nailed. In the silence I heard:
paras.uz: Kimdir qolimni, qollarimni ushladi. Men sukutda eshitdim:

paras.en: “No. Go up to them. There they will cure you; there they will overfeed you with that leavened happiness. Satiated, you will slumber peacefully, organized, keeping time and snoring sweetly. Is it possible that you do not yet hear that great symphony of snoring? Foolish people! Don’t you realize that they want to liberate you from these gnawing, worm-like, torturing question marks? And you remain standing here and listening to me? Quick! Up! To the Great Operation! What is your concern, if I remain here alone? What does it matter to you if I want to struggle, hopelessly struggle? So much the better! What does it matter to you that I do not want others to desire for me? I want to desire for myself. If I desire the impossible.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Yoq, ular sizga shifo berishadi; u erda ular sizni tark etgan baxt bilan toldiradilar. Toyingan, siz tinch tarzda yoq bolib ketasiz, vaqtni tartibga solasiz va shirin his qilasiz. Agar siz hali ham bu dahshatli shovqinni eshitmasligingiz mumkin? ahmoq odamlar! va siz bu erda qoling va meni tinglaysiz!" Buyuk operatsiyaga, agar men yolgiz qolishni xohlasam, nima qilishim kerak?

paras.en: Another voice, slow, heavy:
paras.uz: Boshqa ovoz, sekin, ogir:

paras.en: “Ah, the impossible! Which means to run after your stupid fancies; those fancies would whirl from under your very noses like a tail. No, we shall catch that tail, and then.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Yoq, iloji yoq! bu sizning ahmoqona xayolingizdan keyin yugurishni anglatadi; bu xayol sizning burunlaringiz ostidan quyruq kabi oqib chiqadi.

paras.en: “And then⁠—swallow it and fall snoring; a new tail will become necessary. They say the ancients had a certain animal which they called ‘Ass.’ In order to make it go forward they would attach a carrot to a bow held in front of its nose, so that it could not reach it.⁠ ⁠… If it had caught and swallowed it.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Va keyin uni yutib yuboring va yiqilib tushing; yangi quyruq kerak boladi. Aytishlaricha, qadimgilarning malum bir hayvoni bor edi, ular "Ass deb atashgan.

paras.en: The tentacles suddenly let me go; I threw myself towards the place she was speaking from; but at that very moment everything was brought to confusion. Shouts from behind: “They are coming here! Coming here!” The lights twinkled and went out⁠—someone cut the cable⁠—and everything was like a lava of cries, groaning, heads, fingers.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men tosatdan ketishimga ruxsat berdim; Men u gapirayotgan joyga ozimni tashladim; lekin osha paytda hamma narsa chalkashliklarga olib keldi. "Ular bu erga kelishdi!" chiroqlar bu erga keldi va tashqariga chiqdi - kimdir kabelni kesib tashladi va hamma narsa yiglayotgan, yiglayotgan, boshlari, barmoqlari kabi edi.

paras.en: I do not know how long we were rolled about that way in the underground tube. I only remember that steps were felt, dusk appeared, becoming brighter and brighter, and again we were in the street, dispersing fan-wise in different directions.
paras.uz: Men er osti naychasida qancha vaqt otirganimizni bilmayman.Faqat eslayman, qadamlar sezildi, chang paydo boldi, yanada yorqinroq va yorqinroq boldi va biz yana kochada edik, fanni turli yonalishlarda tarqatib yubordik.

paras.en: Again I was alone. Wind. Gray, low twilight crawling over my head. In the damp glass of the sidewalk, somewhere very deep, there were light topsy-turvy walls and figures moving along, feet upward. And that terribly heavy package in my hands pulled me down into that depth to the bottom.
paras.uz: Men yana yolgiz edim. Shamol, boshim ustidan past yogingarchilik.Toshmaning nam oynasida juda chuqur joyda engil tos boshligi devorlari va korsatkichlar oralgan edi.Qollarimdagi dahshatli ogir paket meni pastga tushirdi.

paras.en: At the desk again. U- was not yet there; her room was dark and empty. I went up to my room and turned on the light. My temples tightly bound by the iron ring were pulsating. I paced and paced, always in the same circle: my table, the white package on the table, the bed, my table, the white package on the table.⁠ ⁠… In the room to my left the curtains were lowered. To my right: the knotty bald head over a book, the enormous parabolic forehead. Wrinkles on the forehead like a series of yellow, illegible lines. At times our eyes met and then I felt that those lines were about me.
paras.uz: Men qorongi va bosh emas edi. temir halqa bilan qoplangan mening ibodatxonalarim, har doim bir xil doirada: mening stolimda, toshagimda, stolimda, stolimda, stolimda oq toplamim.... Mening ongimda: yalangoch bosh kitob ustida, ulkan parabolik bilaguzuk.Bazida bizning kozlarimiz uchrashdi va keyin bu chiziqlar men haqimda ekanligini his qildim.

paras.en: … It happened at twenty-one o’clock exactly. U- came in on her own initiative. I remember that my breathing was so loud that I could hear it and that I wanted to breathe less noisily but was unable to.
paras.uz: Oz tashabbusi bilan u yigirma bir soat ichida sodir boldi.U - Men nafasim shunchalik baland ediki, uni eshitishim mumkin edi va men kamroq shovqinli nafas olishni xohladim, lekin qila olmadim.

paras.en: She sat down and arranged the fold of her unif on her knees. The pinkish-brown gills were waving.
paras.uz: U otirdi va uning boynini tizzalariga ornatdi.

paras.en: “Oh, dear, is it true that you are wounded? I just learned about it, and at once I ran.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Oyijon, siz kasal bolib qolganingizga togri keladimi? men bu haqda bilib oldim va birdan yugurib ketdim."

paras.en: The piston was before me on the table. I jumped up, breathing even louder. She heard, and stopped halfway through a word and rose. Already I had located the place on her head; something disgustingly sweet was in my mouth.⁠ ⁠… My handkerchief! I could not find it. I spat on the floor.
paras.uz: Men ornimdan turdim, undan ham balandroq nafas oldim va bir soz bilan toxtadim va kotarildim. allaqachon uning boshiga joy topdim; ogzimga shirin narsa bor edi.

paras.en: The fellow with the yellow fixed wrinkles which think of me! It was necessary that he should not see. It would be even more disgusting if he could.⁠ ⁠… I pressed the button. (I had no right to do that, but who cared about rights then?) The curtains fell.
paras.uz: Men haqimda oylaydigan sariq sobit chiziqlar bilan yigit! U kormasligi kerak edi. Agar men tugmani bosgan bolsam, bundan ham dahshatli bolar edi. (men buni qilishga haqqim yoq edi, lekin keyin huquqlar haqida kim qaygurardi?) Pardalar qulab tushdi.

paras.en: Evidently she felt and understood what was coming for she rushed to the door. But I was quicker than she and I locked the door with the key, breathing loudly and not taking my eyes for a second away from that place on her head.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ammo men u va men eshikni qulfladim, nafas oldim va kozlarimni osha joydan bir soniya uzoqlashtirmadim.

paras.en: “You⁠ ⁠… you are mad! How dare you.⁠ ⁠…” She moved backward towards the bed, put her trembling hands between her knees.⁠ ⁠… Like a tense spring, holding her firmly with my gaze, I slowly stretched out my arm towards the table (only one arm could move), and I snatched the piston.
paras.uz: "Qanday qilib aqldan ozgansiz?" U orqaga qarab yol oldi, oyoqlari orasiga qollarini qoydi. ... Xuddi chozilgan bahor singari, uni koylagim bilan mahkam ushlab, asta-sekin qolimni stol ustiga qoydim (faqat bitta qol harakat qilishi mumkin) va men pistonni tortib oldim.

paras.en: “I implore you! One day⁠—only one day! Tomorrow I shall go and attend to the formalities.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Бас, Мен сени жуда ҳам яхши кўрдим. Бас, Мен жаннатга кираман», деди.

paras.en: What was she talking about? I swung my arm.⁠ ⁠… And I consider I killed her. Yes, you my unknown readers, you have the right to call me murderer. I know that I should have dealt the blow on her head had she not screamed:
paras.uz: - Yoq, oglim, siz meni oldirish huquqiga egasiz, - dedi u. - Agar ozimni oldirgan bolsam, ozimni oldirishim kerak.

paras.en: “For⁠ ⁠… for the sake⁠ ⁠… I agree.⁠ ⁠… I⁠ ⁠… one moment.⁠ ⁠…” With trembling hands she tore off her unif;⁠—a large, yellow, drooping body, she fell upon the bed.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: "Men... bir lahzaga rozi bolaman..." - u qollari bilan uning boynini yirtib tashladi; - katta, sariq, shongin tanasi, u toshakda yiqilib tushdi.

paras.en: Then I understood; she thought that I pulled the curtains⁠ ⁠… in order to⁠ ⁠… that I wanted.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Keyin tushundim: u men xohlagan narsani qilish uchun pardalarni tortib oldim deb oyladi ...

paras.en: This was so unexpected and so stupid that I burst out laughing. Immediately the tense spring within me broke and my hand weakened and the piston fell to the floor.
paras.uz: Bu kutilmagan va ahmoqona edi, shuning uchun men gazabimni tokib tashladim. tezda ichimdagi achchiq buloq buzilib ketdi va qolim shishib ketdi va piston erga tushdi.

paras.en: Here I learned from personal experience that laughter is the most terrible of weapons; you can kill anything with laughter, even murder. I sat at my table and laughed desperately; I saw no way out of that absurd situation. I don’t know what would have been the end if things had run their natural course, for suddenly a new factor in the arithmetical chain: the telephone rang.
paras.uz: Bu erda men shaxsiy tajribadan sokish eng dahshatli qurol ekanligini bilib oldim; siz yiglab, hatto oldirish bilan biron bir narsani oldirishingiz mumkin. Men stolimda otirdim va tabassum qildim; Men bu bemani vaziyatdan hech qanday yol kormadim. agar narsalar tabiiy yolni bosib otgan bolsa, nima bolar edi, tosatdan patologik zanjirda yangi omil: telefon oraligi.

paras.en: I hurried, grasped the receiver. Perhaps she⁠ ⁠… I heard an unfamiliar voice:
paras.uz: Men uni kordim, lekin uning ovozini eshitdim:

paras.en: “Wait a minute.”
paras.uz: Сен: «Бас, бир оз қимирла», деди.

paras.en: Annoying, infinite buzzing. Heavy steps from afar, nearer and louder like cast-iron, and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uzoqdan, eng yaqin va baland boyli quyma temir kabi ogir qadamlar va...

paras.en: “D-503? The Well-Doer speaking. Come at once to me.”
paras.uz: Бас, Роҳман гапирди. Менга бирдан келинглар», деди.

paras.en: Ding! He hung up the receiver. Ding! like a key in a keyhole.
paras.uz: Бас, у юз ўгирди. Бас, Қуръони Каримда Қуръони Каримни Каримга Пайғамбар қилиб юборди.

paras.en: U- was still in bed, eyes closed, gills apart in the form of a smile. I picked up her clothes, threw them on her and said through clenched teeth:
paras.uz: U- hali yotoqda edi, kozlari yopiq, bir tabassum shaklida ajratilgan gril. Men uning kiyimlarini olib, uni tashladi va klirens tishlari orqali dedi:

paras.en: “Well. Quick! Quick!”
paras.uz: Бас, тезда!» деди.

paras.en: She raised her body on her elbow, her breasts hanging down to one side, eyes round. She became a figure of wax.
paras.uz: U yelkasida tanasini kotardi, kozlarini bir tomonga, kozlarini yumaloq qilib qoydi.

paras.en: “What?”
paras.uz: "Nima?"

paras.en: “Get dressed, that is what!”
paras.uz: «Бу покдир», деб айт.

paras.en: Face distorted, she firmly snatched her clothes and said in a flat voice, “Turn away.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Yuzini burishtirib, kiyimlarini mahkam boglab, tekis ovoz bilan: "Orningdan tur dedi.

paras.en: I turned away, pressed my forehead against the glass. Light, figures, sparks, were trembling in the black, wet mirror.⁠ ⁠… No, all this was I, myself⁠—within me.⁠ ⁠… What did he call me for? Is it possible that he knows already about her, about me, about everything?
paras.uz: Men yuz ogirdi, shisha qarshi mening bosh barmogimni qoydi. nur, raqamlar, uchqunlar, qora qorqinchli edi, hol oyna... Yoq, bularning hammasi men edim, ozim - u meni nima chaqirdi? u allaqachon men haqimda, hamma narsa haqida biladimi?

paras.en: U-, already dressed, was at the door. I made a step toward her and pressed her hand as hard as though I hoped to squeeze out of it drop by drop what I needed.
paras.uz: U-, allaqachon kiyingan edi, eshik oldida edi. Men unga bir qadam qoydim va kerak bolgan narsani tashlab yuborishdan umid qilganimdek, qolimni qattiq tortdim.

paras.en: “Listen.⁠ ⁠… Her name, you know whom I am talking of⁠—did you report her name? No? Tell the truth, I must.⁠ ⁠… I care not what happens, but tell the truth!”
paras.uz: - Nima bo'ldi, nima bo'ldi? - so'radi u. - Nima bo'ldi, nima bo'ldi?

paras.en: “No.”
paras.uz: “Yo'q”.

paras.en: “No? But why not, since you.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Йўқ! Бас, нима учун сизлардан эмас», деди.

paras.en: Her lower lip turned out like the lip of that boy and her face⁠ ⁠… tears were running down her cheeks.
paras.uz: Uning ogzi bu bolaning ogziga oxshab ketdi va uning kozlari yoshlandi.

paras.en: “Because I⁠ ⁠… I was afraid that if I did you might⁠ ⁠… you would stop lov⁠—Oh, I cannot, I could not!”
paras.uz: "Men qorqib ketdim, agar shunday bolsa, siz toxtashingiz mumkin edi - men qila olmayman!"

paras.en: I understood. It was the truth. Absurd, ridiculous, human truth. I opened the door.
paras.uz: Men tushundim. Bu haqiqat edi. bemanilik, bemanilik, inson haqiqati. eshikni ochdim.

paras.en: Empty pages⁠—The Christian god⁠—About my mother.
paras.uz: Bo'sh sahifalar — Nasroniylarning xudosi — Onam haqida.

paras.en: It is very strange that a kind of empty white page should be left in my head. How I walked there, how I waited (I remember I had to wait), I know nothing about it; I remember not a sound, not a face, not a gesture, as if all communicating wires between me and the world were cut.
paras.uz: Qanday qilib men u erga bordim, qanday qilib kutdim (men kutishim kerak edi), bu haqda hech narsa bilmayman; Men yuzni emas, balki yuzni eslayman, xuddi men va dunyo ortasidagi barcha sirpanchiqlar kesilganga oxshaydi.

paras.en: When I came to, I found myself standing before Him; I feared to raise my eyes⁠—I saw only His enormous cast-iron hands upon His knees. Those hands weighed upon Him, bending His knees with their weight. He was slowly moving His fingers. His face was somewhere above as if in fog. And, only because His voice came to my ear from such a height, it did not roar like thunder, it did not deafen me but appeared to be an ordinary human voice.
paras.uz: Men kelganimda, men uning oldida turganimni kordim; Men kozlarimni kotarishdan qorqardim - faqat uning oyoqlariga ulkan quyma temir qollarini kordim. Uning qollari ogirligi bilan oyoqlariga osilgan.U asta-sekin barmoqlarini kotardi.

paras.en: “Then you too, you the Builder of the Integral! You, whose lot it was to become the greatest of all conquistadores! You whose name was to have been at the head of a glorious, new chapter of the history of the United State! You.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Сен ҳам Исломнинг Роббисан! Унинг Ўзи Қуръони Каримда Пайғамбаримиз (с. а. в.) Пайғамбарлик қилган эдинг.

paras.en: Blood ran to my head, to my cheeks⁠—and here again a white page; only the pulsation in my temples and the heavy voice from above; but I remember not a word. Only when He became silent I came to and noticed how His hand moved heavily like a thousand pounds, and crawled slowly⁠—a finger threatened me.
paras.uz: Qon boshimgacha, boynimga va yana oq sahifaga yugurdi; faqat mening ibodatxonalarimdagi pulsatsiya va yuqoridan ogir ovozni eslayman; lekin men bir sozni eslay olmayman.Faqat U jim bolganida, men uning qoli ming funtga oxshab qanday harakat qilganini kordim va asta-sekin - barmogim meni qorqitdi.

paras.en: “Well! Why are you silent? Is it true, or not? Executioner? So!”
paras.uz: «Эй Нуҳ, нима учун пок бўлдингиз?! Бу ҳақми ёки йўқми?!» деди.

paras.en: “So,” I repeated submissively. And then I clearly heard every word of His.
paras.uz: Бас, Мен Унинг ҳар бир сўзини очиқ-ойдин эшитдим.

paras.en: “Well then? Do you think I am afraid of the word! Did you ever try to take off its shell and look into its inner meaning? I shall tell you.⁠ ⁠… Remember a blue hill, a crowd, a cross? Some up on the hill, sprinkled with blood, are busy nailing a body to the cross; others below, sprinkled with tears, are gazing upward. Does it not seem to you that the part which those above must play is the more difficult, the most important part? If it were not for them, how could that magnificent tragedy ever have been staged? True, they were hissed by the dark crowd but for that the author of the tragedy, God, should have remunerated them the more liberally, should he not? And the Christian, most clement God himself, who burnt on a slow fire all the infidels, is he not an executioner? Was the number of those burned by the Christians less than the number of burned Christians? Yet (you must understand this!), yet this God was for centuries glorified as the God of love! Absurd? Oh, no. Just the contrary. It is rather a patent for the imperishable wisdom of man, written in blood. Even at the time when he still was wild and hairy man knew that real, algebraic love for humanity must inevitably be inhuman, and that the inevitable mark of truth is cruelty, just as the inevitable mark of fire is its property of causing the sensation of burning. Could you show me a fire that would not hurt? Well, prove now your point! Proceed! Argue!”
paras.uz: "Xosh, men hech qachon uning qobigini olib, uning ichki manosini korib chiqishga harakat qildimmi?... Kok tepalikni, olomonni, xochni, qon bilan toldirilgan bazi birlarini xochda boglab qoyishni eslayman; boshqalar, koz yoshlari bilan oynashgan. Va Masihning ozi, eng xotirjam Xudo, kim bir sekin olov yoqib, u qatl qiluvchi emas? hali bu Xudo sevgi Xudosi sifatida asrlar davomida bolgan?, Yoq, aksincha. Bu inson aql uchun emas, balki patent, qon yozilgan. hatto u hali ham yovvoyi va soch odam edi, insoniyat uchun algebraik sevgi inson bolishi kerak, deb bilgan va haqiqatning cheksiz belgisi shafqatsiz bolgani kabi, olov uning oziga xos xususiyati bolishi mumkin?

paras.en: How could I argue? How could I argue when those thoughts were once mine, though I was never able to dress them in such a splendid, tempered armor. I remained silent.
paras.uz: Qanday qilib men bu fikrlarni bir marta bolganimda qanday bahslashishim mumkin, garchi men ularni hech qachon bunday ajoyib, shafqatsiz qurolda kiyishga qodir bolmagan bolsam ham. Men jim qoldim.

paras.en: “If your silence is intended to mean that you agree with me, then let us talk as adults do after the children have gone to bed; let us talk to the logical end. I ask: what was it that man from his diaper age dreamed of, tormented himself for, prayed for? He longed for that day when someone would tell him what happiness is and then would chain him to it. What else are we doing now? The ancient dream about a paradise.⁠ ⁠… Remember: there in paradise they know no desires any more, no pity, no love; there they are all⁠—blessed. An operation has been performed upon their centre of fancy; that is why they are blessed, angels, servants of God.⁠ ⁠… And now, at the very moment when we have caught up with that dream, when we hold it like this”: (He clenched his hand so, that if he had held a stone in it sap would have run out!) “At the moment when all that was left for us was to adorn our prize and distribute it amongst all in equal pieces, at that very moment you, you.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Agar sizning sukutingiz men bilan rozi bolishni anglatsa, bolalar uxlab yotganidan keyin kattalar kabi gaplashaylik; mantiqiy maqsadga erishaylik: u oz yoshidan orzu qilgan odam ozi uchun ibodat qildi, ozi uchun ibodat qildimi? U osha kuni uzoq vaqt davomida unga baxt nima ekanligini aytib berdi va keyin uni boglab qoydi. Va endi, biz bu tushni qolga kiritganimizda, biz uni shunday ushlab turganimizda: " (U qolini siladi, agar u osha erda tosh ushlab tursa edi!) "Biz uchun qolgan hamma narsa bizning mukofotimizni bezash va uni teng bolaklarga bolish edi, xuddi shu paytda siz ... "

paras.en: The cast-iron roar was suddenly broken off. I was as red as a piece of iron on an anvil, under the moulding sledgehammer. This seemed to have stopped for a second, hanging in air, and I waited, waited⁠ ⁠… until suddenly:
paras.uz: Tosatdan quyma temir tovoq singan edi. Men arpabodiyon ostida temir parcha kabi qizil boldim.Bu bir soniya davomida toxtab, havoda osilib qolganga oxshardi va men kutib turdim ... tosatdan:

paras.en: “How old are you?”
paras.uz: "Siz necha yoshdasiz?"

paras.en: “Thirty-two.”
paras.uz: Бас, икковлари: «Салом», дедилар.

paras.en: “Just double the age, and as simple as at sixteen! Listen. Is it possible that it really never occurred to you that they (we do not yet know their names but I am certain you will disclose them to us), that they were interested in you only as the Builder of the Integral? only in order to be able through the use of you⁠—”
paras.uz: "Faqat yoshi ikki barobar va on olti kabi oddiy! ular hech qachon sizga sodir bolishi mumkin, deb (biz hali ularning ismlarini bilmayman, lekin men siz ularni bizga oshkor boladi ishonch hosil), Ular faqat integral quruvchi sifatida sizni qiziqtirgan edi, deb? faqat siz foydalanish imkoniyatiga ega bolish uchun -”

paras.en: “Don’t! Don’t!” I cried. But it was like protecting yourself with your hands and crying to a bullet: you may still be hearing your own “don’t” but the bullet meanwhile has burned you through, and writhing with pain, you are prostrated on the ground.
paras.uz: "Yoq!" Men yigladim. Lekin bu sizning qolingiz bilan ozingizni himoya qilish va oqga yiglash kabi edi: siz hali ham ozingizning "yoq ni eshitishingiz mumkin, ammo oq sizni yoqib yubordi va ogriq bilan yozish, siz erga komildingiz.

paras.en: Yes, yes; the Builder of the Integral.⁠ ⁠… Yes, yes.⁠ ⁠… At once there came back to me the angry face of U- with twitching, brick-red gills, on that morning when both of them.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ha, ha, osha kuni ertalab ikkalasi ham bolganida, menga gazablangan U-ning yuzi keldi.

paras.en: I remember now, clearly, how I raised my eyes and laughed. A Socrates-like, bald-headed man was sitting before me; and small drops of sweat dotted the bald surface of his cranium.
paras.uz: Men hozir aniq eslayman, qanday qilib kozlarimni kotarib, kulishni boshladim. oldimda otirgan va ozgina ter tomchilari uning kranining nozik yuzasini boglab turardi.

paras.en: How simple, how magnificently trivial everything was! How simple! Almost to the point of being ridiculous. Laughter was choking me and bursting forth in puffs; I covered my mouth with my hand and rushed wildly out.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qanchalik sodda, hamma narsa ajoyib edi! Qanday qilib sodda bolish kerak.Kongil aynish meni chalgitdi va bogib qoydi; Men ogzimni qolim bilan yopib, tashqariga chiqdim.

paras.en: Steps. Wind. Damp, leaping fragments of lights and faces.⁠ ⁠… And while running: “No! Only to see her! To see her once more!”
paras.uz: "Yoq, faqat uni yana bir bor korish uchun!"

paras.en: Here again, an empty white page. All I remember is feet; not people, just feet; hundreds of feet, confusedly stamping feet, falling from somewhere on the pavement; a heavy rain of feet.⁠ ⁠… And some cheerful, daring voice, and a shout that was probably for me: “Hey, hey! Come here! Come along with us!”
paras.uz: Bu erda yana, bosh oq sahifa.Faqat men eslayman: odamlar, faqat oyoqlari; yuzlab oyoq, notogri oyoq, bir joydan pastga tushib; va bazi yoqimli, jasur ovoz va ehtimol men uchun edi: "Hey!

paras.en: Afterward⁠—a deserted square heavily overloaded with tense wind. In the middle of the square a dim, heavy threatening mass⁠—the Machine of the Well-Doer; and a seemingly unexpected image arose within me in response to the sight of the Machine: a snow-white pillow and on the pillow a head thrown back, and half-closed eyes and a sharp, sweet line of teeth.⁠ ⁠… All this seemed so absurdly, so terribly connected with the Machine. I know how this connection has come about but I do not yet want to see it nor to say it aloud⁠—I don’t want to! I do not!
paras.uz: Shundan song - kvadratning ortasida qattiq shamol bilan juda kotarilgan, ogir ogriqli massa - Yaxshi-Doer mashinasi; va mening ichimda mashinaning koziga javoban kutilmagan tasvir: qor-oq yostiq va yostiqda yarim yopiq kozlar va tishlarning otkir, shirin chizigi paydo boldi ... bularning barchasi bemani korindi, shuning uchun mashina bilan bogliq boldi. Men bu aloqa qanday qilib kelganini bilaman, lekin buni korishni xohlamayman yoki aytishni xohlamayman - men xohlamayman!

paras.en: I closed my eyes, sat down on the steps which lead upwards to the Machine. I must have been running for my face was wet. From somewhere very far away cries were coming. But nobody heard them; nobody heard me crying: “Save me from it⁠—save me!”
paras.uz: Men kozlarimni yumdim, mashinaga olib boradigan qadamlar ustida otirdim. Men yuzimni hol qilib yurgan bolishim kerak edi. juda uzoq joydan yiglab yubordi. Lekin meni hech kim eshitmadi: "Meni undan qutqar!"

paras.en: If only I had a mother as the ancients had⁠—my mother, mine, for whom I should be not the Builder of the Integral and not D-530, not a molecule of the United State but merely a living human piece, a piece of herself, a trampled, smothered, a cast-off piece.⁠ ⁠… And though I were driving the nails into the cross or being nailed to it (perhaps it is the same), she would hear what no one else could hear; her old grown-together wrinkled lips.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Agar men ota-onam bolganimda edi - onam, mening onam, men D-530 emas, balki bitta davlatning molekulasi, ozi, tuzogiga tushgan, tugilgan, quyma qism bolishi kerak edi. ... Va men mixlarni xochga haydab ketayotgan bolsam ham (ehtimol, xuddi shunday), u boshqa hech kim eshitmaydigan narsani eshitishi mumkin edi; uning katta yoshli ogizlari.

paras.en: Infusorian⁠—Doomsday⁠—Her room.
paras.uz: Infuzoriya — Qiyomat kuni — Uning xonasi.

paras.en: This morning while we were in the refectory, my neighbor to my left whispered to me in a frightened tone:
paras.uz: Ertalab ong qolim bilan qotogimni kotarib oldim:

paras.en: “But why don’t you eat? Don’t you see, they are looking at you!”
paras.uz: Бас, нимага емайсизлар?! Улар сенга назар солурлар», деди.

paras.en: I had to pluck up all my strength to show a smile. I felt it⁠—like a crack in my face; I smiled and the borders of the crack drew apart wider and wider; it was quite painful.
paras.uz: Men tabassum korsatish uchun barcha kuchimni ishga solishga majbur boldim. - Men yuzimdagi yoriqlar kabi his qildim; Men tabassum qildim va yoriqlarning chegaralari kengroq va kengroq ajralib chiqdi; bu juda ogriqli edi.

paras.en: What followed was this: no sooner had I lifted the small cube of paste upon my fork, than my fork jerked from my hand and tinkled against the plate, and at once the tables, the walls, the plates, the air even, trembled and rang; and outside too, an enormous, iron, round roar reaching the sky⁠—floating over heads and houses it died away in the distance in small, hardly perceptible circles like those upon water.
paras.uz: Bu quyidagicha edi: ilgari men qolimdan bogimdagi pastaning kichik kubini kotarmadim va bir vaqtning ozida plitalar, devorlar, plitalar, havo, chozilgan va oraligida boglab qoydim; va tashqari, ulkan temir, dumaloq tom osmonga etib bordi - u suvdagi kabi kichik, deyarli sezilmaydigan doiralarda uzoq masofani bosib otdi.

paras.en: I saw faces instantaneously grow faded and bleached; I saw mouths filled with food suddenly motionless and forks hanging in air. Then everything became confused, jumped off the centuries-old tracks, everybody jumped up from his place (without singing the Hymn!) and confusedly, in disorder, hastily finishing chewing, choking, grasping one another.⁠ ⁠… They were asking: “What? What happened? What?⁠ ⁠…” And the disorderly fragments of the Machine which was once perfect and great, fell down in all directions⁠—down the elevators, down the stairs.⁠ ⁠… Stamping of feet.⁠ ⁠… Pieces of words like pieces of torn letters carried by the wind.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men yuzlarni tosatdan oziq-ovqat bilan tolib-toshgan va havoda osilgan vilkalar bilan tolganini kordim. Keyin hamma narsa chalkashib ketdi, asrlar davomida yollarni kesib otdi, hamma oz joyidan sakrab tushdi (Gimn qoshigini tinglamasdan!) va tartibsizlikda, tartibsizlikda, shovqin-suronda, bir-birlarini hayratda qoldirdilar. Ular: "Nima boldi?" Va bir vaqtlar mukammal va ajoyib bolgan mashinaning tartibsiz tebranishi barcha yonalishlarda tushdi - zinapoyalarda pastga tushdi. ... shamol tomonidan otkazilgan yirtiq harflarning bolaklari kabi sozlar.

paras.en: The same outpour from the neighboring houses. A minute later the avenue seemed like a drop of water under a microscope: the infusoria locked up in the transparent, glass-like drop of water were tossing around, to the sides, up and down.
paras.uz: Bir daqiqadan song, yolak mikroskop ostida suv tomchisiga oxshardi: shaffof, shishaga oxshash suv tomchisi atrofga, yon tomonlarga, yuqoriga va pastga siljiydi.

paras.en: “Ah!” Someone’s triumphant voice. I saw the back of a neck and a finger pointing to the sky. I remember very distinctly a yellow-pinkish nail and under the nail a crescent crawling out as if from under the horizon. The finger was like a compass; all eyes were raised to the sky.
paras.uz: "Oh!" kimningdir galaba qozongan ovozi. Men boyin va barmoqning orqa tomonini osmonga ishora qilganini kordim.Men juda aniq sariq-pushti tirnoqni eslayman va tirnoq ostida ufq ostidan chiqqanday bir oy otib ketdi. Barmoq kompasga oxshardi; barcha kozlar osmonga kotarildi.

paras.en: There, running away from an invisible pursuit, masses of cloud were rushing upon each other; and colored by the clouds the aeros of the Guardians, with their tubes like antennae, were floating. And farther to the west⁠—something like.⁠ ⁠… At first nobody could understand what it was, even I, who knew (unfortunately) more than the others. It was like a great hive of black aeros swarming somewhere at an extraordinary height⁠—they looked like hardly noticeable, swiftly moving points.⁠ ⁠… Nearer and nearer.⁠ ⁠… Hoarse, guttural sounds began to reach the earth and finally we saw birds just over our heads! They filled the sky with their sharp, black, descending triangles. The stormy wind drove them down and they began to land on the cupolas, on the roofs, poles and balconies.
paras.uz: U erda kozga korinmas taqibdan qochib, bulut kop bolib ketdi; va qoriqchilarning bulutlari bilan orab olindi, ularning antennalari kabi, garbga oxshash narsalar paydo boldi. ... Avvaliga men (Afsuski, kim) boshqalardan kora koproq biladigan narsa edi.Bu juda katta qora havo tolqiniga oxshardi - ular juda baland boyli, juda tez harakatlanadigan nuqtalarga oxshardi. ... Xoars, ichak tovushlari erga etib bordi va nihoyat biz boshimiz ustida qushlarni kordik!

paras.en: “Ah⁠—ah!” and the triumphant back of the neck turned, and I saw that man with the protruding forehead but it seemed that the title, so to speak, was all that was left of him: he seemed to have crawled out from under his forehead and on his face, around the eyes and lips, bunches of rays were growing. Through the noise of the wind and wings and cawing, he cried to me:
paras.uz: "Oh! - va boyin galaba qozongan orqa ogirilib, men osha odamni kordim, lekin bu unvon, shunchaki, undan qolgan narsa edi: u koz va lablari, kozlari va atrofida, nurlar toplami osib borayotganga oxshardi. shamol va qanotlari va qorgoshin ovozi orqali u menga shunday dedi:

paras.en: “Do you realize? Do you realize! They have blown up the Wall! The Wall has been blown up! Do you understand?”
paras.uz: Эй Пайғамбарлар! Бас, улар жаҳаннамга кирдилар.

paras.en: Somewhere in the background, figures with their heads drawn in were hastily rushing by, and into the houses. In the middle of the pavement a mass of those who had been already operated upon; they moved towards the west.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir joyda fonda, boshlari chizilgan raqamlar zudlik bilan va uylarga kochib otdi.Ortada allaqachon operatsiya qilinganlarning ommaviyligi; ular garbga qarab harakat qilishdi.

paras.en: … Hairy bunches of rays around the lips and eyes.⁠ ⁠… I grasped his hands:
paras.uz: Koz va koz atrofidagi sochlarning sochlari... Men uning qollarini ushladim:

paras.en: “Tell me. Where is she? Where is I-330? There? Beyond the Wall or⁠ ⁠… ? I must.⁠ ⁠… Do you hear me? At once.⁠ ⁠… I cannot.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Menga ayting-chi, u qayerda? «Men u erda 330? devordan tashqaridami yoki... Men bilishim kerakmi? «««««««««» degan so'zlarni bir vaqtning o'zida eshitasiz.

paras.en: “Here!” he shouted in a happy, drunken voice, showing strong yellow teeth, “here in town, and she is acting! Oh, we are doing great work!”
paras.uz: "Bu yerda! - dedi u quvnoq, mast ovozda, kuchli sariq tishlarni korsatib, - bu erda shaharda va u harakat qilmoqda!

paras.en: Who are those “we”? Who am I?
paras.uz: "Biz kimmiz?" deb soradi.

paras.en: There were about fifty around him. Like him, they seemed to have crawled out from under their foreheads. They were loud, cheerful, strong-toothed, swallowing the stormy wind. With their simple, not at all terrible-looking electrocutors (where did they get them?) they started to the west, towards the operated ones, encircling them, keeping parallel to forty-eighth avenue.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning atrofida ellik ga yaqin odam bor edi.Ular baland, quvnoq, kuchli boyli bolib, boronli shamolni bosib olishdi. Ularning soddaligi bilan, hamma dahshatli korinadigan elektrchilarda (ular ularni qaerdan olishdi?) garbga, boshqariladiganlarga qarab, ularni orab, qirq sakkizinchi yolga parallel ravishda orab olishdi.

paras.en: Stumbling against the tightly-drawn ropes woven by the wind, I was running to her. What for? I did not know. I was stumbling.⁠ ⁠… Empty streets.⁠ ⁠… The city seemed foreign, wild, filled with the ceaseless, triumphant, hubbub of birds. It seemed like the end of the world, Doomsday.
paras.uz: Shamol tomonidan toqilgan qattiq chizilgan arqonlarga qarshi qozgalib, men unga yugurib ketayotgan edim. Nima uchun? Men bilmayman. ... Shahar begona, yovvoyi, toxtovsiz, galaba qozonadigan, qushlarning uyasi bilan toldirilgan edi.

paras.en: Through the glass of the walls in quite a few houses (this cut into my mind) I saw male and female Numbers in shameless embraces⁠—without curtains lowered, without pink checks, in the middle of the day!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir nechta uylarda (bu mening miyamga kesilgan) devorlarning oynasi orqali men kun ortasida pushti tekshiruvlarsiz, hech qanday dog tuproqlari bolmagan erkaklar va ayollar raqamlarini kordim.

paras.en: The house⁠—her house; the door ajar. The lobby, the control desk, all was empty. The elevator had stopped in the middle of its shaft. I ran panting up the endless stairs. The corridor. Like the spokes of a wheel figures on the doors dashed past my eyes; 320, 326, 330⁠—I-330! Through the glass wall everything in her room was seen to be upside down, confused, creased. The table overturned, its legs in the air like a beast. The bed was absurdly placed away from the wall, obliquely. Strewn over the floor⁠—fallen, trodden petals of the pink checks.
paras.uz: Uy - uning uyi; eshik ajar. lobbi, nazorat stol, barcha bosh edi. lift uning mil ortasida toxtadi. Men cheksiz yolak boylab boyalgan edi. eshiklar ustida gildirak raqamlar sozlari mening kozlarimga otib ketdi kabi; 320, 326, 330 - I-330! uning xonadagi shisha devor orqali hamma narsa pastga pastga korinib kordim kordim, adashtirdi. stol, bir hayvon kabi havoda uning oyoqlari bemanilik bilan devordan uzoqda joylashtirilgan edi, notogri - yiqilib, pushti cheklarning yirtilgan qollari.

paras.en: I bent over and picked up one, two, three of them; all bore the name D-503. I was on all of them, drops of myself, of my molten, poured-out self. And that was all⁠—that was left.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men ornidan turib, bir, ikki, uchtasini oldim; barchasi D-503 nomini oldi.Men ularning barchasida edim, ozimdan, eriganimdan, ozimdan yiqilib tushdim. va bu hammasi - qoldi.

paras.en: Somehow I felt they should not lie there on the floor and be trodden upon. I gathered a handful of them, put them on the table and carefully smoothed them out, glanced at them and⁠ ⁠… laughed aloud! I never knew it before but now I know, and you too, know, that laughter may be of different colors. It is but a distant echo of an explosion within us; it may be the echo of a holiday, red, blue and golden fireworks, or at times it may represent pieces of human flesh exploded into the air.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qanday bolmasin, men ularning bir nechtasini erga qoyib, ularni stol ustiga qoydim va diqqat bilan silliqladim, ularga qarab, ularga qaradim va hayratdan qotib qoldim!
