Men buni hech qachon bilmas edim, lekin hozir bilaman, va siz ham bilasiz, bu sokish turli xil ranglarda bolishi mumkin.Bu bizning ichimizdagi portlashdan boshqa narsa emas; bu bayram, qizil, kok va oltin goshtning aksi bolishi mumkin yoki bazida u inson goshtining havodagi qismlarini aks ettirishi mumkin.

paras.en: I noticed an unfamiliar name on some of the pink checks. I do not remember the figures but I do remember the letter⁠—F. I brushed the stubs from the table to the floor, stepped on them, on myself, stamped on them with my heels⁠—and went out.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men pushti cheklarning bazilarida nomalum ismni payqadim. Raqamlar esimda yoq, lekin xatni eslayman - F. Men stoldan stolga chotkalarini chozdim, ularning ustiga otirdim, ozimga qaradim, elkalarim bilan ularga yopishib oldim va tashqariga chiqdim.

paras.en: I sat in the corridor on the windowsill in front of her door and waited long and stupidly. An old man appeared. His face was like a pierced, empty bladder with folds; from beneath the puncture something transparent was still slowly dripping. Slowly, vaguely I realized⁠—tears. And only when the old man was quite far off I came to and exclaimed:
paras.uz: Men uning eshigi oldida deraza yonida otirdim va uzoq va ahmoqona kutib turdim. Uning yuzi koz yoshlariga oxshardi, bosh bosh bosh bosh joy kabi edi, bukchaygandan keyin bir narsa asta-sekin ozgarib ketdi.

paras.en: “Please⁠ ⁠… listen.⁠ ⁠… Do you know⁠ ⁠… Number I-330?”
paras.uz: "Iltimos, tinglang ... bilasizmi ... I-330 raqami?"

paras.en: The old man turned around, waved his hand in despair and stumbled farther away.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yigit qolini chozdi-yu, konglidan otkazdi...

paras.en: I returned home at dusk. On the west side the sky was twitching every second in a pale blue electric convulsion:⁠—a subdued, heavy roar was proceeding from that direction. The roofs were covered with black charred sticks⁠—birds.
paras.uz: Men changida uyga qaytdim.Garbiy tomonda osmon har soniyada ochiq kok elektr portlashida ozgarib turardi: - bu yonalishda bogilib qolgan, ogir tomoq qayta ishlangan.Tomlar qora sharchalar bilan qoplangan - qushlar.

paras.en: I lay down; and instantly like a heavy beast sleep came and stifled me.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men uxlab qoldim va darhol ogir hayvon uyqusi keldi va meni siqib qoydi.

paras.en: I don’t know what title⁠—Perhaps the whole synopsis may be called a cast-off cigarette-butt.
paras.uz: Qanday sarlavha qo'yishni bilmayman. Balki bu qisqa mazmunni tashlandiq sigaret qoldig'i desa bo'lar.

paras.en: I awoke. A bright glare painful to look at. I half closed my eyes. My head seemed filled with some caustic blue smoke. Everything was enveloped in fog and through the fog:
paras.uz: Men korish uchun yorqin ogriqli ogriq. Men yarim kozimni yumdim. Mening boshim bazi kaustik kok tutun bilan tolgan korinadi. hamma narsa tuman va tuman orqali oralgan edi:

paras.en: “But I did not turn on the light⁠ ⁠… then how is it.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ammo men yoruglikni ochirmadim ... keyin qanday boladi?"

paras.en: I jumped up. At the table, leaning her chin on her hand and smiling, was I-330, looking at me.
paras.uz: Men yuqoriga kotarildi. stol ustiga, uning qolini va qolini chozib, Men edi-330, menga qarab.

paras.en: She was at the very table at which I am now writing. Those ten or fifteen minutes are already behind me, cruelly twisted into a very firm spring. Yet it seems to me that the door closed after her only a second ago and that I could still overtake her and grasp her hand⁠—and that she might laugh out and say.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U men hozir yozayotgan stolda edi.Osha on yoki on besh daqiqa allaqachon orqamda, juda qattiq bahorga tushib qolgan. Ammo menga korinib turibdiki, eshik bir soniya oldin yopilgan va men hali ham uning qolini tortib olishim va qolini ushlashim mumkin edi - va u kulishi va aytishi mumkin.

paras.en: I-330 was at the table. I rushed towards her.
paras.uz: Men u bilan birga 3-1 hisobida galaba qozondim.

paras.en: “You? You! I have been.⁠ ⁠… I saw your room.⁠ ⁠… I thought you.⁠ ⁠…” But midway I hurt myself upon the sharp, motionless spears of her eyelashes and I stopped. I remembered: she looked at me in the same way before⁠—in the Integral. It was urgent to tell her everything in one second and in such a way that she should believe⁠—or she would never.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men sizning xonangizni kordim... Men sizni oyladim. "Ammo yarim yolda men uning qollarining otkir, harakatsiz nayzalariga zarar etkazdim va men eslayman: u menga xuddi shunday qarab turardi - integralda.

paras.en: “Listen, I-330, I must.⁠ ⁠… I must⁠ ⁠… everything! No, no, one moment⁠—let me have a glass of water first.”
paras.uz: "Yoq, bir daqiqa - avval bir stakan suv bolsin - deydi u.

paras.en: My mouth was as dry as though it were lined with blotting paper. I poured a glass of water but I could not.⁠ ⁠… I put the glass back upon the table, and with both hands firmly grasped the carafe.
paras.uz: Ogzim xuddi shisha qogoz bilan qoplangandek quruq edi. Men bir stakan suv quydim, lekin stol ustiga shishani qoya olmadim va ikkala qolim ham karerni mahkam orab oldi.

paras.en: Now I noticed that the blue smoke was from a cigarette. She brought the cigarette to her lips and with avidity she drew in and swallowed the smoke as I did water; then she said:
paras.uz: Endi men kok tutun sigaret ekanligini payqadim. u sigaretni ogziga olib keldi va tez yordam bilan men suv ichganimda tutunni tortib oldi; keyin u shunday dedi:

paras.en: “Don’t. Be silent. Don’t you see it matters little? I came anyway. They are waiting for me below.⁠ ⁠… Do you want these minutes which are our last⁠ ⁠… ?”
paras.uz: Nima bolganda ham, ular meni kutmoqdalar. ... Siz bizning songgi daqiqalarimiz bolishini xohlaysizmi? "

paras.en: Abruptly she threw the cigarette on the floor and bent backwards over the side of the chair to reach the button in the wall (it was quite difficult to do so), and I remember how the chair swayed slightly, how two of its legs were lifted. Then the curtains fell.
paras.uz: Tosatdan u sigaretni erga tashladi va devorga tugmani bosish uchun stulning orqa tomoniga otirdi (buni amalga oshirish juda qiyin edi) va men stul qanday qilib biroz kotarilganini, uning ikki oyogi qanday kotarilganini eslayman. Keyin pardalar qulab tushdi.

paras.en: She came close to me and embraced me. Her knees, through her dress, were like a slow, gentle, warm, enveloping and permeating poison.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U menga yaqinlashdi va meni qabul qildi. Uning oyoqlari, uning koylagi orqali, sekin, yumshoq, issiq, oralgan va abadiy zaharga oxshardi.

paras.en: Suddenly (it happens at times) you plunge into sweet, warm sleep⁠—when all at once, as if something pricks you, you tremble and your eyes are again widely open. So it was now; there on the floor in her room were the pink checks stamped with traces of footsteps, one of them bore the letter F and some figures.⁠ ⁠… Plus and minus fused within my mind into one lump.⁠ ⁠… I could not say even now what sort of a feeling it was but I crushed her so that she cried out with pain.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tosatdan (bazida bu sodir boladi) siz shirin, iliq uyquga shongib ketasiz - hamma narsa sizni bezovta qilayotganday, siz tabassum qilasiz va kozlaringiz yana keng ochiladi. Shunday qilib, endi u erda; uning xonasida pushti tekshiruvlar izlari bilan qoplangan, ulardan biri F harfini va bazi raqamlarni tugdirdi. ...

paras.en: One more minute out of these ten or fifteen; her head thrown back, lying on the bright white pillow, her eyes half closed, a sharp, sweet line of teeth.⁠ ⁠… And all this reminded me in an irresistible, absurd, torturing way about something forbidden, something not permissible at that moment. More tenderly, more cruelly, I pressed her to myself, more bright grew the blue traces of my fingers.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu on yoki on besh daqiqadan yana bir daqiqa; uning boshi orqaga tashlandi, yorqin oq yostiqqa, uning yarim yopiq, otkir, shirin tishlariga chozildi. ... Va bularning barchasi meni notogri, taqiqlangan narsa haqida qayguradigan, osha paytda yoq bolgan narsa haqida eslatib otdi.Koproq muloyimlik bilan, men uni ozimga tortdim, barmogimning kok izlarini korsatdi.

paras.en: She said, without opening her eyes (I noticed this), “They say you went to see the Well-Doer yesterday, is it true?”
paras.uz: U dedi: "Men buni kormasdan turib, siz kecha yaxshi dostni korish uchun borishingizni aytishdi, togrimi?"

paras.en: “Yes.”
paras.uz: У: «Эй Пайғамбар, албатта, Роббинг Ўзининг Пайғамбари.

paras.en: Then her eyes opened widely and with delight I looked at her and saw that her face grew quickly paler and paler, that it effaced itself, disappearing⁠—only the eyes remained.
paras.uz: Keyin uning kozlari keng korindi va xursand bolib, men unga qaradim va uning yuzi tez osib borayotganini kordim, u ozini tasir qildi va faqat kozlar qoldi.

paras.en: I told her everything. Only for some reason, what I don’t know⁠—(no, it is not true, I know the reason) I was silent about one thing: His assertion at the end that they needed me only in order.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men unga hamma narsani aytdim. Faqat biron bir sababga kora, men bilmagan narsa - (yoq, bu togri emas, men sababni bilaman) men bitta narsa haqida jim edim: oxirida ular menga faqat tartibda kerak bolgan Uning qopolligi.

paras.en: Like the image on a photographic plate in a developing fluid, her face gradually reappeared; the cheeks, the white line of teeth, the lips. She stood up and went to the mirror-door of the closet. My mouth was dry again. I poured water but it was revolting to drink it; I put the glass back on the table and asked:
paras.uz: Uning yuzi asta-sekin ozgarib, tishlari oq chiziq, lablari. U ornidan turib, shkafning oyna eshigiga bordi. Ogzim quruq edi, lekin uni ichish uchun qozgaldi; Men stakanni stolga qaytarib qoydim va soradim:

paras.en: “Did you come to see me because you wanted to inquire⁠ ⁠… ?”
paras.uz: «Siz mendan soramoqchi bolganingiz uchun meni korish uchun keldingizmi?»

paras.en: A sharp, mocking triangle of brows drawn to the temples looked at me from the mirror. She turned around to say something but said nothing.
paras.uz: Kozgudan korinib turgan mabadlarga chizilgan otkir, masxara qiluvchi uchburchagi menga qaradi. U nimadir deyishga, lekin hech narsa demadi.

paras.en: It was not necessary; I knew.
paras.uz: Bu kerak emas edi; men buni bilardim.

paras.en: To bid her goodbye, I moved my foreign limbs, struck the chair with them. It fell upside down, dead, like the table in her room. Her lips were cold⁠ ⁠… just as cold was once the floor, here, near my bed.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning iltifotini taklif qilish uchun men chet el qollarini kochirdim, ular bilan stulga urdim.U olik, xonasida stol kabi pastga tushdi. Uning lablari sovuq edi ... xuddi bir marta sovuq edi, bu erda, mening toshagim yaqinida.

paras.en: When she left I sat down on the floor, bent over the cigarette-butt.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Otirganimda, deraza oldida otirgandim...

paras.en: I cannot write any more⁠—I no longer want to!
paras.uz: Endi yoza olmayman - endi xohlamayman!

paras.en: The end.
paras.uz: Oxiri.

paras.en: All this was like the last crystal of salt thrown into a saturated solution; quickly, needle-like crystals began to appear, to grow more substantial and solid. It was clear to me; the decision was made and tomorrow morning I shall do it! It amounts to suicide but perhaps then I shall be reborn. For only what is killed can be reborn.
paras.uz: Bularning barchasi tuzning songgi kristaliga oxshardi; tezda ignaga oxshash kristallar paydo bola boshladi, yanada kattaroq va mustahkam osishni boshladi.Bu menga aniq edi; qaror qabul qilindi va ertaga buni qilaman! Bu oz joniga qasd qilish, lekin ehtimol men qayta tugilaman.

paras.en: Every second the sky twitched in convulsion there in the west. My head was burning and pulsating inside; I was up all night and I fell asleep only at about seven o’clock in the morning when the darkness of the night was already dispelled and becoming gray and when the roofs crowded with birds became visible.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Har soniyada osmon garbda konvulsiya bilan oralgan edi. Boshim yonib ketdi va ichini tortib oldi; Men tun boyi uxlab qoldim va qorongilik allaqachon yoq bolib ketgan va qushlar bilan toldirilgan tomlar korinadigan bolganida, ertalab soat yettida uxlab qoldim.

paras.en: I woke up; ten o’clock. Evidently the bell did not ring today. On the table⁠—left from yesterday⁠—there stood the glass of water. I gulped the water down with avidity and I ran; I had to do it quickly, as quickly as possible.
paras.uz: Men uygondim; on soat. Qongiroq bugun qongiroq qilmadi. Stolda - kechagidan qolgan - suv stakani bor edi. Men suv bilan pastga tushdim va men yugurdim; buni iloji boricha tezroq qilishim kerak edi.

paras.en: The sky was deserted, blue, all eaten up by the storm. Sharp corners of shadows.⁠ ⁠… Everything seemed to be cut out of blue autumnal air⁠—thin, dangerous to touch; it seemed so brittle, ready to disperse into glass dust. Within me something similar; I ought not to think; it was dangerous to think, for.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma narsa kok kuz havosidan kesilganga oxshardi - ingichka, teginish xavfli; u juda nozik, shisha changga botishga tayyor edi; men oylamaslik kerak edi; oylash xavfli edi.

paras.en: And I did not think, perhaps I did not even see properly; I only registered impressions. There on the pavement, thrown from somewhere, branches were strewn; their leaves were green, amber and cherry-red. Above, crossing each other, birds and aeros were tossing about. Here below heads, open mouths, hands waving branches.⁠ ⁠… All this must have been shouting, buzzing, chirping.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Va men oylamagan edim, ehtimol men ham togri kormadim; Men faqat royxatdan otgan royxatdan otishlarni kormadim; u erda, biron bir joydan tashlab yuborilgan, filiallari qotib qolgan; ularning barglari yashil, amber va gilos-qizil edi.Yuqorida, bir-birlarini kesib otib, qushlar va havolar haqida edi.

paras.en: Then⁠—streets empty as if swept by a plague. I remember I stumbled over something disgustingly soft, yielding yet motionless. I bent down⁠—a corpse. It was lying flat, the legs apart. The face.⁠ ⁠… I recognized the thick negro lips which even now seemed to sprinkle with laughter. His eyes, firmly screwed in, laughed into my face. One second.⁠ ⁠… I stepped over him and ran. I could no longer.⁠ ⁠… I had to have everything done as soon as possible, or else I felt I would break, I would break in two like an overloaded sail.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Songra kochalar bosh bolib qoldi. Men yumshoq bir narsa haqida oyladim, lekin harakat qilmasdan qoldim. - Bu yalangoch yotgan, oyoqlari bir-biridan ajralib turardi.... Bu yalangoch edi. ... Men hali ham qichqirayotganga oxshab korinadigan qalin neno lablarini tanib oldim. Uning kozlari, mahkamlangan, yuzimga yopishib oldim.Bir soniya otib, yugurib ketdim. ... Men hamma narsani iloji boricha tezroq qilishim kerak edi yoki men sindirishimni his qildim, men ikki marta chozilgan suzib ketdim.

paras.en: Luckily it was not more than twenty steps away; I already saw the sign with the golden letters: “The Bureau of Guardians.” At the door I stopped for a moment to gulp down as much air as I could and stepped in.
paras.uz: Yaxshiyamki, bu yigirma qadamdan kop emas edi; men allaqachon oltin harflar bilan belgini kordim: "Qoriqchilar byurosi." Eshikda men iloji boricha koproq havo tokishni toxtatdim va ichkariga kirdim.

paras.en: Inside, in the corridor stood an endless chain of numbers, holding small sheets of paper and heavy notebooks. They moved slowly, advancing a step or two and stopping again. I began to be tossed about along the chain, my head was breaking to pieces; I pulled them by the sleeves, I implored them as a sick man implores to be given something that would even at the price of sharpest pain end everything, forever.
paras.uz: Ular asta-sekin kochib otdilar, bir-ikki qadam oldinga va yana toxtadilar. Men zanjir boylab chokib ketdim, boshim bolaklarga bolinib ketdi; Men yenglar bilan ularni tortib oldim, men ularni hatto ogir ogriqning eng ogir narxida ham beriladigan narsa sifatida korsatdim.

paras.en: A woman with a belt tightly clasped around her waist over the unif and with two distinctly protruding squatty hemispheres tossing about as if she had eyes on them, chuckled at me:
paras.uz: Bir qol bilan kamarli bir ayol bir bolak ustiga egilib, ikkita aniq otkir yarim shar bilan menga qarab turgandek, menga qarab:

paras.en: “He has a bellyache! Show him to the room second door to the right!”
paras.uz: Бас, уни жойга юборинг!

paras.en: Everybody laughed, and because of that laughter something rose in my throat; I felt I should either scream or⁠ ⁠… or.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma yiglab yubordi, chunki bu yiglash mening tomogimda bir narsa paydo boldi; Men yiglashim kerak yoki...

paras.en: Suddenly from behind someone touched my elbow. I turned around. Transparent wing-ears! But they were not pink as usual; they were purplish red; his Adam’s apple was tossing about as though ready to tear the covering.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tosatdan kimdir orqamdan mening tirsakimga tegdi. Ochiq qanot-quloqlar! Lekin ular odatdagidek pushti emas edi; ular qizil rangga oxshardi; uning Odam Atoning olmasi qoplamani yirtib tashlashga tayyor bolganga oxshardi.

paras.en: Quickly boring into me: “What are you here for?”
paras.uz: Tez orada men bilan boring: "Siz bu erda nima uchun keldingiz?"

paras.en: I seized him.
paras.uz: Men uni qolga oldim.

paras.en: “Quickly! Please! Quickly!⁠ ⁠… into your office.⁠ ⁠… I must tell everything⁠ ⁠… right away.⁠ ⁠… I am glad that you.⁠ ⁠… It may be terrible that it should be you to whom.⁠ ⁠… But it is well, it is well.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Iltimos, tezroq!... Men zudlik bilan sizning ofisingizga hamma narsani aytib berishim kerak ... men siz uchun dahshatli bolishi mumkin ... lekin bu yaxshi. "

paras.en: He too, knew her; this made it even more tormenting for me. But perhaps he too, would tremble when he should hear.⁠ ⁠… And we would both be killing.⁠ ⁠… And I would not be alone at that, my supreme second.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U ham uni bilardi; bu men uchun yanada ogir boldi. lekin, ehtimol, u eshitish kerak bolsa, u ham xafa bolardi ... va biz ikkalamiz ham oldiramiz ... va men bu erda yolgiz emas edim, mening oliy ikkinchi...

paras.en: The door closed with a slam. I remember a piece of paper was caught beneath the door and it rustled on the floor when the door closed. And then a strange airless silence covered us as if a glass bell were put over us. If only he had uttered a single, most insignificant word, no matter what, I should have told him everything at once. But he was silent. So keyed up that I heard a noise in my ears, I said without looking at him:
paras.uz: Eshik qulf bilan yopilgan edi. Men bir qogoz bir parcha eshik yopiq edi eslayman va u eshik yopiq qachon qavatda qotib. va keyin bir shisha qongiroq bizga qoydi kabi galati havosiz sukunat bizni qoplangan. faqat u bolsa, nima bolishidan qatiy nazar, men bir vaqtning ozida unga hamma narsani aytib kerak edi. Lekin u jim edi, Men qulogimga shovqin eshitdim, Men unga qarab dedi:

paras.en: “I think I always hated her from the very beginning.⁠ ⁠… I struggled.⁠ ⁠… Or, no, no, don’t believe me; I could have but I did not want to save myself; I wanted to perish; this was dearer to me than anything else⁠ ⁠… and even now, even this minute, when I know already everything.⁠ ⁠… Do you know that I was summoned to the Well-Doer?”
paras.uz: "Men uni har doim boshidanoq yomon koraman ... yoki yoq, menga ishonmas edim; lekin men ozimni qutqarishni xohlamadim; Men olishni xohlardim; bu menga boshqa hech narsadan kora qadrli edi ... va hozir ham, hatto hozir ham, hamma narsani bilganimda ham.

paras.en: “Yes, I do.”
paras.uz: "Ha, men qilaman

paras.en: “But what he told me! Please realize that it was equivalent to⁠ ⁠… it was as if someone should remove the floor from under you this minute, and you and all here on the desk, the papers, the ink⁠ ⁠… the ink would splash out and cover everything with blots.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ammo u menga nima dedi! Iltimos, shuni tushunib etingki, kimdir sizning ostidan polni olib tashlashi kerak edi ... va siz va stoldagi hamma narsa, qogoz, siyoh ... siyoh chiqib, hamma narsani murvat bilan qoplaydi. "

paras.en: “What else? What further? Hurry up, others are waiting!”
paras.uz: «Сен: «Эй Пайғамбарлар! Бас, Сен: «Сен Роббим, албатта, Сен Мендан Мендан Мендан Мен Мендан Ҳамда Мендан Мен Мендан Мендан Ҳам Ҳам Ҳам Қиламан», деди.

paras.en: Then stumbling, muttering, I told him everything that is recorded in these pages.⁠ ⁠… About my real self, and about my hairy self, and about my hands⁠ ⁠… yes⁠ ⁠… exactly that was the beginning. And how I would not do my duty then, and how I lied to myself, and how she obtained false certificates for me, and how I grew worse and worse, every day, and about the long corridors underground, and there beyond the Wall.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Shundan song, osha sahifalarda yozilgan hamma narsani aytib berdim.... mening haqiqiy ozim va sochim haqida va qollarim haqida... ha, aynan shu narsa boshlanishi edi. va qanday qilib men oz vazifamni bajarmadim, keyin qanday qilib yolgon gapirdim va u men uchun qanday qilib yolgon malumot oldi, va qanday qilib men bundan ham yomon va yomon osdi, har kuni, va u erda devordan tashqarida.

paras.en: All this I threw out in formless pieces and lumps. I would stutter and fail to find words. The lips double-curved in a smile would prompt me with the word I needed and I would nod gratefully: “Yes, yes!”.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly, what was it? He was talking for me and I only listened and nodded: “Yes, yes,” and then, “Yes, exactly so,⁠ ⁠… yes, yes.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Bularning barchasi men shaklsiz bolaklarga va bolaklarga tashlab yubordim. Men sozlarni topa olmadim.Kozlarimdagi ikki marta oralgan lablar menga kerak bolgan sozni tezlashtirdi va minnatdorchilik bildirdim: "Ha, ha!" ... tosatdan, nima boldi? U men uchun gapirdi va men faqat tingladim va: "Ha, ha, aniq, ha, ha, ha ... "

paras.en: I felt cold around my mouth as though it were wet with ether, and I asked with difficulty:
paras.uz: Men ogzimdan sovuqni his qildim, xuddi eter bilan hol bolgandek va men qiyinchilik bilan soradim:

paras.en: “But how is it.⁠ ⁠… You could not learn anywhere.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: "Ammo bu qanday ... siz biron bir joyda organa olmaysiz ..."

paras.en: He smiled a smile growing more and more curved; then:
paras.uz: U tobora koproq kulishni boshladi; keyin:

paras.en: “But I see that you do want to conceal from me something. For example, you enumerated everything you saw beyond the Wall but you failed to mention one thing. You deny it? But don’t you remember that once, just in passing, just for a second you saw me there? Yes, yes me!”
paras.uz: "Ammo men siz mendan nimanidir yashirishni xohlayotganingizni kormoqdaman. Masalan, siz devordan tashqarida korgan hamma narsani ochirib tashlagansiz, lekin bitta narsani eslatib otmadingiz.

paras.en: Silence.
paras.uz: Qaraldi: 9-may 2021-yil.

paras.en: Suddenly, like a flash of lightning, it became shamelessly clear to me: he⁠—he too⁠—. And all myself, my torment, all that I brought here, crushed by the burden, plucking up my last strength as if performing a great feat, all appeared to me only funny⁠—like the ancient anecdote about Abraham and Isaac; Abraham all in a cold sweat, with the knife already raised over his son, over himself⁠—and suddenly a voice from above: “Never mind.⁠ ⁠… I was only joking.”
paras.uz: Tosatdan, chaqmoq chaqnashi kabi, u men uchun gamgin bolib qoldi: u ham menga ayon boldi: u ham -. va mening barcha azoblarim, bu erda olib kelgan hamma, men bu erda ogirlikdan xalos boldim, xuddi buyuk maglubiyatni amalga oshirgandek, oxirgi kuchimni tortib oldim, xuddi Ibrohim va Ishoq haqidagi eski hiyla-nayrangga oxshab, menga korindi; sovuq terda Ibrohim, pichoq allaqachon oz ogli ustidan kotarilgan va birdan yuqoridan: "Men shunchaki hazillashdim.

paras.en: Without taking my eyes from the smile which grew more and more curved, I put my hands on the edge of the desk and slowly, very slowly pushed myself with my chair away from him. Then instantly gathering myself into my own hands, I dashed madly out, past loud voices, past steps and mouths.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Osib-ulgaygan tabassumdan kozimni uzmasdan, stolning chetiga qolimni qoydim va asta-sekin sekin ozimni stulimdan uzoqlashtirdim. Keyin darhol oz qollarim bilan yigladim, men aqldan ozdim, otgan baland ovoz, otmishdagi qadamlar va ogriqlar.

paras.en: I do not remember how I got into one of the public restrooms at a station of the Underground Railway. Above, everything was perishing; the greatest civilization, the most rational in human history was crumbling⁠—but here, by some irony everything remained as before, beautiful. The walls shone; water murmured cosily and like the water⁠—the unseen, transparent music.⁠ ⁠… Only think of it! All this is doomed; all this will be covered with grass, some day; only myths will remain.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men temir yol stantsiyasida jamoat hojatxonalaridan biriga qanday kirganimni eslay olmayman.Yuqorida hamma narsa vayron boldi; eng katta tsivilizatsiya, insoniyat tarixidagi eng oqilona narsa yoq edi - lekin bu erda hamma narsa avvalgidek qoldi, gozal.

paras.en: I moaned aloud. At the same instant I felt someone gently patting my knee. It was from the left; it was my neighbor who occupied a seat on my left⁠—an enormous forehead, a bald parabola, yellow unintelligible lines of wrinkles on his forehead, those lines about me.
paras.uz: Shu bilan birga, men tizzamni muloyimlik bilan boyashni his qildim.Bu chapdan edi; bu mening chap orindigimda otirgan qoshnim edi - ulkan qorgoshin, dahshatli parabola, uning peshonasida sariq aql bovar qilmaydigan chiziqlar, men haqimda bu chiziqlar.

paras.en: “I understand you. I understand completely,” he said. “Yet you must calm yourself. You must. It will return. It will inevitably return. It is only important that everybody should learn of my discovery. You are the first to whom I talk about it. I have calculated that there is no infinity! No!”
paras.uz: "Men sizni toliq tushunaman, - dedi u. - Lekin siz ozingizni tinchlantirishingiz kerak. Siz qaytib kelasiz. Bu faqat hamma mening kashfiyotimni organishi kerak.Siz bu haqda gapiradigan birinchi odamsiz. Men cheksizlik yoqligini hisobladim! "

paras.en: I looked at him wildly.
paras.uz: Men unga qattiq qarab qoydim.

paras.en: “Yes, yes, I tell you so. There is no infinity. If the universe is infinite, then the average density of matter must equal zero, but as it is not zero, we know, consequently the universe is finite; it is spherical in form and the square of its radius⁠—R2⁠—is equal to the average density multiplied by.⁠ ⁠… The only thing left is to calculate the numerical coefficient and then.⁠ ⁠… Do you realize what it means? It means that everything is final, everything is simple.⁠ ⁠… But you, my honored sir, you disturb me, you prevent my finishing my calculations by your yelling!”
paras.uz: Agar koinot cheksiz bolsa, materiyaning ortacha zichligi nolga teng bolishi kerak, lekin u nolga teng bolmasa, biz bilamizki, koinot cheksizdir; u shakl va uning radiusi kvadrati - R2 - bu ortacha zichlikning ortacha zichligiga teng. . . . . .

paras.en: I do not know which shattered me more, his discovery, or his positiveness at that apocalyptic hour. I only then noticed that he had a notebook in his hands and a logarithmic dial. I understood then that even if everything was perishing it was my duty (before you, my unknown and beloved) to leave these records in a finished form.
paras.uz: Men osha apokalipt soatida menga nima koproq tasir qilganini, uning kashfiyotini yoki uning ijobiyligini bilmayman. Keyin men uning qolida daftar va logarifmik terish borligini payqadim.

paras.en: I asked him to give me some paper, and here in the restroom to the accompaniment of the quiet music, transparent like water, I wrote down these last lines.
paras.uz: Men undan qogoz berishni soradim va bu erda suv kabi sokin musiqa hamrohligida ushbu songgi satrlarni yozdim.

paras.en: I was about to put down a period as the ancients would put a cross over the caves into which they used to throw their dead, when all of a sudden my pencil trembled and fell from between my fingers.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men bir davrni qoymoqchi edim, chunki qadimgilar ozlarining oliklarini otish uchun ishlatgan gorlari ustidan xoch qoyishar edi, tosatdan mening qalamim qulab tushib, barmoqlarim orasiga tushdi.

paras.en: “Listen!” (I pulled my neighbor). “Yes, listen, I say. There where your finite universe ends, what is there? What?”
paras.uz: «Эй Роббим, Мен: «Эй Пайғамбар! Сен: «Эй Пайғамбар, Мен: «Эй Пайғамбар, Мен, албатта, Мен, Сенинг Ўзинг, Унинг Роббингиз нима?» деб айт.

paras.en: He had no time to answer. From above, down the steps, stamping.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U javob berishga vaqt yoq edi. yuqoridan, pastga, pastga, shtamplash...

paras.en: Facts⁠—The bell⁠—I am certain.
paras.uz: Faktlar — Qo'ng'iroq — Ishonchim komil.

paras.en: Daylight. It is clear. The barometer⁠—760 mm. It is possible that I, D-503, really wrote these⁠—pages? Is it possible that I ever felt, or imagined I felt all this?
paras.uz: Kunduz. Havo ochiq. Barometr — 760 millimetr. Bu — sahifalarni rostdan ham men, D-503, yozgan bo'lishim mumkinmi? Nahot bularning barini qachondir his qilgan yoki his qildim deb tasavvur etgan bo'lsam?

paras.en: The handwriting is mine. And what follows is all in my handwriting. Fortunately only the handwriting. No more delirium, no absurd metaphors, no feelings⁠—only facts. For I am healthy, perfectly, absolutely healthy.⁠ ⁠… I am smiling; I cannot help smiling; a splinter has been taken out of my head and I feel so light, so empty! To be more exact, not empty, but there is nothing foreign, nothing that prevents me from smiling. (Smiling is the normal state for a normal human being).
paras.uz: Xat meniki. Quyida yozilganlar ham o'z qo'lim bilan yozilgan. Baxtimga, faqat xatning o'zi meniki. Endi alahlash ham, bema'ni tashbehlar ham, his-tuyg'ular ham yo'q. Faqat faktlar. Chunki men sog'lomman, bus-butun, mutlaqo sog'lomman… Tabassum qilyapman. Tabassum qilmay turolmayman. Boshimdan bir zirapchani olib tashlashdi, o'zimni shunchalik yengil, shunchalik bo'sh his qilyapman! Aniqrog'i, bo'sh emas. Ichimda begona hech narsa yo'q, tabassum qilishimga hech narsa xalaqit bermaydi. (Tabassum — normal odamning normal holati.)

paras.en: The facts are as follows: That evening my neighbor who discovered the finiteness of the universe, and I, and all others who did not have a certificate showing that we had been operated on, all of us were taken to the nearest auditorium. (For some reason the number of the auditorium, 112, seemed familiar to me). There they tied us to the tables and performed the great operation. Next day, I, D-503, appeared before the Well-Doer and told him everything known to me about the enemies of happiness. Why before it seemed hard for me to go, I cannot understand. The only explanation seems to be my illness⁠—my soul.
paras.uz: Faktlar quyidagicha. O'sha oqshom koinotning chekli ekanini kashf etgan qo'shnimni ham, meni ham, operatsiyadan o'tganlik guvohnomasi yo'q boshqalarni ham eng yaqin auditoriyaga olib ketishdi. (Negadir auditoriyaning raqami, 112, menga tanish tuyuldi.) U yerda bizni stollarga bog'lab, buyuk operatsiyani o'tkazishdi. Ertasi kuni men, D-503, Homiy huzuriga bordim va baxt dushmanlari haqida bilganlarimning barini aytib berdim. Nega ilgari u yerga borish menga og'ir tuyulganini tushunolmayman. Buning yagona izohi kasalligim — ruhim bo'lsa kerak.

paras.en: The same evening, sitting at the same table with Him, with the Well-Doer, I saw for the first time in my life the famous Gas Chamber. They brought in that woman. She was to testify in my presence. That woman remained stubbornly silent and smiling. I noticed that she had sharp and very white teeth which were very pretty.
paras.uz: O'sha oqshom U bilan, Homiy bilan bir stolda o'tirib, mashhur Gaz kamerasini umrimda birinchi bor ko'rdim. O'sha ayolni olib kirishdi. U mening huzurimda ko'rsatma berishi kerak edi. Ayol o'jarlik bilan sukut saqlab, tabassum qilardi. Uning o'tkir, juda oppoq tishlarini payqadim. Chiroyli tishlar ekan.

paras.en: Then she was brought under the Bell. Her face became very white and as her eyes were large and dark⁠—all was very pretty. When they began pumping the air from under the Bell she threw her head back and half closed her eyes; her lips were pressed together. This reminded me of something. She looked at me, holding the arms of the chair firmly. She continued to look until her eyes closed. Then she was taken out and brought to by means of electrodes and again put under the Bell. The procedure was repeated three times, yet she did not utter a word.
paras.uz: Keyin uni Qo'ng'iroq ostiga olib kirishdi. Yuzlari oqarib ketdi. Katta qora ko'zlari bilan hammasi juda chiroyli ko'rinardi. Qo'ng'iroq ostidan havoni so'rib olishni boshlashganda, u boshini orqaga tashlab, ko'zlarini yarim yumdi. Lablari bir-biriga qattiq jipslashgan edi. Bu menga nimanidir eslatdi. U kursining tirsaklarini mahkam changallab menga qaradi. Ko'zlari yumilguncha qarab turdi. So'ng uni olib chiqishdi, elektrodlar yordamida hushiga keltirishdi va yana Qo'ng'iroq ostiga qo'yishdi. Buni uch marta takrorlashdi. U bir og'iz ham gapirmadi.

paras.en: The others who were brought in with that woman, proved to be more honest; many of them began to speak after the first trial. Tomorrow they will all ascend the steps to the Machine of the Well-Doer. No postponement is possible for there still is chaos, groaning, cadavers, beasts in the western section, and to our regret there are still quantities of Numbers who betrayed Reason.
paras.uz: O'sha ayol bilan birga olib kelinganlar halolroq chiqdi. Ko'pchiligi birinchi sinovdayoq gapira boshladi. Ertaga ularning bari Homiy Mashinasining zinapoyalaridan ko'tariladi. Buni ortga surib bo'lmaydi. G'arbiy qismda hanuz tartibsizlik, ingroq, jasadlar, yovvoyi hayvonlar bor. Afsuski, Aqlga xiyonat qilgan Raqamlar ham hali ko'p.

paras.en: But on the transverse avenue Forty, we succeeded in establishing a temporary Wall of high voltage waves. And I hope we win. More than that; I am certain we shall win. For Reason must win.
paras.uz: Ammo Qirqinchi ko'ndalang xiyobonda yuqori kuchlanishli to'lqinlardan vaqtinchalik Devor tiklashga muvaffaq bo'ldik. Men g'alaba qozonishimizga umid qilaman. Undan ham ortig'i, g'alaba qozonishimizga aminman. Negaki Aql g'alaba qilishi shart.
